text: Ginmanduan ni Ombudsman Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla ang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) nga imbestigaran ang mga nagapalapta sang mga malain nga impormasyon kaangot sa iya nga ikaayong lawas.
english: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla has ordered the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) to investigate those who spread false information about his health.

text: Sang nagligad nga semana, naglagaw ang mga social media posts nga nagasiling nga gindala sa ospital si Remulla, apang ginpanginwala ini sang iya utod kag mismo sang Ombudsman.
english: Last week, social media posts circulated claiming that Remulla had been taken to hospital, but this was denied by his brother and the Ombudsman himself.

text:
Suno kay Remulla, isa ini ka “orchestrated campaign.”

Pahayag sini, wala siya nakahibalo kun ano ang tuyo sini nga mga post, apang posible suno sa iya nga parte ini sang propaganda machine sang pila ka mga partido sa pulitika.
english:
Remulla said it was an “orchestrated campaign.”

He said he does not know the purpose of these posts, but it is possible that they are part of the propaganda machine of some political parties.

text: “Pinapaimbestigahan ko yan.
english: “I’m investigating that.

text: kasi we’ve reached the limit of cyberlibel already.
english: because we’ve reached the limit of cyberlibel already.

text: Kaya tignan natin kung saan pupunta,” suno sa Ombudsman.
english: So let’s see where it goes,” according to the Ombudsman.

text: Ginklaro man sini nga wala sang problema sa iya nga ikaayong lawas bangud naga-work out man ini adlaw-adlaw, nagatulog sang temprano, kag nagabugtaw sang aga pa.
english: He also clarified that he has no health problems because he works out every day, goes to bed early, and wakes up early in the morning.

text: “An idle mind is the devil’s workshop.
english: “An idle mind is the devil’s workshop.

text: Wala tayong magagawa naghahanap sila ng iistoryahin.
english: We can't do anything, they're looking for something to talk about.

text: I came out of my radio program last Saturday, but Sunday, meron na naman, tuloy na naman.
english: I came out of my radio program last Saturday, but Sunday, there's another, continue.

text: Kaya makikita mo iyong bad faith,” suno sa iya.
english: So you can see your bad faith,” he said.

text: Oktubre 2025 sang nagsugod pungko si Remulla bilang Ombudsman.
english: Remulla took office as Ombudsman in October 2025.

text: Nagpaidalom siya anay sa quintuple bypass surgery sang 2023 sang siya pa ang justice secretary.
english: He previously underwent quintuple bypass surgery in 2023 when he was justice secretary.

text: Sang nagligad nga tuig, ginsapubliko sini nga na-diagnose siya nga may leukemia matapos ang surgery, apang naka-recover na siya kasunod sang treatment.#
english: Last year, he announced that he was diagnosed with leukemia after surgery, but he recovered following treatment.

text: Inatasan ni Pangulong Lee Jae Myung ang agarang paggamit ng “lahat ng magagamit na yaman” upang tugunan ang matinding pinsalang dulot ng walang patid na pag-ulan na kumitil ng hindi bababa sa apat na katao.
english: President Lee Jae Myung ordered the immediate use of “all available resources” to address the severe damage caused by the unrelenting rains that killed at least four people.

text: Sa isang pulong para sa pamamahala ng sakuna nitong Biyernes, binigyang-diin ng Pangulo ang kahalagahan ng mabilis at agresibong aksyon upang mapigilan ang karagdagang pinsala.
english: In a disaster management address on Friday, the President stressed the importance of swift and aggressive action to prevent further damage.

text: “Dapat tayong maglunsad ng sapat, o baka higit pa sa sapat na mga yaman upang maiwasan pa ang mga sakuna at aksidente,” ani Lee.
english: “We should launch enough, or maybe more than enough resources to avoid disasters and accidents,” Lee said.

text: Ayon sa ulat ng Ministry of the Interior and Safety, higit sa 5,000 residente ang inilikas at kasalukuyang nanunuluyan sa mga pansamantalang evacuation centers.
english: According to the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, more than 5,000 residents have been evacuated and are currently staying in temporary evacuation centers.

text: Isa pa rin ang nawawala habang patuloy ang mga search and rescue operations.
english: One person is still missing while search and rescue operations continue.

text: Patuloy ang mga babala ng matinding pag-ulan sa mga rehiyon ng kanluran at timog ng bansa, ayon sa Korean Meteorological Administration.
english: Heavy rain warnings continue in the western and southern regions of the country, according to the Korean Meteorological Administration.

text: Nagbabala rin ang ahensya sa posibleng pagguho ng lupa at biglaang pagbaha hanggang Sabado, Hulyo 19.
english: The agency also warned of possible landslides and flash flooding until Saturday, July 19.

text: Patuloy na pinapayuhan ang publiko na mag-ingat at sumunod sa mga kautusan ng awtoridad para sa kanilang kaligtasan.
english: The public continues to be advised to be vigilant and follow the orders of the authorities for their safety.

text: Nakarekord sang dos puntos kag tatlo ka blocks ang anak ni basketball superstar LeBron James nga si Bronny sa preseason debut sini sa Los Angeles Lakers nga amo man ang imbukada nga hampang sang team antes ang regular season sang National Basketball Association (NBA).
english: Basketball superstar LeBron James' son Bronny recorded two points and three blocks in his preseason debut with the Los Angeles Lakers, which was also the team's opening game before the National Basketball Association (NBA) regular season.

text: 16 minutos ang ginlawig ni Bronny sa court kun sa diin wala nakasulod ang nauna nga lima ka tira, apang nakahimo man ang 6-foot-2 guard sang isa ka rebound kag isa ka assist sa first half sang second quarter kag sa ikaapat nga frame.
english: Bronny spent 16 minutes on the court where the first five shots missed, but the 6-foot-2 guard also managed a rebound and an assist in the first half of the second quarter and in the fourth frame.

text: 124-107 ang resulta sang hampang pabor sa Minnesota Timberwolves.
english: The score was 124-107 in favor of the Minnesota Timberwolves.

text: Wala pa gihapon nasaksihan sang fans ang historic father-son duo nga nagahampang sa isa lang ka NBA team bangud nagpungko lang si LeBron, wala naka-uniporme, kag wala nakaupod sa mga naghampang.
english: Fans still haven’t witnessed the historic father-son duo playing on the same NBA team because LeBron just sat, didn’t wear a uniform, and didn’t join the players.

text: Nahibaluan nga napilian si Bronny sa second round sang NBA Draft kag nakahampang ini sa summer league sa Las Vegas.
english: Bronny was selected in the second round of the NBA Draft and played in the summer league in Las Vegas.

text: Ginalantaw nga magahampang ini sa Lakers sa preseason apang sa regular season, posible nga magatupa ini sa South Bay Lakers sa G League.
english: He is expected to play with the Lakers in the preseason but in the regular season, he will likely land with the South Bay Lakers in the G League.

text: Magluwas nga wala si LeBron sa una nga preseason game, wala man si Anthony Davis sa hampang sang Lakers, apang patas lang para sa fans bangud ginbangko man sang Wolves ang ila 2024 All-Stars nga amo ang shooting guard nga si Anthony Edwards kag power forward nga si Julius Randle.
english: In addition to missing LeBron for the first preseason game, Anthony Davis was also out for the Lakers game, but it was fair for fans as the Wolves also benched their 2024 All-Stars in shooting guard Anthony Edwards and power forward Julius Randle.

text: Buwas, 9:30 sa aga (oras sa Pilipinas), magahampang liwat ang Lakers batok sa Phoenix Suns kun sa diin ginalauman nga makaupod na ang 39-anyos nga league topscorer nga dungan naman sa ika-20 nga kaadlawan ni Bronny.#
english: Tomorrow, at 9:30 am (Philippine time), the Lakers will play again against the Phoenix Suns where the 39-year-old league topscorer is expected to join them on Bronny's 20th birthday.

text: Nagpagwa sang official statement si former Iloilo City First Lady Maria Victoria ‘Marivic’ Mabilog kasunod sang pagpauli na sa Pilipinas sang iya bana nga si ex-Iloilo City Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog.
english: Former Iloilo City First Lady Maria Victoria 'Marivic' Mabilog issued an official statement following the return of her husband, ex-Iloilo City Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog, to the Philippines.

text: Sa iya official statement nga ginpadala sa Bombo Radyo Iloilo, ginpahayag sang anay First Lady nga ginakabig niya nga daw kaangay sang rollercoaster ang ila naagyan.
english: In her official statement sent to Bombo Radyo Iloilo, the former First Lady said she considers their experience to be like a rollercoaster.

text: “It has been a rollercoaster ride the last few days.
english: “It has been a rollercoaster ride the last few days.

text:
I tried to stay upbeat and even managed to post some funny memes to comfort myself and our many friends who felt our pain.”

Ginbalikan man sini ang natabo sang 2017 sa diin nagbiya sila sa Pilipinas matapos nakabaton sang pamahog sa kabuhi ang anay alkalde halin kay former President Rodrigo Duterte sa diin ginbansagan pa ini nga protector sang iligal nga droga.
english:
I tried to stay upbeat and even managed to post some funny memes to comfort myself and our many friends who felt our pain.”

He also recalled what happened in 2017 when they left the Philippines after the former mayor received a death threat from former President Rodrigo Duterte who called him a protector of illegal drugs.

text: “But it has been difficult, heartbreaking at times.
english: “But it has been difficult, heartbreaking at times.

text: To be honest, I am still conflicted.
english: To be honest, I am still conflicted.

text: The trauma of 2017, where I was literally on the run with an 8-year-old boy just to stay alive, survive that darkest night, is gushing down and I get that drowning feeling.
english: The trauma of 2017, where I was literally on the run with an 8-year-old boy just to stay alive, survive that darkest night, is gushing down and I get that drowning feeling.

text: I had been crying myself to sleep, but I am strong, right?
english: I had been crying myself to sleep, but I am strong, right?

text: Strong-willed, Jed said.
english: Strong-willed, Jed said.

text: In my own interpretation of his words, tig-ulo and a pain in the neck, too.
english: In my own interpretation of his words, headache and a pain in the neck, too.

text:
Ha.ha.”

Ginpaathag man sini nga emosyonal ang iya mga anak nga sanday Nathan kag Patricia matapos nakita sang mga ini ang ila amay nga naghibi samtang ginapatpat ang naagyan nga kasakit ilabi na sang napatay ang iloy sang anay alkalde nga si Melchorita, sa diin wala sila nakapauli tubtob nga nalubong na lang ini.
english:
Ha.ha.”

He also explained that his children Nathan and Patricia were emotional after they saw their father crying while explaining the pain he went through especially when the mother of the former mayor, Melchorita, died, where they did not return home until she was buried.

text: “Watching Jed bare his heart on national TV was overwhelming.
english: “Watching Jed bare his heart on national TV was overwhelming.

text: The kids were crying and I had to explain it to them that on TV was precisely the reason why in the end I allowed their Dad to go home.
english: The kids were crying and I had to explain it to them that on TV was precisely the reason why in the end I allowed their Dad to go home.

text: He needed closure.
english: He needed closure.

text: He needed to visit his Mom’s final resting place.
english: He needed to visit his Mom’s final resting place.

text: He needed to redeem his honor of which he had worked so hard to earn.
english: He needed to redeem his honor of which he had worked so hard to earn.

text:
He needed to protect his legacy for which he dedicated most of his life to achieve.”

Ginpasalamatan man ni Marivic ang tanan nga nagbulig agud safe nga makagwa ang mga ini sa Pilipinas sang amo nga tion.
english:
He needed to protect his legacy for which he dedicated most of his life to achieve.”

Marivic also thanked everyone who helped them safely leave the Philippines at that time.

text: “Truth be told, I must not forget to mention that on that fateful night of August 28th, there was one steadfast friend who stayed with me and Nathan until we were safely out of the country.
english: “Truth be told, I must not forget to mention that on that fateful night of August 28th, there was one steadfast friend who stayed with me and Nathan until we were safely out of the country.

text: Thank you from the bottom of my heart.
english: Thank you from the bottom of my heart.

text:
I won’t ever forget.”

Mangin ang mga Sisters of Dominican Order suno sa natungdan ang nagbulig man sa pagpangamuyo para sa ila tubtob nangin safe ang ila flight pagwa sa Pilipinas.
english:
I won’t ever forget.”

Even the Sisters of the Dominican Order, he said, helped pray for them until their flight out of the Philippines was safe.

text: Matandaan nga kahapon sang nag-abot sa Pilipinas ang anay alkalde matapos ang halos pito ka tuig nga pagtinir sa luwas sang pungsod.
english: The former mayor arrived in the Philippines yesterday after nearly seven years abroad.

text: Sa iya pag-abot sa Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA) Terminal 3, ginabanta 11:00 AM, sakay sang Cathay Pacific flight halin sa New York, United States, ginsugata ang anay alkalde sang mga operatiba sang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI).
english: Upon his arrival at Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA) Terminal 3, around 11:00 AM, aboard a Cathay Pacific flight from New York, United States, the former mayor was met by operatives of the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI).

text: Ginkumpirma ni NBI Director Jaime Santiago nga boluntaryo nga nagsungka ang anay alkalde sa mga tinawo sang NBI-NCR.
english: NBI Director Jaime Santiago confirmed that the former mayor voluntarily surrendered to NBI-NCR personnel.

text: Suno kay Santiago, gin-isyu ang warrant of arrest bangud sa mga paglapas sa Republic Act 3019 ukon Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act kag Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards.
english: According to Santiago, the warrant of arrest was issued for violations of Republic Act 3019 or Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act and Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards.

text: Yara ang anay alkalde sa kustodiya sang NBI kag gindala sa Sandiganbayan kag nagpiyansa sa balor nga P90,000 para sa iya nga temporary nga kahilwayan.
english: The former mayor is in the custody of the NBI and was brought to the Sandiganbayan and posted bail of P90,000 for his temporary release.

text: Ang anay alkalde ang ginapahayag nga nalakip sa mga gin-imbitar nga Resource Persons nga magatambong sa pagpadayon sang Quad Committee House Probe sa bwas.
english: The former mayor is reportedly among the invited Resource Persons who will attend the continuation of the Quad Committee House Probe tomorrow.

text: Hindi inaprubahan ni Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas ang kahilingan ng Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) para sa signal jamming o anumang uri ng network shutdown kasabay ng mga pangunahing aktibidad ng Dinagyang Festival.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas did not approve the request of the Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) for signal jamming or any kind of network shutdown during the main activities of the Dinagyang Festival.

text: Sa panayam ng Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantilaga Gorzal, tagapagsalita ng alkalde, sinabi niyang ang desisyong ito ng alkalde ay ginawa sa koordinasyon sa Iloilo Festivals Foundation, Inc.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Joy Fantilaga Gorzal, spokesperson for the mayor, said the decision was made in coordination with the Iloilo Festivals Foundation, Inc.

text: (IFFI).
english: (IFFI).

text: Ayon sa kanya, ayaw na ng Pamahalaang Lungsod na maulit ang mga nakaraang edisyon ng Dinagyang kung saan ipinatupad ang signal shutdown, na hindi lamang nakaapekto sa Lungsod ng Iloilo kundi pati na rin sa mga karatig-bayan at maging sa lalawigan ng Guimaras.
english: According to him, the City Government does not want to repeat the previous editions of Dinagyang where the signal shutdown was implemented, which not only affected the City of Iloilo but also the neighboring towns and even the province of Guimaras.

text: Noong panahong iyon, naapektuhan din ang mga food delivery riders, mga industriya ng e-commerce, pati na rin ang mga hakbang sa emergency response.
english: At the same time, food delivery riders, e-commerce industries, as well as emergency response measures were also affected.

text: Sa halip na signal shutdown, hiniling ng Pamahalaang Lungsod sa Philippine National Police (PNP) na magpatupad ng mas mahigpit at mas nakikitang mga hakbang sa seguridad upang matiyak ang kaligtasan ng mga dadalo sa kapistahan.
english: In lieu of the signal shutdown, the City Government asked the Philippine National Police (PNP) to implement stricter and more visible security measures to ensure the safety of those attending the festival.

text: Nangako naman ang pulisya ng full force deployment, kabilang ang mobilisasyon ng mga force multipliers.#
english: The police promised full force deployment, including the mobilization of force multipliers.

text: ILOILO – Isa sa pinaka importante nga sahog sang manamit nga sud-an kaangay sang sinigang, dinuguan kag iban pa kun wala sang katumbal.
english: ILOILO – One of the most important ingredients of delicious dishes such as porridge, dinuguan and others if there is no medicine.

text: Ano bala ang mga benepisyo sang katumbal sa aton nga lawas?
english: What are the benefits of medicine to our body?

text: Suno kay Dr. Philip Nino Tan-Gatue isa ka Intergrative Medicine Expert, ang katumbal makabulig sa pagpanubo sang blood cholesterol,maayo man kun ikaw may sip-on, nagapabaskog man ini sang aton nga resistensya batok sa mga balatian.
english: According to Dr. Philip Nino Tan-Gatue is an Integrative Medicine Expert, the herb can help lower blood cholesterol, good if you have a cold, it also strengthens our immune system against diseases.

text: Pwede man ini nga himuon nga massage oil agud makapaayo sang mga sakit sa aton nga mga muscles kag kalamnan.
english: It can also be used as a massage oil to relieve pain in our muscles and muscles.

text:
Oil price hike, ipatuman sa masunod nga semana

Bad news sa mga motorista!
english:
Oil price hike to be implemented next week

Bad news for motorists!

text: Matapos ang rollback sa presyo sang gatong, lauman naman ang panibag-o nga oil price hike sa masunod nga semana.
english: After the rollback in fuel prices, a new oil price hike is expected next week.

text:
Suno sa oil industry sources, yari ang estimated nga pagsaka sa presyo sang gatong:

Gasoline – magasaka sang P0.40 – 0.70 per liter
Diesel – magasaka sang P0.75 – 1.00 per liter
Kerosene – magasaka sang P0.70 – 0.80 per liter

Ipagwa naman ang pinal nga presyo sang gatong sa Lunes kag ipatuman naman ini sa Martes.
english:
According to oil industry sources, here is the estimated increase in fuel prices:

Gasoline – to rise by P0.40 – 0.70 per liter
Diesel – to rise by P0.75 – 1.00 per liter
Kerosene – to rise by P0.70 – 0.80 per liter

The final fuel price will be released on Monday and implemented on Tuesday.

text: Liwat nga magaupdanay ang iconic ’90s dance group nga The Streetboys sa isa ka reunion concert sa Nobyembre 8.
english: Iconic ’90s dance group The Streetboys will reunite for a reunion concert on Nov. 8.

text: Sa isa ka Instagram post, ginpakigbahin ni Vhong Navarro ang detalye sang amo nga reunion concert.
english: In an Instagram post, Vhong Navarro shared the details of that reunion concert.

text: Ang Streetboys isa ka dance group nga gintukod ni Chito Roño sang 1993.
english: Streetboys is a dance group founded by Chito Roño in 1993.

text: Ini ginabug-usan nanday Vhong Navarro, Jhong Hilario, Spencer Reyes, Michael Sesmundo, Nicko Manalo, Meynard Marcellano, Christopher Cruz, Joey Andres, Joseph De Leon, Jayvee Amurao, Winferd Chua.
english: It consists of Vhong Navarro, Jhong Hilario, Spencer Reyes, Michael Sesmundo, Nicko Manalo, Meynard Marcellano, Christopher Cruz, Joey Andres, Joseph De Leon, Jayvee Amurao, Winferd Chua.

text: Ila ginpasikat ang dance moves pareho sang “Mmbop” kag “I Saw the Sign” kag kilala bangud sa ila acrobatic dance moves.
english: They popularized dance moves like “Mmbop” and “I Saw the Sign” and are known for their acrobatic dance moves.

text: Ang The Streetboys’ reunion concert ang i- produce sang singer-songwriter nga si Ogie Alcasid sa idalom sang iya company nga A-Team.
english: The Streetboys’ reunion concert will be produced by singer-songwriter Ogie Alcasid under his company A-Team.

text: Isa ang kumpirmado nga patay kag ginabanta nga 30 ang missing sa landslide nga nagluntad sa landfill site sa Barangay Binaliw, Cebu City kahapon sang hapon, Enero 8.
english: One person was confirmed dead and an estimated 30 are missing in the landslide that occurred at the landfill site in Barangay Binaliw, Cebu City yesterday afternoon, January 8.

text: Suno kay Cebu City Mayor Nestor Archival, ginabanta nga 94 ka mga trabahador ang yara sa area sang natiphag ang duta.
english: According to Cebu City Mayor Nestor Archival, an estimated 94 workers were in the area when the landslide occurred.

text: As of 10 p.m., 9 workers ang na-rescue kag isa ang kumpirmado nga napatay.
english: As of 10 p.m., 9 workers were rescued and one was confirmed dead.

text: Ginpasiguro sang local government unit ang 24 oras nga retrieval operation.
english: The local government unit ensured a 24-hour retrieval operation.

text: Yara naman sa lugar ang medical assistance kag emergency support teams bilang suporta sa search kag rescue operations.
english: Medical assistance and emergency support teams are on the scene to support the search and rescue operations.

text: Sa separado nga statement, ginkumpirma naman sang Prime Waste Solutions Cebu nga natabo ang landslide sa ila nga waste management facility sa Barangay Binaliw sang alas kuwatro sang hapon.
english: In a separate statement, Prime Waste Solutions Cebu confirmed that the landslide occurred at their waste management facility in Barangay Binaliw at 4 pm.

text: Suno sa operator sang pasilidad, naga-trabaho ini kaupod sa mga ahensya sang gobyerno kag sa lokal nga pamunuan agud nga maghatag sang kinahanglanon nga assistance kag agud nga maka-suporta sa mga apektado sang insidente.
english: According to the operator of the facility, it is working with government agencies and local government units to provide necessary assistance and to support those affected by the incident.

text: Dugang pa sang Prime Waste Solutions Cebu, suspendido anay ang operasyon sang pasilidad.
english: Prime Waste Solutions Cebu added that the operation of the facility is temporarily suspended.

text: Ginapangabay man sa publiko nga likawan anay ang pagpalapit sa area.
english: The public is also requested to avoid approaching the area.

text: Una naman nga ginpahayag sang iban nga mga opisyal sang syudad nga bangud sa sunod-sunod nga mga pag-ulan, naghumok ang duta sa landfill rason nga wala nalikawan ang pag-collapse sini.
english: Earlier, other city officials said that due to the consecutive rains, the soil in the landfill softened and its collapse was inevitable.

text: Nag-imbitar ang organizers sang 24 ka dekalidad nga judges agud nga makapili kun sin-o ang magapangibabaw sa pinaka-balantayan nga mga aktibidad sa Dinagyang Festival 2026.
english: The organizers invited 24 quality judges to choose who will dominate the most watched activities in the Dinagyang Festival 2026.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Elvert Bañares, head sang Committee on Judges sa Dinagyang Festival 2026, iya ginpahayag nga sa numero nga ini, lima ang bag-o, samtang ang iban naman ang naka-agi na pungko bilang judges sa nauna nga mga edisyon sang world-class nga Dinagyang.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Elvert Bañares, head of the Committee on Judges for the Dinagyang Festival 2026, said that of this number, five are new, while others have already sat as judges in previous editions of the world-class Dinagyang.

text: Ini nga judges ang makabig suno sa iya bilang “best people” sa patag sang culture and arts, dance, direction, kag iban pa.
english: These judges are considered as “best people” in the fields of culture and arts, dance, direction, and others.

text: Wala sini gindetalye kun sanday sin-o sila, apang suno sa iya, kilala, naapresyar, kag ginakalangkagan gid sang judges ang Dinagyang.
english: He did not elaborate on who they are, but he said the judges know, appreciate, and look forward to Dinagyang.

text: “We assure you, they know Dinagyang, they appreciate Dinagyang, and they look forward to Dinagyang,” suno kay Bañares.
english: “We assure you, they know Dinagyang, they appreciate Dinagyang, and they look forward to Dinagyang,” Bañares said.

text: Dugang sini: “I’m very happy to say nga ang gin-invite naton nga judges, maabot sila sa January 23, in time for the ILOmination, and then ma-judge sila sa Kasadyahan, kag ma-judge man sila sa Dinagyang.
english: He added: “I’m very happy to say that the judges we invited, they will arrive on January 23, in time for the ILOmination, and then they will judge in Kasadyahan, and they will also judge in Dinagyang.

text:
Sa hapon, sa Sadsad.”

Sandig sa schedule nga gin-release sang Iloilo Dinagyang Festival, matabo ang Ilomination Streetdance Competition sa Enero 23.
english:
In the afternoon, in Sadsad.”

According to the schedule released by the Iloilo Dinagyang Festival, the Ilomination Streetdance Competition will take place on January 23.

text: Matuon naman sa Sabado, Enero 24, ala una sang hapon, ang Kasadyahan sa Kabanwahanan, samtang alas otso sang aga sa Domingo, Enero 25, ang Dinagyang Tribes Competition.
english: The Kasadyahan sa Babanwahana will be held on Saturday, January 24, at 1 pm, while the Dinagyang Tribes Competition will be held at 8 am on Sunday, January 25.

text: Alas tres sa hapon naman maga-umpisa ang Sadsad sa Calle Real.
english: The Sadsad will start at 3 pm in Calle Real.

text: Naka-sentro ang tema sang Dinagyang 2026 sa “Bugay sang Ginoo.
english: The theme of Dinagyang 2026 is centered on “The Grace of the Lord.

text: Bugal sang mga Ilonggo.”
english: Pride of Ilonggos.”

text: Nagdaog ang 2024 Champions nga Boston Celtics sa imbukada nga hampang sa National Basketball Association (NBA) preseason batok sa Denver Nuggets nga kampyon naman sang 2023.
english: The 2024 Champions Boston Celtics won the opening game of the National Basketball Association (NBA) preseason against the 2023 champion Denver Nuggets.

text: Nakuha sang Celtics ang 107-103 nga kadalag-an sa Etihad Arena sa Abu Dhabi nga kapital sang United Arab Emirates.
english: The Celtics pulled off a 107-103 victory at the Etihad Arena in Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates.

text: Nanguna si Payton Pritchard sa players nga may 21 points kun sa diin napasulod sini ang anum sa 12 ka tres.
english: Payton Pritchard led the players with 21 points, hitting six of 12 threes.

text: Naka-12 puntos naman si Jayson Tatum kag may eight points si Jaylen Brown sa 19 minutos nga hampang sa court antes sila naghatag ligwa sa backups.
english: Jayson Tatum scored 12 points and Jaylen Brown had eight points in 19 minutes on the court before they relieved the backups.

text: Magluwas sini nga international preseason game, magaatubangay pa liwat ang duha ka teams sa Etihad Arena buwas, Oktubre 6 (petsa sa Pilipinas).
english: Besides this international preseason game, the two teams will face each other again at the Etihad Arena tomorrow, October 6 (date in the Philippines).

text: Nagapanguna sa Nuggets ang Serbian superstar nga si Nikola Jokic nga three-time MVP kag ang Canadian guard nga si Jamal Murray.
english: The Nuggets are led by Serbian superstar Nikola Jokic three-time MVP and Canadian guard Jamal Murray.

text: Nagdugang sa ila puwersa ang veteran guard kag nine-time All-Star nga si Russell Westbrook kag isa pa ka Balkan nga si Dario Saric.
english: Adding to their force were veteran guard and nine-time All-Star Russell Westbrook and another Balkan, Dario Saric.

text: Preska naman ang Boston sa panibag-o nga record sang nakuha sini ang ila ika-18 na nga korona sa NBA nga una man nga titulo halin sang 2008 sang ginporma na ang super team nanday star forwards Jayson Tatum kag Jaylen Brown kag guards nga sanday Jrue Holiday kag Derrick White kag ang Latvian Center nga si Kristaps Porzingis.#
english: Boston was fresh off a new record when it won its 18th NBA crown, its first title since 2008 when the super team of star forwards Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown and guards Jrue Holiday and Derrick White and Latvian Center Kristaps Porzingis was formed.

text: DAPAT prioridad gid sang gobyerno ang problema sang kakulangon sang bugas sa merkado kag ang “inflation”, ukon ang daku na nga pagsaka sang presyo sini, upod sa iban pa nga tig-una nga pagkaon.
english: THE problem of rice shortages in the market and inflation, along with other staple foods, should be a top priority for the government.

text: In fact, indi gid dapat pabay-an ang ini nga problema kag indi gid paglahog-lahogan ang pagsolbar sini.
english: In fact, this problem should never be neglected and should never be rushed into solving it.

text: Ang bugas kag ang tig-una nga pagkaon ang ginatil-og sa ginhawa sang aton sobra 100 ka milyon nga pumuluyo kag natural lang nga indi naton dapat pabay-an ini.
english: Rice and staple foods are the breath of our more than 100 million people and naturally we should not neglect them.

text: Man kon gutom na gani ang problema sang pumuluyo tungod sa indi na nila masarangan ang pagbakal sang ila kalan-on, patiha ako basi mag-rebolusyon na ang mga pumuluyo.
english: Even if the people are hungry because they can't afford to buy their food, believe me, the people might revolutionize.

text: Mapati man kamo seguro nga wala pa sing natabo nga rebolusyon tungod sa problema sa droga.
english: You probably believe that there has never been a revolution because of the drug problem.

text: Gani, samtang indi ta mapabay-an ang problema sa droga, dapat lang nga seryosohon man naton ang problema ta sa bugas.
english: Therefore, while we cannot neglect the drug problem, we must also take our rice problem seriously.

text: Tungod sini, nahangpan naton ang karon nga pagpanikasug sang gobyerno nga solbaron gid ang problema sang kakulangon sang bugas kag ang pagsaka sang presyo sini, nga indi na masarangan solbaron sang National Food Authority (NFA) paagi sa solo niya sini nga poder sa pag-import sang bugas.
english: Therefore, we understand the government's current efforts to solve the problem of rice shortage and rising prices, which the National Food Authority (NFA) can no longer solve through its sole power to import rice.

text: May tariffication bill na gani nga ginahingyo sa Kamara (House of Representatives) kag sa Senado agud buwagon ang ining solo nga poder sang NFA.
english: There is even a tariffication bill being requested in the House of Representatives and the Senate to dissolve this sole power of the NFA.

text: Sa matuod, ang version sang Kamara napasar na sadtong Agosto 2018 pa.
english: In fact, the House version was passed back in August 2018.

text: Ginahulat na lang ang pagpasar sang version sang Senado.
english: The passage of the Senate version is awaited.

text: Si Presidente Rodrigo Duterte nagpadala na sing sulat gani sa kay Speaker Gloria Macapagal kag Senate President Vicente Sotto III agud ipanawagan ang “immediate enactment” sining tariffication bill.
english: President Rodrigo Duterte has already sent a letter to Speaker Gloria Macapagal and Senate President Vicente Sotto III calling for the “immediate enactment” of this tariffication bill.

text: Pagkatapos sini, magapungko na ang mga tulugyanan sang Kamara kag Senado agud humanon ang joint bill sa ila conference committee, aprubahan ini, kag ipasa na para sa pirma sang Presidente kag mangin kasuguan na.
english: After that, the representatives of the House and Senate will sit down to finalize the joint bill in their conference committee, approve it, and submit it for the President's signature and become law.

text: Sunu man  sa oposisyon, sa pagpamuno ni Senate Minority Leader Franklin Drilon, dapat gani pabahaon ang merkado sang bugas kag kutlon ang “restriction power” sang NFA sa importasyon sang bugas.
english: According to the opposition, led by Senate Minority Leader Franklin Drilon, the rice market should be flooded and the NFA's restriction power on rice imports should be cut.

text: Ining “restriction power” sang NFA, paathag niya, amo gid ang kabangdanan sang padayon nga kakulangon sang “supply” sang bugas sa merkado kag sang pagsaka sang presyo sini.
english: This restriction power of the NFA, he explained, is the cause of the continuous shortage of rice supply in the market and the increase in its price.

text: Samtang, ang mga consumer group naga-oponer sa sining tariffication bill.
english: Meanwhile, consumer groups are opposing this tariffication bill.

text: Sunu sa ila wala garantiya nga mapadamo sini ang lokal nga “supply” sang bugas, ang pagkuha sang barato nga bugas halin sa gwa, kag kon bala mapilit ang mga lokal nga mga “producers” agud mapanubo ang presyo sang bugas.
english: They said there is no guarantee that it will increase the local supply of rice, the import of cheap rice, and whether local producers will be forced to reduce the price of rice.

text: Yara man gani gihapon, sunu kay Anakpawis Partylist Representative Ariel Casilao, ang cartel sa bugas nga maga-manipular sang presyo.
english: There is still, according to Anakpawis Partylist Representative Ariel Casilao, the rice cartel that will manipulate the price.

text:
***

Kon wala sing mahimo ang NFA agud masolbar ining aton problema sa bugas, wala na kita seguro sing mahimo kundi ipasar ining tariffication bill nga magapahanugot sang hilway nga pag-import sang bugas.
english:
***

If the NFA does nothing to solve our rice problem, we probably have no choice but to pass this tariffication bill that will allow the free importation of rice.

text: Ugaling lang, dapat ta man buligan ang aton mga mangunguma sa ila pangabuhian.
english: However, we must also help our farmers in their livelihood.

text: Kon magnubo na gid ang bili sang bugas tungod sining tariffication law, paano na lang mabuhi sila sing matarong?
english: If the price of rice drops so much because of this tariffication law, how can they live fairly?

text: Sa subong yara sila gihapon sa poverty level sang pangabuhi.
english: They are still at the poverty level of living.

text: Dapat handumon ta man nga mapasaka naton ang ila level nga pangabuhi sa middle class.
english: We should also aspire to raise their standard of living to the middle class.

text: Ang aton suhestyon amo nga tantyahon ta sing nagakaigu ang tariff (import duty), lakip ang retailer’s fee kag iban pa nga buhis, sang nagasulod nga bugas.
english: Our suggestion is that we properly estimate the tariff (import duty), including retailer's fee and other taxes, of incoming rice.

text: Ina agud indi man mapanubo gid ang bili sang bugas para makaginhawa man ang mga mangunguma sa ila pangabuhi, samtang indi man matam-an ang mga bumalakal.
english: This is to ensure that the price of rice is not too low so that farmers can breathe in their lives, while there are not many buyers.

english: (w_mateojr@yahoo.com/PN)

text: Paano bala ma likawan ang Hyperacidty ukon ang tuman nga kasakit sang tiyan bangud sa acid.
english: How to avoid Hyperacidty or severe stomach pain due to acid.

text: Suno kay Dr.Robert Tan isa ka Gastroenterologist, ang acid isa ka importante nga komponent para sa aton nga lawas bangud ini ang naga bulig sa pag tunaw sang mga ginkaon naton.
english: According to Dr. Robert Tan a Gastroenterologist, acid is an important component for our body because it helps to digest what we eat.

text: Defense man naton ang acid sa mga indi manami nga pagkaon nga aton nakaon.
english: We also defend the acid from the bad foods we eat.

text: Apang kun tuman na kadamo ang acid sa aton lawas may yara na ini sang malain nga epekto.
english: But when there is too much acid in our body, it has a bad effect.

text: Suno kay Tan, agud malikawan ang Hyperacidty likawan ang pag inom sang kape, gatas kag softdrinks.
english: According to Tan, to avoid hyperacidty avoid drinking coffee, milk and softdrinks.

text: Dugang sang natungda, nagakadapat man likawan ang pagpanigarilyo, pag inom sang makahululubog nga ilimnon, pagkaon asng matambok kag makahang nga mga pagkaon.
english: He added that smoking, drinking alcoholic beverages, eating fatty and spicy foods should also be avoided.

text: Nagpanugyan ang doktor nga gilayon nga magpakonsulta sa mga espesyalista agud mahatagan sang nagaka igo nga pagbulong.
english: The doctor advised to immediately consult specialists for proper treatment.

text: Nagaguwa sa isa ka pagtuon nga nagapangatlo ang Pilipinas sa mga pungsod nga may pinakamatahum nga mga babaye kun basehan ang performance sa international beauty pageants.
english: A study shows that the Philippines ranks third among the countries with the most beautiful women based on performance in international beauty pageants.

text: Ini santo sa Wethrift nga isa ka online coupon platform nga amo ang nag-calculate sa beauty score sandig sa resulta sang Miss Universe, Miss World, Miss International, Miss Grand International, kag Miss Earth pageants.
english: This is according to Wethrift, an online coupon platform that calculated the beauty score based on the results of the Miss Universe, Miss World, Miss International, Miss Grand International, and Miss Earth pageants.

text: Sa ila methodology, may tatlo ka puntos ang titleholders, may dos puntos sa first runner-ups, kag tres puntos naman para sa second runner-ups.
english: In their methodology, the titleholders have three points, the first runner-ups have two points, and the second runner-ups have three points.

text: Ang Pilipinas ang may 16 titleholders, 12 first runner-ups, kag pito ka second runner-ups kag may kabug-usan nga beauty score nga 79.
english: The Philippines has 16 titleholders, 12 first runner-ups, and seven second runner-ups and a total beauty score of 79.

text: Nagpanguna naman ang Venezuela (127) samtang nagsunod ang United States (125).
english: Venezuela topped the list (127) while the United States (125) followed.

text: Sulod man sa Top 10 ang United Kingdom (62), India (58), Colombia (54), Australia (52), Brazil (50), Puerto Rico (47), kag South Africa (41).
english: Also in the Top 10 are the United Kingdom (62), India (58), Colombia (54), Australia (52), Brazil (50), Puerto Rico (47), and South Africa (41).

text: Nahibaluan nga kilala ang Pilipinas nga may apat na ka korona sa Miss Universe paagi kanday Gloria Diaz, Margie Moran, Pia Wurtzbach, kag Catriona Gray.
english: The Philippines is known for having four Miss Universe crowns through Gloria Diaz, Margie Moran, Pia Wurtzbach, and Catriona Gray.

text: May anum ini ka Miss International, apat ka Miss Earth, isa ka Miss World, kag isa ka Miss Grand International titleholders.
english: It has six Miss International, four Miss Earth, one Miss World, and one Miss Grand International titleholders.

text: ANG SANTOL indi mamunga sang paho, kundi sang santol man.
english: SANTOL does not bear the fruit of smoke, but also of santol.

text: Masami mabatian naton ini nga panugdaon halin sa aton mga katigulangan sa ila paghusga sa pamatasan sang isa ka tawo.
english: We often hear this advice from our ancestors in their judgment of a person’s behavior.

text: Tungod pangbug-os (generalization) lang ini, syempre may mga exception ini.
english: Because this is a generalization, of course there are exceptions.

text: Sa kaso sang santol kag paho, puede mamunga ang santol sang paho paagi sa “grafting”.
english: In the case of santol and paho, the santol of paho can bear fruit by grafting.

text: Pag-angot ini sang isa ka linghod nga sanga sang paho sa puno sang santol sa diin mabuhi sa ulihi ang naulihi.
english: It is the attachment of a young branch of the paho to the santol tree where the latter will eventually survive.

text: Sa masami, ugaling, nagakatabo ini nga kamatuoran (ang siling nga pagpamunga sang santol sang santol) sa eksperyensya mismo sang tawo kag bisan man sa paghibalo sa pagtuon sang mga mangin-alamon sa siyensya.
english: Often, however, this fact (the so-called santol bearing of santol) occurs in human experience itself and even in the knowledge of the study of scientists.

text: Sunu mismo sa tinun-an sang mga mangin-alamon, may mga sulundon nga kinaiya ang isa ka tawo nga mapanubli niya sa pagkatawo sang iya mga ginikanan.
english: According to the teachings of the wise, there are ideal characteristics that a person inherits from his parents.

text: Ang mga ambungan nga ginikanan (sa iloy ukon sa amay, ukon sa ila nga duha), sa masami, may mga ambungan man nga mga kabataan.
english: Adoptive parents (on either the mother or the father, or both), usually, also have adoptive children.

text: Ang maalam nga mga ginikanan magabunga man sang mga maalam nga mga kabataan.
english: Intelligent parents will also produce intelligent children.

text: Kag kon indi makapanubli sa ila, sa mga kalolohan ukon kalolahan nila.
english: And if not inherit to them, to their grandparents or great-grandchildren.

text: Madamo man nga talento ang mapanubli halin sa mga ginikanan, katulad sang talento sa musika, sa pagsaot, sa pagka-atleta, sa arte katulad sang pag-pinta, ang pagka-manunulat, ang maayo nga pagpamaba (debate, publc speaking), ang mangin komedyante, kag iban pa.
english: Many talents are also inherited from parents, such as talent in music, dancing, athletics, arts such as painting, writing, good speaking (debate, public speaking), becoming a comedian, and others.

text: Ang mga pamatasan nga mapanubli halin sa ginikanan galakip sang natural nga pagka-isganan (courageous) nga ginahalinan sang mga pulis kag mga soldado, pagkasupog sang panghuna-huna ukon gawi (daring) nga diri nagahalin ang mga siyentipiko kag ang luyag magpasimpalad (adventurer, businssman), ang ma-imbento kag mahuyog magtuga sang mga bag-o nga mga butang, mahuyogon mag-lider, ma-artistahon sing ugali, madale maganyat sang mga bagay nga matahum (artistic), mahuyaon man ukon madale makig-abyan, kag iban pa.
english: The traits inherited from parents include the natural courage of policemen and soldiers, the daring of scientists and adventurers, the inventive and creative, the creative leader, artistic, easily attracted to beautiful things (artistic), shy or easy to make friends, and so on.

text: By the way, luyag ta gali koreheran ang una nga pagpati sang pila ka mangin-alamon – sa ila pagtuon sa mga kriminal – nga may pamilya nga may kinaiya sang pagka-kriminal nga puede mapanubli sang mga kabataan.
english: By the way, we want to correct the initial belief of some scholars – in their study of criminals – that there are families with criminal tendencies that can be inherited by children.

text: Ining mangin-alamon amo man, ugaling, mismo ang nag-koreher sang ila una nga pagpati sa padayon nila nga pagtuon sa pagsiling nga indi ini matuod.
english: This same wise man, however, himself corrected their initial belief in their continued study to say that it was not true.

text: In fact, bisan sin-o nga tawo puede mangin kriminal sa mga kahigayunan kag tion sang  tuman nga kaalipungot.
english: In fact, any person can become a criminal in times of extreme anger.

text: Nagagwa man, ugaling, sa mga pagtuon nga ang tawo indi ginhimo robot sang naturalisa.
english: It also emerges, however, from studies that humans were not made robots by naturalization.

text: May ikasarang siya agud mapa-uswag ang iya natural nga kinaalam kag talento, kag mag-kontrol, kon indi man niya lubos maligwat, ang iya napanubli nga pamatasan.
english: He has the ability to develop his natural intelligence and talents, and to control, if not completely overcome, his inherited temperament.

text:
Tungod sini, ma-impluwensyahan man siya sang iya palibut agud magpanibag-o.

Diri nagasulod ang pagka-importante sang mga manunudlo agud ma-impluwensyahan padulong sa kaayuhan ang ila mga estudyante.
english:
Because of this, he will also be influenced by his environment to change.

This is where the importance of teachers comes in to influence their students for the better.

text:
***

Bilang manunudlo, ginapauswag niya ang kinaalam kag talento sang mga kabataan santu sa mabungahon nga metodo sang pagtudlo.
english:
***

As a teacher, he develops the knowledge and talents of children through effective teaching methods.

text: Ginaubayan man niya ang mga kabataan sa pag-angkon sang maayo nga pamatasan kag ang paglikaw sa makahalalit nga mga bisyo, upod sa maayo man nga pagtudlo sang mga ginikanan kag sang pag-ubay man sang iban pa nga ahensya sang gobyerno nga nagatatap sa kaayuhan sang mga kabataan.
english: He also helps children to acquire good manners and avoid harmful habits, along with good teaching by parents and the support of other government agencies that care for the welfare of children.

text: Syempre, upod man dira ang pagtudlo sang ila mga simbahan.
english: Of course, that includes the teaching of their churches.

text: Bilang manunudlo, ikaduha gani siya nga ginikanan sang mga kabataan.
english: As a teacher, she is even a second parent to the children.

text: Kag dapat indi liwan ang pagtamod niya sa ila sa iya kaugalingon nga mga kabataan kag mga kahinablusan.
english: And he should view them no differently than his own children and grandchildren.

text: Gani, samtang yara sila sa iya poder sa eskwelahan kag sa iban nga kahigayunan, dapat tungdan sang manunudlo ang obligasyon sang isa ka maayo nga ginikanan –may pag-ulikid kag pagpalangga sa ila, kag nagahatag proteksyon sa ila kaayuhan sa tanan nga kahigayunan.
english: Therefore, while they are in his care at school and on other occasions, the teacher must fulfill the obligation of a good parent –to care for and love them, and to protect their welfare at all times.

text: Naga-kasubo kita, ugaling, sa paghibalo nga may pila ka mga manunudlo nga indi masaligan sa sining ila mga obligasyon.
english: We are sorry, however, to know that there are some teachers who cannot be trusted with these obligations.

text: Sila mismo mga “bad example” sa mga kabataan, kag naga-“take advantage” pa sang kahinaan kag pagka-inosente sang ila mga estudyante.
english: They themselves are bad examples to the children, and even take advantage of the weakness and innocence of their students.

english: There was a teacher who was a drug addict.

text: May ara man nga naghimulos sa iya menor nga estudyante.
english: Someone also raped his minor student.

text: Sang sini lang, isa pa gid ka maestro ang gin-report nga ginbastos niya ang iya mga estudyante.
english: Recently, another teacher was reported to have abused his students.

text: Padayon ang pagguwa sang dome nga may pyroclastic density current sa Bulkang Mayon base sa ginpaguwa nga report sang Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS).
english: The dome with pyroclastic density current in Volcano Mayon continues to erupt based on the report released by the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS).

text: Ginpakigbahin man sang PHIVOLCS nga nagapakita ang bulkan sang baga sa crater sang bulkan.
english: PHIVOLCS also shared that the volcano shows ash in the crater of the volcano.

text: Suno pa sa ahensya nga ang sobra kainit nga gas halin sa bag-o nga magma nagapahiwatig sa atmospera sang crater sa sulod sang bulkan.
english: The agency said the superheated gas from the new magma indicates the atmosphere of the crater inside the volcano.

text: Nagapahanumdum ang PHIVOLCS nga nagapabilin sa Alert Level 3 ang Bulkang Mayon kag ginabawalan ang pagsulod sa anom ka kilometro nga permanent danger zone sa lugar.
english: PHIVOLCS reminds that Volcano Mayon remains at Alert Level 3 and is prohibited from entering the six-kilometer permanent danger zone in the area.

text: Samtang, ginmando na ni Social Welfare Secretary Rex Gatchalian ang pagpadala sang dugang nga 100, 000 family food packs sa Rehiyon sang Bicol para sa mga pamilya nga apektado sang padayon nga pag-alburuto sang Bulkan Mayon.
english: Meanwhile, Social Welfare Secretary Rex Gatchalian has ordered the sending of an additional 100,000 family food packs to the Bicol Region for families affected by the ongoing eruption of Volcano Mayon.

text: Ginapasiguro sang DSWD nga may naka-preposition nga mga pagkaon kag non-food items sa nagkalain-lain nga bodega sa Rehiyon sang Bicol.
english: The DSWD ensures that there are prepositioned food and non-food items in various warehouses in the Bicol Region.

text: May ara sang P132.59 million nga stockpile kag standby funds nga handa sa DSWD field office 5 agud suportahan ang relief operations para sa mga pamilya nga apektado sang hulag sang Mayon.
english: There is P132.59 million in stockpile and standby funds ready at DSWD field office 5 to support relief operations for families affected by the Mayon movement.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagpagwa sang report ang PHIVOLCS nga may ara sang narekord nga masobra 130 rockfall events sa Mayon.Ginsundan pa ini sang isa ka “ongoing dome collapse pyroclastic density current” ukon uson nga nacapture sang camera nga ginpahamtang malapit sa Mayon.
english: It is known that PHIVOLCS released a report that there are more than 130 rockfall events recorded in Mayon. This was followed by an “ongoing dome collapse pyroclastic density current” or uson captured by a camera installed near Mayon.

text: Sa subong may kabug-usan nga masobra 558 FFPS ang DSWD sa Disaster Resource Center sa Pasay City, Visayas Disaster Resource Center sa Mandaue City, kag Mindanao Disaster Resource Center sa Butuan City.
english: Currently, the DSWD has a total of more than 558 FFPS at the Disaster Resource Center in Pasay City, Visayas Disaster Resource Center in Mandaue City, and Mindanao Disaster Resource Center in Butuan City.

text: Nag-develop na ang Tropical Depression Crising sa Tropical Storm samtang yara gihapon sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR).
english: Tropical Depression Crising has developed into a Tropical Storm while still in the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR).

text: Gina-forecast nga magapadayon ini sa pagbaskog kag magatupa sa Severe Tropical Storm category sa buwas sang aga ukon sa hapon.
english: It is forecast to continue to intensify and drop into the Severe Tropical Storm category tomorrow morning or afternoon.

text: Ulihi nga nakit-an ang sentro sini sa 335 km nasidlangan sang Echague, Isabela ukon 325 km nasidlangan sang Tuguegarao City, Cagayan.
english: Its center was last found 335 km east of Echague, Isabela or 325 km east of Tuguegarao City, Cagayan.

text:
Dala sini ang kabaskugon sang hangin nga 65 km/h malapit sa sentro kag pagmadlos nga tubtub sa 80 km/h.

Ginpasaka naman sa Signal Number 2 ang masunod nga mga lugar sa Luzon: Batanes, Cagayan lakip ang Babuyan Islands, ang northern kag eastern portions sang Isabela, Apayao, ang northern portion sang Kalinga, ang northern portion sang Abra, Ilocos Norte, kag ang northern portion sang Ilocos Sur.
english:
It brought winds of 65 km/h near the center and gusts of up to 80 km/h.

The following areas in Luzon were placed on Signal Number 2: Batanes, Cagayan including Babuyan Islands, the northern and eastern portions of Isabela, Apayao, the northern portion of Kalinga, the northern portion of Abra, Ilocos Norte, and the northern portion of Ilocos Sur.

text: Yari naman ang mga areas sa Luzon nga nagapabilin sa Signal Number 1: Nabilin nga bahin sang Isabela, Quirino, Nueva Vizcaya, nabilin nga bahin sang Kalinga, Mountain Province, Ifugao, nabilin nga bahin sang Abra, Benguet, nabilin nga bahin sang Ilocos Sur, La Union, ang northern portion sang Pangasinan, ang northern portion sang Aurora, ang northeastern portion sang Nueva Ecija, Polillo Islands, Camarines Norte, Catanduanes, kag ang northeastern portion sang Camarines Sur.
english: The following are the areas in Luzon that remain under Signal Number 1: Rest of Isabela, Quirino, Nueva Vizcaya, rest of Kalinga, Mountain Province, Ifugao, rest of Abra, Benguet, rest of Ilocos Sur, La Union, the northern portion of Pangasinan, the northern portion of Aurora, northeastern portion of Nueva Ecija, Polillo Islands, Camarines Norte, Catanduanes, and the northeastern portion of Camarines Sur.

text:
Sa forecast track sang DOST-PAGASA, matabo ang landfall scenario sa mainland Cagayan ukon Babuyan Islands karon sa hapon ukon sa gab-i.

Mahimo magguwa ang bagyo sa PAR sa buwas sang hapon, dugang pa sang state weather bureau.#
english:
According to the forecast track of DOST-PAGASA, the landfall scenario will occur in mainland Cagayan or Babuyan Islands this afternoon or evening.

The typhoon may exit the PAR tomorrow afternoon, the state weather bureau added.
