text: Wala pa pormal nga nakasugod ang 2024-2025 regular season sa National Basketball Association (NBA) apang nagasuprer na sang injury ang Dallas Mavericks superstar guard nga si Luka Doncic.
english: The 2024-2025 regular season in the National Basketball Association (NBA) has not yet formally begun but Dallas Mavericks superstar guard Luka Doncic is already suffering from an injury.

text: Suno sa Mavs, indi makatambong sa isa ka semana nga pre-season preparation si Doncic bangud sa left calf contusion nga naangkon sini sa training.
english: According to the Mavs, Doncic will miss a week of pre-season preparation due to a left calf contusion he suffered in training.

text: Natalana man nga iga-reevaulate ang kondisyon sang Slovenian star.
english: The Slovenian star’s condition is also set to be reevaluated.

text: Sa Lunes pagabuksan sang Dallas ang pre-season campaign sini sa Lunes sa isa ka home game batok sa Memphis Grizzlies.
english: On Monday Dallas will open its pre-season campaign on Monday with a home game against the Memphis Grizzlies.

text: Sa Oktubre 24 naman, magasunod ang regular season sang Mavs batok kay Victor Wembanyama kag sa San Antonio Spurs kag ginalaauman nga maka-recover na si Luka.
english: The Mavs will play the regular season against Victor Wembanyama and the San Antonio Spurs on October 24 and Luka is expected to recover.

text: May average si Doncic nga 33.9 points, 9.2 rebounds kag 9.8 assists per game sang nagligad nga season nga nagbulig sa Mavericks nga makalab-ot sa 2024 NBA Finals apang ginkabos batok kanday Jayson Tatum, Jaylen Brown, kag Boston Celtics nga amo ang nagkampyon.
english: Doncic averaged 33.9 points, 9.2 rebounds and 9.8 assists per game last season to help the Mavericks reach the 2024 NBA Finals but fell short against defending champion Jayson Tatum, Jaylen Brown, and the Boston Celtics.

text: Kampyonato naman ang target ni Doncic sa iya ikapito nga season kaupod sa Mavs.
english: Doncic's goal is a championship in his seventh season with the Mavs.

text: Daku ang paglaum sang team ilabi na subong nga kaupod na nila ang four-time champion halin sa Golden State Warriors nga si Klay Thompson nga ginakilala nga isa sa greatest shooters sa NBA history.
english: The team has high hopes especially now that they are joined by four-time champion from the Golden State Warriors Klay Thompson who is considered one of the greatest shooters in NBA history.

text: Magluwas kay Thompson kag Doncic, yara man sa Mavs ang beterano nga eight-time All-Star nga si Kyrie Irving nga ginpaidalom man sa surgery bangud sa nabali nga wala nga butkon sang Hulyo.#
english: In addition to Thompson and Doncic, the Mavs also have veteran eight-time All-Star Kyrie Irving, who also underwent surgery for a broken left forearm in July.#

text: Ginpasalamatan kag gindayaw ni Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas ang serbisyo nga nahatag ni Police Colonel Kim Legada bilang director sang Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO).
english: Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas thanked and praised the service provided by Police Colonel Kim Legada as director of the Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO).

text: Ginpabutyag ini sang alkalde matapos gin-anunsyo sang Police Regional Office (PRO) VI nga gin-relieve si Legada kag temporaryo nga iga-assign sa regional headquarters bangud sa lapses sa imbestigasyon sa Lamasan case.
english: The mayor said this after the Police Regional Office (PRO) VI announced that Legada has been relieved and will be temporarily assigned to the regional headquarters due to lapses in the investigation of the Lamasan case.

text: Sa interview naman sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantilaga Gorzal, spokesperson ni Mayor Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga ginakilala sang syudad nga sa idalom sang liderato ni Legada, ginpasidunggan ang ICPO bilang back-to-back Best City Police Office.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joy Fantilaga Gorzal, spokesperson of Mayor Treñas, said the city recognizes that under Legada's leadership, the ICPO was honored as the back-to-back Best City Police Office.

text: Ginbalikan man sang alcalde ang mas mabaskog nga kampanya sang ICPO kontra sa droga kun sa diin sa idalom sang pagpamuno ni Legada, malapit 1,00 ka drug operations ang natigayon, masobra 1,300 ka ginaalegar nga durugista ang naaresto, kag masobra P300-million nga balor sang droga ang nakumpiskar.
english: The mayor also recalled the ICPO's stronger anti-drug campaign where under Legada's leadership, nearly 1,000 drug operations were conducted, more than 1,300 alleged drug pushers were arrested, and more than P300-million worth of drugs were confiscated.

text: Sa iya statement, ginpahayag man sang alcalde nga naghingyo siya kay PRO 6 Director Brigadier Gen Josefino Ligan nga ikonsiderar ang bulig kag paggiya ni Legada ilabi na sa palaabuton nga major events sa syudad kaangot sa Dinagyang.
english: In his statement, the mayor also said that he asked PRO 6 Director Brigadier Gen Josefino Ligan to consider Legada's help and guidance especially in the upcoming major events in the city related to Dinagyang.

text: “Naintindihan ko nga leaders come and go, kag kabahin ini sang normal nga dalagan sang serbisyo publiko.
english: “I understand leaders come and go, and it’s part of the normal flow of public service.

text: Apang sa sini nga tion, ginahambal ko ang akon bug-os nga pagpasalamat sa iya serbisyo para sa Iloilo City.
english: But at this time, I express my full gratitude for his service to Iloilo City.

text: And, I challenge the incoming City Director to be at par or surpass the achievement of PCOL Legada,” kabahin sang statement nga ginpaguwa sang alcalde sang syudad.
english: And, I challenge the incoming City Director to be at par or surpass the achievement of PCOL Legada,” part of the statement issued by the city mayor.

text: Matandaan nga nagpungko si Legada bilang ICPO chief sadtong 2024 tal-os kay Colonel Joeresty Coronica nga subong yara na sa Negros Island Region (NIR).#
english: It can be recalled that Legada took over as ICPO chief in 2024 replacing Colonel Joeresty Coronica who is now in the Negros Island Region (NIR).#

text: Nagpabutyag si former Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog nga luyag sini nga magpauli sa Iloilo City.
english: Former Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog said he wants to return to Iloilo City.

text:
“Simple lang po ang gusto ko… gusto ko lang pong umuwi, gusto ko lang ng peace.”

Ini ang kasunod man sang pagpadulong sini sa Canada matapos nakabaton sang pamahog gikan kay former President Rodrigo Duterte nga patyon niya ang anay alkalde.
english:
"I just want something simple... I just want to go home, I just want peace."

This follows his visit to Canada after receiving a threat from former President Rodrigo Duterte to kill the former mayor.

text: Suno kay Mabilog, ang iya desisyon nga magbalik sa Iloilo City ang kasunod man sang panawagan sang quad committee sa Kamara nga hatagan ini sang kahigayunan nga makapaathag sa mga akusasyon batok sa iya.
english: Mabilog said his decision to return to Iloilo City follows the call of the quad committee in the House of Representatives to give him the opportunity to explain the accusations against him.

text: Gin-ako man sini nga nahadlok siya sang una sa iya seguridad, apang sa subong, nabatyagan sini nga safe na nga magpauli sa Pilipinas.
english: He also admitted that he was afraid of his safety at first, but now, he feels safe to return to the Philippines.

text: Matandaan nga gin-akusaran ni Duterte si Mabilog nga protector sang iligal nga droga.
english: Duterte accused Mabilog of being a protector of illegal drugs.

text: Ginbansagan man sang anay presidente ang Iloilo City nga most shabulized city.
english: The former president also called Iloilo City the most shabulized city.

text: May kaupod ka bala sa balay nga masami naga huragok?
english: Do you have a roommate who often snores?

text: Ano bala ang rason kun ngaa naga huragok ang tawo?
english: What is the reason why people sneeze?

text: Suno kay Dr. Patrick Moral isa ka pulmonologist posible nga gutok ang alagyan sang ginhawa sang isa ka tawo rason kun ngaa nabudlayan mag gwa ang hangin kun sya ang nagakatulog.
english: According to Dr. Patrick Moral, a pulmonologist, said it is possible that a person's airway is clogged, making it difficult for him to breathe when he is asleep.

text: May yara man sang kaangtanan ang kabug-aton sang isa ka tawo.
english: A person’s weight also has something to do with it.

text: Suno kay Moral, kun mabug-at ang isa ka tawo dako ang posibilidad nga ma bara ang hangin bangud sa madamo nga tambok nga yara sa parte sang liog.
english: According to Moral, if a person is heavy, there is a high possibility of air blockage due to the large amount of fat in the neck.

text: Dako man ang tsansa nga mag suprer sang hypertension ang tawo nga masami naga huragok.
english: People who smoke frequently are also more likely to suffer from hypertension.

text: Nagpanugyan ang doktor nga nagakadapat magpa konsulta sa doktor agud mahatagan sang insakto nga aksyon ang nasambit nga problema.
english: The doctor advised that it is necessary to consult a doctor to give the right action to the said problem.

text: Magasugata sa mga motorista ang senintimos nga rollback sa presyo sang gatong sa bisperas sang bag-ong tuig, Disyembre 31.
english: Motorists will be greeted by a one-cent rollback in fuel prices on New Year's Eve, December 31.

text: Suno sa Department of Energy, santo sa international trading data, ang retail sang  gatong ang nagbarato subong nga semana.
english: According to the Department of Energy, based on international trading data, retail fuel prices have fallen this week.

text:
Yari ang pagnubo sa presyo sang gatong:

Gasoline  – maganubo sang P0.30 per liter
Diesel    – maganubo sang P0.30 per liter
Kerosene  – maganubo sang P0.90 per liter

Ang rollback ang bangud sa prediction sang International Energy Agency nga pagsulobra sang supply sang gatong sa 2025.
english:
Here is the drop in fuel prices:

Gasoline – to drop by P0.30 per liter
Diesel – to drop by P0.30 per liter
Kerosene – to drop by P0.90 per liter

The rollback is due to the International Energy Agency's prediction of an oversupply of fuel by 2025.

text: NORMAL lang sa mga Filipino ang magkilala sang kabalaslan – sang mga kaayuhan nga nabaton nila halin sa kon sin-o man nga benefactor.
english: IT IS normal for Filipinos to recognize rewards – the good things they have received from any benefactor.

text: Sa kaayuhan – pangabuhian man ukon proyekto ukon programa nga makasabat sang problema sang pumuluyo – nga ila nabaton, indi na nila gani makita ang ano man nga kalainan sang benefactor.
english: In the welfare – whether livelihood or project or program that can solve the problems of the people – that they receive, they cannot even see any evil in the benefactor.

text: Kon may isaway man sila sa sining mga benefactor, wala na ini nila ginasapak.
english: If they have anything to say about these benefactors, they don't care.

text: “Ang kaayuhan lang ang sa amon, wala na kami sing labot sa kon ano man ang gina-akusar sa ila, ubra na ina ya sang iban,” ang masami gani isiling nila.
english: “We are only good, we don't care what they are accused of, it's someone else's job,” they often say.

text: In fact, isa man ini ka rason kon ngaa nagapabilin nga mabaskug ang mga ilegalista, katulad sang mga smugglers kag druglords, sa aton komunidad kag kon ngaa mabudlay lupigon ini sang aton gobyerno.
english: In fact, this is also one of the reasons why illegals, such as smugglers and druglords, remain strong in our community and why it is difficult for our government to defeat them.

text: Sa nahibal-an ta na, kilala ining mga smugglers kag mga druglords sa pagdala sang kaayuhan sa mga pumuluyo a la Robin Hood.
english: As we know, these smugglers and druglords are known for bringing good to the people a la Robin Hood.

text: Ginakawatan sang mga smugglers ang gobyerno sang buhis agud maka-ganansya sing daku, samtang nagapakita sang kaalwan sa mga pigado agud ma-proteksyunan ang ila hulag batok sa mga otoridad.
english: Smugglers rob the government of taxes to make huge profits, while showing generosity to the poor to protect their movement against the authorities.

text: Amo man sina ang ginahimo sang mga druglords.
english: Druglords do the same thing.

text: Gapakita sang peke nga kaalwan sa mga pumuluyo agud dayawon sila sa ila pagbulig baylo sa paghipos sa ila ilegal nga negosyo.
english: Showing fake kindness to the people to praise them for their help instead of keeping quiet about their illegal business.

text: In fact, mahaylo man gani nila ang pila ka opisyales sa gobyerno agud proteksyunan sila.
english: In fact, they can even persuade some government officials to protect them.

text: In the long run, ugaling, mabuking man sila sang mga otoridad nga sinsero sa ila pagserbisyo, kag sa amat-amat man nga pag-realisar sang mga pumuluyo nga sila man gali may katungdanan sa pag-away sa kalainan.
english: In the long run, however, they will also be revealed by the authorities who are sincere in their service, and by the gradual realization of the people that they too have a duty to fight evil.

text: Ugaling lang kay ningas cogon man ang ugali sang aton mga otoridad kag dungol man ang iban sa ila malain nga gawi.
english: Unfortunately, our authorities are also stupid and some are stupid in their bad behavior.

text: Gani ara man gihapon sila nga nagabalik-balik sa ila ilegal nga buhat.
english: So there are still those who repeat their illegal activities.

text:
***

Ang kaayuhan gani nga madala sang isa ka kandidato sa mga pumuluyo isa man sang mabaskug nga isyu agud magdaug sa eleksyon.
english:
***

The good that a candidate can bring to the people is also a strong issue to win the election.

text: Labi na gid kon kilala man siya sa iya mahumok nga balatyagon sa mga pumuluyo, katulad ni Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Sr.
english: Especially if he is known for his soft feelings for the people, like Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Sr.

text: Tungod sini, indi katingalahan nga magtutok ang mga kasumpong niya sa pulitika sang ila pinakamabaskug nga kanyon sa iya bisan indi na siya kandidato.
english: Because of this, it is not surprising that his political opponents will focus their strongest cannon on him even though he is no longer a candidate.

text: Ina tungod ang kaayuhan nga dala niya sakop na dira ang kandidatura ni Toto Defensor para Gobernador kag Beng Tupas para Bise Gobernador.
english: That's because the good things he brought include the candidacy of Toto Defensor for Governor and Beng Tupas for Vice Governor.

text: Sa karon gani, ginabanhaw pa sang mga kasumpong ang kuno korapsyon ni Gob, kag kon ano pa dira nga isyu batok sa iya.
english: Even now, the opponents are still raising the alleged corruption of Gob, and whatever other issues against him.

text: “Pan-os na nga isyu ining korapsyon” ugaling ang tawag sini ni Gob, nga limpyo ang rekord sa panghimanwa.
english: “This corruption is a full-fledged issue” but called it Gob, who has a clean record in citizenship.

text: Well, kinamatarong ina sang kontra nga magpakalain sa kay Gob.
english: Well, that's the right of the opponent to criticize Gob.

text: Nga daan lapit na ang Eleksyon 2019 sa diin Isyu kontra Isyu na ang hampang.
english: That the 2019 Election is approaching where Issue against Issue is the game.

text: Ang maayo nga lider syempre indi lang maghipos.
english: A good leader of course doesn’t just keep quiet.

text: Gapaabot ang pumuluyo nga sabton niya ang ano man nga akusasyon.
english: The people expect him to answer any accusation.

text: Indi ugaling mapilit sang kontra nga sabton ni Gob ang ila isyu sa ila binayaran nga mga programa.
english: However, the opponents cannot force Gob to answer their issue on their paid programs.

text: Paano abe sabton ni Gob ang mga isyu sa isa ka programa nga “biased” ukon “partial” kay manghalit man lang ina?
english: How can Gob address issues in a program that is “biased” or “partial” because it will only harm?

text: Natural lang nga sabton niya ini sa mga programa nga “fair and just” sa iya kag sa nagapalamati nga mga pumuluyo.
english: Naturally, he will respond with programs that are “fair and just” to him and the listening citizens.

text: Okey man ina ang mag-debate sa mga isyu.
english: It's okay to debate issues.

text: Ginadayaw nga debater sa UP si Gob kag indi ina problema sa iya.
english: Gob is an acclaimed debater in UP and that is not a problem for him.

text: In fact, kon may isyu sa iya ginasabat man niya ini sa outlet sa diin “comfortable” siya, labi na gid kon ”fair and just” ang gadala sing programa.
english: In fact, if there is an issue with him, he answers it in the outlet where he is “comfortable”, especially if the program is “fair and just”.

text: Kon luyag gid man sang kontra konfrontahon direkta si Gob, may panahon man nga ginahatag ang Comelec agud mag-atubangay ang mga kandidato.
english: If the opponent really wants to confront Gob directly, the Comelec also gives time for the candidates to face each other.

text: Kon indi gid makahulat ang kontra sa sini nga panahon, puede man sila mag-file sang kaso, sa diin ma-debatehan gid sing maayo ang pag-akusar sa iya.
english: If the opponent cannot wait for this period, they can also file a lawsuit, where the charges against him can be thoroughly debated.

text: Gob deserves sining “fair and just” nga kahigayunan sa pagsabat sang mga isyu.
english: Gob deserves this “fair and just” opportunity to address the issues.

text: Kag ina sa nasiling ta – sa programa nga “fair and just” sa iya, sa panahon nga ginahatag sang Comelec, kag, kon nagasaku gid ang kontra, ang pag-file nila sang kaso kontra kay Gob sa kon san-o luyag nila.
english: And that's what we said – the program that is “fair and just” to him, the time given by the Comelec, and, if the opponent is really busy, they can file a case against Gob whenever they want.

text: (w_mateojr@yahoo.com/PN)
english: (w_mateojr@yahoo.com/PN)

text: Nalab-ot na sang aktres, singer, kag entrepreneur nga si Selena Gomez ang billionaire status sa edad nga 32-anyos.
english: Actress, singer, and entrepreneur Selena Gomez has achieved billionaire status at the age of 32.

text: Suno sa financial data kag media company nga Bloomberg, isa na si Selena sa youngest self-made billionaires sa United States — pareho kanday Taylor Swift kag Rihanna — nga may net worth nga $1.3 billion (P73.1 billion).
english: According to financial data and media company Bloomberg, Selena is now one of the youngest self-made billionaires in the United States — alongside Taylor Swift and Rihanna — with a net worth of $1.3 billion (P73.1 billion).

text: Ginpahayag nga kadam-an sa manggad sini ang naghalin sa iya makeup line nga Rare Beauty nga iya ginbuksan sang 2019.
english: Most of her wealth is said to have come from her makeup line, Rare Beauty, which she opened in 2019.

text: Magluwas pa ini sa iya earnings bilang isa ka entertainer kag wala-tuo nga brand endorsements kaangay sa Louis Vuitton, Coach kag Puma.
english: This is in addition to his earnings as an entertainer and countless brand endorsements such as Louis Vuitton, Coach and Puma.

text: Sa mga endorsement, daku nga bulig kay Selena ang iya 424 million followers sa social media platform nga Instagram.
english: In terms of endorsements, Selena's 424 million followers on the social media platform Instagram are a big help.

text: Siya subong ang most-followed woman sa kalibutan kag third-most overall kasunod sa football stars nga sanday Cristiano Ronaldo kag Lionel Messi sa amo nga platform.
english: She is now the most-followed woman in the world and third-most overall after football stars Cristiano Ronaldo and Lionel Messi on the platform.

text: Nabun-ag si Selena sa Texas kag halos tatlo ka dekada na nga kilala sa show business.
english: Selena was born in Texas and has been well-known in show business for almost three decades.

text: Bilang isa ka artista, lakip sa kontrobersiya sa iya amo ang fashion kag boyfriends, kag naistoryahan man mangin ang iya ikaayong lawas lakip ang pagka-diagnose nga may bipolar disorder kag autoimmune disease nga lupus.
english: As an actress, she has been controversial about fashion and boyfriends, and her health has also been discussed including being diagnosed with bipolar disorder and the autoimmune disease lupus.

text: Matandaan nga sang Abril, ang suod nga abyan ni Selena nga si Taylor ang matunog man nga gin-istoryahan sang nakasulod ini sa billionaire list bangud sa iya nga “Eras” tour.
english: In April, Selena's close friend Taylor was also talked about when she entered the billionaire list because of her “Eras” tour.

text: Nagdangat sa 69 ka mga tawo ang napatay kag 11 ka iban pa ang missing kasunod sang daku nga sunog sa hypermarket sa al-Kut city sa southern Iraq.
english: At least 69 people have been killed and 11 others are missing following a massive fire at a hypermarket in al-Kut city in southern Iraq.

text: Sa inisyal nga imbestigasyon, nagsugod ang sunog sa panalgan sang “Corniche Hypermarket” building kun sa diin may yara sang perfumes kag cosmetics nga ginabaligya.
english: According to initial investigation, the fire started on the floor of the Corniche Hypermarket building where perfumes and cosmetics were sold.

text: Makit-an sa videos ang mga tawo nga nagasaka na sa atop sang building samtang nagabulig ang mga bumbero kag rescue teams nga maluwas sila sa insidente.
english: Videos show people climbing onto the roof of the building as firefighters and rescue teams help rescue them from the incident.

text: Samtang ginapreparar na ang iban nga mga bangkay para sa lubong, may iban naman nga nagakinahanglan pa sang DNA test para ma-identify sila sang ila nga mga pamilya.
english: While some of the bodies are being prepared for burial, others still need a DNA test to be identified by their families.

text: Nagmando naman si Prime Minister Mohammed Shia al-Sudani sang insigida kag madalom nga imbestigasyon para sa rason sang insidente kag agud mahibaluan kun ano ang nangin kakulangan sang mall.
english: Prime Minister Mohammed Shia al-Sudani ordered an immediate and in-depth investigation into the cause of the incident and to find out what was wrong with the mall.

text: Sa statement sang opisina sang opisyal, may yara man sang ginpanawagan nga national mourning.
english: In a statement, the official's office also called for national mourning.

text: Nahibaluan nga may kakulang sa safety measures sa Iraq nga nagatuga sang madamo nga casualties sa kada sunog.
english: It is known that there is a lack of safety measures in Iraq which causes many casualties in each fire.

text: Sang 2023, matandaan nga masobra man sa 100 ang patay sang nasunog ang isa ka wedding hall sa northern town sang amo man nga pungsod.
english: In 2023, more than 100 people were also killed when a wedding hall caught fire in the northern town of the same country.

text: Ang asthma isa ka common nga balatian sa kabataan.
english: Asthma is a common disease in children.

text: Apang kabalo ka bala kun ano ang rason sang asthma kag kun paano mo ini malikawan para sa imo nga kabataan?
english: But do you know what causes asthma and how you can prevent it for your children?

text: Suno sa National Asthma Council sang Australia, isa ka gina tunaan sang asthma amo kun may yara sang nagapanigarilyo sa sulod sang balay.
english: According to the National Asthma Council of Australia, one of the most common causes of asthma is smoking indoors.

text: Isa pa ka rason amo kun ang nagapanigarilyo ang isa ka iloy samtang ini ang nagabusong.
english: Another reason is if a mother smokes during pregnancy.

text: Dugang pa nga rason amo ang viral respiratory infections kaangay sang sip-on, exposure sa allergens kaangay sang yab-ok, bulbol nagikan sa mga hinuptan kag pollen, exposure sa mala kag malamig nga hangin, pagkadlaw kag strong emotions, pila ka mga bulong kaangay sang aspirin, non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs kag Echinacea.
english: Other causes include viral respiratory infections such as colds, exposure to allergens such as dust, pet hair and pollen, exposure to dry and cold air, laughter and strong emotions, certain medications such as aspirin, non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs and echinaceous drugs.

text: Nagpanugyan ang National Asthma Council nga mas maayo nga gilayon nga magpa konsulta sa doktor agud mahatagan sang insakto nga impormasyon kun paano ma tapna ang paglala sang asthma sang inyo mga kabataan.
english: The National Asthma Council advises that it is best to consult a doctor immediately to be given accurate information on how to prevent the worsening of asthma in your children.

text: Handa ang National Food Authority (NFA) nga magpaguwa sang suplay sang bugas agud nga masabat ang kinahanglanon sang relief agencies pananglitan may mga emerhensya subong nga holiday season.
english: The National Food Authority (NFA) is ready to release rice supplies to meet the needs of relief agencies in case of emergencies this holiday season.

text: Gin-isyu sang ahensya ang statement kasunod sang reports sa padayon nga aktibidad sa Bulkan Kanlaon sa Negros Island kag ang na-monitor nga intertropical convergence kag lapta-lapta nga pag-ulan sa kadam-an nga parte sang pungsod.
english: The agency issued the statement following reports of continued activity at Volcano Kanlaon on Negros Island and the monitored intertropical convergence and scattered rains in most parts of the country.

text: Suno kay NFA Administrator Larry Lacson, nagmandu na siya sa mga empleyado sa field nga iga-activate ang Operation Centers (OpCen) sa mga lugar nga apektado sang baha, bagyo, kag iban pa nga mga emerhensya.
english: NFA Administrator Larry Lacson said he has already directed field employees to activate Operation Centers (OpCen) in areas affected by floods, typhoons, and other emergencies.

text: Ginpabaskog man sang NFA ang ila nga palay buying strategies sa idalom sang Price Range Scheme agud malab-ot ang rice relief requests sang Department of Social Welfare and Development, Local Government Units, kag Legislators para sa distribution sa mga pamilya nga apektado sang kalamidad.
english: The NFA also strengthened its palay buying strategies under the Price Range Scheme to meet the rice relief requests of the Department of Social Welfare and Development, Local Government Units, and Legislators for distribution to disaster-affected families.

text: Gin-report man sang ahensya nga nakumpleto sini ang 95% sang ila nga buffer stocking target subong nga tuig.
english: The agency also reported that it has completed 95% of its buffer stocking target this year.

text: Base sa grains agency, may buffer stock ini subong nga 5.661 million bags sang equivalent milled rice.
english: According to the grains agency, it currently has a buffer stock of 5.661 million bags of equivalent milled rice.

text: SAMTANG halos imposible ang pagdaug sa lottery, katulad sang PCSO lotto, madamo gihapon ang nagataya diri sa ila handom nga magdaug sang minilyon nga jackpot.
english: WHILE it is almost impossible to win the lottery, such as the PCSO lotto, many people still bet here in their dream of winning millions of jackpots.

text: Sunu sa Lottery.co.uk, ang odds (oportunidad) sa pagdaug sa lotto, nga may anom ka numero, ang pilian amo ang 1 sa 45,O57,474 nga kahigayunan.
english: According to Lottery.co.uk, the odds of winning the six-number lottery are 1 in 45,57,474 chances.

text: Susmariosep, daw imposible matuod ang pagdaug diri!
english: Susmariosep, it seems impossible to win here!

text: Mabaskug ugaling ang handom sang tawo nga makaigu sang minilyon, labi na gid ang mga imol nga nagapati nga “kon kis-a ang lagpat makaigu man”.
english: However, the desire of man to hit millions is strong, especially the poor who believe that “sometimes the sparrow can hit”.

text: Tutal kaya man nila ang P20 nga taya, hambalon pa.
english: After all, they can afford the P20 bet, so to speak.

text: “May pag-asa mientras gakabuhi,” dugang pa gani sang isa ka obrero.
english: “There is hope while living,” added one worker.

text:
***

Sadtong Setyembre 30, 2018, ginbalita nga wala gihapon madaug ang jackpot sa Ultra Lotto 6/58 (kumbinasyon sang anom ka numero kuha sa 1 tubtub 58) nga naglab-ut na sa P809 ka milyon.
english:
***

On September 30, 2018, it was reported that the jackpot in Ultra Lotto 6/58 (combination of six numbers from 1 to 58) reached P809 million.

text: Tungod sini, ginbalita man ang pag-dinagoso sang nagapataya agud madaug ining daku nga jackpot.
english: Because of this, it was also reported that the gamblers were rushing to win this big jackpot.

text: Ining 6/58 jackpot magataas pa kon indi pa gid madaug.
english: This 6/58 jackpot will go higher if not yet won.

text: Man kon mas gadugang ang pataya, gadugang man ang balor sang jackpot.
english: Also, the more the stakes increase, the more the value of the jackpot increases.

text: Ako ya, ugaling, indi na ma-excite sa handom nga dag-on ang nagadaku nga lotto jackpot, ukon ano pa nga pasugal.
english: I, however, can no longer be excited about the dream era of the growing lotto jackpot, or any other form of gambling.

text: Man, wala na ako ya nagasugal.
english: Man, I don't gamble anymore.

text: Nadudla na ako sang masami ko nga pagpamierde sa sugal.
english: I was tired of my frequent gambling losses.

text: Sa pensar ko sadto mapa-enjoy lang ako sang sugal – sang bisan ano lang nga sugal.
english: I thought I could just enjoy gambling – any gambling.

text: Gali halit lang ini sa akon pangabuhi.
english: It's just a bad thing in my life.

text: Salamat man sa karon kay ang napangasawa ko wala nagasugal.
english: Thankfully, my husband does not gamble.

text: Wala man nagasugal ang amon mga kabataan tungod seguro kay wala man nila kami nakita nga nagasugal.
english: Our children don't gamble because they probably don't see us gambling.

text: Luas gali sa 6/58, ang iban nga padaug galakip sang 6/42 (42 ka numero), 6/45, 6/49 kag iban pa nga ang jackpot gabalor pataas kon gadiutay man ang numero nga pilian.
english: In addition to 6/58, other winners include 6/42 (42 numbers), 6/45, 6/49 and others where the jackpot increases if there are fewer numbers to choose from.

text: Of course, ang ano man nga himuon sang iban wala kita ya gapahilabot.
english: Of course, whatever others do, we don't care.

text: Ila man ina ya kahilwayan.
english: They too have freedom.

text: Tani lang kon mag-entra sa sugal, kon indi gid malikawan,  ang ipusta amo lang ang puede malibre sa galastuhon (disposable income) sang panimalay agud indi man mag-problema ang pamilya sa ila mga kinahanglanon.
english: Hopefully, when participating in gambling, if it is inevitable, the bet is only what can be free from the disposable income of the household so that the family does not have problems with their needs.

text: In fact, gataya pa man ako sa legal nga STL kon kis-a agud lang makabulig sa mga abyan nga masugata ko nga nagaalungay nga magtaya ako.
english: In fact, I still bet on legal STL sometimes just to help friends I meet who encourage me to bet.

text: Talagsa man lang, kag ang ginataya ko taas na gid ang singwenta pesos.
english: It's rare, and my bet is fifty pesos.

text: Yawat pa ang gamay nga porsyento nga makadto sa ila.
english: The small percentage that goes to them is still small.

text:
***

Sa isa ka bahin, samtang nagahandom ang madamo sa pagdaug sang lotto jackpot, may kakulba man kita sa kon sin-o ang magadaug (kon wala pa madaug) sa sining P809 ka milyon nga 6/58 lotto jackpot kag sang kasubong kadaku nga lottery jackpot.
english:
***

On the one hand, while many dream of winning the lotto jackpot, we are also worried about who will win (if not already won) this P809 million 6/58 lotto jackpot and a similarly large lottery jackpot.

text: Nadumduman ko ang natabo sa isa ka nagdaug sang 6/42 jackpot sadtong 2002.
english: I remember what happened to a 6/42 jackpot winner back in 2002.

text: Naglab-ut sa mga P19.6 ka milyon ang ining iya dinag-an.
english: His profit amounted to about P19.6 million.

text: Taxi driver lang ini nga wala sing nahibal-an kundi ang wala katapusan nga kapigaduhon tubtub nga nagdaug siya sining P19.6 ka milyon nga 6/42 lotto jackpot.
english: He was a taxi driver who knew nothing but endless poverty until he won this P19.6 million 6/42 lotto jackpot.

text: Ang ining nagdaug, si Arturo Eufemia, 58, ginkawatan kag gintiro patay sang pitu ka naga-maskara sa ila kaugalingon nga balay pagkatapos lang sang mga duha ka semana nga nahibal-an ang  iya pagdaug.
english: The winner, Arturo Eufemia, 58, was robbed and shot dead by seven masked men in his own house just two weeks after his victory was announced.

text: Ining natabo kay Eufemia natabo man sa pila ka nagdalaug sing daku sa lottery.
english: What happened to Eufemia has also happened to some big lottery winners.

text: Ang iban nga nagdalaug – mga 70 porsyento, sunu sa survey – naghinulsol man gani nga nagdaug sila tungod sa ila masubo nga nadangatan.
english: Some of the winners – about 70 percent, according to the survey – even regretted winning because of their unfortunate circumstances.

text: Por ejemplo lang, gin-kidnap kag ginpatay ang nagdaug sang $20 ka milyon sa Illinois, USA lottery sang mismo sister-in-law kag sang nobyo sini.
english: For example, the winner of the $20 million Illinois, USA lottery was kidnapped and murdered by her own sister-in-law and her boyfriend.

text: May nagdaug man sang $5.4 ka milyon sa New Jersey, USA.
english: There was also a winner of $5.4 million in New Jersey, USA.

text: Tinodohan niya ang iya pagsugal sa iya gindaug.
english: He stopped his gambling with his winnings.

text: Wala lang dugay “broke” na siya kag naga-istar na lang sa parke.
english: Soon he was “broke” and living in the park.

text: May nagdaug man sang 152,000 pounds (mga $5 ka milyon) sa Britanya sadtong 1961.
english: Someone also won 152,000 pounds (about $5 million) in Britain in 1961.

text: Naghinala gasto siya tubtub indi na gani siya makabayad sang iya buhis kag naghinala sing pahubog nga daw wala na sing kapuslanan ang iya kabuhi.
english: He suspected he spent so much that he couldn't even pay his taxes and suspected that his life was meaningless.

text: Sa mga nakapulos sing husto sang ila minilyon nga dinag-an, tani sige lang ang inyo maayo nga swerte.
english: To those who have made the most of their millions of dollars, I hope you continue to have good luck.

text: Okey lang kami ya sa amon kubos apang malinong nga pagpangabuhi nga wala sing sugal.
english: We were fine with our modest but peaceful life without gambling.

text: Ginhingyo ni Vice President Sara Duterte sa Kamara nga ipa-iway na lang ang question and answer format agud depensahan ang budget sang Office of the Vice President.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte has asked the House of Representatives to do away with the question and answer format to defend the budget of the Office of the Vice President.

text: Ini apisar nakalinya na ang 17 ka mga mamalidha agud mag-uisa sa budget sang opisina ni Duterte.
english: This is despite the fact that 17 lawmakers have already lined up to vote on the budget of Duterte's office.

text:
“Magsasayang lang tayo ng oras dito.”

Nahibaluan nga ang proposed budget sang OVP para sa 2025 ang nagadangat sa P2.037-billion nga mas mataas sang 8% sa budget subong nga 2024.
english:
“We’re just wasting time here.”

The proposed budget of the OVP for 2025 is P2.037-billion, which is 8% higher than the current 2024 budget.

text: Ginbasura sang mga hukom sa International Criminal Court (ICC) ang hingyo sang petisyon nga bawion ukon i-withdraw ang gindagdag sini nga arrest warrants batok sa prime minister kag former defense minister sang Israel.
english: Judges at the International Criminal Court (ICC) rejected a petition's request to withdraw the arrest warrants it added against Israel's prime minister and former defense minister.

text: Sa ginbalhag nga desiyon sa ICC website, nakasiling nga gin-reject man sang international tribunal ang hingyo sang Israel nga i-suspende ang imbestigasyon sa ginaalegar nga atrocity crimes sa Palestinian Territories.
english: In a decision published on the ICC website, it said the international tribunal also rejected Israel's request to suspend the investigation into alleged atrocity crimes in the Palestinian Territories.

text: Matandaan nga sang Nobyembre 21 sang nagpaguwa ang korte sang arrest warrant batok kanday Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu kag iya former defense chief nga si Yoav Gallant.
english: It can be recalled that on November 21, the court issued an arrest warrant against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his former defense chief Yoav Gallant.

text: Lakip man sa gin-isyuhan sang warrant amo ang Hamas leader nga si Ibrahim al-Masri bangud sa ginaalegar nga war crimes kag crimes against humanity nga naangot sa gyera sa Gaza.
english: Also issued a warrant was Hamas leader Ibrahim al-Masri for alleged war crimes and crimes against humanity in connection with the war in Gaza.

text: Sang Pebrero, gin-anunsyo sang korte nga gin-withdraw na sini ang arrest warrant kay al-Masri ukon kilala man nga Mohammed Deif bangud sang reports nga napatay na ini.
english: In February, the court announced that it had withdrawn the arrest warrant for al-Masri or also known as Mohammed Deif due to reports that he had died.

text: Sang Hunyo, matandaan nga nag-apin ang US sa Israel paagi sa pagpapanaog sang sanctions sa apat ka judges sa ICC bangud sang arrest warrant sini batok kay Netanyahu.
english: In June, the US defended Israel by imposing sanctions on four ICC judges over its arrest warrant against Netanyahu.

text: Masami bala nga naga lingin ang ulo mo?
english: Do you often feel dizzy?

text: Suno sa Oncologist nga si Dr. Isaac David Ampil II ang masami nga pagsakit sang imon ulo may yara sang nagkalain-lain nga rason.
english: According to Oncologist Dr. Isaac David Ampil II your frequent headaches have a variety of causes.

text: Isa sa pinaka common nga rason amo ang problema sa mata.
english: One of the most common reasons is eye problems.

text: Suno kay Ampil posible nga may yara sang depekto ang imo mata rason kun ngaa nabudlayan ini mag adjust kag naga tuga sang paglingin sang ulo.
english: According to Ampil, it is possible that there is a defect in your eye that makes it difficult to adjust and causes dizziness.

text: Isa pa gid ka rason amo ang ear infection ukon middle ear problem.
english: Another reason is an ear infection or middle ear problem.

text: Posible man nga may yara ka sang sakit sa puso, anemia ukon low blood ka kun sa diin nabuhinan ang oxygen nga naga saka sa imo nga utok.
english: You may also have heart disease, anemia or low blood pressure where the oxygen supply to your brain is reduced.

text: Ang pinaka seryoso amo ang may posibilidad nga simptomas ini sang problema sa utok.
english: The most serious is the possibility that it is a symptom of a brain problem.

text: Nagpanugyan si Ampil nga kun masami naga lingin ang imo ulo, gilayon nga mag kadto sa imo nga doctor agud mahatagan sang nagakadapat nga diagnosis.
english: Ampil advised that if you have frequent dizziness, see your doctor immediately for a proper diagnosis.

text: Ipaguwa na subong nga adlaw, Enero 7, 2026, ang resulta sang 2025 bar examinations.
english: The results of the 2025 bar examinations will be released today, January 7, 2026.

text: 13,193 ang admitted applicants para sa bar exams, apang 11,425 ka examinees lamang ang nakakumpleto sa pagkuha sang test sadtong Septyembre 7, 10, kag 14.
english: 13,193 admitted applicants for the bar exams, but only 11,425 examinees completed the test on September 7, 10, and 14.

text: Ini ang pinakamataas nga rekord sang nakatapos sang exam sa Philippine Bar history.
english: This is the highest record of passing the exam in Philippine Bar history.

text: Na-highlight man sa 2025 Bar Examinations ang resilience sang mga Pilipino nga luyag mangin abogado.
english: The 2025 Bar Examinations also highlighted the resilience of Filipinos who want to become lawyers.

text: Sa numero sang examinees, lakip sa rekord amo ang 41 ka nagabusong, 206 ka senior citizens, 139 ka mga indibidwal nga may medical conditions, kag 241 ka persons with disabilities.
english: Among the number of examinees, the record includes 41 pregnant women, 206 senior citizens, 139 individuals with medical conditions, and 241 persons with disabilities.

text: Ginpatigayon ang exams sa 14 local testing centers sa lain-lain nga bahin sang pungsod lakip na sa Central Philippine University (CPU) sa Iloilo City.
english: The exams were conducted at 14 local testing centers in different parts of the country including the Central Philippine University (CPU) in Iloilo City.

text: Suno sa Korte Suprema, maga-umpisa sa pagguwa ang pangalan sang bar passers 1:00 karon sa hapon.
english: According to the Supreme Court, the names of the bar passers will be released at 1:00 pm today.

text: I-post man ang pangalan sang mga nakapasar sa LED walls sa Supreme Courtyard, kag sa website kag official social media accounts sang Korte Suprema.
english: The names of the passers will also be posted on the LED walls in the Supreme Courtyard, and on the website and official social media accounts of the Supreme Court.

text: Magasumpa ang bar passers kag magapirma sa Roll of Attorneys sa Pebrero 6.
english: Bar passers will take the oath and sign the Roll of Attorneys on February 6.

text: ISA KA “Friend’s Request” sa Facebook sang sini lang ang nakakuha sang akon atensyon.
english: A “Friend’s Request” on Facebook recently caught my attention.

text: Nabalhag diri ang ngalan German Ray P. Gonzales Jr.
english: The name German Ray P. Gonzales Jr. is listed here.

text: sang Barotac Nuevo, Iloilo.
english: of Barotac Nuevo, Iloilo.

text: Familiar kaayo ini nga ngalan sa akon, pati na ang iya nawong, gani maabtik ko nga gin-click ang “Accept”.
english: This name was very familiar to me, as was his face, so I quickly clicked “Accept”.

text: Bugtong nga anak si Ray ni anay Iloilo City Councilor German  Gonzales (Sr.), isa ka suod nga abyan kag ka-kawsa kontra sa “establisiminento” sadtong estudyante pa kami.
english: Ray is the only son of former Iloilo City Councilor German Gonzales (Sr.), a close friend and anti-establishment ally when we were students.

text: Masami “Germs” ang tawag ko sa iya, kon indi “Man”, kag “Matt” kon tawgon man niya ako.
english: I usually call him “Germs”, otherwise “Man”, and “Matt” if he calls me too.

text: Pareho kami nga mga student leader sadto.
english: We were both student leaders at the time.

text: Si Germs ang presidente sang student council sang University of the Phlippines, Iloilo City Campus.
english: Germs is the president of the student council of the University of the Philippines, Iloilo City Campus.

text: Ako naman ang presidente sang College Editors’ Guild of the Philippines, Iloilo Chapter.
english: I am the president of the College Editors' Guild of the Philippines, Iloilo Chapter.

text: Kag bisan lain ang amon organisasyon, nagakilit-anay man kami sa mga madamo nga kawsa sang mga estudyante.
english: And even though our organization is different, we also meet in many student causes.

text: Suod gid kami nga mag-abyan ni Germs, kag sa masami ginakadtuan ko siya sa UP-Iloilo agud mag-istorya parti sa amon nga mga kawsa.
english: Germs and I are very close friends, and I often visit him at UP-Iloilo to talk about our causes.

text: Sang magsaylo ako sa University of Iloilo sa kurso nga Education (Math major), halin sa Banking & Finance sa The Lincoln College, diri na kami nag-upod sa isa ka eskwelahan – ang UI.
english: When I moved to the University of Iloilo in Education (Math major), from Banking & Finance at The Lincoln College, we joined the same school – UI.

text: Wala matapos ni Germs ang iya Pol-Sci nga kurso sa UP-Iloilo kag diri na niya gintapos sa UI.
english: Germs did not complete his Pol-Sci course at UP-Iloilo and graduated from UI.

text: Diri sa UI, nangin Senate President ako sang UI Student Republic, samtang gapanguna man sa hublag estudyante si Germs sa College of Arts.
english: Here at UI, I became the Senate President of the UI Student Republic, while Germs also led the student movement in the College of Arts.

text: Diri man kami nag-upod sa Sigma Rho Fraternity.
english: This is also where we joined the Sigma Rho Fraternity.

text: Sang magtapos kami sang amon mga kurso, nangin maestro ako anay sa kolehiyo sa subject nga The Life & Works of Dr. Jose P. Rizal sa UI, bag-o ako magsaylo sa Iloilo City (Molo) National High School sa pagtudlo sa Mathematics, partikular sa subject nga Geometry.
english: When we finished our courses, I became a college teacher in the subject The Life & Works of Dr. Jose P. Rizal at UI, before I moved to Iloilo City (Molo) National High School to teach Mathematics, particularly the subject of Geometry.

text: Bati ko sadto konsehal na si Germs sa Barotac Nuevo.
english: I heard that Germs was a councilor in Barotac Nuevo.

text: Samtang nagatudlo ako sa ICNHS, nagkuha ako sing masteral sa Mathematics sa UI.
english: While I was teaching at ICNHS, I got a master’s in Mathematics at the UI.

text: Sa sina nga tinion (1970) nagainit na ang student activism kag ang enkwentro sa pulitika sang Nacionalista Party ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos kag sang Liberal Party nga ginapangunahan ni Senador Benigno “Ninoy” Aquino.
english: At that time (1970) student activism and the political encounter between the Nacionalista Party of President Ferdinand Marcos and the Liberal Party led by Senator Benigno “Ninoy” Aquino were heating up.

text: Nag-untat ako sa akon masteral nga kurso kag nagsulod sa pagka-abogado sa UI.
english: I dropped out of my master’s degree and went into law at UI.

text: Sa second year na ako sang gin-deklarar ni Marcos ang martial law sadtong Setyembre 21, 1972.
english: I was in my second year when Marcos declared martial law on September 21, 1972.

text: Bag-o sining pagdeklarar ni Marcos sang martial law, kaupod ko si Germs sa radio column nga On the Air Force, sa diin gintalakay namon ang dalagku nga mga isyu bahin sa kagarukan sang gobyerno.
english: Before Marcos' declaration of martial law, Germs and I were on the radio column On the Air Force, where we discussed major issues of government corruption.

text: Sa mismo masunod nga adlaw sang martial law, samtang naga-program kami, may nag-abot nga Philippine Constabulary, kag ginpa-untat kami sang amon programa.
english: The very next day of martial law, while we were programming, the Philippine Constabulary came, and we were stopped from our program.

text: Sa sina nga tion, gina-kritikar gid namon ang martial law.
english: At that time, we were very critical of martial law.

text: Si Germs nagpauli sa ila lugar sa Barotac sa diin siya nadakpan sang mga militar ni Marcos nga naga-lecture sa katubuhan.
english: Germs returned to his hometown of Barotac where he was arrested by Marcos' military while lecturing in the countryside.

text: Na-priso siya sa Camp Delgado upod sa isa man ka kolumnista sa radyo nga si Vic Mercado.
english: He was imprisoned at Camp Delgado along with another radio columnist, Vic Mercado.

text: Ang nagamasakit ko nga iloy, nga anom ka tuig ang paghigda, kahibalo sang akon balatyagon kontra sa martial law kag gindestino niya ako anay sa uma namon sa Guimaras.
english: My ailing mother, who had been bedridden for six years, knew of my feelings against martial law and assigned me to our farm in Guimaras.

text: Sang mapatay ang akon iloy sadtong 1979, nagbalik ako sa siyudad sang Iloilo.
english: When my mother died in 1979, I returned to Iloilo City.

text: Nag-upod ako kay Germs, nga sadto may programa liwat sa radyo.
english: I accompanied Germs, who then had another radio program.

text: Nag-upod man ako sa mga hublag batok sa martial law regime ni Marcos.
english: I also joined the movements against Marcos' martial law regime.

text: Nag-konsehal si Germs sang Iloilo City sang matumba si Marcos sang Edsa Revolution.
english: Germs became a councilor of Iloilo City when Marcos was overthrown during the Edsa Revolution.

text: Ginpundar ko man ang Iloilo City Press Corps bilang reporter kag kolumnista sang Panay News.
english: I also founded the Iloilo City Press Corps as a reporter and columnist for Panay News.

text: Ako man ang nagpundar sang Guimaras Press Corps.
english: I also founded the Guimaras Press Corps.

text: Nangin director man ako sang Iloilo Press Club.
english: I also became the director of the Iloilo Press Club.

text: Kag nangin editor sang pila ka pamantalaan diri sa siyudad.
english: And became editor of several newspapers here in the city.

text: Sa karon, kolumnista ako gihapon sa Panay News.
english: Today, I am still a columnist for Panay News.

text: Sa pulong na ugaling nga Hiligaynon – for sentimental reason – pagkatapos sang pagsulat sa English sa sulod sang mga 30 ka tuig.
english: But in Hiligaynon – for sentimental reason – after writing in English for about 30 years.

text: Si Brod German nagtaliwan sang pila na ka tuig nga nagligad, apang indi gihapon malipatan sang mga pumuluyo nga nanguna siya sa pag-away sa Panay Electric Company agud matagaan sila sing maayo nga serbisyo.
english: Brod German passed away a few years ago, but the residents will never forget that he led the fight against the Panay Electric Company to provide them with good service.

text: Nalugaw-an siya, apang nagresulta man ini sa amat-amat nga pag-improbar sang serbisyo sang PECO.
english: He was disappointed, but it also resulted in PECO's gradual improvement in service.

text: Gintalikdan sang 21-anyos nga Houston forward nga si AJ Griffin ang karera sini sa National Basketball Association (NBA) agud pasulabihon ang full-time ministry.
english: 21-year-old Houston forward AJ Griffin gave up his career in the National Basketball Association (NBA) to pursue the full-time ministry.

text:
Pahayag sini, “I gave up basketball to follow Jesus.”

Sang 2022, matandaan nga ginpili sang Atlanta Hawks si Griffin sa first round sang NBA Draft.
english:
He said, “I gave up basketball to follow Jesus.”

In 2022, it will be noted that the Atlanta Hawks selected Griffin in the first round of the NBA Draft.

text: Antes ang 2024-2025 season, nakahampang ini sang 92 games kag may average nga 7.5 puntos kag 17.1 minutes per game.
english: Ahead of the 2024-2025 season, he played 92 games and averaged 7.5 points and 17.1 minutes per game.

text: Sang offseason, gin-trade siya halin sa Hawks pakadto sa Houston Rockets, kabaylo sang 43rd overall pick nga si Nikola Durisic halin naman sa Miami Heat.
english: In the offseason, he was traded from the Hawks to the Houston Rockets, in exchange for 43rd overall pick Nikola Durisic from the Miami Heat.

text: “I know that in a lot of people’s eyes, that seems like, it seems like a loss in the world’s eyes.
english: “I know that in a lot of people’s eyes, that seems like, it seems like a loss in the world’s eyes.

text: But I just want to let you guys know that I’m super excited because I truly get to serve God, you know, with my full Yes, and I feel like letting go of basketball is allowing me to, you know, go into full-time ministry and truly serving the Lord with all my heart — with all my time too, as well.
english: But I just want to let you guys know that I’m super excited because I truly get to serve God, you know, with my full Yes, and I feel like letting go of basketball is allowing me to, you know, go into full-time ministry and truly serving the Lord with all my heart — with all my time too, as well.

text: So, I’m just excited to see where that leads me,” paathag sini sa iya desisyon nga mag-retiro sang temprano.
english: So, I’m just excited to see where that leads me,” he explained of his decision to retire early.

text: Si Griffin nga tumandok sang Texas indi amo ang una nga NBA player nga nagdesisyon nga untaton ang karera sa basketball kag idedikar ang kabuhi sa pagtuo.
english: Texas native Griffin is not the first NBA player to decide to put a basketball career on hold and dedicate a life to faith.

text: Sang 2019, matandaan nga nag-retiro man sa NBA ang veteran point guard nga si Darren Collison matapos ang 10 ka seasons agud nga matutukan ang iya pamilya kag pagtuluuhan.
english: In 2019, veteran point guard Darren Collison also retired from the NBA after 10 seasons to focus on his family and faith.

text: Nakahampang siya sa New Orleans Hornets, Indiana Pacers, Dallas Mavericks, LA Clippers kag Sacramento Kings.
english: He played with the New Orleans Hornets, Indiana Pacers, Dallas Mavericks, LA Clippers and Sacramento Kings.

text: “While I still love basketball, I know there is something more important, which is my family and my faith,” paathag ni Collison sang amo nga tion.
english: “While I still love basketball, I know there is something more important, which is my family and my faith,” Collison explained at the time.

text: “I am one of Jehovah’s Witnesses and my faith means everything to me.
english: “I am one of Jehovah’s Witnesses and my faith means everything to me.

text: I receive so much joy from volunteering to help others and participate in a worldwide ministry.
english: I receive so much joy from volunteering to help others and participate in a worldwide ministry.

text: The joy I feel is unmatched.
english: The joy I feel is unmatched.

text: With that being said, I have decided to retire from the NBA.”
english: With that being said, I have decided to retire from the NBA.”

text: Isa ang Filipino- Israeli soldier sa mga napatay sa padayon nga away sang Israeli Defense Forces batok sa Hamas sa Gaza.
english: The Filipino-Israeli soldier was one of those killed in the ongoing fighting of the Israeli Defense Forces against Hamas in Gaza.

text: Ini amo si Staff Sergeant Shoham Menahem, 21, nga nagaistar sa Moshav Yardena kag anak sang Pinay nga si Rachel Marichel Menahem, tumandok sang Miagao, Iloilo.
english: They are Staff Sergeant Shoham Menahem, 21, who lives in Moshav Yardena and is the son of Filipina Rachel Marichel Menahem, a native of Miagao, Iloilo.

text: Suno sa IDF, magluwas kay Menahem, patay man ang 20-anyos nga si Sgt.
english: According to the IDF, besides Menahem, 20-year-old Sgt.

text: Shlomo Yakir Shrem, kag 19-anyos nga si Sgt.
english: Shlomo Yakir Shrem, and 19-year-old Sgt.

text: Yuliy Faktor.
english: Julius Factor.

text: Ang tatlo nga suldado ang nagaserbisyo sa 401st Brigade sang Armored Corps.
english: The three soldiers serve in the 401st Brigade of the Armored Corps.

text: Napatay sila samtang yara sa sulod sang tangke de giyera sa isa ka brigade mission sa Jabalya sa northern Gaza Strip batok sa isa ka local Hamas battalion.
english: They were killed while inside a battle tank on a brigade mission in Jabalya in the northern Gaza Strip against a local Hamas battalion.

text: Sa initial assessment, isa ka anti-tank missile ang nagtuga sang paglupok sang tangk.
english: In the initial assessment, an anti-tank missile caused the tank to explode.

text: Apang may ginsiling man nga isa ka operational accident ang natabo.
english: But it was also said that an operational accident occurred.

text: Padayon pa ini nga gina-imbestigaran sang IDF.
english: The IDF is still investigating the incident.

text: Nagpalab-ot naman sang pagpakig-unong ang Filipino Organization in Northern Israel ( FONI) kaupod ang bilog nga Filipino Community sa Israel para sa pamilya sang ni Menahem.
english: The Filipino Organization in Northern Israel (FONI) together with the entire Filipino community in Israel extended their condolences to the family of Menahem.

text: Nakighinun-anon ang kapulisan sa bar owners sa Mandurriao, Iloilo City agud nga mapasiguro nga mangin safe ang mga bar-goers kadungan sang Dinagyang Festival 2026.
english: Police met with bar owners in Mandurriao, Iloilo City to ensure the safety of bar-goers during the Dinagyang Festival 2026.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Val Cambel, hepe sang Iloilo City Police Station 10, iya ginpahayag nga nakapasalig naman ang mga tag-iya nga magabulig sa pagpabilin sang kalinong kag katawhay, apang ginpahanumdom lang sa ila ang ila nga katungdanan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Val Cambel, chief of Iloilo City Police Station 10, said the owners have promised to help maintain peace and order, but they were reminded of their duty.

text: Suno kay Cambel, gina-finalize man subong ang mga aktibidad para sa bouncer training para nga ma-edukar sila kag ma-refresh ang ila ihibalo agud mahibal-an nila ang dapat himuon kag ang ila limitasyon kun may sitwasyon nga nagakinahanglan sang ila serbisyo.
english: According to Cambel, the activities for bouncer training are also being finalized to educate them and refresh their knowledge so that they know what to do and their limitations when there is a situation that requires their services.

text: Magluwas diri, handa naman ang pulis nga magserbisyo para sa festival-goers nga magatambong sa ILOmination nga kinaandan ginahiwat sa Diversion Road.
english: Besides, the police are ready to serve for the festival-goers who will attend the ILOmination which is usually held at Diversion Road.

text: Nagpangabay man ang pamunuan nga kun magkadto sa syudad agud mag-selebrar sang Dinagyang, ipaiway ang pagtuga sang gamo ukon pag-inaway ilabi na kun maka-inom.
english: The authorities also requested that when going to the city to celebrate Dinagyang, avoid causing trouble or fighting especially when drinking.

text: Ginapangabay man nga likawan ang pagsuksok sang malahalon nga alahas kag pag-expose sang gadgets ukon iban pa nga malahalon nga gamit agud nga indi maka-engganyo sang mga kawatan.
english: People are also asked to avoid wearing expensive jewelery and exposing gadgets or other expensive items so as not to encourage thieves.

text: Indi magpahilabot si President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. will not interfere.

text: kun may panibag-o nga impeachment complaint nga ipasaka batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: if there is a new impeachment complaint filed against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Suno kay Palace Press Officer Claire Castro, wala nagapatunga ang Malacañang sa sini nga bagay bangud natuon ini sa hurisdiksyon sang Kongreso.
english: Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said Malacañang does not interfere in the matter because it is under the jurisdiction of Congress.

text: Apang suno kay Castro, ginasulit sang Palasyo ang panindugan nga luyag sang presidente nga manabat kun sin-o ang dapat nga manabat.
english: But Castro said the Palace reiterates its position that the president wants to hold who should be held accountable.

text: “Hindi magkakaroon ng pagkakaisa kung may naiiwang isyung dapat sagutin.
english: “There will be no unity if there is an issue left to be answered.

text: Sa ngayon, muli, hindi po sakop ng Pangulo kung sinuman po ang magsasampa ng impeachment complaint laban sa Bise Presidente,” suno sa iya.
english: Now, again, it is not up to the President who will file an impeachment complaint against the Vice President,” he said.

text: Ini nga reaksyon ang kasunod sang pahayag sang Makabayan bloc nga handa sila nga mag-endorso sang bag-o nga impeachment bid batok kay Dutete kun mag-expire na ang one-year ban sang Korte Suprema sa Pebrero.
english: This reaction follows the Makabayan bloc's statement that they are ready to endorse a new impeachment bid against Dutete when the one-year ban of the Supreme Court expires in February.

text: Sang Disyembre 2024, apat ka impeachment complaints ang gin-file batok sa vice president.

text: MALAPIT na ang midterm election 2019, sa diin mapahuway-huway anay ang eleksyon sa pagka-Presidente kag ibilin lang ang eleksyon sa pagka-senador, congressman kag iban nga lokal nga pwesto sa gobyerno – meyor, bise meyor, kag mga konsehal – sa sulod sang tatlo pa ka tuig.

text: Sa aton nga bahin, masid-ing lang seguro kita sa mga isyu nasyonal, tungod mayor ini gaapekto sa subong nga administrasyon ni Presidente Duterte.
english: For our part, we are probably focused on national issues, because they mainly affect the current administration of President Duterte.

text: In fact, matandug gid lang kita sa nasyonal nga mga isyu nga dalhon sang mga kandidato sa pagka-senador tungod sang ila man nasyonal nga “concern”.

text:

text: Sa panahon man ini ang pagkakinahanglan sa isa ka lider nga kasubong ni Duterte nga ginpamatud-an niya sa sobra 20 ka tuig nga siya meyor sang Davao.

text: Nalipat siya nga halin siya sa isa ka gamay nga lugar nga ang mga problema gamay man, samtang gahulat sa iya ang isa ka daku nga lugar nga may malawak man nga mga problema.
english: He forgot that he came from a small place with small problems, while waiting for him was a big place with big problems.

text: Kag kon halos lang siya ginasapak sa iya ginahimo sa iya gamay nga banwa, mangin-mainit na siya kay bug-os na nga pungsod ang nagapanilag sang iya mga hulag.

text: Sa pagkapogoso niya, natandug na gani ni Duterte ang pagtaha sang mga pumuluyo sa ila pagtuo (relihiyon) kag bisan sa Diyos nga gintawag pa niya nga “stupid”.
english: In his poverty, Duterte has even touched the people's respect for their faith (religion) and even for God whom he called “stupid”.

text: Tungod sina, ang iya pensar nga ang problema sa pungsod masolbar niya katulad sang pagsolbar niya sang problema sang Davao indi gali niya matuman sing basta-basta.
english: Because of that, his thought that he could solve the problem in the country like he solved the problem of Davao, he could not fulfill easily.

text: Basi siya pa ang lupigon sang sining mga problema sa droga, krimen kag korapsyon.
english: Maybe he will be overwhelmed by these problems of drugs, crime and corruption.

text: Diri na seguro masulod ang mga mabaskug nga isyu sang oposisyon sa Eleksyon 2019 – ang indi matarong nga mga insidente sang pagpamatay sang mga kriminal kag mga suspetsado sa krimen kag ang korapsyon mismo sang pila ka tauhan sang administrasyon.
english: This is probably where the strong issues of the opposition in the 2019 Election will come in – the unjust incidents of killings of criminals and crime suspects and the corruption of some administration officials.

text: Kag ngaa mabaskug ini nga isyu?

text: Sunu sa aton abyan, sa pagkadula  sang Due Process kag Rule of Law, ginakulbaan siya nga magaresulta ini sa Rule of Violence.

english: Instead of criminals defying our fair justice system when caught, they will fight because they will be killed without mercy.

text: Gintudlo niya ang nagakatabo sa Mexico, sa diin ang mga kriminal nagapakig-away na gid lang sang todo-todo sa gobyerno sa pagbalos pamatay sang mga pulis, prosecutor, mga hwes kag bisan sang ila mga pamilya, samtang nagadulot man sang kahadlok sa bisan inosente nga mga pumuluyo.

text: Ginmandu ang pag-evacuate sang masobra 700 ka mga pamilya ukon malapit 3,000 ka mga indibidwal nga nagapuyo sa sulod sang six-kilometer Permanent Danger Zone sang Bulkan Mayon sa Albay.
english: The evacuation of more than 700 families or nearly 3,000 individuals living within the six-kilometer Permanent Danger Zone of Volcano Mayon in Albay has been ordered.

text: Suno sa Office of Civil Defense sa Bicol, nagpadala na ang lokal nga pamunuan sang mga Army truck agud nga mapadasig ang paghakot sa mga residente.
english: According to the Office of Civil Defense in Bicol, the local government has already sent Army trucks to expedite the evacuation of the residents.

text: May ginbutang naman nga checkpoints sa palibot sang bulkan agud wala na sang makasulod sa permanent danger zone.
english: Checkpoints have been set up around the volcano to prevent anyone from entering the permanent danger zone.

text: Kahapon, Enero 6, sang ginpasaka sa Alert Level 3 ang status sang bulkan bangud sa pyroclastic density current ukon “uson” nga makamamatay para sa mga tawo.
english: Yesterday, January 6, when the volcano's status was raised to Alert Level 3 due to the pyroclastic density current or “uson” that is deadly for humans.

text: Suno sa Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs), ang pag-collapse sang lava dome ukon ang lava nga nagtipon kag nagtig-a sa tuktok sang Mayon, ang nagpaguwa sang pyroclastic density currents (PDCs) sa southeast side sang bulkan.
english: According to the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs), the collapse of the lava dome or the lava that accumulated and solidified at the summit of Mayon, released pyroclastic density currents (PDCs) on the southeast side of the volcano.

text: Katapusan nga napaidalom ang Mayon sa Alert Level 3 sadtong Hunyo 2023 bangud man sang effusive magmatic eruption.
english: Mayon was last placed under Alert Level 3 in June 2023 due to an effusive magmatic eruption.

text: Ang alert levels nagahalin sa 1 tubtub 5.
english: Alert levels range from 1 to 5.

text: Ang Level 5 nagakahulugan nga may yara na sang hazardous eruption.
english: Level 5 means there is already a hazardous eruption.

text: Paborito gid sang mga bata ang mga matam-is nga pagkaon kaangay sang dulce, ice cream kag madamo pa.

english: According to pediatrician Dr. Svetlana Pomeranets, only 25 grams or six teaspoons of sugar can be eaten and 8 ounces of sugar sweetened beverages per week for children aged 2 to 18 years.

text: Dugang nya, ang mga bata nga naga edad manubo sa duha ka tuig ang indi pwede magkaon sang matam-is nga pagkaon.
english: He added that children under the age of two are not allowed to eat sweet foods.

english: Pomeranets said sweet foods increase the chances of obesity, high blood pressure, type 2 diabetes and heart disease in children.

text: Nagpanugyan si Pomeranets nga wala sang malain sa pagkaon sang matam-is bangud normal lang nga nanamian ang mga kabataan sang mga nasambit nga pagkaon apang mas maayo kun mas madamo nga masustansya nga pagkaon kaangay sang prutas kag utan ang ila ginakaon.
english: Pomeranets advised that there is nothing wrong with eating sweets because it is normal for children to enjoy these foods but it is better if they eat more nutritious foods such as fruits and vegetables.

text: Sa katapusan sang hampang, ang magadaog nga team ang magadala pauli sang trophy kag iban pa nga papremyo.
english: At the end of the game, the winning team will take home the trophy and other prizes.

text: Wala sang gana si anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte nga i-upod ang iya partido nga Partido Demokratiko Pilipino (PDP) sa partido ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: Former President Rodrigo Duterte has no desire to merge his party, the Democratic Party of the Philippines (PDP), with the party of President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: nga Partido Federal ng Pilipinas (PFP).
english: Federal Party of the Philippines (PFP).

text: Suno kay Duterte, bisan mag-updanay pa ang tanan nga partido, indi na kinahanglan nga magpakig-alyansa siya kag mas malipayon siya kun isahanon na lamang.
english: According to Duterte, even if all parties work together, he does not need to form an alliance and he is happier if he is alone.

text: “Mas mabuti yung malayo kami.
english: “We better stay away.

text: Magsama-sama na kayo lahat doon.
english: You're all together there.

text: Dito lang kami.
english: We’re just here.

text: Kaya nga sabi ko sa inyo, mas maligaya ako ‘pag mag-isa na lang ako.
english: That's why I tell you, I'm happier when I'm alone.

text: Nandoon na kayo lahat,” suno sa former president.
english: You are all there,” the former president said.

text: “Kung matalo man [ang PDP], I will sink on my own.
english: “If [the PDP] loses, I will sink on my own.

text: Ako na ang lulubog mag-isa,” dugang sini.
english: I will sink alone,” he added.

text: Matandaan nga sang Huwebes, pormal na nga nakig-alyansa ang political base sang Villar Family nga Nacionalista Party sa partido ni President Marcos.
english: It can be recalled that on Thursday, the political base of the Villar Family, the Nacionalista Party, formally entered into an alliance with President Marcos' party.

text: Nagpanguna si Marcos sa ceremonial signing sang alliance agreement sa tunga sang duha ka nasambit nga mga partido sa Taguig.
english: Marcos led the ceremonial signing of the alliance agreement between the two parties in Taguig.

text: Magluwas sa Nacionalista Party, nagpirma man anay ang Partido Federal sang alliance agreements kaupod sa Lakas-CMD, Nationalist People’s Coalition, kag National Unity Party.
english: Besides the Nacionalista Party, the Federal Party also signed alliance agreements with Lakas-CMD, Nationalist People's Coalition, and National Unity Party.

text: DUHA ka dalagku nga okasyon sa sining bulan sang Setyembre ang gina-selebrar sang aton mga pumuluyo – ang National Teachers’ Month kag ang Generics Awareness Month.
english: TWO major occasions in this month of September are celebrated by our people – the National Teachers’ Month and the Generics Awareness Month.

text: Liwat nga ginapadumdum kita sang National teachers’ Month sang ka-importante sang aton mga ma’am kag sir.
english: National teachers’ Month once again reminds us of the importance of our ma’am and sir.

text: Madumduman ta naman liwat sa bulan nga ini ang pagka-martir sang aton mga manunudlo sa halos adlaw-adlaw nga pag-antos kag pag-ugtas sa mga estudyante agud lang masudlan ang ila mga ulo sang kinaalam kag matuytuyan sila sa maayo nga pamatasan bilang ikaduha nga ginikanan nila.
english: This month we remember again the martyrdom of our teachers in the almost daily suffering and persecution of students just to fill their heads with knowledge and guide them to good behavior as their second parents.

text: Madamo gani sa ila ang daku gid nga bugal sang aton pungsod.
english: Many of them are even the great pride of our country.

text: Mga baganihan ini sila sang aton mga pumuluyo sa ila paghalad sang ila pinasahe nga kabudlay kag tinion “without counting the cost” sa kawsa sang edukasyon bisan pa sa manubo kag halos makabuhi nga sueldo sang manunudlo.
english: They are heroes of our people in sacrificing their hard work and time “without counting the cost” to the cause of education despite the low and almost living wages of teachers.

text: May nagatudlo sa mga rebel returnee bisan sa padayon nila nga kulba nga ma-kidnapan sang mga kasumpong nga rebelde samtang gapakadto pakari kag naga-usoy sang mga makatalagam nga mga dalanon.
english: Some teach the rebel returnees despite their continued fear of being kidnapped by fellow rebels while traveling and exploring dangerous routes.

text: May nagalakat sang walo ka kilometro kag magsakay sa barato sa sulod sang 40 ka minutos agud lang malab-ut ang iya mga estudyante sa ila liblib nga mga lugar sa kabukiran.
english: Some walk eight kilometers and take a cheap bus for 40 minutes just to reach his students in their remote areas in the mountains.

text: May naga-street educator nga nagadala sing kinaalam sa mga street children samtang ginatulod ang isa ka kariton nga dala ang mga gamit kag mga libro niya sa pagtudlo.
english: There is a street educator who brings knowledge to street children while pushing a cart with his teaching materials and books.

text: May nagatudlo sa sulod na sang 35 anyos sa mga bulag kag nakapatapos pa sang pila sa ila sa kolehiyo.
english: Some have been teaching the blind for 35 years and have graduated some of them from college.

text: Isa gani nagtapos nga summa cum laude sa kurso nga Mathematics, kag ang isa, cum laude sa kurso nga Mass Communications.
english: One even graduated summa cum laude in Mathematics, and the other, cum laude in Mass Communications.

text: May ara gani, sa magpati kamo ukon indi, nga bulag nga maestra nga nangusog gid agud mag-alam kag nangin maestra pa sa pareho niya nga bulag.
english: There was even, believe it or not, a blind teacher who worked hard to learn and became a teacher to her fellow blind people.

text: May ginpadunggan man nga maestra paagi sa paghingadlan sang isa ka gamay nga planeta sa iya ngalan – ang Planeta Biyo.
english: A teacher was also honored by naming a small planet after her – Planeta Biyo.

text: Ini pagkilala sang iya katumtum sa pagtudlo sa siyensya sa iya mga estudyante sa Massachussetts Institute of Technology sa Estados Unidos.
english: This is in recognition of his dedication to teaching science to his students at the Massachussetts Institute of Technology in the United States.

text: Mabuhay ang aton  mga manunudlo sa sining tion sang National Teachers’ Month!
english: Long live our teachers during this National Teachers' Month!

text: Syempre, ginalakip ko man diri ang akon kaugalingon bilang isa man ka nangin kubos nga manunudlo sa kabuhi ni Dr. Jose Rizal sa kolehiyo sa University of Iloilo (UI) kag sang Mathematics sa Iloilo City (Molo) Natonal High school bag-o gin-agaw ang akon interest sang abogasiya.
english: Of course, I also include myself here as having also been a humble mentor in Dr. Rodriguez’s life. Jose Rizal in college at the University of Iloilo (UI) and Mathematics at Iloilo City (Molo) Natonal High School before taking over my interest in law.

text: Wala ko ugaling matapos ang abogasiya tungod sa Marcos Martial Law.
english: However, I did not finish law because of the Marcos Martial Law.

text: Nagtipyok na gid lang ako sang ulihi sa radio broadcasting kag pagsulat sa pamantalaan diri sa rehiyon tubtub sa karon.
english: I later focused on radio broadcasting and newspaper writing here in the region until now.

text: Mabuhay ang aton mga manunudlo!
english: Long live our teachers!

text:
***

Gina-selebrar man naton sa sining bulan sang Setyembre ang Generics Awareness Month sa tema nga “Tatlong Dekada: Generics, Abot Kamay…Abot Kaya!”

Pagdumdum ining selebrasyon sang pagpirma ni anay Presidente Cory Aquino sang Republic Act No.
english:
***

We are also celebrating Generics Awareness Month this September with the theme “Three Decades: Generics, Affordable...Affordable!”

This celebration commemorates the signing of Republic Act No.

text: 6675, ukon ang Generics Act of 1988, sadtong Setyembre 13, 1988.
english: 6675, or the Generics Act of 1988, on September 13, 1988.

text: Gapadumdum man ini sa abyan ta nga si Congressman Narciso Dolar Monfort, M.D., ang principal author sang Generics Law kag sang iban pa nga kasuguan sa ikaayong lawas katulad sang Magna Carta for Public Health Workers, Philippine Nursing Law, Miwifery Act of 1992, kag iban pa.
english: This also reminds us of our friend Congressman Narciso Dolar Monfort, M.D., the principal author of the Generics Law and other health laws such as the Magna Carta for Public Health Workers, Philippine Nursing Law, Miwifery Act of 1992, and others.

text: Ginpasangkad man ni Dr. Monfort ang medicare coverage agud masakop ang mga mangunguma, drayber, vendors, kag self-employed workers nga wala mahimo sang subong nga congressman nga si Dr. Ferjenel Biron.
english: He also expanded on Dr. Monfort urged medicare coverage to cover farmers, drivers, vendors, and self-employed workers that incumbent congressman Dr. Ferjenel Biron.

text:
***

Isa ka importante nga provision sang Generics Law amo ang pagpaseguro sang bastante nga supply sang mga barato nga mga bulong nga “generic” nga may pareho nga epekto kag benepisyo sangsa mas mahal nga branded nga mga bulong.
english:
***

An important provision of the Generics Law is to ensure a sufficient supply of affordable “generic” drugs that have the same efficacy and benefits over more expensive branded drugs.

text: Ang “generic” nga mga bulong ginkopya lang ini sa mga branded nga mga bulong sa pagpahanugot man sang kasuguan sang mag-expire na ang ila patent.
english: “Generic” drugs were just copied into branded drugs to allow the law when their patent expired.

text: Sa Estados Unidos kag sa Pilipinas, ang patent sang isa ka bulong nagadangat sa 20 anyos.
english: In the United States and the Philippines, the patent of a drug lasts for 20 years.

text: Sa sining pag-selebrar sang Generics Awareness Month, padayon nga ginapasalig sang aton Department of Health, paagi sa Food and Drugs Administration (FDA), nga ang ining mga “generics” nagaabot sa aton mga botika nga dala ang kapareho nga kalidad kag benepisyo sa branded nga bulong luas nga mas barato ini.
english: In this celebration of Generics Awareness Month, our Department of Health, through the Food and Drugs Administration (FDA), continues to assure that these generics come to our pharmacies with the same quality and benefits as branded drugs besides being cheaper.
