english: Cruz Regional Trial Court sentenced Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) player John Amores and his brother who were involved in a shooting incident in Laguna.

text: Pananglitan makalusot ang reklamo nga attempted murder, mahimo nga kaso, kag madutlan ang mga ginreklamo, ang mag-utod nga Amores ang maga-atubang sang anum tubtub dose ka tuig nga pagka-preso.
english: If the attempted murder complaint survives, a possible case, and the complainants are arrested, the Amores brothers will face six to 12 years in prison.

text: Amo man ini ang makabig nga posible “premature end” sang basketball career ni Amores nga subong 24-anyos pa lamang.
english: This is also considered a possible “premature end” to the basketball career of Amores, who is now only 24 years old.

text: Nag-ugat ang insidente sa isa ka basketball game sa Laguna kun sa diin may baisay nga natabo sa Barangay Maytalang Uno sa Lumban.
english: The incident stemmed from a basketball game in Laguna where an argument broke out in Barangay Maytalang Uno in Lumban.

text: Pasado alas sais sang gab-i sang Miyerkules sang nagpalupok si Amores sang pusil kag gintuyo nga iguon ang kontra sini nga si Lee Cacalda.
english: Around 6 pm on Wednesday, Amores fired his gun and tried to hit his opponent, Lee Cacalda.

text: Maswerte nga wala sang samad ang biktima apang nakit-an gid sa CCTV kun ano kadasig ang pagtal-as sini sang nagpalupok na ang suspek.
english: Fortunately, the victim was not injured but CCTV footage showed how fast he ran when the suspect opened fire.

text: Alas dos sang kaagahon kahapon sang nagsungka ang mag-utod sa otoridad bangud sa ginaalegar mga pamahog sa ila kabuhi.
english: The brothers surrendered to the authorities at 2 am yesterday due to alleged threats to their lives.

text: Suno sa basketball player, ginhaboy na nila ang pusil matapos ang shooting incident.
english: According to the basketball player, they threw away the gun after the shooting incident.

text: Wala pa sang kabug-usan nga statement kag desisyon ang PBA sa status ni Amores bangud nagapadayon pa ang imbestigasyon, apang nagpahayag si PBA commissioner Willie Marcial nga nasubuan gid sila sa nagluntad nga insidente.
english: The PBA has yet to issue a full statement and decision on the status of Amores as the investigation is still ongoing, but PBA commissioner Willie Marcial said they are deeply saddened by the incident.

text: Sang 2022, matandaan nga ginpiyestahan man ang pangalan ni Amores bangud estudyante pa lamang ini sa Jose Rizal University (JRU), nangtapungol na ini sang kasumpong nga players halin sa College of St.
english: In 2022, Amores' name was also celebrated because he was still a student at Jose Rizal University (JRU), he beat opposing players from the College of St.

text: ILOILO CITY- Normal lang nga sa isa ka pamilya may yara gid ya sang grabe kun maghuragok.
english: ILOILO CITY- It's normal for a family to have something serious when they hug.

text: Kun kaisa, maham-ot ka apang kun kaisa, maugot ka man ilabi na kun ikaw indi na matulugan bangud sa ila paghuragok.
english: Sometimes, you feel good but sometimes, you get angry especially if you can't sleep because of their hugging.

text: Apang didto sa Jordan, may yara sang isa ka pamilya nga bangud sa huragok, nagresulta pa sa pag-diborsyo sang mag-asawa.
english: But in Jordan, there was a family that because of the huragok, resulted in the divorce of the couple.

text: Ini matapos nga gin-kuhaan sang video sang isa ka asawa ang nagahuragok nga nanay sang iya bana.
english: This was after a wife took a video of her husband's mother hugging him.

text: Gin-upload niya ini sa social media nga ginkaakig naman sang bana.
english: She uploaded it on social media which angered her husband.

text: Bangud sini, nag-file sang divorce ang lalaki kag natigayon gid ang ila pagbulagay.
english: As a result, the man filed for divorce and their separation was finally achieved.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang 2016, ang Jordan ang may pinakamataas nga divorce rate sa Middle East, kag base sa Department of Statistics,ang numero sang divorces sang 2016 ang yara sa 21,969 gikan sa 1,000 sang 2011.
english: In 2016, Jordan had the highest divorce rate in the Middle East, and based on the Department of Statistics, the number of divorces in 2016 was 21,969 from 1,000 in 2011.

text: Magarampa bilang isa sa official candidates sa Miss Universe New Zealand 2024 si anay Miss Universe Philippines Charity Victoria Velasquez Vincent ukon kilala bilang si VVV.
english: Former Miss Universe Philippines Charity Victoria Velasquez Vincent or known as VVV will compete as one of the official candidates for Miss Universe New Zealand 2024.

text: Sa iya Instagram broadcast channel, gin-anunsyo sini nga mangin kabahin siya sang amo nga pageant bilang paagi sa paghatag-dungog sa heritage sang iya amay.
english: On her Instagram broadcast channel, she announced that she would be a part of that pageant as a way to honor her father’s heritage.

text: “I’ve always been proud of being mixed race.
english: “I’ve always been proud of being mixed race.

text: I’m a symbol of my parent’s love, which endured so much discrimination back when they first got together,” pahayag sini.
english: I’m a symbol of my parent’s love, which endured so much discrimination back when they first got together,” she said.

text: “Time to honor my dad’s side of my heritage and the country where I took my first step, spoke my first word, had my first heartbreak and earned my double master’s degree I never shut up about,” dugang ni VVV.
english: “Time to honor my dad’s side of my heritage and the country where I took my first step, spoke my first word, had my first heartbreak and earned my double master’s degree I never shut up about,” VVV added.

text: Apang ginplastar sini nga indi gid madula sa iya ang iya Filipino roots: “Mahal kong Pilipinas, lagi kayong nasa puso ko.
english: But he stressed that he will never lose his Filipino roots: “My dear Philippines, you are always in my heart.

text:
Kahit saan, Kahit kailan.”

Nahibaluan nga yara sa bag-o nga management ang Miss Universe organization sa amo nga pungsod.

Anywhere, Anytime.”

The Miss Universe organization in the country is under new management.

text: Antes ang anunsyo ni VVV, ginkumpirma na nga ang Filipino Kiwi model-turned-actress nga si Franki Russell ang magatiglawas sang amo nga pungsod sa idalom sang Yugen PR management apang nag-withdraw ini sang ang local license holder sang Miss Universe New Zealand ang nag-cancel sang franchise bangud sa indi pag-comply sa specific order sang organization.
english: Before VVV’s announcement, it had been confirmed that Filipino Kiwi model-turned-actress Franki Russell would represent that country under Yugen PR management but she withdrew when the local license holder of Miss Universe New Zealand canceled the franchise for not complying with the organization’s specific order.

text: Patigayunon ang koronasyon sa amo nga pageant sa September 29 sa Dorothy Winstone Centre Performing Arts Theatre.
english: The coronation of the pageant will be held on September 29 at the Dorothy Winstone Center Performing Arts Theatre.

text: Si Victoria nga nabun-ag kag nagdaku sa New Zealand ang nag-compete diri sa Pilipinas sang 2021 kun sa diin nakuha sini ang title nga Miss Universe Philippines Charity sang ginrepresentar ang Cavite.
english: Victoria, who was born and raised in New Zealand, competed here in the Philippines in 2021 where she won the title of Miss Universe Philippines Charity when she represented Cavite.

text: Sa recent edition sang Miss Universe Philippines, gintiglawas sini ang Bacoor City kag nagtapos sa semi-final round.
english: In the recent edition of Miss Universe Philippines, she represented Bacoor City and finished in the semi-final round.

text: Nakapamati na bala ang tanan sa “Christmas in Our Hearts”?
english: Has everyone listened to “Christmas in Our Hearts”?

text: Basta magsugod na gani ang ber months, awtomatiko na dayon nga nagatukar ini nga musika nga himo sang Ilonggo singer-songwriter nga si Jose Mari Chan!
english: As soon as the ber months start, this music by Ilonggo singer-songwriter Jose Mari Chan automatically plays!

text: Kaangot diri, isa ka musical nga maga-feature sa music ni Chan ang iga-stage sa maabot nga Nobyembre.
english: In this regard, a musical featuring Chan's music will be staged in November.

text: Suno sa Filipino theater company nga Repertory Philippines, ang musical nga “Going Home To Christmas: A Jose Mari Chan Musical” ang patigayunon sa Nobyembre 29 sa Carlos P. Romulo Auditorium sa RCBC Plaza sa Makati.
english: According to Filipino theater company Repertory Philippines, the musical “Going Home To Christmas: A Jose Mari Chan Musical” will be held on November 29 at the Carlos P. Romulo Auditorium at RCBC Plaza in Makati.

text:
Indi lamang sa Yuletide hit nga “Christmas in Our Hearts” kilala si Chan kundi mangin sa iya hit songs nga “Afraid for Love to Fade,” “Can’t We Start Over Again,” “Please Be Careful With My Heart,” “Can We Just Stop and Talk Awhile,” kag “Beautiful Girl.”

Siya ang naga-uyat sang record sa best-selling albums sa Philippine music history nga amo ang Christmas in Our Hearts (1990) sa number one, kag ginasundan sang iya 1989 record nga Constant Change.
english:
Chan is not only known for the Yuletide hit “Christmas in Our Hearts” but also for his hit songs “Afraid for Love to Fade,” “Can’t We Start Over Again,” “Please Be Careful With My Heart,” “Can We Just Stop and Talk Awhile,” and “Beautiful Girl.”

He holds the record for best-selling albums in Philippine music history with Christmas in Our Hearts (1990) at number one, followed by his 1989 record Constant Change.

text: Nahibaluan nga tinuig na nga popular ang musicals sa Pilipinas nga naga-sentro sa discography sang Pinoy artists.
english: It is known that musicals have been popular in the Philippines for years that focus on the discography of Pinoy artists.

english: These include the Rak of Aegis featuring Aegis; Here You Are!

text: Sug-alawon sang mga Pinoy ang Bag-ong Tuig nga wala sang mangin pagsaka sa presyo sa flight tickets.
english: Filipinos will welcome the New Year without any increase in flight ticket prices.

text: Santo ini sa gin-anunsyo sang Civil Aeronautics Board (CAB) nga wala sang pagbag-o sa fuel surcharge — buot silingon, ika-apat na nga sunod-sunod nga bulan na nga yara ini sa Level 4.
english: This is in line with the announcement by the Civil Aeronautics Board (CAB) that there is no change in the fuel surcharge — meaning that it is at Level 4 for the fourth consecutive month.

text: Base sa matrix, ang Level 4 nagakahulugan nga maka-kolekta ang airlines sang fuel surcharge nga P117 to P342 para sa domestic flights apang depende sa distansya.
english: Based on the matrix, Level 4 means that airlines can collect a fuel surcharge of P117 to P342 for domestic flights but depending on the distance.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, mahimo naman masukot ang fuel surcharge nga P385.7 and P2,867.82 para sa international flights.
english: On the other hand, fuel surcharge of P385.7 and P2,867.82 can be charged for international flights.

text: Ginapahanugutan ang airlines nga magsukot sang fuel surcharge agud nga makabangon man sila sa mahal nga petroleum costs nga mas nagataas pa gid bangud sa price fluctuations sa international market.
english: Airlines are allowed to charge fuel surcharge so that they can also recover from the expensive petroleum costs that are increasing due to price fluctuations in the international market.

text: Ginatumod sang ahensya ang fuel surcharge base sa monthly average sang jet fuel kag mahimo magsaka ukon magnubo depende sa price movements.
english: The agency determines the fuel surcharge based on the monthly average of jet fuel and can increase or decrease depending on price movements.

text: Kun magkaon ka sang lubi ukon niyog, ano ang imu paborito nga parte?
english: When you eat a coconut, what is your favorite part?

text: Ang unod?
english: The flesh?

text: ang iya juice ukon ang iya gata nga gina sahog sa sud-an?
english: its juice or its milk that is added to the dish?

text: Kun ano kadako ang niyog amo man kadako kag kadamo nga nutrisyon ang sarang mo makuha sa ini nga prutas.
english: The bigger the coconut, the bigger and more nutrition you can get from this fruit.

text: Indi kaangay sang iban nga prutas nga mataas ang carbohydrates, ang niyog may yara sang mas madamo nga fats.
english: Unlike other fruits that are high in carbohydrates, coconut contains more fats.

text: Suno kay Anne Danahy, isa ka registered dietician ang lubi ang may yara  sang protein kag mataas ang manganese sini nga makabulig sa aton nga bone health, metabolism kag carbohydrates.
english: According to Anne Danahy, a registered dietician, coconut is rich in protein and manganese that helps us with bone health, metabolism and carbohydrates.

text: Manggaranon man ini sa copper kag iron nga maayo sa aton red blood cells, selenium kag importante amo ang antioxidant nga makaprotekta sa aton cells.
english: It is also rich in copper and iron which are good for our red blood cells, selenium and importantly antioxidants that can protect our cells.

text: Madamo pa nga mga benipisyo kag nutrisyon ang sarang naton makuha sa lubi, humalin sa unod tubtob sa duga.
english: There are many other benefits and nutrition that we can get from the coconut, from the flesh to the juice.

text: MABUDLAY matuod sa mga ordinaryo nga mga pumuluyo ang maghangop sa mga mangin-alamon – labi na gid kon ang ginahambalan amo ang ila madalom nga panghuna-huna kag tinun-an, katulad sang mga engineer, accountant, mathematician, economics professor, kag abogado.
english: IT IS difficult for ordinary people to understand the wise – especially when it comes to their deep thinking and learning, such as engineers, accountants, mathematicians, economics professors, and lawyers.

text: Isa ka problema, por ejemplo sa Mathematics amo ang problema sang pagpalumba ni Achilles nga atleta kag sang mahinay kaayo nga bao (Zeno’s Paradox) gamit ang “fractions” (1/10, 1/100, 1/1,000, etc.) bilang solusyon.
english: One problem, for example in Mathematics is the problem of the race of Achilles the athlete and the very slow bao (Zeno's Paradox) using “fractions” (1/10, 1/100, 1/1,000, etc.) as a solution.

text: Kon ini ang gamiton nga solusyon (fractions), si Achilles indi gid kalab-ut tubtub san-o sa bao.
english: If this is used as a solution (fractions), Achilles will never reach the bao.

text: Man, kon ang bao may headstart nga 10 ka metro kag gasunod si Achilles sa bao sing 1/10 ka metro kada minuto, mientras tanto yara gihapon ang bao sa unahan sing 1/10 sang malab-ut ni Achilles.
english: Also, if the bao has a headstart of 10 meters and Achilles follows the bao at 1/10 meter per minute, meanwhile the bao is still ahead by 1/10 of Achilles' reach.

text: Of course, kon maisipan mo nga ang solusyon gali paagi sa “equational values” ukon sa aktwal mismo nga sitwasyon, wala gid man gali sing problema.
english: Of course, if you think that the solution is actually through “equational values” or the actual situation itself, there is no problem.

text: Sa isa man ka ejemplo sang makalilibug nga problema, may isa nga luyag magbawi sang iya kotse nga nagdangop sa husgado.
english: In another example of a perplexing problem, someone who wanted to get his car back went to court.

text: Sa padayon nga pagbinaisay sang iya abogado kag sang kontra, naglibug na ang ulo sang tag-iya sang kotse.
english: With the continuous argument between his lawyer and the opponent, the owner of the car became confused.

text: Siling sang nagdaug sa kaso nga tag-iya sang kotse sa iya abogado: “Abe mo, Attorney sadtong gasugod pa lang ang aton kaso segurado ko gid nga ako ang tag-iya sang kotse.
english: The winning car owner said to his lawyer: “You know, Attorney, when our case started, I was sure that I was the owner of the car.

text: Pero sang sige ang binaisay, kag nagdaug na kita, daw galibug na ang akon ulo.
english: But when the argument went on, and we won, I felt confused.

text:
Daw indi ko na segurado nga ako gid ang tag-iya sang kotse nga gindaug ta sa kaso…”

***

Daw amo man gani karon ang aton ginapaligban sa kaso nga amnestiya batok kay Senador Antonio Trillanes IV ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte.
english:
I'm not sure I'm the owner of the car we won in the case...”

***

It seems that we are now concerned about the amnesty case against Senator Antonio Trillanes IV by President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Ang pagbinaisay sa subong sa tunga ni Duterte nga isa ka abogado kag sang iya kadampig nga mga abogado, kag sang mga abogado ni Trillanes isa sa karon sa mainit nga isyu sa tunga sang mga pumuluyo.
english: The current dispute between Duterte, a lawyer, and his lawyers, and Trillanes' lawyers is one of the hot issues among the people.

text: Nagsugod ining problema sang nagpagwa si Duterte sang Presidential Proclamation 572 nga gapahayag nga ang amnestiya ni Trillanes indi balido, ukon “ab initio” gid gani, ukon wala epekto sa pagsugod pa lang.
english: The problem began when Duterte issued Presidential Proclamation 572 declaring that Trillanes' amnesty was invalid, or even “ab initio”, or had no effect at the outset.

text: Ini nga amnestiya para kay Trillanes ginpanaog ni anay Presidente Benigno Aquino III sa iya Proclamation 75 sa kay Trillanes, Brig.
english: This amnesty for Trillanes was issued by former President Benigno Aquino III in his Proclamation 75 to Trillanes, Brig.

text: Gen.
english: Gen.

text: Danilo Lim kag 25 pa ka opisyales angot sa Oakwood Mutiny sadtong Hulyo 27, 2003 batok sa anay Presidente Gloria Arroyo.
english: Danilo Lim and 25 other officials in connection with the Oakwood Mutiny on July 27, 2003 against former President Gloria Arroyo.

text: Sa karon, nagapabilin si Trillanes sa proteksyon sang Senado agud indi siya madakop kon maggwa ini sa Senado, samtang ginatun-an sang Korte Suprema kon balido ukon indi ang Presidential Proclamation 572 ni Duterte batok sa iya.
english: At present, Trillanes remains under the protection of the Senate so that he will not be arrested if he leaves the Senate, while the Supreme Court is studying whether Duterte's Presidential Proclamation 572 against him is valid or not.

text:
***

Medyo galingin ang ulo sang mga pumuluyo sa sining akusasyon ni Duterte sa kay Trillanes.
english:
***

The people are a little confused by Duterte's accusation against Trillanes.

text: Una, ngaa si Trillanes lang ang ipa-aresto ni Duterte samtang mga 27 ining mga mutineers?
english: First, why should Duterte arrest only Trillanes when there are about 27 mutineers?

text: Dason, sa sige na nga pag-binaisay, gintugyan na ni Duterte ang pag-isyu sang warrant of arrest kay Trillanes sa Korte Suprema, apang wala magsalig sini si Trillanes kag nagpabilin sa Senado.
english: Then, in the ongoing dispute, Duterte handed over the issuance of the warrant of arrest to Trillanes to the Supreme Court, but Trillanes did not trust it and remained in the Senate.

text: Sa una nga akusasyon, ginsiling ni Duterte nga ang amnesty nga gin-isyu ni Aquino sang 2011 indi balido tungod wala nag-comply si Trillanes sa “minimum requirements to qualify under the amnesty proclamation” tungod wala man gani makita ang iya application for amnesty.
english: In the first accusation, Duterte said the amnesty issued by Aquino in 2011 was invalid because Trillanes did not comply with the “minimum requirements to qualify under the amnesty proclamation” because his application for amnesty was not even seen.

text: Wala man kuno si Trillanes nag-aku sang iya sala angot sa Oakwood Mutiny kag iban pa nga akusasyon.
english: Trillanes also pleaded not guilty to the Oakwood Mutiny and other charges.

text: Sang maggwa ang kopya sang Proclamation 75, kag ang media coverage, nakita na diri ang iya application kag deklarasyon sang pag-aku sang iya sala, upod sang iya kaupdanan sa Oakwood Mutiny.
english: When a copy of Proclamation 75 came out, and the media coverage, it showed his application and declaration of confession, along with his accomplices in the Oakwood Mutiny.

text: May lusot naman ugaling ang Palasyo.
english: However, the Palace has a loophole.

text: Siling nila sa certification of amnesty nga ginpadala sa Kongreso, si anay Defense Secretary Voltaire Gazmin ni Presidente Aquino lang ang nag-pirma sa sini nga dokumento.
english: They said in the certification of amnesty sent to Congress, only former Defense Secretary Voltaire Gazmin of President Aquino signed this document.

text: Dapat kuno ang Presidente gid ang mapirma, kag indi lang ang kon sin-o nga tal-os sa Presidente.
english: The President should sign, and not just whoever is the President's successor.

text: Well, inabogado ini nga problema.
english: Well, this problem is lawyered.

text: Ang masiling ko lang nga sa corporate organization duha ka klase ang pag-delegar sang poder – paagi sa ordinaryo nga delegasyon kag ang paghatag gid sing lubos nga poder (empowerment) sa isa ka empleyado, katulad sang pagpirma sang papeles “in behalf” sa Presidente sang korporasyon, “indisposed” man siya ukon may masakit ukon wala.
english: I can only say that in a corporate organization there are two types of delegation of power – through ordinary delegation and the actual empowerment of an employee, such as signing papers “in behalf” of the President of the corporation, whether he is “indisposed” or sick or not.

english: (w_mateojr@yahoo.com/PN)

text: Gindayaw sang mga senador ang pagpirma ni President Bongbong Marcos sang P6.793 trillion nga 2026 national budget amo man ang pag-veto sini sang halos P92.5 billion nga balor sang mga proyekto sa idalom sang unprogrammed appropriations (UAs).
english: The senators praised President Bongbong Marcos' signing of the P6.793 trillion 2026 national budget as well as his veto of nearly P92.5 billion worth of projects under unprogrammed appropriations (UAs).

text: Suno kay Senate President Vicente “Tito” Sotto III, ang 2026 budget amo ang pinakamalimpyo nga budget, apang luyag pa gid sang presidente nga mas mangin matinlo ini.
english: According to Senate President Vicente “Tito” Sotto III, the 2026 budget is the cleanest budget ever, but the president still wants it to be cleaner.

text: Ginsiling ni Sotto nga husto ang desisyon sang president nga i-veto ang pila ka items.
english: Sotto said the president's decision to veto some items was right.

text: “I know the 2026 budget is by far the cleanest ever but it seems the President wants it squeaky clean.
english: “I know the 2026 budget is by far the cleanest ever but it seems the President wants it squeaky clean.

text: He even highlighted the Senate provision that prevents political patronage by politicians,” suno kay Sotto.
english: He even highlighted the Senate provision that prevents political patronage by politicians,” Sotto said.

text:
“Malinis yun budget pero gusto ni PBBM mas malinis pa.”

Para naman kay Senator Erwin Tulfo, Vice Chairperson sang Senate Finance Committee, amo ini ang “most transparent budget law” sa recent history sang Pilipinas.
english:
“That budget is clean but PBBM wants to be cleaner.”

For Senator Erwin Tulfo, Vice Chairperson of the Senate Finance Committee, this is the “most transparent budget law” in the recent history of the Philippines.

text: Amo ini ang budget suno sa iya nga makabalik sang salig sang publiko sa gobyerno.
english: This is the budget, he said, that will restore public confidence in the government.

text: Gindayaw man sini ang pag-veto sa pila ka items sa unprogrammed funds bangud ginapatihan sini nga mahimo ini gamiton sa misuse.
english: He also praised the veto of some items in the unprogrammed funds because he believes they can be used for misuse.

text: “This is what we need, a budget that will restore the public’s trust to the government.
english: “This is what we need, a budget that will restore the public’s trust to the government.

text: We are grateful that the President heeded our call to limit the use of unprogrammed appropriations and vetoed P92.5 billion worth of projects lodged under this budgetary mechanism,” kabahin sang iya nga statement.
english: We are grateful that the President heeded our call to limit the use of unprogrammed appropriations and vetoed P92.5 billion worth of projects lodged under this budgetary mechanism,” he said in a statement.

text: Gin-abi-abi naman ni Senator Bam Aquino ang budget signing.
english: Senator Bam Aquino welcomed the budget signing.

text: Ginhatagan sini sang pagtamod ang kinahanglanon nga bulig sang sector sang edukasyon lakip na ang pagtukod sang classrooms, dugang nga pondo sa school-based feeding program kag libre nga kolehiyo, kag iban pa nga suporta sa mga estudyante.
english: He highlighted the need for assistance from the education sector including the construction of classrooms, additional funding to the school-based feeding program and free college, and other support to students.

text: “Panalo ang kabataang Pilipino ngayong naaprubahan na ang 2026 national budget.
english: “Filipino youth are victorious now that the 2026 national budget has been approved.

text: Sa pamamagitan nito, mapopondohan na at maipatutupad nang tama ang mga mahahalagang programang makatutulong upang mapalakas at mapabuti ang sektor ng edukasyon,” suno kay Aquino.
english: Through this, important programs that will help strengthen and improve the education sector can be funded and implemented properly,” Aquino said.

text: Malipayon naman kag kuntento si Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo sa veto.
english: Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo is happy and satisfied with the veto.

text: Gin-abi-abi man sini ang mensahe sang presidente nga dumilian na ang involvement sang pulitika sa pagpanagtag sang assistance.
english: He also welcomed the president's message to ban political involvement in the distribution of assistance.

text: Sa pagpirma ni Marcos sa Republic Act No.
english: With Marcos signing Republic Act No.

text: 12314 ukon ang 2026 General Appropriations Act kahapon sa Malacañang, ginsiling sini nga ang veto nagatuyo nga masigurado nga magasto ang pondo sang gobyerno santo sa kun ano ang prayoridad sang national government kag kun ano ang interes sang nasyon.
english: 12314 or the 2026 General Appropriations Act yesterday in Malacañang, he said the veto aims to ensure that government funds are spent in accordance with the priorities of the national government and the interests of the nation.

text: Mangin maulanon kag magal-umon ang madamo nga parte sang pungsod bangud sang nanuhay-tuhay nga weather systems.
english: Rainy and cloudy weather is expected in many parts of the country due to various weather systems.

text: Suno sa state weather bureau, ang nagaapekto subong sa Pilipinas amo ang shear line sa eastern section sang Southern Luzon, Northeast Monsoon ukon amihan sa nabilin nga bahin sang Luzon, kag easterlies sa nabilin nga bahin sang pungsod.
english: According to the state weather bureau, the Philippines is currently affected by shear line in the eastern section of Southern Luzon, Northeast Monsoon in the rest of Luzon, and easterlies in the rest of the country.

text: Sa Visayas, posible ang flash floods kag ang pagtiphag sang duta bangud sang kasarangan tubtub mamunog nga pag-ulan.
english: In the Visayas, flash floods and landslides are possible due to moderate to heavy rains.

text: May Low Pressure Area (LPA) nga na-monitor sa guwa sang Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) partikular sa 725 km nabagatnan-nakatundan sang Pagasa Island, Kalayaan, Palawan.
english: A Low Pressure Area (LPA) was monitored outside the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR) particularly 725 km southwest of Pagasa Island, Kalayaan, Palawan.

text: Suno sa weather bureau, posible nga indi ini mag-develop sa bagyo.
english: According to the weather bureau, it is unlikely to develop into a hurricane.

text: Nagadala ang trough sini sang magal-umon nga tyempo kag lapta-lapta nga pag-ulan kag thunderstorms sa Zamboanga Peninsula, Basilan, Tawi-Tawi, kag Palawan.#
english: Its trough is bringing cloudy weather with patchy rain and thunderstorms over the Zamboanga Peninsula, Basilan, Tawi-Tawi, and Palawan.#

text: Nagwa sa survey nga ginpatigayon sang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) nga kalabanan sa mga Filipinos ang nagasuporta sa polymerization sang Philippine banknotes.
english: A survey conducted by the Central Bank of the Philippines (BSP) showed that most Filipinos support the polymerization of Philippine banknotes.

text: Suno sa BSP, nagwa sa first quarter sang ila Consumer Expectation Survey nga 61.3% sang respondents ang nagasuporta sa polymerization sang Philippine banknotes, nga mas mataas sang 10.9% sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: According to the BSP, the first quarter of its Consumer Expectation Survey revealed that 61.3% of respondents support the polymerization of Philippine banknotes, up from 10.9% last year.

text: “The introduction this month of new polymer banknote denominations — namely, 500- 100-, and 50-piso notes — followed studies that show the smarter, cleaner, and stronger characteristics of polymer banknotes,” pahayag sang BSP.
english: “The introduction this month of new polymer banknote denominations — namely, 500- 100-, and 50-piso notes — followed studies that show the smarter, cleaner, and stronger characteristics of polymer banknotes,” the BSP said.

text: Una diri, ginpagwa sang central bank ang bag-o nga polymer banknotes nga ginalakipan sang P500, P100, kag P50, sa diin makit-an ang mga imahe sang native kag protected species, mangin ang local weave designs.
english: Earlier, the central bank released new polymer banknotes that include P500, P100, and P50, which feature images of native and protected species, as well as local weave designs.

text: Ang bag-o nga polymer banknote denominations ang mangin available sa limitado nga quantities sa Greater Manila Area subong nga Disyembre, apang mangin fully available sa first quarter sang 2025.
english: The new polymer banknote denominations will be available in limited quantities in the Greater Manila Area this December, but will be fully available in the first quarter of 2025.

text: Magabalik si anay Miss Universe Organization president Paula Shugart sa pageant scene paagi sa pagpungko bilang judge sa Miss Cosmo International 2024.
english: Former Miss Universe Organization president Paula Shugart will return to the pageant scene by sitting as a judge at Miss Cosmo International 2024.

text: Gin-anunsyo sang international pageant ang partisipasyon sini paagi sa pag-cite sa iya impressive career pareho sa beauty pageant kag television production.
english: The international pageant announced its participation by citing her impressive career both in beauty pageant and television production.

text: Magluwas sa shows sa major networks kaangay sang ABC, NBC, MTV, kag Columbia Pictures, miyembro man si Paula sang Director’s Guild of America kag Producers Guild of America.
english: In addition to shows on major networks such as ABC, NBC, MTV, and Columbia Pictures, Paula is also a member of the Director’s Guild of America and the Producers Guild of America.

text: Nakabaton siya sang Medal of Merit for Achievement in Entertainment and Television Production kag commissioner sang Latin Media and Entertainment Commission sa New York City.
english: He received the Medal of Merit for Achievement in Entertainment and Television Production and is commissioner of the Latin Media and Entertainment Commission in New York City.

text: Matandaan nga nagpanaog sa pwesto si Paula sang Nobyembre kadungan sang preliminary competition sang 72nd Miss Universe pageant sa El Salvador.
english: Paula stepped down in November during the preliminary competition of the 72nd Miss Universe pageant in El Salvador.

text: Kun balikan, nag-upod siya sang 1998 bilang vice president sang production sa Miss Universe organization kag tatlo ka tuig ang nagligad, siya ang nangin presidente.
english: He joined the Miss Universe organization in 1998 as vice president of production and three years later, he became president.

text: Gin-uyatan niya ang entire business operations kag ginpangunahan ang production sang tuigan nga live global telecast.
english: He handled entire business operations and led the production of the annual live global telecast.

text: Patigayunon ang Miss Cosmo 2024 pageant sa September 15th to October 5th sa Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.
english: The Miss Cosmo 2024 pageant will be held from September 15th to October 5th in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

text: Si Ahtisa Manalo amo ang tiglawas sang Pilipinas.
english: Ahtisa Manalo is the representative of the Philippines.

text: Naghimo sang iya basketball comeback si Joe Devance matapos ang duha ka tuig nga pagpahuway.
english: Joe Devance made his basketball comeback after a two-year break.

text: Sa iya pagbalik, liwat ini nga magaupod sa Barangay Ginebra San Miguel Kings antes ang PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals.
english: Upon his return, he will again join the Barangay Ginebra San Miguel Kings before the PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals.

text: Ang forward halin sa Escalante City, Negros Occidental, ang nag-anunsyo sang iya pagbalik sa Gin Kings paagi sa social media post kahapon sang hapon.
english: The forward from Escalante City, Negros Occidental, announced his return to the Gin Kings through a social media post yesterday afternoon.

text: Ang pagbalik sang 42-anyos nga si Devance ang timing gid agud mapabaskog ang maluya nga frontline sang Gin Kings kasunod sang injuries nanday Jeremiah Gray, Jamie Malonzo, kag George Isaac Go.
english: The return of 42-year-old Devance is timed just right to bolster the Gin Kings’ weak frontline following injuries to Jeremiah Gray, Jamie Malonzo, and George Isaac Go.

text: Ang 6-foot-7 nga si Devance ang una na nagtapos sang iya 16-year PBA career sang June 2022, nga nagbiya sa professional league nga may 12 championships, sa idalom tanan ni Gin Kings head coach Tim Cone.
english: The 6-foot-7 Devance previously ended his 16-year PBA career in June 2022, leaving the professional league with 12 championships, all under Gin Kings head coach Tim Cone.

text: Ang Gin Kings magaatubang sa Meralco Bolts sa best-of-five quarterfinals umpisa sa Septyembre 27, sa Ninoy Aquino Stadium sa Manila.
english: The Gin Kings will face the Meralco Bolts in the best-of-five quarterfinals starting September 27, at the Ninoy Aquino Stadium in Manila.

text: GINAKASUBO gid naton ang pagtaliwan ni Danny Fajardo, 72, founder kag editor/publisher sang Panay News, ang nagapanguna nga rehiyonal nga daily sa English diri sa Kabisay-an Nakatundan.
english: We are deeply saddened by the passing of Danny Fajardo, 72, founder and editor/publisher of Panay News, the leading regional daily in English here in Western Visayas.

text: Siya man ang tagtukod sang naga-isahanon nga daily nga pamantalaan sa Hiligaynon (Ilonggo dialect) – ang Panay Balita, nga ginabalhag man sa Kabisay-an  Nakatundan.
english: He is also the founder of the only daily newspaper in Hiligaynon (Ilonggo dialect) – Panay Balita, which is also published in Western Visayas.

text: Gin-admitir si Danny sa ospital, sunu sa iya anak nga si Idol, sadtong Miyerkoles, Setyembre 5, tungod sa barado nga ugat sa iya tagipusuon.
english: Danny was admitted to the hospital, according to his son Idol, on Wednesday, September 5, due to a blocked artery in his heart.

text: Nangin-madinalag-on ang operasyon, sunu man kay Idol, apang nag-kumplikasyon ini nga amo ang iya ginkamatay.
english: The operation was successful, Idol said, but there were complications that led to his death.

text: Didto na siya ginkuhaan sing ginhawa sa Asian Hospital sa diin ginhingagaw siya.
english: He was rushed to the Asian Hospital where he was rushed to the hospital.

text: Sunu kay Idol, basi dalhon sa Iloilo ang bangkay ni Danny kahapon (Setyembre 11) ukon buas (karon, Setyembre 12).
english: According to Idol, Danny's body may be brought to Iloilo yesterday (September 11) or tomorrow (today, September 12).

text: Wala pa sing schedule ang lubong.
english: The funeral has not yet been scheduled.

text:
***

Isa si Danny sa maisug (fearless) nga mga peryodista diri sa rehiyon, nga bisan ang mga kaaway niya sa iya sinulatan may pagtahod, kay samtang wala siya ginakilala nga ginakahadlukan sa iya panulat, “fair” ini siya sa iya mga panugdaon.
english:
***

Danny is one of the fearless journalists in the region, who even his enemies in his writing have respect for, because while he is not known to be feared in his writing, he is “fair” in his suggestions.

text: Indi man madumtanon si Danny.
english: Danny wasn’t hateful.

text: Kon maghalin ka sa iya pamantalan “to seek greener pasture” ukon maghalin tungod may indi ka nagustuhan sa iya pagdumala, wala ini siya nagatanom sing dumot kag madale makalimot sang kon ano man nga paglainay sing buot.
english: If you leave his newspaper “to seek greener pasture” or leave because you don't like something about his management, he doesn't plant hatred and quickly forgets any resentment.

text: In fact, kon maghalin ka, puede ka gihapon makabalik sa pagsulat sa iya pamantalaan, “no questions asked” basta may lugar lang.
english: In fact, if you leave, you can still come back to write in his newspaper, “no questions asked” as long as there is room.

text: Kon kis-a siya pa gani ang ga-imbitar sa imo agud magbalik.
english: Sometimes he even invites you to come back.

text: Ako gani katatlo naghalin sa Panay News kag katatlo man nagbalik sa pagsulat sa Panay News nga wala man sing lainay sing buot.
english: I even left Panay News for the third time and returned to write for Panay News for the third time without any disagreement.

text: Mag-amigo man kami gihapon.
english: We are still friends.

text: Trabaho lang nga wala sing personalay.
english: Just work with no personality.

text: Paalam, abyan kag boss Danny…Sa imo ang dayon nga kapahuwayan upod sa aton mapinalanggaon nga Makaako sa Kalangitan.
english: Farewell, friend and boss Danny…To you be eternal rest with our loving Almighty in Heaven.

text:
***

Ginahingyu sa karon sang Public Safety and Transportation Management Office (PSTMO) ang Iloilo City Sanggunian agud  nga i-legalize ang trabaho sang mga barkers, ukon  transport dispatchers, diri sa siyudad.
english:
***

The Public Safety and Transportation Management Office (PSTMO) is now asking the Iloilo City Sanggunian to legalize the work of barkers, or transport dispatchers, here in the city.

text: Ini sila makita naton sa kon diin lang nga bahin sang mga dalanon nga nagapatigayon sang pagsakay sang mga pasahero sa kon diin may nagahulat nga salakyan – dyep, tricycle, bus, express van, kag bisan sa taksi, sa authorized man ukon indi nga lugar sa siyudad.
english: These can be seen on any part of the roads that allow passengers to ride where there are waiting vehicles – jeeps, tricycles, buses, express vans, and even taxis, whether in authorized or unauthorized areas of the city.

text: Nangin daku ugaling nga problema ang mga barkers tungod man sa madamo nga problema nga ginadulot nila sini sadto kag tubtub subong.
english: However, barkers have become a big problem because of the many problems they caused in the past and still do.

text: Isa na dira ang reklamo sang mga drayber sang mga dyepney (kag sang iban pa nga salakyan) parti sa ila pagpatigayon sang pasahero nga ginapangayuan nila sing bayad bisan wala man lang ginalihog sang mga drayber.
english: One of these is the complaint of jeepney drivers (and other vehicles) about their handling of passengers that they ask for payment even if the drivers do not ask.

text: Labi na gid kon yara na ang mga dyepney sa mga authorized loading/unloading nga lugar, sa diin nagalinya na agud magapasakay na gid lang sang pasahero nga indi na kinahanglan sang kon sin-o nga magpatigayon.
english: Especially when the jeepneys are already in the authorized loading/unloading areas, where they are already lined up to board passengers without the need for anyone to facilitate.

text: Ginasiling man nga nagapangayo ining mga barker sang bayad sa ila serbisyo (sa masami tag-lima ka pesos kada trip), nga kon indi ka maghatag tandaan ka nila kag himuan sing indi maayo.

text: at CIDG Acting Director Major General Robert Alexander Morico II upang tutukan ang kaso.

english: Secretary Remulla said it is important to immediately investigate and secure the crime scene in all shooting incidents in order to determine the true cause of the incident.

text: Isang ulat mula sa Senado ng Estados Unidos ang nagsiwalat ng serye ng mga “preventable failures” o kapalpakan sa seguridad ng U.S. Secret Service na halos ikinasawi ni dating U.S. President Donald Trump sa isang campaign rally sa Butler, Pennsylvania noong Hulyo 13, 2024.
english: A report from the US Senate has exposed a series of "preventable failures" in the security of the U.S. Secret Service that almost caught former U.S. President Donald Trump at a campaign rally in Butler, Pennsylvania on July 13, 2024.

text: Ayon sa imbestigasyon ng Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee na pinamumunuan ng mga Republican, nakalusot ang suspek na si Thomas Matthew Crooks, 20 taong gulang, at nakapagpuslit sa isang bubong malapit sa lugar ng rally.
english: According to an investigation by the Republican-led Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee, the suspect, Thomas Matthew Crooks, 20 years old, managed to sneak through a rooftop near the rally site.

text: Mula roon, nakapagpaputok siya ng walong bala, kung saan tinamaan si Trump sa tainga.
english: Since then, he has fired eight bullets, hitting Trump in the ear.

text:
Bagamat nasugatan, nakaligtas si Trump at nagpakita agad ng katatagan sa publiko sa pamamagitan ng pagtayo at pagtataas ng kamao habang sumisigaw ng “Fight, fight!”

“Itinuturing naming isang himala ang kanyang pagkakaligtas,” ani Senator Rand Paul, chairman ng komite.
english:
Despite being wounded, Trump survived and immediately showed strength to the public by standing up and raising his fist while shouting “Fight, fight!”

“We consider his survival a miracle,” said Senator Rand Paul, chairman of the committee.

text: Tinawag niyang “inexcusable” ang naging kapalpakan at iginiit na hindi sapat ang mga hakbang na isinagawa laban sa mga sangkot.
english: He called the failure “inexcusable” and insisted that the steps taken against those involved were not enough.

text: Batay sa ulat, kulang umano sa koordinasyon ang mga security agency bago pa man isagawa ang naturang rally.
english: According to reports, the security agencies lacked coordination before the rally.

text: Anim na miyembro ng Secret Service ang sinuspinde ng hanggang 42 araw na walang bayad, ngunit ayon sa mga mambabatas, hindi ito sapat bilang parusa.
english: Six members of the Secret Service were suspended for up to 42 days without pay, but according to lawmakers, that was not enough punishment.

text: Isa sa mga itinuturong malaking pagkukulang ay ang hindi pagbibigay ng babala mula sa lokal na pulisya tungkol sa isang kahina-hinalang lalaki na may dalang rangefinder—25 minuto bago ang pamamaril.
english: One of the alleged major shortcomings was the failure to warn the local police about a suspicious man with a rangefinder—25 minutes before the shooting.

text: Hindi ito naiparating sa mga ahente ng Secret Service sa lugar, kabilang na sa isang counter-sniper na nagsabing hindi siya inabisuhan ng anumang banta, kaya’t hindi rin niya inaksyunan ang kahina-hinalang nakita.
english: This was not brought to the attention of Secret Service agents in the area, including a counter-sniper who said he was not alerted to any threat, so he did not act on the suspicious sightings.

text: Bukod kay Trump, isang lokal na bumbero ang nasawi sa insidente, habang ilan pang indibidwal ang nasugatan bago napatay si Crooks ng isang Secret Service sniper.
english: Besides Trump, a local firefighter was injured in the incident, while several other individuals were injured before Crooks was killed by a Secret Service sniper.

text: Patuloy ang panawagan para sa mas masusing imbestigasyon at reporma sa seguridad ng mga pampublikong opisyal sa Amerika.
english: The call for more thorough investigation and reform of the security of public officials in the United States continues.

text: Magataas ang iga-import nga mais sang Pilipinas sang 7.2 percent ukon pasaka sa 1.63 million metric tons (MMT) para sa marketing year (MY) 2024-2025 agud malab-ot ang nagataas man nga demand sang domestic animal feed industry.
english: Philippine corn imports will increase by 7.2 percent or upwards of 1.63 million metric tons (MMT) for the marketing year (MY) 2024-2025 to meet the rising demand of the domestic animal feed industry.

text: Suno sa United States Department of Agriculture-Foreign Agricultural Service sa Manila, ginapanan-aw man nga ang corn production sang pungsod ang magatubo sang 0.4 percent ukon pasaka sa 8.15 million metric tons halin sa 8.119 million metric tons sang 2023-2024.
english: According to the United States Department of Agriculture-Foreign Agricultural Service in Manila, the country's corn production is also expected to grow by 0.4 percent or up to 8.15 million metric tons from 8.119 million metric tons in 2023-2024.

text: Gindugang pa diri nga ang amat-amat nga pagpadamo sang baboy samtang nagahulat sa commercialization sang African swine fever (ASF) vaccine ang makapataas pa gid sang demand para sa imported feed corn sa ulihi nga parte sang 2024-2025.
english: He added that the gradual increase in pig production while waiting for the commercialization of the African swine fever (ASF) vaccine will further increase demand for imported feed corn in the later part of 2024-2025.

text: Ginpataas man ang forecasts sang feed kag residual use sang 2.7 percent sa 7.6 million metric tons halin sa 7.4 million metric tons.
english: Feed and residual use forecasts were also raised by 2.7 percent to 7.6 million metric tons from 7.4 million metric tons.

text: Samtang, ginsiling man sang ahensya nga magataas ang food, seed, kag industrial consumption sa 1.4 percent ukon magasaka sa 2.23 million metric tons halin sa 2.20 million metric tons bangud sa increased demand para sa corn-based food snacks kag byproducts, kaangay sang cornstarch, oil, kag syrup.
english: Meanwhile, the agency also said food, seed, and industrial consumption will increase by 1.4 percent or rise to 2.23 million metric tons from 2.20 million metric tons due to increased demand for corn-based food snacks and byproducts, such as cornstarch, oil, and syrup.

text: Nagaproblema ka bala sa nagalala nga falling hair ukon pagkala-unot sang buhok?
english: Are you struggling with worsening falling hair or hair loss?

text: Kun manghusay ka bala madamo nga buhok ang nagasunod?
english: When you shave, does a lot of hair follow?

text: Kabalo ka bala kun ano ang rason sang pagkala-unot sang buhok?
english: Do you know what causes hair loss?

text: Suno kay Dr. Jean Marquez isa ka dermatologist sa DARE dermatology, aesthetics, and restoration clinic, iya ginpahayag nga ang stress, hormonal imbalance, iron deficiency kag hyperthyroidism ang rason sang hair fall.
english: According to Dr. Jean Marquez is a dermatologist at DARE dermatology, aesthetics, and restoration clinic, he said that stress, hormonal imbalance, iron deficiency and hyperthyroidism are the causes of hair fall.

text: Dugang pa ni Marquez, mas dako ang posibilidad sapagkala-unot  sang buhok sa mga estudyante bangud masami sila nga stress sa eskwelahan.
english: Marquez added that students are more likely to lose their hair because they are often stressed at school.

text: Nagpanugyan si Marquez nga mas maayo nga magp kunsulta sa dermatologist agud mahatagan sang naga-igo nga pagbulong.
english: Marquez advised that it is better to consult a dermatologist for proper treatment.

text: Apang kabalo ka bala nga may yara sang mas mahapos kag simple nga pama-agi agud amat-amat nga masolusyunan ang pagkala-unot sang imo buhok.
english: But did you know that there is an easier and simpler way to gradually solve your hair loss.

text: Gin-athag ni Dr.  Marquez nga ang duga sang bombay kag dahon sang bayabas ang sarang makabulig sa pag solbar sa pagkala-unot  sang imo nga buhok.
english: Dr. explained.  Marquez said that bombay juice and guava leaves can help solve your hair loss.

text: Ang bombay may yara sang madamo nga calcium, magnesium kag iron nga may maayo nga epekto sa aton nga ikaayong lawas kag sa aton nga buhok.
english: Bombay is rich in calcium, magnesium and iron which have a good effect on our health and our hair.

text: Samtang ang bayabas naman ang manggaranon sa B complex, bitamina C nga nagabulig sa aton nga immune system kag nagapabaskog sa aton nga buhok.
english: Meanwhile, guava is rich in B complex, vitamin C which helps our immune system and strengthens our hair.

text: SA TION sang ginakibang nga panahon, natural lang nga gustuhon sang mga pumuluyo ang maisug kag may “political will” nga liderato nga magadumala sa ila.

english: There are even those who are okay with a dictator, as long as he is a “benevolent dictator”, or a leader who has only the welfare of the people in his mind and heart.

text:
***

Ugaling, “power corrupts and absolute power corrupts absolutely.”

Gani, sa masami, ang pagkilala sa isa ka diktador sa kasaysayan sang kalibutan amo nga isa ini ka lider nga gamiton lang ang mga pumuluyo sa iya ambisyon sa padayon nga pag-angkon lang sang poder, manggad kag pagdayaw lang sa iya kaugalingon.
english:
***

However, “power corrupts and absolute power corrupts absolutely.”

Therefore, often, the identification of a dictator in world history is that he is a leader who will only use the people in his ambition to continue to gain power, wealth and glorify himself.

text: Nagagamit man ini sang matig-a nga kamot kag kapintas sa kay kon sin-o man nga naga-upang sa iya handom.
english: It also uses a hard hand and cruelty towards anyone who gets in the way of its dreams.

text: Ginahimo man sini ang mga padugi nga, sa masami, labag sa balatyagon sang mga pumuluyo tungod wala ini siya nagahatag sang importansya sa “value of human life and dignity” agud lang matuman ang iya luyag.
english: It also makes decisions that, often, are against the feelings of the people because it does not give importance to the “value of human life and dignity” just to fulfill its wishes.

text: Katulad ini ni Adolf Hitler sang Germany, nga akig gid sa mga Jew kag nagpapatay pa sang mga 6 ka milyon sini.
english: This is similar to Adolf Hitler of Germany, who was so angry with the Jews that he had about 6 million of them killed.

text: Katulad man ini kay Pol Pot sang Cambodia nga ginpilit ang taga-siyudad kag taga-uma sa pagbayluhanay pangabuhi nga labag sa ila konsyensya, kag nagpapatay pa sang minilyon nga indi magsunod sa iya luyag.
english: It is similar to Pol Pot of Cambodia who forced urban and rural people to exchange lives against their conscience, and even killed millions who did not follow his will.

text: Ang malain pa kay ginagamit sang diktador sa iya malain nga padugi ang mga pulis kag militar nga ang mga pumuluyo mismo ang nagapa-sueldo sa ila.
english: What is worse is that the dictator uses the police and military for his evil purposes who are paid by the people themselves.

text: Kon makamarasmas gid man sang ulihi ang mga pulis kag militar nga may konsyensya, madamo na ang nag-antus kag nagkalamatay sa pagsunod sa mapintas nga mando sini.
english: If the police and military with a conscience finally come to their senses, many have suffered and died in obedience to its brutal orders.

text: Salamat sa pagbangon sang kusog-hangaway sa idalom ni Heneral Fidel Ramos kag Defense Secretary Juan Ponce Enrile, kag natumba gid man ang rehimeng Marcos sadtong 1986!
english: Thanks to the rise of the army under General Fidel Ramos and Defense Secretary Juan Ponce Enrile, the Marcos regime was overthrown in 1986!

text:
***

Sang sini lang, ginpabutyag ni Duterte nga kon si Robredo man lang ang magbulos sa iya pwesto, indi na lang!
english:
***

Recently, Duterte said that if Robredo were to succeed him, he would not!

text: Indi kuno competent si Robredo, kag maayo pa nga ang isa ka diktador katulad ni Marcos ang magbulos sa iya.
english: Robredo is said to be incompetent, and it is better for a dictator like Marcos to replace him.

text: Nagulpihan lang seguro si Presidente Duterte sa sining iya nga pabutyag  nga mas maayo pa ibulos kay Robredo ang  katulad ni Marcos.
english: President Duterte must have been surprised by his statement that it would be better to replace Robredo with someone like Marcos.

text: Ina tungod indi “benevolent dictator” si Marcos nga maluyagan sang mga pumuluyo!
english: That's because Marcos is not a “benevolent dictator” that the people will like!

text:
***

Sadto, samtang gainit man ang problema sang pungsod, luyag man gani ni Presidente Duterte ang mag-deklarar sing Revolutionary Government katulad ni Cory agud matagaan siya sing dugang nga poder.
english:
***

In the past, while the country's problems were heating up, President Duterte wanted to declare a Revolutionary Government like Cory's to give him more power.

text: Sa nasiling ta na, isa ka “Benevolent Dictator” si Cory, nga ang handom sini amo lang ang mapabalik ang Demokrasya sa pungsod.
english: As we have already mentioned, Cory is a “Benevolent Dictator”, whose only desire is to restore democracy in the country.

text: In fact, naghalin ini  siya sa poder pagkatapos sang anom ka tuig nga pagdumala sang pungsod.
english: In fact, he left power after six years of ruling the country.

text: Apang lain na ina ya kon ang ibulos mo sa poder ang katulad ni Marcos.
english: But it's different when you put someone like Marcos in power.

text: Man, indi ini ya “benevolent dictator”.
english: Man, this is not a “benevolent dictator”.

text: Mapintas ini ya kag “corrupt”.
english: It is cruel and corrupt.

text: Wala kaluoy nga ginpanglagas ni Marcos ang mga political opposition, mga journalists, kag kon sin-o pa nga naga-upang agud ma-solo niya ang poder.
english: Marcos mercilessly pursued the political opposition, journalists, and anyone else who stood in his way of securing power.

text: Sadtong 2003 (DAVAOTODAY.com, Don J. Pagusara, The Legacy of Marcos, Mar.
english: In 2003 (DAVAOTODAY.com, Don J. Pagusara, The Legacy of Marcos, Mar.

text: 15, 2016) gin-“define” sang Korte Suprema ang “ill-gotten wealth” sang Marcos family nga amo lang ang sobra sa legal nga kita sini nga mga $304,000 halin sang 1965 tubtub 1986 sang ginpatalsik siya sang Edsa Revolution.
english: 15, 2016) the Supreme Court defined the Marcos family's ill-gotten wealth as the excess of its legal income of about $304,000 from 1965 to 1986 when he was overthrown by the Edsa Revolution.

text: In fact, ang Presidential Commission on Good Government (PCCG) naka-“recover” sing mga $4 ka bilyon sa mga $10 ka bilyon sa ginpatihan nga natipon sang mga Marcoses sa sulod sa sining mga tinuig.
english: In fact, the Presidential Commission on Good Government (PCCG) was able to “recover” about $4 billion of the approximately $10 billion that the Marcoses were believed to have accumulated internally during these years.

text: Ang iban sini ginpanghatag gani sa mga biktima sang martial law.
english: Some of them were even distributed to victims of martial law.

text: Ti, paano abe naton itugyan liwat ang pungsod sa isa ka kasubong ni Marcos nga mapintas kag “corrupt”?
english: Well, how can we hand over the country again to someone like Marcos who is cruel and “corrupt”?

text: Agud liwat nga mag-antos kita?
english: So that we may suffer again?

text: Indi na!
english: Unable!

text: Naggradwar sang iya Master’s Degree sa Public Administration sa World Citi College ang host nga si Jhong Hilario.
english: Host Jhong Hilario graduated with his Master’s Degree in Public Administration from World Citi College.

text: Kaupod sang iya iloy, asawa, kag anak nga babayi, proud nga nagmartsa si Hilario kag nagbaton sang iya diploma gikan sa iya alma mater sa tion sang commencement exercises nga ginhiwat sa PICC Plenary Hall.
english: Accompanied by his mother, wife, and daughter, Hilario proudly marched and received his diploma from his alma mater during the commencement exercises held at the PICC Plenary Hall.

text: Si Jhong ang nalipay gid pagkatapos nga makuha ang “highest merits” para sa iya master program.
english: Jhong was ecstatic after getting the “highest merits” for his master program.

text: Siling niya, bonus na ini sa iya nga paggradwar sa masters.
english: He said it was a bonus to his masters graduation.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Jhong nga ang time management ang yabi — ang pag-juggling sang iya schedule halin sa pagka-konsehal sa Makati City, pag-host sang mga katungdanan sa noontime show kag pagka-amay, asawa, kag estudyante — tanan sa amo man nga tion.
english: Jhong also said time management is key — juggling his schedule from being a Makati City councilman, hosting noontime show duties and being a father, wife, and student — all at the same time.

text: Apang sang ginpamangkot si Jhong ko ngaa importante nga matapos ang iya Master’s?
english: But when I asked Jhong why it was important to finish his Master’s?

text: Ini ang gin-explain ni Jhong, bangud suno sa iya, indi mapakot kon tubtob san-o siya nga mangin artista kag mas makapamaayo para sa iya nga magtuon bangud ang pag-artista ang may kataposan.
english: Jhong explained this, because according to him, he cannot predict how long he will be an actor and it is better for him to study because acting has an end.

text: Apang ginklaro man sang actor-host nga wala siya nagatinguha nga mag-eskwela para sa mas mataas nga posisyon sa masunod nga eleksyon.
english: However, the actor-host also made it clear that he is not trying to pursue higher positions in the next election.

text: Balantayan ang mangin performance sa Dinagyang Festival 2026 sang grupo sang mga Persons Deprived of Liberty ukon PDL sa Iloilo City District Jail–Male Dormitory sa Barangay Ungka, Jaro.
english: Watch the performance at the Dinagyang Festival 2026 of the group of Persons Deprived of Liberty or PDL at the Iloilo City District Jail-Male Dormitory in Barangay Ungka, Jaro.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jail Superintendent Denver Beltran, jail warden,  iya ginpahayag nga ang grupo sang sini nga mga PDLs ang ginatawag nga Tribu Paghilom.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jail Superintendent Denver Beltran, jail warden, said the group of these PDLs is called Tribu Paghilom.

text: Suno kay kay Beltran, patigayunon ang performance sa sulod mismo sang pasilidad  kag malantaw sang publiko  paagi sa live feed ukon recorded video nga ipakita sa mga venues sang festival.
english: According to Beltran, the performance will be held inside the facility and will be viewed by the public through live feed or recorded video that will be shown at the venues of the festival.

text: Gin-athag naman ni Beltran nga ang pagpasakop sang grupo ang indi kabahin sang opisyal nga kompetisyon.
english: Beltran clarified that the group's participation is not part of the official competition.

text: Suno kay Beltran, ang inisyatibo ang naghalin mismo sa mga PDLs agud ipakita man ang ila nga debosyon kay Sr.
english: According to Beltran, the initiative came from the PDLs themselves to show their devotion to Sr.

text: Sto Niño kag bilang kabahin man sang ila nga rehabilitasyon.
english: Sto Niño and as part of their rehabilitation.

text: Mahimo makonsiderar nga wala na sang pulos ang nabilin nga miyembro sang Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) apisar isa ini ka retirado nga mahistrado.
english: The remaining member of the Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) can be considered useless despite being a retired judge.

text: Suno sa Constitutional law expert nga si Atty. Domingo Egon Cayosa, dako nga kadulaan ang mga naghalalin nga miyembro sang panel kag amo man ang mga imbestigador sini.
english: According to Constitutional law expert Atty. Domingo Egon Cayosa, the outgoing members of the panel as well as its investigators are a great loss.

text: Dugang niya, redundant ang ICI bangud ginasulit lamang sini ang katungdanan sang Office of the Ombudsman nga may mas masangkad nga gahum batok sa kagarukan.
english: He added that the ICI is redundant because it only repeats the duties of the Office of the Ombudsman which has broader powers against corruption.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Cayosa nga ang Ombudsman may ara sang mandato nagikan sa konstitusyon kag may kina-iya ini nga suguon ang tanan nga ahensya sang gobyerno, law enforcement, investigatoty units kag Commission on Audit.
english: Cayosa also said that the Ombudsman has a mandate from the constitution and has the power to command all government agencies, law enforcement, investigatoty units and the Commission on Audit.

text: Dugang pa sini, mangin limitado lamang sa fact finding kag recommendatory power ang ICI gani indi na ini makahulag gid sang epektibo batok sa mga anomalya sa flood control projects.
english: He added that the ICI will be limited to fact finding and recommendatory powers so it will not be able to act effectively against anomalies in flood control projects.

text: Nagapati man si Cayosa nga mas mangin maayo kun ang Sandiganbayan kag ang korte ang magatalana sang kaugalingon sini nga deadlines para mapadali ang pagresolba sang mga kaso sa korapsyon.Nagpanawagan man sila nga bantayan kag obligahon sang Ombudsman ang ila katungdanan bilang institusyon batok sa korapsyon nga nagakatabo sa pungsod.
english: Cayosa also believes that it would be better if the Sandiganbayan and the court set their own deadlines to expedite the resolution of corruption cases. They also called on the Ombudsman to monitor and oblige their duty as an institution against corruption in the country.

text: ANG administrasyon ni Presidente Duterte nagdaug sa isyu kontra droga, korapsyon kag kriminalidad nga wala masabat  sang nagliligad nga mga administrasyon sa “satisfaction” sang mga pumuluyo.
english: THE administration of President Duterte has won the issues against drugs, corruption and crime that previous administrations have not addressed to the satisfaction of the people.

text: Sa karon nga pagbutyog sang presyo sang mga balaklon, basi diri man mapierde ang administrasyon ni Duterte sa palaabuton nga mid-term eleksyon, labi na gid ang sa bahin sang mga kandidato sa pagka-senador.
english: With the current rise in commodity prices, the Duterte administration may lose the upcoming mid-term elections, especially in the case of senatorial candidates.

text: Ina tungod ang gutom kag kapigaduhon daku nga isyu para sa mga imol, nga mayoriya sini ang mga botante.
english: That's because hunger and poverty are big issues for the poor, the majority of whom are voters.

text: Pati ang galunggong, ang “poorman’s fish”,nga sadto gabili lanng P140 ang kada kilo nagabili na sang P200 kada kilo.
english: Even galunggong, the “poorman’s fish”, which used to cost only P140 per kilo, now costs P200 per kilo.

text: Ang bugas nagtaas pa gani ang bili sini nga kon mag-ariya gid man sa  tig-alani dira lang ini sa iya daan nga mahal nga presyo.
english: The price of rice has even increased so that when it comes to harvest, it is still at its old high price.

text: Madamo man nga imported rice ang NFA nga gina-istaran na sang mga sapat-sapat nga kinahanglan ma-fumigate.
english: The NFA also has a lot of imported rice that is already inhabited by animals that need to be fumigated.

text: Ti, bal-an ta man nga kon ma-fumigate ini may baho na ini nga indi mauyunan sang madamo, kag basi madunot lang sa bodega kag ihaboy nga indi mapuslan.
english: Well, we know that if it is fumigated, it will have a smell that many people will not like, and it will probably rot in the warehouse and be thrown away.

text: Diri gani sa siyudad sang Iloilo ang pletehan nagtaas na sing duha ka pesos, ukon mga P100 dugang nga plete ini sa isa ka bulan sang mga estudyante.
english: Even here in Iloilo City, the fare has increased by two pesos, or about P100 more per month for students.

text: Ang regular nga softdrink nga sadto P13 sa retail, P15 pesos na.
english: The regular softdrink that used to be P13 at retail is now P15 pesos.

text: Ang masami ko nga baklon nga probiotics sadto P35 lang, karon P45 na.
english: The probiotics I used to buy were only P35, now they are P45.

text: Ang bugas nga masami ko baklon nagtaas na sing P3 kada kilo.
english: The rice I usually buy has gone up by P3 per kilo.

text: Ambot kon ano lang ang wala magsaka.
english: I don’t know what just didn’t go up.

text: Siling sang pirme gapamalakon sa merkado “wala na sing nagbarato”.
english: As the market says, “nothing has gone cheaper”.

text: Sang sini lang ang Bangko Sentral nga Pilipinas (BSP) nagsiling nga ang “inflation”, ukon ang pagsaka sang presyo sang mga balaklon naglab-ut na sa 5.7 ka porsyento, samtang ang bagay lang sina amo ang 2-4 ka porsyento.
english: The Central Bank of the Philippines (BSP) recently said that inflation has reached 5.7 percent, while the opposite is 2-4 percent.

text: Posible kuno ining 5.7 porsyento sang “inflation” magapadayon sing pagsaka tungod sa pagpasaka sang buhis sa petrolyo kag iban nga “essential” nga kinahanglanon sang mga pumuluyo sa idalom sang TRAIN Law.
english: It is possible that this 5.7 percent “inflation” will continue to rise due to the increase in taxes on petroleum and other “essential” necessities of the people under the TRAIN Law.

text: Of course madamo man nga isyu ang puede ihaboy sa administrasyon sa palaabuton nga eleksyon sa Mayo 2019 nga ang amat-amat na ginaduso sang taga-oposisyon.
english: Of course there are many issues that can be thrown at the administration in the upcoming elections in May 2019 that the opposition is slowly pushing.

text: Indi lang ang padayon nga “inflation”, kundi pati man ang nagalain nga relasyon sang Pilipinas kag Amerika, ang isyu sa Western Philippine Sea sa Tsina, ang isyu kontra sa extrajudicial killing, kag madamo pa.
english: Not only the continuous “inflation”, but also the deteriorating relations between the Philippines and the United States, the Western Philippine Sea issue with China, the issue against extrajudicial killing, and many more.

text: Tungod sini, ginatan-aw naton ang masadya gid nga kampanyahanay  para sa Mayo 2019 nga eleksyon.
english: As a result, we are looking forward to a very exciting campaign for the May 2019 elections.
