text: Iniulat ng South Korean Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA) na patuloy ang pagpapadala ng North Korea ng mga artillery shells at iba pang armas sa Russia simula nang sumiklab ang digmaan sa Ukraine.
english: The South Korean Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA) reported that North Korea has continued to send artillery shells and other weapons to Russia since the outbreak of the war in Ukraine.

text: Ayon sa datos ng DIA, higit 28,000 containers ang naipadala ng Pyongyang na naglalaman ng artillery shells at iba pang uri ng bala.
english: According to DIA data, Pyongyang sent more than 28,000 containers containing artillery shells and other types of ammunition.

text: Tinatayang katumbas ito ng 12 milyong 152mm artillery rounds.
english: It is estimated to be equivalent to 12 million 152mm artillery rounds.

text: “Patuloy ang North Korea sa pagbibigay ng armas sa Russia,” pahayag ni Kang Daeshik, isang mambabatas sa South Korea.
english: "North Korea continues to supply weapons to Russia," said Kang Daeshik, a South Korean lawmaker.

text: “Ang aming militar ay patuloy na nire-reassess ang lawak ng suportang militar ng North Korea sa Russia sa pakikipagtulungan sa mga kaugnay na ahensya at kaalyadong bansa,” dagdag pa niya.
english: “Our military is continuously reassessing the extent of North Korea’s military support to Russia in cooperation with relevant agencies and allied countries,” he added.

text: Sa ulat ng Bloomberg, lumalawak na umano ang saklaw ng tulong-militar ng North Korea.
english: According to Bloomberg, the scope of North Korea's military aid is allegedly expanding.

text: Bukod sa mga bala, ipinapadala na rin umano ng Pyongyang ang missiles, self-propelled guns, at iba pang kagamitan para sa combat.
english: In addition to ammunition, Pyongyang is also reportedly sending missiles, self-propelled guns, and other combat equipment.

text: Unang inihayag ni Kyrylo Budanov, pinuno ng Ukrainian military intelligence, na tinatayang 40% ng kasalukuyang pangangailangan sa ammunition ng Russia ay mula sa North Korea.
english: Kyrylo Budanov, head of Ukrainian military intelligence, first revealed that an estimated 40% of Russia's current ammunition needs come from North Korea.

text: Dagdag pa niya, kabilang sa ipinapadalang armas ang mga high-quality ballistic missiles at artillery systems.
english: He added that among the weapons being sent are high-quality ballistic missiles and artillery systems.

text: Bukod sa mga kagamitang militar, nagsimula na rin umanong magpadala ang North Korea ng mga tauhang militar.
english: In addition to military equipment, North Korea has also begun sending military personnel.

text: Mula pa noong Oktubre 2024, tinatayang 13,000 sundalo na ang ipinadala ng Pyongyang upang suportahan ang kampanya ng Russia.
english: As of October 2024, Pyongyang has deployed an estimated 13,000 troops to support Russia's campaign.

text: Ayon sa South Korea’s spy agency, inaasahan pang madaragdagan ito ng 5,000 construction workers at 1,000 military engineers (sappers) ngayong Hulyo o sa darating na Agosto sa Kursk, Russia.
english: According to South Korea's spy agency, it is expected to increase by 5,000 construction workers and 1,000 military engineers (sappers) this July or next August in Kursk, Russia.

text: Samantala, patuloy na lumalalim ang alyansa ng Moscow at Pyongyang.
english: Meanwhile, the alliance between Moscow and Pyongyang continues to deepen.

text: Kamakailan lamang ay bumisita si Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov sa North Korea at kinumpirma ang suporta ni Kim Jong Un sa Kremlin.
english: Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov recently visited North Korea and confirmed Kim Jong Un's support for the Kremlin.

text: Kapalit ng suporta ng North Korea, nagbibigay umano ang Russia ng pinansyal na tulong at teknolohiyang makatutulong sa rehimen ni Kim Jong Un upang mabawasan ang epekto ng internasyonal na pag-iisa.
english: In exchange for North Korea's support, Russia is allegedly providing financial aid and technology to help Kim Jong Un's regime reduce the impact of international isolation.

text: Mas ginpili ni Vice President Sara Duterte nga magkadto sa haya sang bise gobernador sang Bohol sa baylo nga magtambong sa ikatatlo nga State of the Nation Address (SONA) ni President Ferdinand ‘Bongbong’ Marcos, Jr., Hulyo 22.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte preferred to attend the funeral of the vice governor of Bohol instead of attending the third State of the Nation Address (SONA) of President Ferdinand 'Bongbong' Marcos, Jr., July 22.

text: Ang nagtaliwan nga si Bohol Vice Governor Dionisio Victor Balite amo ang nagapungko kuntani nga acting governor sang probinsya.
english: The late Bohol Vice Governor Dionisio Victor Balite was the incumbent acting governor of the province.

text: Sa statement sang bise-presidente, ginsiling man sini nga nahatagan siya sang oportunidad nga makapalab-ot sang simpatiya sa pamilya, lokal nga panguluhan sang probinsya, kag tanan nga taga-Bohol nga nasubuan gid sa pagtaliwan sang ila mataas nga opisyal.
english: In a statement, the vice-president said he was given the opportunity to extend his condolences to the family, the local government of the province, and all Bohol residents who are deeply saddened by the passing of their senior official.

text: “Nabigyan rin ako ng pagkakataong makamusta at makausap ang ilang mga opisyales ng probinsya, munisipalidad, at barangay.
english: “I was also given the opportunity to greet and talk to some provincial, municipal, and barangay officials.

text: Maraming salamat sa inyong mainit na pagtanggap at suporta.
english: Thank you very much for your warm welcome and support.

text: Ang pagbisita natin ay pagpapakita ng pakikiisa sa ating mga kababayang Bol-anons upang bigyan sila ng pag-asa sa paggunita nila ng kanilang Bohol Day ngayong araw,” kabahin sang Facebook post ni Duterte.
english: Our visit is a show of solidarity with our fellow Bol-anons to give them hope as they celebrate their Bohol Day today,” Duterte said in a Facebook post.

text: Ang pagbisita sang vice president ang kadungan man sa Bohol Day ukon ang charter day sang amo nga probinsya.
english: The vice president's visit also coincides with Bohol Day or the charter day of the province.

text: Antes sini, nauna na nga ginkumpirma ni Sara nga magluwas nga indi siya magkadto sa Batasang Pambansa sa Quezon City para sa SONA bangud gina-appoint niya ang iya kaugalingon bilang ‘designated survivor’, indi man siya mag-monitor sa speech sang presidente bisan sa TV ukon sa gadgets.
english: Earlier, Sara confirmed that besides not going to the Batasang Pambansa in Quezon City for the SONA because she appoints herself as a designated survivor, she will not monitor the president's speech either on TV or on gadgets.

text: Matandaan nga sanday Marcos kag Duterte ang nag-updanay sa UniTeam tandem sang 2022 elections nga amo man ang nagkuha sang suporta sang pinakadalagku nga political parties kag clans sa pungsod.
english: It can be recalled that Marcos and Duterte joined the UniTeam tandem in the 2022 elections which also won the support of the largest political parties and clans in the country.

text: Sang Hunyo 19, nagpasa si Sara sang iya resignation sa Gabinete ni Marcos kag nangin epektibo sang Hulyo 19 ang iya pagpanaog sa pwesto bilang tiglikom sang Department of Education.
english: On June 19, Sara submitted her resignation to the Marcos Cabinet and her resignation as secretary of the Department of Education became effective on July 19.

text:
Pagamarkahan sang Bombo BOMBO RADYO PHILIPPINES ang anom ka dekada nga pagpangibabaw sa patag sang pagwaragwag paagi sa liwat nga pagpatigayon sang Top Level Management Conference umpisa Enero 5 tubtob 11, 2026, nga may tema nga “Bombo Radyo Philippines: Celebrating 60 Years of Media Excellence.”

Pangunahan sang Chairman nga si Dr. Rogelio M. Florete kag network President kag Chief Executive Officer Margaret Ruth C. Florete, ang conference magatipon sang tanan nga station managers kag senior officers gikan sa 25 key areas sang Bombo Radyo Philippines network sa Iloilo City.
english:
Bombo BOMBO RADYO PHILIPPINES will mark six decades of dominance in the field of broadcasting by once again holding the Top Level Management Conference from January 5 to 11, 2026, with the theme “Bombo Radyo Philippines: Celebrating 60 Years of Media Excellence.”

Chairman Dr. Rogelio M. Florete and network President and Chief Executive Officer Margaret Ruth C. Florete, the conference will bring together all station managers and senior officers from the 25 key areas of the Bombo Radyo Philippines network in Iloilo City.

text: Ang week-long gathering magasentro sa strategic planning kag direction-setting samtang nagahulag ang network padulong sa makabig nga milestone sang pag-eksister sini.
english: The week-long gathering will focus on strategic planning and direction-setting as the network moves toward what can be considered a milestone of its existence.

text: Ang mga diskusyon ang magasentro sa inobasyon, public service, kag padayon nga commitment sa masaligan, responsable kag public service–oriented broadcasting.
english: Discussions will focus on innovation, public service, and continued commitment to trustworthy, responsible and public service–oriented broadcasting.

text: Bilang kabahin sang ika- 60 nga anniversary celebration, ginapabugal gid sang Bombo Radyo Philippines ang malawig nga listahan sang prestihiyoso nga awards nga nagakilala sa kasampat sang Bombo Radyo sa patag sang pagdul-ong sang balita, public affairs programming, kag public service broadcasting.
english: As part of its 60th anniversary celebration, Bombo Radyo Philippines is proud of its long list of prestigious awards that recognize Bombo Radyo's excellence in the fields of news delivery, public affairs programming, and public service broadcasting.

text: Pila sa mga achievements nagalakip sang pagdaug sang flagship nationwide program sang network nga Bombo Network News nga back-to-back winner sang Catholic Mass Media Awards (CMMA) bilang Best News Program para sa 2024 kag 2025.
english: Some of the achievements include winning the network’s flagship nationwide program Bombo Network News back-to-back winner of the Catholic Mass Media Awards (CMMA) as Best News Program for 2024 and 2025.

text: Ang FM counterpart sini nga Star FM ang ginkilala naman nga Best Entertainment Program sa sulod sang tatlo ka sunod-sunod nga tuig halin 2023 tubtob 2025.
english: Its FM counterpart Star FM was recognized as the Best Entertainment Program for three consecutive years from 2023 to 2025.

text: Samtang, ang Bombo Radyo Iloilo, ang flagship station sang network, ang ginkilala bilang Best AM Station (Provincial) kag Best News Program (Provincial) ang Bombo News and Views Morning Edition sa 28th Golden Dove Awards (2025) sang Kapisanan ng mga Brodkaster sa Pilipinas (KBP).
english: Meanwhile, Bombo Radyo Iloilo, the flagship station of the network, was recognized as Best AM Station (Provincial) and Best News Program (Provincial) the Bombo News and Views Morning Edition at the 28th Golden Dove Awards (2025) of the Association of Broadcasters in the Philippines (KBP).

text: Magluwas sa sini nga mga awards, nagapamatuod man ang resulta sang independent surveys tuhoy sa kredibilidad sang network kag ang pagsalig sang publiko.
english: In addition to these awards, the results of independent surveys also prove the credibility of the network and the trust of the public.

text: Ang Bombo Radyo nangibabaw bilang Most Trusted News and Information Source sa Radio category sa Philippine Information Agency National Survey on Media and Information Literacy of Filipino Youth (November 2024).
english: Bombo Radyo topped the Most Trusted News and Information Source in the Radio category in the Philippine Information Agency National Survey on Media and Information Literacy of Filipino Youth (November 2024).

text: Ginkilala man ini sang OCTA Research (December 2024) bilang leading radio source sang news and information sa mga Filipino adults, kag nalakip man sa top rank sa quarterly Pahayag Survey sang Publicus Asia, Inc.
english: It was also recognized by OCTA Research (December 2024) as the leading radio source of news and information among Filipino adults, and was also included in the top rank in the quarterly Pahayag Survey of Publicus Asia, Inc.

text: sa idalom sang Most Trusted Media Outlets in the Radio category.
english: under the Most Trusted Media Outlets in the Radio category.

text: Ini nga mga pasidungog ang repleksyon sang dedikasyon sang Bombo Radyo Philippines sa pagtib-ong sang pinakamataas nga standards sang broadcast journalism.
english: These awards are a reflection of Bombo Radyo Philippines' dedication to upholding the highest standards of broadcast journalism.

text: Ang conference nagapamatuod man sang legasiya sang Bombo Radyo Philippines bilang leading radio network sa pungsod, nga naga- operate sang 32 fully digitalized AM kag FM stations nationwide, kag nagaserbe nga simbolo sang hugot sa tagipusuon nga pagpahayag sang pagpasalamat sa publiko.
english: The conference also affirms the legacy of Bombo Radyo Philippines as the leading radio network in the country, operating 32 fully digitalized AM and FM stations nationwide, and serves as a symbol of heartfelt expression of gratitude to the public.

text: Bangud sa inyo, ang Bombo Radyo padayon sa pagtib-ong sang EXCELLENCE in BROADCASTING kag pag-dul-ong sang balita kag serbisyo publiko sa indi matupungan nga performance.
english: Because of you, Bombo Radyo continues to promote EXCELLENCE in BROADCASTING and deliver news and public service with unparalleled performance.

text: Basta Radyo, BOMBO!
english: Just Radio, BOMB!

text: Nagpa-in ang Iloilo Provincial Government sang P1 million nga budget para sa repair sang track oval sang Iloilo Sports Complex.
english: The Iloilo Provincial Government has allocated a P1 million budget for the repair of the track oval of the Iloilo Sports Complex.

text: Inisyal ini nga tikang agud ma-rehabilitate ang pasilidad nga ginahingadlan na nga expired na ang rubberized surface.
english: This is an initial step to rehabilitate the facility whose rubberized surface is already named expired.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ray Cabarles, Sports Development Officer IV sang Iloilo Provincial Government, iya ginpahayag nga kinahanglan nga i-rehabilitate ang track oval, ilabi na bangud madamo nga sports competitions ang pagapatigayunon sa Iloilo Sports Complex.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Ray Cabarles, Sports Development Officer IV of the Iloilo Provincial Government, said the track oval needs to be rehabilitated, especially since many sports competitions will be held at the Iloilo Sports Complex.

text: Suno sa opisyal, napalab-ot na ang kahimtangan sang pasilidad kay Governor Toto Defensor.
english: The official said the condition of the facility has been conveyed to Governor Toto Defensor.

text: Suno sa program of work, kun matigayon gid man nga mga rehabilitate ini ang gasto mahimo maglab-ot sa P40 tubtob P44 million.
english: According to the program of work, if these are rehabilitated, the cost could reach P40 to P44 million.

text: Apang sa karon, repair pa lang anay ang mahatag sang probinsya samtang nagapangita pa sang dugang nga pondo ang gobernador.
english: However, for now, the province can only provide repairs while the governor is still looking for additional funds.

text: Lakip sa mga palaabuton nga aktibidad amo ang City Meet sa Pebrero kag ang PRISAA.
english: Upcoming activities include the City Meet in February and PRISAA.

text: Suno kay Cabarles, may ara sang mga patches ilabi na sa starting line sang 100-meter dash nga guba na gid.
english: According to Cabarles, there are patches especially in the starting line of the 100-meter dash that are badly damaged.

text: Duagng pa sini sa bahin naman sang patiagyunon nga Dinagyang Festival, dira man magaperform ang mga nagkalain-lain nga tribo nga magapasakop sa nasambit nga aktibidad.
english: He added that in the upcoming Dinagyang Festival, there will also be performances by the various tribes that will participate in the said activity.

text: Ang budget nga P1 million ang nagikan sa General Services Office gamiton para sa repair sang track oval.
english: The budget of P1 million from the General Services Office will be used for the repair of the track oval.

text: Sa karon, padayon ang pagpangita sang probinsya para sa rehabilitation sang rubberized track.
english: The province is currently looking for the rehabilitation of the rubberized track.

text: Samtang, ginapahayag man nga ang Iloilo Sports Complex may ara sang sitting capacity nga 8,000 ka tawo, nga ginapaabot nga magaserbe sa madamo nga bisita kag participants sa mga aktibidad, ilabi na sa tion sang Dinagyang Festival.
english: Meanwhile, the Iloilo Sports Complex has a sitting capacity of 8,000 people, which is expected to serve many visitors and participants in activities, especially during the Dinagyang Festival.

text: ON SECOND thought, gaduha-duha kita subong kon bala kinahanglan gid naton ang Federalismo.
english: ON SECOND thought, we are now doubting whether we really need Federalism.

text: Sa madumduman ta pa, isa sang mga ginpangako ni President Rodrigo Duterte sa kampanya sadtong Mayo 2016 nga presidential election amo ang pagpatuman sang Federalismo sa pungsod.
english: As we recall, one of the promises of President Rodrigo Duterte during his May 2016 presidential election campaign was the implementation of Federalism in the country.

text: Lakip ini sa iya ginpangako nga away kontra droga, korapsyon kag kriminalidad.
english: This is part of his promised fight against drugs, corruption and crime.

text: Apang ang isyu sang Federalismo isa gid bala sang mga isyu nga nagpadaug kay Duterte agud tagaan niya ini sing importansya?
english: But is the issue of Federalism really one of the issues that won Duterte to give it importance?

text: Indi!
english: No!

text: Kon ako ang inyo pamangkuton.
english: If you ask me.

text: Kon may nagpadaug kay Duterte, sa aton pagpati, ina amo lang ang away sa droga, korapsyon kag kriminalidad nga wala mapatuman sa “satisfaction” sang mga pumuluyo sang nagliligad pa nga mga administrasyon.
english: If anyone has defeated Duterte, in our belief, it is the fight against drugs, corruption and crime that has not been implemented to the satisfaction of the people of previous administrations.

text: Ugaling may paghinulsol man sa karon ang iban nga nagboto sa kay Duterte tungod sa kabangis sa pagpatuman sining away niya sa aton mapatawaron nga kultura.
english: But there is also regret now that some who voted for Duterte because of the cruelty in implementing this fight against our forgiving culture.

text: Ginpamatud-an naton ining mapatawaron nga kultura sa aton madali nga pagpatawad sa bisan sang kapintas sang mga Katsila, mga Hapon kag sang mga Amerikano sang kita ila ginlupig kag gingamhan sa madamo nga tinuig.
english: We have proven this forgiving culture in our easy forgiveness of even the cruelty of the Spanish, the Japanese and the Americans when we were oppressed and ruled by them for many years.

text: Ina tungod seguro sa gintudlo ni Kristo, nga may 90 porsyento nga tumuluo sa pungsod, nga “Love your enemy”, ukon higugmaon bisan ang kaaway.
english: That's probably because of what Christ taught, with 90 percent of the country's believers, to “Love your enemy”, or love even the enemy.

text:
***

Kon ngaa indi luyag sang pumuluyo ang Federalismo, ginpakita ini sa survey sang Social Weather Survey (SWS) sadtong first quarter sang 2018 nga ang resulta ginpa-publiko  sadtong Hunyo 28, 2018.
english:
***

Why the people do not want Federalism, it was shown in the survey of the Social Weather Survey (SWS) in the first quarter of 2018 whose results were made public on June 28, 2018.

text: Ining SWS nga survey nagpakita nga 25 porsyento lang sang mga ginpamangkot ang may ihibalo parti sa Federal System nga pang-gobyerno.
english: This SWS survey showed that only 25 percent of the respondents had knowledge about the Federal System of government.

text: In other words, ang 75 porsyento sang mga pumuluyo wala sing ihibalo sa Federalismo.
english: In other words, 75 percent of citizens have no knowledge of Federalism.

text: Madalom ini (Federalismo) nga ideya sang pagpang-gobyerno nga ang aton kubos nga pumuluyo indi dale-dale makahangop.
english: This (Federalism) is a deep idea of ​​government that our poor people cannot easily understand.

text: Isa pa, anad na kita sa aton “unitary” nga forma sang gobyerno nga may isa lang ka “central government” nga nagagahum.
english: Furthermore, we are used to our “unitary” form of government with only one “central government” in power.

text: Lubos man naton na-intiendihan ang pagpalakat sini.
english: We also fully understand how it works.

text:
***

Sa pamatasan mismo sang Filipino, segurista kag mahinadlukon ang Filipino sang bag-o nga panghuna-huna.
english:
***

In the very nature of the Filipino, the Filipino is secure and fearful of new thinking.

text: Mas gusto nila sundon ang daan nga mga bagay kag pangitaan lang sing medyos nga ma-koreharan ang ano man nga puede ma-koreharan.
english: They prefer to follow the old ways and just find a way to correct whatever can be corrected.

text: In other words, mas gustuhon nila nga amendaron lang ang Local Government Code agud madugangan ang share sang mga lokal nga gobyerno halin sa pondo sang gobyerno nasyonal para sa ila development; pagpasangkad sang “public assistance” sa mga kubos; pagpalawak sang kadutaan sang gobyerno sa pagpanguma sa aton “self-sufficiency” nga programa; kag iban pa nga indi naton matolin sa mga gobyerno lokal tungod sa kakulangan sang ila ikasarang.
english: In other words, they would prefer to amend the Local Government Code to increase the share of local governments from the national government's funds for their development; expanding public assistance to the poor; expansion of government farmland in our self-sufficiency program; and others that we cannot pass on to local governments because of their lack of capacity.

text: In fact, nagapakita ang gobyerno nasyonal nga makasarang ini pagbulig sa mga pigado nga mga gobyerno lokal.
english: In fact, the national government is showing that it can help poor local governments.

text: Ang pabay-an lang sila, sunu sa Federalismo, isa gani ka delikado nga proposisyon sa sini nga tinion tungod madamo pa nga asin ang makaon naton bag-o matigayon ang ano man nga posible nga kaayuhan nga matigayon diri.
english: Leaving them alone, according to Federalism, is even a dangerous proposition at this time because we have a lot of salt to eat before we can achieve any possible benefits here.

text: Basi “too late” na gani ini, kag laspag na kita bag-o masid-ing man lang ining posible nga kaayuhan.
english: Maybe it's too late, and we're too late to see this possible benefit.

text: Isa pa, ang pagsaylo sa Federalismo nagakinahanglan sang pag-amendar gid sang konstitusyon.
english: Moreover, moving to Federalism requires actually amending the constitution.

text: Daku nga huol ini sang gobyerno sa daku nga galastuhon nga magamit diri.
english: This is a big concern for the government with the huge expenditure that can be used here.

text: Sa karon gani nagaantos pa ang mga pumuluyo sa sige pagsaka sang bili sang balaklon nga indi naton mapabay-an.
english: Even now, the people are still suffering from the continuous rise in the price of goods that we cannot neglect.

text:
***

Kon may ara nga maluyag sa Federalismo, ang mga Muslim lang seguro tungod sa ila tuhay nga kultura kag pagtuo.
english:
***

If anyone likes Federalism, it's probably Muslims because of their different culture and faith.

text: Nahangpan naton ang problema sang mga Muslim nga mga duha ka milyon sa Mindanao.
english: We understand the problem of the Muslims who are about two million in Mindanao.

text: “Theocracy” ang ila ginapatihan nga pang-gobyerno nga sandig sa ila pagtuo sa Islam nga ginagamhan sang ila mga relihiyoso.
english: They believe in “Theocracy” as a form of government based on their faith in Islam ruled by their religious leaders.

text: Pero, indi naman kinahanglan ang Federalismo agud masabat ang problema sang mga Muslim sa Mindanao.
english: However, Federalism is not necessary to solve the problem of Muslims in Mindanao.

text: Na-aprubahan  na ang Bangsamoro Basic Law agud mapatuman sa Morolandia ang klase sang pang-gobyerno kag pangabuhi nga luyag nila.
english: The Bangsamoro Basic Law has been approved to implement in Morolandia the kind of government and life they want.

text: Tuhay ini sa ginatindugan sang kabug-usan nga mga pumuluyo, nga sobra 90 porsyento sini mga Kristiyano nga nagapati sa pang-gobyerno sa idalom sang prinsipyo sang “Separation of Church and State”.
english: This is in contrast to the position of the general population, more than 90 percent of whom are Christians who believe in government under the principle of “Separation of Church and State”.

text: Ang Simbahan tutok lang sa ispirtual nga kabuhi sang mga pumuluyo, samtang ang Estado tutok sa lawasnon (wordly) nga kinahanglanon sang mga tawo.
english: The Church focuses only on the spiritual life of the people, while the State focuses on the physical (wordly) needs of the people.

text: Kita ya, okey sini.
english: See ya, okay here.

english: Leonard Ellerbe, chief of Mayweather Promotions, confirmed the participation of retired American boxer Floyd Mayweather in the fight between 8th Division boxing champ Manny Pacquiao and American boxer Keith Thurman.

text: Madumduman nga masami nga makita sa ringside ang retired boxer sa mga hampang ni Pacquiao kaangay sang away ni boxing champ batok kay Jessie Vargas sa Thomas & Mack Center sang 2016 kag Adrien Broner sang Enero sini lang nga tuig.
english: The retired boxer was often seen ringside during Pacquiao's fights such as the boxing champ's fight against Jessie Vargas at the Thomas & Mack Center in 2016 and Adrien Broner in January this year.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagapabilin nga bukas si Pacquiao kag training consultant Freddie Roach sa rematch batok kay Mayweather matapos ang ulihi nila nga away sang 2015 apang sa subong mas nangin kuntento ang retired american boxer sa iya nga kabuhi sang ini ang nag retiro pagkatapos sang iya ulihi nga away sang 2017 batok sa UFC star nga so Conor McGregor.
english: Pacquiao and training consultant Freddie Roach remain open to a rematch against Mayweather after their last fight in 2015 but the retired American boxer is now more satisfied with his life when he retired after his last fight in 2017 against UFC star Conor McGregor.

text: Nasaksikan sang fans ang nangin kabuhi ni Mayweather sa iya nga social media kun sa diin nya ginapost ang pictures sang iya byahe sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: Fans have witnessed Mayweather's life on his social media where he posts pictures of his trips around the world.

text: KINAHANGLAN ta seguro sang kasuguan nga nagahatag sing grace period sa pagbayad sang aton consumption bill.
english: We probably need a law that gives us a grace period to pay our consumption bill.

text: Sa eksperyensya sang madamo diri sa siyudad sang Iloilo, isa lang ka adlaw nga naatrasar ka sa pagbayad may multa ka na sing 20 porsyento sa MIWD.
english: In the experience of many here in Iloilo City, just one day if you are late in paying, you will be fined 20 percent by MIWD.

text: May amo man nga multa sa isa ka memorial park nga nahibal-an naton.
english: There is the same fine in a memorial park that we know of.

text: Natabuan lang nga nagmasakit ang kliyente sa balay kag indi makasulod sa upisina minultahan dayon.
english: If the client happens to be sick at home and cannot enter the office, he will be fined immediately.

text: Puede man kadtuan sa balay ang kliyente sang ahente apang nagpadungol ini nga naghulat sa upisina sa kliyente nga nagmasakit, kag pinatungan gid sing multa ang kliyente sang indi makaulhot sa upisina.
english: The agent could have visited the client at home but he waited in the office for the client who was sick, and the client was fined for not being able to leave the office.

text: Daw martial law ni Marcos nga wala patawad bisan may rason ka pa!
english: It's like Marcos' martial law that doesn't forgive even if you have a reason!

text: To be fair sa mga may konsiderasyon nga mga kumpaniya, ang Panay Electric Company (PECO) gahatag, sandig sa aton eksperyensya, sing allowance sa pagbayad sing atrasado sa pila ka adlaw nga wala sing multa.
english: To be fair to considerate companies, the Panay Electric Company (PECO) does, based on our experience, provide an allowance for late payment for a few days without penalty.

text: Tani makita ini nga problema sang aton mapisan kag maabi-abihon nga Congressman (sang Iloilo)  Toto Defensor kag Congressman (Iloilo City) Jerry Treñas agud mapasaran ini sing kasuguan.
english: I hope our hardworking and hospitable Congressman (of Iloilo) Toto Defensor and Congressman (Iloilo City) Jerry Treñas will see this problem so that it can be passed into law.

text:
***

NAPIERDE kita sa China sang nagligad nga engkwentro sadtong  Martes, Agosto 21, sa duha gid lang ka puntos, 80-82, sa ginahiwat sa karon nga Asian Games.
english:
***

WE lost to China in the last encounter on Tuesday, August 21, by just two points, 80-82, in the current Asian Games.

text: In fact, abanse kita, 80-77, sa China samtang gapasulod na ang hampang sa lapit isa na lang ka minuto.
english: In fact, we are ahead, 80-77, in China as the game enters the near one minute.

text: Nakalagas ugaling ang China kag nagpatas ang score, 80-80.
english: China, however, caught up and tied the score, 80-80.

text: Na-foul ang China kag nakadugang sang duha ka puntos paagi sa free shots.
english: China was fouled and added two points with free shots.

text: Nakahingagaw ang Pilipinas, paagi kay Paul Lee, agud maka-3 pointer samtang mga anom na lang ka segundos, ugaling wala makapasulod.
english: The Philippines managed, through Paul Lee, to score a 3 pointer with about six seconds left, but missed.

text: Nonetheless, upod kita kay Coach Yeng Guiao sa pagpati nga nagdaug kita bisan nalutos.
english: Nonetheless, we are with Coach Yeng Guiao in believing that we won even though we lost.

text: Ina tungod ang padaug sang Pilipinas ginbanta lang sa 20 porsyento, tungod man sa tatlo ka mataas nga player sang China nga kanday NBA player Zhou Qi (7’2”), NBA player Ding Yanyuhang (6’.7”), kag NBA draft Wang Shelin (7.0’) nga masami dungan pa nga nagahampang.
english: That's because the Philippines' chance of winning is only estimated at 20 percent, as well as three tall Chinese players, NBA player Zhou Qi (7'2"), NBA player Ding Yanyuhang (6'.7"), and NBA draft Wang Shelin (7.0') who often play together.

text: Ginadayaw man naton si Jordan Clarkson sa iya maayo gid nga hampang sadtong pagdaug sang Pilipinas kontra Kasakhstan, 96-59, sa diin namuntos siya sing husto.
english: We also commend Jordan Clarkson for his excellent performance in the Philippines' 96-59 win over Kazakhstan, where he scored well.

text: Tam-an man kaayo sang hampang ni Clarkson kontra sa China, sa diin duha lang ang abanse sang China sa Pilipinas.
english: Clarkson also played very well against China, where China was only two ahead of the Philippines.

text: Nag-score siya diri sing 28 bisan indi lubos ang iya hampang tungod nakapahuway siya sang magbiring ang iya tiil.
english: He scored 28 here despite not playing well because he was rested when his leg twisted.

text: Ginadayaw ta man ang hampang sang Pilipinas, sa kabug-usan.
english: We also praise the Philippine game, as a whole.

text: Nangin madinalag-on ang fast play nila nga nag-confuse sang guarding sang mas dalagku nga mga Intsik.
english: Their fast play was successful in confusing the guarding of the bigger Chinese.

text: Epektibo man sila sa perimeter shots kag sa penetration.
english: They are also effective on perimeter shots and in penetration.

text: Kon nakalusot si Pringle sa idalom sang ring, sang ang score 80-77 na pabor sa Pilipinas, nagdaug na seguro ang Pilipinas sa naulihi nga ginutlo sang hampang.
english: If Pringle had escaped under the ring, when the score was 80-77 in favor of the Philippines, the Philippines would have won the last quarter of the match.

text: Sa nasiling ta na ugaling, nakabawi ang China kag nagpatas sa 80-80 ang score.
english: As we said, however, China recovered and leveled the score at 80-80.

text: Na-foul kag nakapuntos sing duha sa free shots.
english: Was fouled and scored two on free shots.

text: Naghingagaw si Paul Lee para sa isa ka 3-pointer apang nalugaw-an.
english: Paul Lee scrambled for a 3-pointer but missed.

text: Well, malas lang seguro.
english: Well, I guess it was just bad luck.

text:
***

Wala kita gapati nga malampasan sang Kazakhstan ang abanse sang Pilipinas nga 37 points (96-59) sa ila hampang sa China kag ang Pilipinas ang makasulod sa quarterfinals.
english:
***

We do not believe that Kazakhstan will overcome the Philippines' lead of 37 points (96-59) in their match against China and the Philippines will enter the quarterfinals.

text: Sa pagdaug sang South Korea sa Group A (Group D ang Pilipinas), mangin kasumpong sang Pilipinas ang South Korea sa palaabuton nga Agosto 27.
english: With South Korea winning Group A, South Korea will face the Philippines on August 27.

text: Galaum kita nga dag-on sang Pilipinas ang South Korea sa sining hugada nga kaupod ang aton ka-Filipino nga si NBA Cavaliers Jordan Clarkson sa idalom sang isa ka coach (Yeng Guiao) nga daw NBA coach man magdala sang aton mga player.
english: We hope that the Philippines will beat South Korea in this round with our fellow Filipino NBA Cavaliers Jordan Clarkson under a coach (Yeng Guiao) who is like an NBA coach to bring our players.

text: Good luck sa aton tanan nga mga Filipino!
english: Good luck to all of us Filipinos!

text: Napilian ang Hong Kong-born martial arts actor nga si Jackie Chan bilang isa sa torchbearers antes ang nagahilapit nga opening ceremony sang 2024 Paralympics sa Paris, France.
english: Hong Kong-born martial arts actor Jackie Chan has been selected as one of the torchbearers ahead of the upcoming opening ceremony of the 2024 Paralympics in Paris, France.

text: Ang 70-anyos nga renowned actor nga kilala sa iya stunts kag acrobatic fight scenes ang magadala sang torch halin sa Mierkules sang hapon sa Paris.
english: The 70-year-old renowned actor known for his stunts and acrobatic fight scenes will carry the torch from Wednesday afternoon in Paris.

text: Yara man sa torch relay ang French actress nga si Elsa Zylberstein kag ang dancer/choreographer nga si Benjamin Millepied.
english: Also in the torch relay were French actress Elsa Zylberstein and dancer/choreographer Benjamin Millepied.

text: Ang seremonya ang patigayunon sa Stade de France nga may kabahin nga parada halin sa Champs-Elysees pakadto sa Place de la Concorde sa central Paris.
english: The ceremony will be held at the Stade de France with part of a parade from the Champs-Elysees to the Place de la Concorde in central Paris.

text: Sang weekend sang ginpasiga ang torch sa Stoke Mandeville sa United Kingdom nga amo ang historic birthplace sang Paralympic Games kag nag-abot ini sa France paagi sa Channel Tunnel sang Domingo kag gindala sang wheelchair fencing medalist nga si Emmanuelle Assmann.
english: It was at the weekend when the torch was lit in Stoke Mandeville in the United Kingdom which is the historic birthplace of the Paralympic Games and it arrived in France via the Channel Tunnel on Sunday and was carried by wheelchair fencing medalist Emmanuelle Assmann.

text: Iga-multiply ini nga sulu sa 12 Paralympic flames kag dal-on sang 1,000 torchbearers sa ginabanta 50 towns sa 12 ka simultaneous relays.
english: This torch will be multiplied by 12 Paralympic flames and carried by 1,000 torchbearers to approximately 50 towns in 12 simultaneous relays.

text: Pormal nga magasugod ang Paralympics 2:00 sa kaagahon sa Huwebes, Agusto 29 (oras sa Pilipinas) kag magatakop sa Domingo, Septyembre 8.
english: The Paralympics will formally begin at 2:00 am on Thursday, August 29 (Philippine time) and end on Sunday, September 8.

text: May anum ka Filipinos nga maga-compete subong sa Paris nga amo ang biggest delegation sang Pilipinas sa amo nga quadrennial meet halin sang 2012.
english: There are six Filipinos who will now compete in Paris, the biggest delegation of the Philippines in the quadrennial meet since 2012.

text: Magapanguna sa Filipino Paralympians ang flagbearers nga amo ang beterano nga para swimmer nga si Ernie Gawilan kag para archer nga si Agustina Bantiloc.
english: Veteran para swimmer Ernie Gawilan and para archer Agustina Bantiloc will lead the Filipino Paralympians.

text: Balantayan na subong nga adlaw, Septyembre 22, ang pagsaka sa ring sang reigning Filipino world champion nga si Melvin Jerusalem agud depensahan ang iya World Boxing Council (WBC) minimumweight crown.
english: Reigning Filipino world champion Melvin Jerusalem will step into the ring today, September 22, to defend his World Boxing Council (WBC) minimumweight crown.

text: Hingalitan ni Jerusalem ang home advantage sa sambuwa batok sa challenger nga si Luis Castillo halin sa Mexico.
english: Jerusalem will take advantage of the home advantage in the fight against challenger Luis Castillo from Mexico.

text: Ang Blow by Blow sang Manny Pacquiao Promotions ang may yara sang 14 ka undercards nga magasugod ala una karon sa hapon antes ang Jerusalem-Castillo main event nga ginabanta alas syete karon sa gab-i sa Mandaluyong City College.
english: Manny Pacquiao Promotions' Blow by Blow will have 14 undercards starting at 1 pm today before the Jerusalem-Castillo main event at 7 pm tonight at Mandaluyong City College.

text: Pareho nga knockout ang target sang duha sa ila pag-atubangay karon.
english: Both are aiming for a knockout in their clash today.

text: Wala sang gin-mensyonar si Castillo kun ano nga round sini matumba ang Pinoy boxer, apang ginsiling sini nga kumpyansa siya nga madala-pauli ang korona sa Mexico.
english: Castillo did not mention which round the Filipino boxer will fall, but said he is confident that he will bring home the crown to Mexico.

text: Wala sang kalutusan ang 27-anyos nga southpaw sa 21 sini ka hampang, may 13 ka knockouts kag isa ka draw kag ginalantaw man nga gamiton sini ang height kag reach advantage batok sa 30-anyos nga pambato sang Pilipinas.
english: The 27-year-old southpaw is undefeated in his 21 fights, with 13 knockouts and one draw and is also expected to use his height and reach advantage against the 30-year-old Philippine fighter.

text: Gamiton naman ni Jerusalem ang iya natun-an sang una nga tion sini nga gintinguhaan nga depensahan ang iya World Boxing Organization (WBO) mini flyweight belt sang 2023 apang nalutos.
english: Jerusalem will use what he learned the first time he tried to defend his World Boxing Organization (WBO) mini flyweight belt in 2023 but lost.

text: Espesyal ang sambuwa sang duha bangud ini ang una nga world title fight sa Pilipinas sa sulod sang pito ka tuig.
english: The fight between the two is special because it is the first world title fight in the Philippines in seven years.

text: Nahibaluan nga magluwas kay Jerusalem, ang nabilin na lamang nga reigning Filipino world boxing titlist sa boxing amo si Pedro Taduran nga naga-uyat sang International Boxing Federation (IBF) 105-pound crown.
english: It is known that besides Jerusalem, the only reigning Filipino world boxing titlist in boxing is Pedro Taduran who holds the International Boxing Federation (IBF) 105-pound crown.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, lakip sa Blow-by-Blow card ang former world super flyweight champion nga si Jerwin Ancajas nga magasaka man sa crucial comeback batok kay Sukpraserd Ponpitak sang Thailand kasunod sang sixth-round bantamweight bout defeat batok kay Takuma Inoue sa Tokyo.
english: Meanwhile, included in the Blow-by-Blow card is former world super flyweight champion Jerwin Ancajas who will also mount a crucial comeback against Sukpraserd Ponpitak of Thailand following a sixth-round bantamweight bout defeat against Takuma Inoue in Tokyo.

text: ILOILO – Ginplastar sang Ilonggo nga mamalidha ang iya mga ginalauman nga ipatpat ni President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.
english: ILOILO CITY – An Ilonggo lawmaker has laid out his expectations for the implementation of President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.

text: sa iya ikatatlo nga State of the Nation Address (SONA).
english: in his third State of the Nation Address (SONA).

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo 2nd District Rep.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Iloilo 2nd District Rep.

text: Michael Gorriceta, iya ginpahayag nga lakip sa mga ginalauman sini nga iplastar sang presidente sa iya SONA amo ang ikaayong lawas, edukasyon, inflation, turismo, infrastructure, enerhiya kag teknolohiya.
english: Michael Gorriceta, he said that among the issues he expects the president to put forward in his SONA are health, education, inflation, tourism, infrastructure, energy and technology.

text: Suno kay Gorriceta, bilang isa ka Ilonggo nga mamalidha, nagalaom ini nga matutukan man sang presidente ang mga kinahanglanon sang Iloilo kaangay sang kakulang sang kuryente kag ang ginalauman nga maumpisahan na ang Panay-Guimaras-Negros Island Bridge.
english: Gorriceta said that as an Ilonggo lawmaker, he hopes that the president will also focus on the needs of Iloilo such as the lack of electricity and the expected completion of the Panay-Guimaras-Negros Island Bridge.

text: Ang SONA ang patigayunon sa Lunes, Hulyo 24, las 4:00 sa hapon matapos ang pagbukas sang Second Regular Session sang 19th Congress sa diin maga-convene ang Senado kag House of Representatives.
english: The SONA will be held on Monday, July 24, at 4:00 pm after the opening of the Second Regular Session of the 19th Congress where the Senate and House of Representatives will convene.

text: Ini ang patigayunon sa Plenary Hall sang Batasang Pambansa sa Quezon City.
english: It will be held at the Plenary Hall of the National Assembly in Quezon City.

text: Paborito mo bala ang Pizza?
english: Is Pizza your favorite?

text: French Fries?
english: French Fries?

text: Chocolate?
english: Chocolate?

text: kag iban pa?
english: and so on?

text: Ang ini nga mga pagkaon masami naton ginakaon bangud manamit ini kag saboroso.
english: We eat these foods often because they are delicious and tasty.

text: Apang sa pihak sang saboroso nga damil sang ini nga mga pagkaon,  ini man ang may yara sang malain nga epekto sa aton ikaayong lawas .
english: But despite the delicious taste of these foods, they also have a negative impact on our health.

text: Suno kay Dr. Michael W. Smith, myembro sang Nutrition Wellness Educator Certification Pane,  ang Pizza, Tsokolate kag French Fries ang tatlo sa mga pagkaon nga dapat naton likawan.
english: According to Dr. Michael W. Smith, member of the Nutrition Wellness Educator Certification Pane, said Pizza, Chocolate and French Fries are three of the foods we should avoid.

text: Nagapanguna ang Pizza nga may yara sang madamo nga calories kag saturated fats.
english: Pizza takes the lead in terms of calories and saturated fats.

text: Suno kay Smith, mas maayo kun ang pizza nga may yara sang manipis nga crust, may vegetables ukon utan kag light cheese ang imo kan-on.
english: According to Smith, it is best to eat pizza with a thin crust, vegetables or vegetables and light cheese.

text: Ikaduha ang French fries, ang gamay nga order sang french fries may yara sang 230 calories kag mas maayo ang baked kompara sa fried nga french fries bangud sa mantika nga indi man maayo sa aton ikaayong lawas.
english: Second is the French fries, a small order of french fries has 230 calories and baked is better than fried french fries because of the oil which is not good for our health.

text: Ikatatlo amo ang tsokolate nga paborito sang mga bata, ang isa ka bar sang tsokolate ang may yara sang madamo nga kalamay, unhealthy fats kag preservatives.
english: Third is chocolate which is a favorite of children, a bar of chocolate contains a lot of sugar, unhealthy fats and preservatives.

text: Kun luyag mo gid magkaon sang tsokolate pilion mo ang dark chocolate bangud ini ang makapanubo sang blood pressure, makapaayo sang blood flow sa imo utok kag heart, kag naga protekta sang aton nga mga cells.
english: If you really want to eat chocolate, choose dark chocolate because it lowers blood pressure, improves blood flow to your brain and heart, and protects our cells.

text: Maayo man ang tsokolate nga may yara sang cocoa content halin 70% tubtob 85%.
english: Chocolate is also good with a cocoa content ranging from 70% to 85%.

text: Ang ini nga mga pagkaon matuod nga manamit kag saboroso apang mas maayo nga likawan naton ang masami nga pagkaon sini agud mangin healthy kita.
english: These foods are really delicious and tasty but it is better to avoid eating them too often to stay healthy.

text: Ginpasangkad sang Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP), ang seguridad sang kontrobersyal nga contractor nga si Sara Discaya, para sa nakatalana sini nga hearing sa Lunes.
english: The Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) has stepped up the security of controversial contractor Sara Discaya for her hearing scheduled for Monday.

text: Suno kay Jail Chief Inspector Ivy Christine Manigos, warden sang female dormitory sa Lapu-Lapu City Jail, ipinatuman na ang angay nga seguridad para sa kaluwasan ni Discaya kag sa iya mahilway nga pagbiyahe padulong sa korte, pananglitan nga magsugot ini nga magtambong sa korte sang personal.
english: Jail Chief Inspector Ivy Christine Manigos, warden of the female dormitory at the Lapu-Lapu City Jail, said adequate security has been implemented for Discaya's safety and her free travel to court, should she agree to attend court in person.

text: Nagdugang naman ang BJMP Regional Office 7 sang Special Tactics and Response Team kag nakigkoordinar sa Philippine National Police para sa dugang nga suporta sa posibilidad sang transportasyon ni Discaya.
english: The BJMP Regional Office 7 has added a Special Tactics and Response Team and is coordinating with the Philippine National Police for additional support on the possibility of Discaya's transportation.

text: Sa matandaan, kaupod si Discaya sa walo ka empleyado sang Department of Public works and Highways (DPWH) nga naka-detain sa Cebu sa karun, bangud sa pagkaulamit sini sa ginapahayag “ghost project” sa Davao Occidental.
english: Discaya is among eight employees of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) who are currently detained in Cebu for his involvement in an alleged “ghost project” in Davao Occidental.

text: Nagpahayag si Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi nga handa ang Iran nga magkooperar sa International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) sa pihak sang ginpatuman nga bag-o nga layi sang ila parliament nga nagauntat sang direkta nga inspeksyon sa nuclear facilities sang pungsod.
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi said Iran is ready to cooperate with the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) despite a new law passed by its parliament that stops direct inspections of the country's nuclear facilities.

text: Suno kay Araqchi, limitado lamang ang ila kooperasyon sa nuclear program, kag indi ini magalab-ot sa isyu sang defense system, lakip na ang mga missile development nga ginapanindugan sang Iran nga kabahin sang ila national security.
english: Araqchi said their cooperation on the nuclear program would be limited, and would not extend to the issue of the defense system, including missile developments that Iran insists are part of its national security.

text: Ginpasar ang layi kasunod sang pagpangbomba sang Israel kag Estados Unidos sa pila ka nuclear facilities sa Iran, nga kabahin sang nagapadayon nga tensyon sa Middle East.
english: The law was passed following Israeli and U.S. bombings of several nuclear facilities in Iran, part of ongoing tensions in the Middle East.

text: Sa idalum sang bag-o nga patakaran, ang mga inspeksyon sang IAEA sa nuclear sites kinahanglan na sang approval sang Supreme National Security Council, nga amo ang pinakamataas nga security body sang Iran.
english: Under the new rule, IAEA inspections of nuclear sites now need the approval of the Supreme National Security Council, which is Iran’s top security body.

text: Samtang ginapanindugan sang Western countries nga ang Iran may plano nga maghimo sang atomic weapon.
english: Meanwhile, Western countries insist that Iran has plans to develop an atomic weapon.

text: Ginpasalig naman sang Iranian government nga ang ila nuclear program ang indi delikado.
english: The Iranian government has assured that its nuclear program is not dangerous.

text: Apang ginpahayag man sang mga eksperto nga delikado ang magkadto sa bombed nuclear sites bangud sa posibilidad sang chemical contamination kag security threats.
english: But experts also said it is dangerous to go to bombed nuclear sites due to the possibility of chemical contamination and security threats.

text: Padayon ang panawagan sang international community sa Iran nga magpabilin nga transparent kag mag-aplikar sang full cooperation sa mga inspeksyon agud malikawan ang dugang nga tensyon kag posible nga military conflict.
english: The international community continues to call on Iran to remain transparent and apply full cooperation in the inspections to avoid further tensions and possible military conflict.

text: Pila ka strawberries ang sarang mo nga makaon?
english: How many strawberries can you eat?

text: Madamo sa aton ang nahiligan na nga magkaon sang strawberries ilabi na gid kun ini ang ginsawsaw sa tsokolate.
english: Many of us already love to eat strawberries especially when they are dipped in chocolate.

text: Apang, sa Israel, nadiskubrehan ang isa ka giant strawberry.
english: However, in Israel, a giant strawberry was discovered.

text: Ini ang nagabug-at sang 10.19-ounce ukon ginabanta 288 grams.
english: It weighs 10.19-ounces or approximately 288 grams.

text: Ang Israeli farmer nga si Ariel Chahi ang nakabaton sang award nga Guinness World bangud sa pinkadako nga strawberry nga ila gintanom sang iya nga pamilya.
english: Israeli farmer Ariel Chahi received the Guinness World Award for the largest strawberry grown by his family.

text: Ang pamilya ni Ariel Chahi ang nagapanag-iya sang Strawberry field bilang ila nga negosyo sa Kadima-Zoran, Israel.
english: Ariel Chahi's family owns a strawberry field as their business in Kadima-Zoran, Israel.

text: Ang amu nga strawberry ang sahi sang Ilan variety, nga una gin-bred ni Nir Dai, researcher sang Israel’s Agricultural Research Organization.
english: The strawberry is the Ilan variety, which was first bred by Nir Dai, a researcher at Israel's Agricultural Research Organization.

text: Suno kay Dai, ang amu nga sahi sang strawberry, ang masami nagadako bangud sa malamig nga temperatura.
english: According to Dai, the strawberry usually grows due to cold temperatures.

text: All-set na ang OPM iconic rock band nga Rivermaya para sa 7-city North America tour sa Septyembre kag Oktubre subong nga tuig.
english: OPM iconic rock band Rivermaya is all-set for a 7-city North America tour in September and October this year.

text: Matapos ang ila madinalag-on nga reunion concert sang nagligad nga Pebrero, dal-on nanday Bamboo, Rico Blanco, Mark Escueta kag Nathan Azarcon ang ila nga classic hits sa Filipino fans sa United States kag Canada.
english: After their successful reunion concert last February, Bamboo, Rico Blanco, Mark Escueta and Nathan Azarcon will bring their classic hits to Filipino fans in the United States and Canada.

text: Para kanday Bamboo kag Blanco, ini nga once-in-a-lifetime reunion tour ang pat-od gid nga mangin “intimate, personal” kag syempre, madamo sang dapat paabuton nga sorpresa ang fans!
english: For Bamboo and Blanco, this once-in-a-lifetime reunion tour is sure to be “intimate, personal” and of course, fans have plenty to look forward to!

text: Lakip sa naanunsyo nga kadtuan sang banda amo ang Vancouver, Toronto, kag Alberta sa Canada; New York City sa USA; kag Temecula, Los Angeles, kag San Francisco sa California sa Estados Unidos.
english: Among the band's announced stops are Vancouver, Toronto, and Alberta in Canada; New York City in the USA; and Temecula, Los Angeles, and San Francisco in California in the United States.

text: Una na nga gin-anunsyo sang banda nga magluwas sa US kag Canada, may natalana man sila nga performance sa Middle East, Singapore, Australia kag London.
english: The band has previously announced that in addition to the US and Canada, they also have performances scheduled in the Middle East, Singapore, Australia and London.

text: Sanday Bamboo, Mark, Nathan Azarcon kag Rico kaupod si Perf de Castro amo gid ang original members sang Rivermaya nga nangin popular umpisa sang 1994 bangud sa ila hit songs kaangay sang “214,” “Kisapmata,” “Elesi,” kag “Awit ng Kabataan.”
english: Bamboo, Mark, Nathan Azarcon and Rico along with Perf de Castro are the original members of Rivermaya who became popular since 1994 with their hit songs such as “214,” “Kisapmata,” “Elesi,” and “Awit ng Kabataan.”

text: ANG problema sa ilegal nga droga madugay na nga nagaluntad bisan sa mga poderoso kag manggaran nga mga pungsod.
english: THE problem of illegal drugs has long existed even in powerful and wealthy lands.

text: Bisan gani ang Estados Unidos nga may madalom sing kinaalam, lantip nga kagamitan sa pagpaniktik, kag mas hanas nga kusog hangaway indi gid makapauntat sang negosyo sa droga.
english: Even the United States with its deep knowledge, sophisticated intelligence equipment, and more skilled military force cannot stop the drug trade.

text: In fact, mga duha na ka dekada gani ang problema sang Estados Unidos batok sini apang wala gihapon sing lubos nga kasolbaran ini.
english: In fact, the United States has had a problem against it for about two decades but there is still no complete solution.

text: Gabalik-balik lang ang problema.
english: The problem keeps coming back.

text: Kon may kadalag-an man limitado lang kag indi makapaseguro sing lubos nga kadalag-an.
english: If there is success it is limited and does not ensure complete success.

text: Ngaa ayhan?
english: Why maybe?

text: Una nga rason dira seguro amo nga ang bisyo unay sa tawo – unay sa lawas, kon hambalon pa – nga malikawan lang paagi sa matuod-tuod nga pagpamat-ud nga sumpungon ini.
english: The first reason is probably that addiction is inherent in man – inherent in the body, so to speak – that can only be avoided by a genuine determination to overcome it.

text: Ikaduha, ang bisyo sa ilegal nga droga sa karon nangin global na kag lapnagon na gid nga mabudlay na untaton.
english: Second, illegal drug addiction has now become so global and widespread that it is difficult to break.

text: Daw lizard (tiki ukon tuko) nga kon mautod mo ang ikog matubo liwat.
english: It looks like a lizard (tick or lizard) that if you cut off the tail will grow back.

text: Una nga sabat sang mga otoridad sa sini nga problema amo nga kutlon ang “supply”.
english: The first response of the authorities to this problem was to cut off the supply.

text: Ang problema ugaling kay sa madamo nga lugar ini gina-“manufacture” kag sa patago pa nga paagi.
english: The problem, however, is that in many places it is manufactured and secretly.

text: Pili ka lang sa gamiton mo sa imo masarangan ukon masahuan – heroin, methamphetamine (lakip ang shabu) nga gina-producir sa Mexico; cocaine sa Bolivia, Colombia kag Peru sa South America nga gina-transport sa Mexico agud ibaligya sa Estados Unidos, kag kon diin pa nga may maayo nga merkado.
english: Just choose what you can use – heroin, methamphetamine (including shabu) produced in Mexico; cocaine in Bolivia, Colombia and Peru in South America being transported to Mexico for sale in the United States, and wherever else there is a good market.

text: Naga-ululhot man ini sa China, Myanmar, Africa kag bisan gani diri sa Pilipinas, Indonesia kag Malaysia.
english: It is also spreading in China, Myanmar, Africa and even here in the Philippines, Indonesia and Malaysia.

text: Madakpan mo ang isa, may ara man sa unhan.
english: You catch one, there's more ahead.

text: Kon maghina ang “demand” tungod sa pagkutol sang “supply” sa sige panglagas sang mga otoridad, mangita naman ini sila medyos sa pag-producir sang barato nga mga “synthetic” nga droga.
english: If demand weakens due to supply cuts in the authorities' constant pursuit, they will find ways to produce cheap synthetic drugs.

text: Ti, diin da ang masiling naton nga mapauntat ang “supply” sini sing lubos?
english: Well, where can we say that we can stop the supply of it completely?

text: Gani, ginahingagaw ta karon nga indi madalasa ang mga kabataan samtang wala pa sila sing animo parti sini kag magtutok sa problema sang “recovery” sa mga gabisyo na paagi sa rehabilitasyon.
english: Therefore, we are now trying to prevent children from being abused while they are still unaware of it and focus on the problem of recovery from addictions through rehabilitation.

text: Ang sige duso pa sang ilegal nga droga, nagakapatay ugaling sa ila pag-engkwentro sa mga otoridad.
english: Those who continue to push illegal drugs, however, die in their encounters with the authorities.

text: Kay ang kapigaduhon isa ka daku nga rason nga indi mapauntat ang ilegal nga droga, nagatutok man kita sa pag-away sa “unemployment” kag pagpasangkad sang “public assistance” katulad sang 4Ps, mas masangkad nga “free education” kag “health care”, kag iban pa.
english: Because poverty is a major reason why illegal drugs cannot be stopped, we are also focusing on fighting unemployment and expanding public assistance such as 4Ps, better free education and health care, among others.

text: Nangin amat-amat man praktikal ang away sa droga.
english: The fight against drugs is also gradually becoming practical.

text: Sa karon, mga napulo na ka estado sa Estados Unidos ang nakapasar sang kasuguan nga ga-“legalize” sang paggamit sang “less dangerous” nga marijuana.
english: Currently, about ten states in the United States have passed laws legalizing the use of less dangerous marijuana.

text: Kag indi lang bilang bulong kundi pati “pleasure drug” para sa mahuyog sa sobra nga pagpangalipay sa mga “party” agud mapalayo sila sa mas makatalagam nga droga katulad sang cocaine, shabu, ecstacy kag iban pa.
english: And not only as a medicine but also as a pleasure drug for those who are fond of partying to keep them away from more dangerous drugs such as cocaine, shabu, ecstacy and others.

text: Sa Pilipinas ugaling, upod pa kita sa pagpati sang mas madamo nga mga doktor kag siyentipiko nga delikado gihapon ining marijuana sa utok sang tawo, gani indi naton ini ma-“legalize” pa.
english: In the Philippines, however, we still believe that more doctors and scientists believe that marijuana is still dangerous to the human brain, so we cannot legalize it.

text:
***

Tungod sa sining problema sa ilegal nga droga, ano abe kon admitiron ta na gid lang nga ang pag-away sini pareho sa away batok sa prostitusyon kag ilegal nga hampang nga pabalik-balik lang?
english:
***

Given this problem of illegal drugs, what if we just admit that the fight against it is like the fight against prostitution and illegal gambling that goes back and forth?

text: In fact, ang away sa droga daw away na gani sang “Good versus Evil” nga matapos gid lang sa pag-abot sang “Last Judgment”, sa diin ang mga salawayon ibulag na “forever” sa Ginuo kag sa padayon nga matutom sa kasuguan  sang Diyos.
english: In fact, the fight against drugs is like a fight of “Good versus Evil” that will end only with the coming of the “Last Judgment”, where the guilty will be separated “forever” from the Lord and those who continue to be faithful to the law of God.

text: In other words, samtang sige ining mga kalainan sa aton sosyedad, sige man ang aton away tubtub mapa-kunta ini sa “level” nga makagulu-ginhawa kita sa sini nga mga problema, kon indi gid man lubos makunta, samtang sige man ang aton away.
english: In other words, while these evils continue in our society, we will continue to fight until they are counted to the level that we can breathe in these problems, if not completely counted, while we continue to fight.

text: Sa karon, amat-amat na gid man kanay ang problema ta sa ilegal nga droga kag sa iban pa nga krimen diri sa Pilipinas.
english: Now, our problem with illegal drugs and other crimes in the Philippines is slowly disappearing.

text: Salamat sa wala pahuway nga pag-away sang aton mga otoridad (kag pumuluyo) sa sining mga kalainan.
english: Thank you for the relentless fight of our authorities (and people) against these evils.

text: Ang mahambal na lang amo nga tani obserbahan ta lang ang “rule of law” kay kon ang aton away amo ang “Good versus Evil” segurado gid ya ang aton kadalag-an kay upod ini sa Ginuo.
english: All I can say is that we should observe the rule of law because if our fight is “Good versus Evil” our victory is sure because it is with the Lord.

english: (w_mateojr@yahoo.com/PN)

text:
(This content contains details about a stabbing incident, which may be disturbing or triggering for some readers.)

Patay ang isa ka lalaki matapos nga ginbuno sang iya hilaw nga umagad sa Barangay Sto.
english:
(This content contains details about a stabbing incident, which may be disturbing or triggering for some readers.)

A man was stabbed to death by his son-in-law in Barangay Sto.

text: Niño, San Miguel, Iloilo.
english: Niño, San Miguel, Iloilo.

text: Natabo ang krimen sa sulod mismo sa balay sang biktima.
english: The crime took place inside the victim's house.

text: Ang biktima amo si alyas Albert, 47-anyos samtang ang suspek amo si alyas Ian, 34-anyos.
english: The victim was identified as Albert, 47, while the suspect was identified as Ian, 34.

text: Stepdaughter sang biktima ang live-in partner sang suspek.
english: The victim's stepdaughter is the suspect's live-in partner.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Anabelle Agunda, live-in partner sang biktima, iya ginpahayag nga antes ang insidente, wala man ini sang naobserbahan nga may konplikto sa tunga sang iya partner kag sang suspek.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Anabelle Agunda, the victim's live-in partner, said that before the incident, she did not observe any conflict between her partner and the suspect.

text: Apang, baliskad diri ang pahayag ni alyas Ann nga anak ni Agunda.
english: However, the statement of alias Ann, daughter of Agunda, is the opposite.

text: Suno kay Ann nga live- in partner sang suspek, nakasugid sa iya si Ian nga ginkastigo ini ni Albert kag ginatan-aw nga rason kun ngaa ginhimo sang suspek ang krimen.
english: According to Ann, the suspect's live-in partner, Ian told her that Albert had beaten her and that is believed to be the reason why the suspect committed the crime.

text: Ginpahayag pa nga ginhulat sang suspek nga makatulog ang biktima antes ini gintadtad sang buno nga naglab-ot sa 21 ka beses.
english: The suspect reportedly waited for the victim to fall asleep before stabbing her 21 times.

text: Pagkatapos sang krimen, madasig nga nagpalagyo ang suspek dala ang iya mga gamit.
english: After the crime, the suspect quickly fled the scene with his belongings.

text: Tubtob subong, at-large pa ini kag wala na nakapakig-angot sa iya live-in partner nga si Alyas Ann.
english: He is still at large and has not been in contact with his live-in partner, alias Ann.

text: Igahatag ang isa ka posthumous award sa late South Korean actor nga si Lee Sun-kyun kadungan sang Busan International Film Festival nga amo ang pinakadaku sa Asya.
english: A posthumous award will be presented to late South Korean actor Lee Sun-kyun in conjunction with the Busan International Film Festival, the largest in Asia.

text: Pinakakilala sang fans si Lee sa iya papel sa 2019 Oscar-winning film nga “Parasite”.
english: Lee is best known to fans for his role in the 2019 Oscar-winning film “Parasite”.

text: Matandaan nga hinali nga gin-anunsyo ang iya kamatayon sang Disyembre 2023 kun sa diin nagguwa nga isa ka suicide incident ang natabo sandig sa duha ka bulan nga police investigation kag gina-angot man sa paggamit sang iligal nga droga.
english: It can be recalled that his death was suddenly announced in December 2023 where it turned out that a suicide incident occurred based on a two-month police investigation and was also linked to illegal drug use.

text: Ang Korea Cinema Award sa film fest ang ginahatag sa filmmakers nga nagpasaka sang status sang Korean cinema kag nag-amot sang daku para makilala ini sa bug-os nga kalibutan.
english: The Korea Cinema Award at the film fest is given to filmmakers who have raised the status of Korean cinema and contributed significantly to its global recognition.

text: Napilian sang festival nga ihatag ini nga award kay Lee bangud nakuha sini ang buot sang domestic kag international film fans.
english: The festival chose to give this award to Lee because he won the hearts of domestic and international film fans.

text: Sa award ceremony sa Oktubre 2, malakip man sa programa ang katapusan nga obra-maestra ni Lee nga “Land of Happiness” (2024) kun sa diin ginadala sang late actor ang papel bilang isa ka military solider kadungan sang South Korean authoritarian period sang 1970s.
english: At the award ceremony on October 2, the program will also include Lee's last masterpiece “Land of Happiness” (2024) in which the late actor plays a military solider during the South Korean authoritarian period of the 1970s.

text: Magluwas diri, may lima pa gid ka proyekto nga ipakita man sa programa kun sa diin featured man si Lee: ang 2009 film “Paju,” 2013 film “Our Sunhi,” 2014 film “A Hard Day,” 2018 drama “My Mister,” kag ang 2019 film “Parasite”.
english: In addition, there are five other projects that will be shown in the program where Lee is also featured: the 2009 film “Paju,” 2013 film “Our Sunhi,” 2014 film “A Hard Day,” 2018 drama “My Mister,” and the 2019 film “Parasite”.

text: Graduate si Lee sang prestihiyoso nga Korea National University of Arts kag isa sa pinakakilala sa South Korea nga nakabaton sang wala-tuo nga awards sa lain-lain nga mga papel sini halin sang iya debut sang 2000s.
english: Lee is a graduate of the prestigious Korea National University of Arts and is one of the most well-known in South Korea having received countless awards for its various roles since her debut in the 2000s.

text: Liwat nga napaslawan sa paghimo sang impresyon sa iya nga team ang Los Angeles Lakers rookie nga si Bronny James matapos nga nahulog sa match 0-3 ang ila team sa NBA Summer League play.
english: Los Angeles Lakers rookie Bronny James once again failed to make an impression on his team after his team fell 0-3 in NBA Summer League play.

text: Si Bronny nga anak ni NBA all-time leading scorer LeBron James ang nagbutang sang pinakagamay nga mga tira sa tanan nga mga starter sang Lakers batok sa Miami Heat kag natapos nga may tatlo lang ka puntos sa 1-for-3 nga shooting halin sa field.
english: Bronny son of NBA all-time leading scorer LeBron James put up the fewest shots of all the Lakers starters against the Miami Heat and finished with just three points on 1-for-3 shooting from the field.

text: Ang iya bug-os nga stat line ang yara lamang sa tatlo ka puntos, lima ka rebounds, tatlo ka assists, duha ka steals, kag tatlo ka blocks nga nagtapos sa 80-76 nga kapierdihan sa Miami.
english: His entire stat line was limited to three points, five rebounds, three assists, two steals, and three blocks that ended in an 80-76 loss to Miami.

text: Ginpangunahan naman ang Lakers sang kaupod nga rookie nga si Dalton Knecht – nga nagtira sang 7-of-18 gikan sa field kag 2-for-8 halin sa 3-point range.
english: The Lakers were led by fellow rookie Dalton Knecht – who shot 7-of-18 from the field and 2-for-8 from 3-point range.

text: Gintapos niya ang hampang nga may 20 puntos kag siyam ka rebounds.
english: He finished the game with 20 points and nine rebounds.

text: Samtang, ang Heat ginpangunahan sang isa ka pares sang 21-puntos nga mga pasundayag halin kay Keshad Johnson kag Aldones Williams.
english: Meanwhile, the Heat were led by a pair of 21-point performances from Keshad Johnson and Aldones Williams.

text: Gintapos naman ni Johnson ang hampang nga may 21 puntos, walo ka rebound, tatlo ka assist, tatlo ka steal, kag tatlo ka blocks.
english: Johnson finished with 21 points, eight rebounds, three assists, three steals, and three blocks.

text: Si Williams naman ang nakatapos nga may 21 puntos, siyam ka rebounds, tatlo ka assists, isa ka steal, kag duha ka blocks.
english: Williams, meanwhile, finished with 21 points, nine rebounds, three assists, a steal, and two blocks.

text: Sa subong, wala pa naka-impress si Bronny sa Summer League play – nga nakahampang lang sang duha sa tatlo ka mga hampang pagkatapos nga wala maintra sa ikaduha nga hampang bangud sa pagbanog sang iya nga tuhod.
english: So far, Bronny has not impressed in Summer League play – playing only two of three games after missing the second game with a swollen knee.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang iya una nga hampang, ang isa ka kapierdihan sa Sacramento Kings, natapos sa pag-iskor ni Bronny sang apat ka puntos, duha ka rebound, duha ka assist, kag isa ka steal sa sulod sang 21 minutos.
english: Notably, his first game, a loss to the Sacramento Kings, ended with Bronny scoring four points, two rebounds, two assists, and a steal in 21 minutes.

text: DALAYAWON ining hingyo sang siyudad sang Iloilo sa paghiwat sang clean-up, ukon pagpanglimpyo, sang bug-os nga siyudad sang Iloilo sa Sabado, Agosto 18.
english: The city of Iloilo's request to conduct a clean-up of the entire city on Saturday, August 18 is commendable.

text: Matuod, kon ginatagaan naton sang importansya ang aton personal hygiene kag kalimpyo sang aton panimalay, ngaa indi ta man hiwaton ini sa bug-os nga siyudad?
english: True, if we give importance to our personal hygiene and cleanliness of our homes, why don't we do it all over the city?

text: Ini sa kaayuhan man naton nga tanan, indi bala, lakip na kon ginahimo ta man ini sa adlaw-alaw nga indi paghaboy sang mga basura sa mga dalanon kag kon diin lang?
english: It's in the best interest of all of us, isn't it, especially if we do it every day not to throw garbage on the streets and everywhere else?

text: Kon maghaboy man, sa mga trash bins ukon sa mga natalana nga mga basurahan.
english: If you throw it away, it's in trash bins or designated bins.

text: Una nga rason dira sa pagpanglimpyo sing ugyon amo nga ang paghimo sang ugyon nga hublag ga-cultivar ini sang civic consciousness sa aton.
english: The first reason for cleaning up is that making a consensus movement cultivates civic consciousness in us.

text: Paagi sa civic consciousness, matalupangdan naton indi lang ang aton kaayuhan kundi pati na sang aton kasilingan kag sang aton katilingban sa siyudad.
english: Through civic consciousness, we can not only notice our own well-being but also that of our neighborhood and our city society.

text: Sa partikular nga pagpanglimpyo naton sang siyudad, matalupangdan naton nga kon nagapanglimpyo ang tanan, makabulig man ini sa ikaayong lawas sang tanan.
english: In our particular cleaning of the city, we notice that when everyone cleans, it also helps everyone's health.

text: Indi bala maayo isipon nga kita tanan naga-enjoy sang maayong kalawason kag panghuna-huna kag ang magasto naton sa pagpabulong magamit ta pa sa iban nga kinahanglanon sa panimalay?
english: Isn't it good to think that we all enjoy good health and well-being and that what we spend on medical treatment can be used for other household needs?

text: Sa karon, daku nga negosyo ang turismo, kag ang kalimpyo sang siyudad daku man nga rason kon ngaa makadto diri ang mga turista.
english: Today, tourism is a big business, and the city's cleanliness is also a big reason why tourists come here.

text: Segurado indi ina sila magkadto diri kon ma-basura kag mabaho ang aton palibot.
english: Surely they won't come here if our environment is garbage and smelly.

text: Nga daan ang siyudad sang Iloilo ginakabig nga isa sang mga gateway sang turismo sa Western Visayas pakadto sa probinsya sang Iloilo, sa Negros Occidental, kag sa isla sang Guimaras.
english: Iloilo City is already considered one of the gateways of tourism in Western Visayas to the province of Iloilo, Negros Occidental, and the island of Guimaras.

text: In fact, kon indi man sila magtener malawig diri, makapahuway-huway anay sila diri sa aton mga hotel kag makaduaw man sa madamo ta nga mga tourism sites.
english: In fact, if they don't stay long here, they can rest here in our hotels and visit our many tourism sites.

text: Ma-proteksyunan man naton ang aton palibot batok sa mga basura nga gabara sa aton mga drainage kag alagyan sang tubig agud malikawan ang pagbaha tungod sa barado nga mga guluwaan sang tubig.
english: We can also protect our environment against garbage that clogs our drainage and waterways to avoid flooding due to blocked water outlets.

text: Tungod malimpyo ang aton siyudad kag hilway sa  pagbaha, ma-enggayo man naton ang mga investor (negosyante) nga magbutang sang ila negosyo diri.
english: Because our city is clean and free from flooding, we can also encourage investors to set up their businesses here.

text: Ina tungod matahum, kay limpyo, ang aton siyudad kag makalikaw pa sila sa perhwisyo sang baha tungod sa gabara nga mga basura.
english: That's because our city is beautiful, because it's clean, and they can avoid the damage of floods because of the garbage.

text: Kon madamo nga negosyo ang magtindug diri, syempre madamo man ang trabaho sang aton mga pumuluyo.
english: If more businesses build here, of course there will be more jobs for our residents.

text: Tungod kon kis-a a la basura man ang mga ilegal nga istruktura sa mismo nga mga dalanon, mahawanan ta man ang dalan para magsulhay ang trapiko.
english: Because sometimes the illegal structures on the roads themselves are not garbage, we can also clear the road to ease traffic.

text: Ma-proteksyunan man naton ang aton mga makasaysayan nga mga lugar kag istruktura kon mapabilin naton sila sing limpyo.
english: We can also protect our historic sites and structures if we can keep them clean.

text: Indi lang sa basura kundi lakip na ang a la basura nga mga graffiti, ukon mahigko nga mga sinulatan nga ginahimo dira sang mga salawayon nga mga kabataan.
english: Not only in the garbage but also in the a la garbage graffiti, or dirty writings made there by the naughty children.

text: Of course, ma-proteksyunan ta man ang mga dunang manggad naton diri sa siyudad batok sa kahigko sang palibot.
english: Of course, we can also protect our natural resources here in the city against environmental pollution.

text: In fact, matahum nga panublion sang aton mga kabataan sa ulihi ang limpyo nga siyudad, indi bala?
english: In fact, a clean city is a beautiful legacy for our children in the future, isn't it?

text:
***

Ini nga pagpanglimpyo ginpahibalo ni Engr.
english:
***

This cleaning was announced by Engr.

text: Noel Hechanova, ang gapamuno sa City Environment and Natural Resources Office (City ENRO), sadtong  Lunes, Agosto 13.
english: Noel Hechanova, the head of the City Environment and Natural Resources Office (City ENRO), on Monday, August 13.

text: Sunu kay Hechanova, nahisugtan ini nila ni Mayor Jose Espinosa III bilang pagtamyaw kag pagselebrar sang City Charter Day sa palaabuton nga Agosto 25.
english: According to Hechanova, they agreed with Mayor Jose Espinosa III as a greeting and celebration of the City Charter Day on August 25.

text: Angot diri, ginasaligan gid ang pagpartisipar sang tanan nga mga pumuluyo.
english: In this regard, the participation of all citizens is highly relied upon.

text: Imbitado na ang mga eskwelahan kag mga national agencies sa pag-upod sa sining hublag sang siyudad.
english: Schools and national agencies have been invited to join the city's movement.

text: Ang pagpati ta sini nga ang mga naga-partisipar pagatagahan sing partikular nga lugar nga ila pagalimpyuhan nga itudlo sa ila sang Barangay Captain.
english: It is believed that the participants will be given a specific area to clean that will be pointed out to them by the Barangay Captain.

text: Katulad ini sang paghiwat sang International Coastal Day nga sadto gintalana sa siyudad sa isa ka resolusyon nga ginpasar kag ginsuguran ni anay Konsehal Dave Jamora.
english: This is similar to the celebration of International Coastal Day that was previously scheduled in the city in a resolution passed and initiated by former Councilor Dave Jamora.

text: Ang International Coastal Day ginahiwat kada tuig sa ikatlo nga Sabado sang Setyembre.
english: International Coastal Day is held annually on the third Saturday of September.

text: Sa nadumduman ko, daw wala na ugaling ini gina-selebrar sang siyudad.
english: As far as I remember, the city doesn't seem to celebrate it anymore.

text: Kon gina-selebrar man daw pasapayan lang.
english: If it is celebrated, it seems to be taken for granted.
