text: Pareho nga knockout ang target sang Filipino champion nga si Melvin Jerusalem kag Mexican challenger nga si Luis Castillo sa ila pagkitaay agud agawan ang World Boxing Council (WBC) minimumweight crown.
english: Filipino champion Melvin Jerusalem and Mexican challenger Luis Castillo are both targeting knockouts in their fight to clinch the World Boxing Council (WBC) minimumweight crown.

text: Matabo ang sambuwa sa Domingo, Septyembre 22, sa Mandaluyong City College.
english: The match will take place on Sunday, September 22, at Mandaluyong City College.

text: Wala sang gin-mensyonar si Castillo kun ano nga round sini matumba ang Pinoy boxer, apang ginsiling sini nga kumpyansa siya nga madala-pauli ang korona sa Mexico.
english: Castillo did not mention which round the Filipino boxer will fall, but said he is confident that he will bring home the crown to Mexico.

text: Wala sang kalutusan ang 27-anyos nga southpaw sa 21 sini ka hampang, may 13 ka knockouts kag isa ka draw kag ginalantaw man nga gamiton sini ang height kag reach advantage batok kay Jerusalem.
english: The 27-year-old southpaw is undefeated in 21 of his fights, with 13 knockouts and one draw and is also expected to use his height and reach advantage against Jerusalem.

text: Gamiton naman ni Jerusalem ang iya natun-an sang una nga tion sini nga gintinguhaan nga depensahan ang iya World Boxing Organization (WBO) mini flyweight belt sang 2023 apang nalutos.
english: Jerusalem will use what he learned the first time he tried to defend his World Boxing Organization (WBO) mini flyweight belt in 2023 but lost.

text: Kumpyansa naman ang pambato sang Pilipinas nga nabasa na sini ang hulag sang kasumpong bangud madugay sini nga gin-sulit-sulit ang iya mga hampang.
english: The Philippine boxer is confident that he has read his opponent's movements because he has been repeating his games for a long time.

text: Espesyal ang sambuwa sang duha bangud ini ang una nga world title fight sa Pilipinas sa sulod sang pito ka tuig.
english: The fight between the two is special because it is the first world title fight in the Philippines in seven years.

text: Ini man ang una nga title defense sang Pinoy boxer sa kaugalingon nga pungsod, partikular para sa WBC belt, halin sang nadepensahan ni Manny Pacquiao ang iya WBC flyweight crown batok anay kay Gabriel Mira sang Mexico sa Araneta Coliseum sang 1999.
english: It is also the first title defense of a Filipino boxer in his own country, specifically for the WBC belt, since Manny Pacquiao defended his WBC flyweight crown against former Gabriel Mira of Mexico at the Araneta Coliseum in 1999.

text: Nagpahayag ng buong suporta si North Korean leader Kim Jong Un kay Russian President Vladimir Putin kaugnay ng patuloy na digmaan sa Ukraine, ayon sa ulat ng state media ng Pyongyang nitong Linggo.
english: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has expressed full support to Russian President Vladimir Putin over the ongoing war in Ukraine, Pyongyang's state media reported on Sunday.

text: Ginawa ni Kim ang kanyang pahayag sa pakikipagpulong kay Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov, na bumisita sa North Korea bilang bahagi ng serye ng diplomatic missions ng mga mataas na opisyal ng Russia.
english: Kim made his remarks during a meeting with Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov, who visited North Korea as part of a series of diplomatic missions by senior Russian officials.

text: Layunin ng mga pagbisitang ito na palakasin ang ugnayang diplomatiko sa gitna ng nagpapatuloy na tensyon sa pagitan ng Russia at ng mga bansang Kanluranin.
english: The visits aim to strengthen diplomatic relations amid ongoing tensions between Russia and Western countries.

text: Ipinahayag ni Kim ang kanyang matibay na suporta sa anumang hakbang na gagawin ng pamahalaan ng Russia upang maresolba ang krisis sa Ukraine.
english: Kim expressed his strong support for any steps taken by the Russian government to resolve the crisis in Ukraine.

text: Kumpyansa rin umano ang North Korean leader na magtatagumpay ang Russian army sa kanilang layuning ipagtanggol ang dignidad at soberanya ng kanilang bansa.
english: The North Korean leader is also confident that the Russian army will succeed in its goal of defending the dignity and sovereignty of their country.

text: Matapos ang kanilang pag-uusap, nagpugay si Lavrov kay Kim at muling pinagtibay ang mga kasunduang nabuo sa summit ng North Korea at Russia noong Hunyo 2024.
english: After their conversation, Lavrov shook hands with Kim and reaffirmed the agreements reached at the North Korea-Russia summit in June 2024.

text: Kabilang sa mga ito ang mga usaping pang-ekonomiya, militar, at diplomatikong kooperasyon.
english: These include economic, military, and diplomatic cooperation.

text: Nagtaas ang mga presyo sang mga grocery items sa Noche Buena lima ka porsyento.
english: Prices of grocery items on Noche Buena increased by five percent.

text: Suno sa pinakaulihi nga mga inspeksyon sang Department of Agriculture (DA), ang presyo sang manok kag baboy nagtaas bangud sang mas mataas nga demand sa tion sang bakasyon.
english: According to the latest inspections by the Department of Agriculture (DA), chicken and pork prices increased due to higher demand during the holiday season.

text: Nagpasalig naman si Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.
english: Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.

text: sa publiko nga wala na sang ginapaabot nga pagtaas sang presyo antes sang katapusan sang tuig.
english: to the public that no more price increases are expected before the end of the year.

text: Suno kay Tiu Laurel, gina-imbestigaran pa nila kon ngaa “stubbornly” nga nagpabilin nga mataas ang presyo sang bugas, nga may P12 nga premium nga presyo.
english: Tiu Laurel said they are still investigating why the price of rice remained “stubbornly” high, with a P12 premium price.

text: Availabale naman ang mas barato nga bugas sa balor nga P40 tubtub P45 ang ginabaligya sang DA sa idalom sang programa nga Rice-for-All.
english: Cheaper rice at P40 to P45 is available under the Rice-for-All program.

text: Maga-file sang resolution si Senate Minority Leader Aquilino Pimentel III agud ma-imbestigaran sa Senado ang bag-o lang ginpaguwa nga polymer banknotes kun sa diin ginpangkakas na ang imahe sang former presidents, mga baganihan, kag mga martir.
english: Senate Minority Leader Aquilino Pimentel III will file a resolution to investigate in the Senate the recently issued polymer banknotes where the images of former presidents, heroes, and martyrs have been removed.

text: Suno kay Pimentel, madamo sang kinahanglan ipaathag ang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) kaangot sa pag-desinyo sa bag-o nga banknotes sa baylo nga magtutok kuntani sila sa ila trabaho sa pagtapna sang inflation.
english: According to Pimentel, the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) has a lot to explain regarding the design of the new banknotes instead of focusing on their work to curb inflation.

text: Gintawag sang senador nga buang-buang nga ideya ang pagpili sang “plastic” sa baylo sa “paper money” nga himo sa abaca kag cotton.
english: The senator called the choice of “plastic” instead of “paper money” made of abaca and cotton a stupid idea.

text: Sa iya igaduso nga resolution, ginalauman nga pangunahan sang Senate committee on banks, financial institutions and currencies ang pag-usisa sa amo nga isyu.
english: In his proposed resolution, the Senate committee on banks, financial institutions and currencies is expected to lead the investigation into the issue.

text: Bukadon man kun pila ang gingasto para sa bag-o nga desinyo kag hibaluon kun ano ang resulta sang trial run sang una nga ginpaguwa ang P1,000 nga polymer notes sang 2022.
english: It will also reveal how much was spent on the new design and find out the results of the trial run when the P1,000 polymer notes were first released in 2022.

text: Sa bag-o nga gin-release nga polymer notes, ang Philippine Eagle kag sampaguita ang nakabutang sa P1000 bill; Visayan spotted deer kag Acanthephippium mantinianum sa P500 bill; Palawan peacock-pheasant kag Ceratocentron fesselii sa P100 note; kag Visayan leopard cat kag Vidal’s lanutan sa P50 note.
english: In the newly released polymer notes, the Philippine Eagle and sampaguita are on the P1000 bill; Visayan spotted deer and Acanthephippium mantinianum for P500 bill; Palawan peacock-pheasant and Ceratocentron fesselii for P100 note; and Visayan leopard cat and Vidal’s lanutan on the P50 note.

text: Buot silingon, lakip sa ginpangdula nga mga imahe amo ang ila sang tatlo ka World War II martyrs sa P1000 bill nga sanday Chief Justice Jose Abad Santos, Brig.
english: In other words, among the deleted images were those of three World War II martyrs on the P1000 bill, Chief Justice Jose Abad Santos, Brig.

text: Gen.
english: Gen.

text: Vicente Lim, kag suffragist kag Girl Scouts founder Josefa Llanes Escoda.
english: Vicente Lim, and suffragist and Girl Scouts founder Josefa Llanes Escoda.

text: Wala naman sanday late former presidents Manuel Roxas kag Sergio Osmeña nga yara anay sa P100 kag P50 bill.
english: Late former presidents Manuel Roxas and Sergio Osmeña, who were on the P100 and P50 bills, were not present.

text: Ang ginakabig pinaka-kontrobersyal nga gindula nga imahe sa P500 polymer note amo ang ila nanday late president Corazon Aquino kag iya bana nga si anay Senador Ninoy Aquino.
english: The most controversial deleted image on the P500 polymer note is that of late President Corazon Aquino and her husband, former Senator Ninoy Aquino.

text: Ini nga mag-asawa ang makabig nga central figures sa pagtapos sang diktadurya ni anay President Ferdinand Marcos, Sr.
english: The couple are considered central figures in ending the dictatorship of former President Ferdinand Marcos, Sr.

text: nga amay ni President Bongbong Marcos, Jr.
english: father of President Bongbong Marcos, Jr.

text: Ginareklamo sang pila ka mga konsehal sa syudad sang Iloilo ang opisina sa City Hall Annex Building bangud sa pag-moist kag pag-molds sa kisame, nga ginpahayag nga posible naghalin sa leakage sang tubig sa pipelines.
english: Some councilors in Iloilo City are complaining about the office in the City Hall Annex Building due to moisture and molds on the ceiling, which is said to be possibly caused by water leakage in the pipelines.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Councilor Sheen Marie Mabilog, iya ginpahayag nga wala pa sang problema sa kisame sang Disyembre, apang sang nagbalik sila, nakita nila nga naga-moist ini kag may molds na sa kisame.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Councilor Sheen Marie Mabilog said there was no problem with the ceiling in December, but when they returned, they found it moist and there were molds on the ceiling.

text: Nagpadala na sila sang sulat sa City Engineers Office kag kay Mayor Raisa Treñas kag nagapangayo sila sang bulig agud mahatagan sang solusyon ang nasambit nga problema.
english: They have already sent a letter to the City Engineers Office and Mayor Raisa Treñas asking for help to find a solution to the problem.

text: Ginreport man nga may ara sang leakage sa opisina ni Councilor Rex Sarabia kag sa opisina ni Vice Mayor Love-love Baronda amo man kay Councilor Nene De Llana nga opisina.
english: It was also reported that there was a leakage in the office of Councilor Rex Sarabia and in the office of Vice Mayor Love-love Baronda as well as in the office of Councilor Nene De Llana.

text: Nagapakita nga indi lang isa ka lugar ang apektado kundi madamo nga opisina sa building.
english: It appears that not just one area is affected but multiple offices in the building.

text: ANG TANAN nga atleta ukon team luyag magdaug sa kompetisyon.
english: ALL athletes or teams want to win the competition.

text: Kon indi gid man tsampyon, okey na ang makasulod sa Top 3 sa madamo nga nagapasakop agud makadala sing medalya nga mapabugal nila.
english: If it's not a championship, it's okay to be in the Top 3 of the many participants to bring a medal that they can be proud of.

text: Ukon bisan magpakita man lang sang maayo nga showing sa ila pag-representar sang ila eskwelahan, distrito, ukon sang pungsod.
english: Or even just show a good showing in their representation of their school, district, or country.

text: In fact, ang pagpakita sang maayo nga showing sang atleta ukon team, madaug man ukon mapierde, bastante na nga makapasadya kag mag-ani sing pagdayaw sang mga supporter.
english: In fact, showing a good showing by the athlete or team, whether winning or losing, is enough to satisfy and garner the admiration of the supporters.

text: Indi bala?
english: Isn't it?

text: Tungod sini, himuon sang pamunuan ang tanan agud mapabakud ang ila mga atleta kag team, katulad sang basketbol nga ginakalingawan gid sang mga Filipino.
english: Therefore, the government will do everything to strengthen its athletes and teams, such as basketball that Filipinos enjoy.

text: Sa pagpabakud sang team, kon matugutan, ang pamunuan nagakuha gani sang mga bag-o ukon dugang nga mga atleta halin sa gwa sang lokal nga team.
english: To strengthen the team, if permitted, the leadership even recruits new or additional athletes from outside the local team.

text: Sa masami, partikular sa kaso sang basketbol sa Pilipinas, ginatugutan sang FIBA World Cup kag Asian Games (Asiad) nga malakip sa lokal nga team ang mga maayo nga player nga makuha naton halin sa mga half-Filipino kag naturalized nga mga Filipino sa mga internasyonal nga mga pahampang katulad sang NBA sang Estados Unidos.
english: Often, particularly in the case of basketball in the Philippines, the FIBA ​​World Cup and Asian Games (Asiad) allow the local team to include the best players we get from half-Filipinos and naturalized Filipinos in international games such as the NBA in the United States.

text: Kon kis-a indi man ugaling mahapos ang pagkuha sang mga player halin sa gwa sang lokal nga team, labi na gid kon magahalin pa sa iban nga team sang iban nga pungsod tungod sa mga regulasyon sang ila pagpasakop sa gwa sang ila team.
english: Sometimes it is not easy to get players from outside the local team, especially if they are coming from other teams in other countries because of the regulations of their participation outside their team.

text: Sa sining ulihi lang, nagka-problema gani kita sa pagkuha sa half-Filipino nga si Jordan Clarkson sang Cavaliers agud ilakip sa aton team sa Asian Games nga hampangon na sa Agosto 18 tubtub Setyembre 2 sa sining tuig.
english: Recently, we even had trouble getting half-Filipino Jordan Clarkson of the Cavaliers to be included in our team for the Asian Games which will be played on August 18 to September 2 this year.

text: Sunu sa pagdumalahan sang Cavaliers, matugutan lang nila nga makuha sang Pilipinas ang 6’5” nga si Clarkson sa FIBA pero indi sa Asian Games.
english: According to the Cavaliers management, they will only allow the Philippines to take the 6'5” Clarkson in FIBA ​​but not in the Asian Games.

text: Madamo ugaling ang nagkwestyon sining desisyon sang pagdumalahan sang Cavaliers.
english: Many, however, questioned this decision by the Cavaliers management.

text: Ina tungod gintugutan man sang Houston Rockets nga mahulam ang 7’2” nga si Zhou Qi sang Tsina agud makapasakop sa Asian Games nga may blessings sang NBA.
english: That's because the Houston Rockets also allowed China's 7'2” Zhou Qi to be borrowed to participate in the Asian Games with the blessings of the NBA.

text: Madamo nga mga utod naton nga netizen sa social media ang nagsiling nga may discriminasyon ang ining desisyon sa kaso ni Clarkson kag Zhou Qi.
english: Many of our brother netizens on social media said that this decision in the case of Clarkson and Zhou Qi is discriminatory.

text: Nga daan bag-o lang kita ginpakitaan sang indi maayo nga batasan (pagka-arogante, pagpakanubo kag pagkapintas) sang mga Boomers sang Australia sa qualifying game naton (Gilas Pilipinas) sa FIBA sadtong hampang nila diri mismo sa Pilipinas sa Bocaue, Bulacan.
english: That we have just been shown the bad behavior (arrogance, humiliation and cruelty) of the Boomers of Australia in our qualifying game (Gilas Pilipinas) in FIBA ​​during their match here in the Philippines in Bocaue, Bulacan.

text: Sa sining ila hampang, si Pogoy sang Gilas ginsiko sa liog ni Kickert sang Boomers nga, sunu sa isa ka karate expert, puede ini siya mapatay kon napuruhan.
english: In this match, Pogoy of the Gilas was elbowed in the neck by Kickert of the Boomers who, according to a karate expert, could have killed him if he had been injured.

text: Ginbangdan gani ini sang kinagamo sa basketball court nga naglakip kay Gilas coach nga si Chot Reyes kag assistant coach Uichiko.
english: It even caused a riot on the basketball court involving Gilas coach Chot Reyes and assistant coach Uichiko.

text: Napulo gid ka player sang Gilas, lakip ang ining duha, ang ginpatongan sing suspension.
english: Ten Gilas players, including these two, were suspended.

text: Tatlo lang ang sa Boomers.
english: Only three are in Boomers.

text: Gapati kita ugaling nga ang penalidad ni Kickert sang Boomers amo gid nga i-“ban for life” siya kag indi lang suspendihon sang tatlo ka games.
english: We believe, however, that Kickert's penalty from the Boomers is to ban him for life and not just suspend him for three games.

text: Tani, i-reconsider sang NBA ang desisyon sang Cavaliers nga indi ipahulam si Clarkson sa Philippine team para sa Asian Games kay gintugutan man sini ang pagpahulam kay Zhou Qi sa team sang Tsina.
english: Hopefully, the NBA will reconsider the decision of the Cavaliers not to loan Clarkson to the Philippine team for the Asian Games because it also allowed the loan of Zhou Qi to the Chinese team.

text: Kon mahimo nila ini, puede na kita magpati nga wala man gali sing diskriminasyon ang desisyon sang NBA sa aton nga mga Filipino.
english: If they do this, we can believe that the NBA's decision is not discriminatory against us Filipinos.

text:
***

Tandaan naton nga ang away (lakip ang kontrobersya sa indi pagpahulam kay Clarkson sa Philippine team) indi lang madaug paagi sa pagpakita sang kusog, kundi sa mas epektibo nga away psychological.
english:
***

Let us remember that the fight (including the controversy over Clarkson not being loaned to the Philippine team) is not only won by a show of strength, but by a more effective psychological fight.

english: The Vietnamese also regained their country from foreign power simply because of their unwavering love and rights to their country even when they faced the unparalleled strength of foreigners.

text:
MANILA – “We’ve always been okay, we just don’t agree politically.”

Ini ang nangin pahayag ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english:
MANILA – “We’ve always been okay, we just don’t agree politically.”

This was stated by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: sang gin-usisa kaangot sa indi pag-intindihanay sang pamilya Marcos kag Aquino.
english: when asked about the misunderstanding between the Marcos and Aquino families.

text: Kahapon, Hulyo 9, ginpakigbahin ni First Lady Atty. Louise “Liza” Araneta-Marcos ang mga pictures kaupod ang anay sang aktres kag TV host nga si Kris Aquino nga sanday Josh kag Bimby sang nagpadulong ini sa iya opisina.
english: Yesterday, July 9, First Lady Atty. Louise “Liza” Araneta-Marcos took pictures with actress and TV host Kris Aquino's ex, Josh and Bimby, when she went to his office.

text: Suno kay Presidente Marcos, si Kris, nga yara subong sa Estados Unidos agud magpabulong, ang nagpangayo sang travel assistance, nga wala naman gindetalye pa sini.
english: According to President Marcos, Kris, who is currently in the United States for medical treatment, requested travel assistance, which he did not elaborate on.

text: Ginkalipay naman sang presidente ang ginhimo sang mag-utod nga sanday Josh kag Bimby nga pagbisita sa First Lady.
english: The president welcomed the visit of brothers Josh and Bimby to the First Lady.

text: “The reason na pinuntahan nila si First Lady ay simple lamang, nangailangan si, I think it was Kris Aquino who needed some assistance for something,” pahayag ni Presidente Marcos.
english: “The reason they went to the First Lady is simple, Kris Aquino needed some assistance for something,” President Marcos said.

text: “So tumulong si First Lady, sabi niya magpasalamat sila … and so I think it was a fine gesture on the part of the Aquino family,”dugang pa sini.
english: “So the First Lady helped, she said they should thank ... and so I think it was a fine gesture on the part of the Aquino family,” he added.

text: Ginpakigbahin man sang presidente nga ang First Lady ang tiya nanday Josh kag Bimby.
english: The president also shared that the First Lady is Josh and Bimby’s aunt.

text: “Liza is their aunt.
english: “Liza is their aunt.

text: Dahil ang kanyang auntie ay napangasawa si Don Pepe na eldest brother of Cory so they are related,” paathag sang presidente.
english: Because his auntie married Don Pepe who is Cory's eldest brother so they are related,” the president explained.

text:

Ginbawian sang kabuhi ang isa ka police officer halin sa Dao, Capiz matapos ang natabo nga ginaalegar nga accidental discharge sang service firearm sa sulod sang ila quarters sa 4th Maneuver Platoon sang 1st Aklan Provincial Mobile Force Company sa Sitio Murayan Junction, Poblacion, Altavas, Aklan.
english:
(This content discusses an incident involving an accidental firearm discharge that may be distressing to some readers.)

A police officer from Dao, Capiz was killed after an alleged accidental discharge of a service firearm inside their quarters in the 4th Maneuver Platoon of the 1st Aklan Provincial Mobile Force Company in Sitio Murayan Junction, Poblacion, Altavas, Aklan.

text: Ang biktima isa ka 28-anyos nga Patrolman kag residente sang Barangay Bita, Dao, Capiz.
english: The victim is a 28-year-old Patrolman and resident of Barangay Bita, Dao, Capiz.

text: Siya ang assigned sa Aklan PMFC.
english: He is assigned to Aklan PMFC.

text: Base sa report, may nabatian nga lupok ang kaupod sini kag sang iya ginlantaw ang quarters sang biktima, nakit-an sini ang duguon nga lawas sang pulis.
english: According to the report, his companion heard gunshots and when he looked in the victim's quarters, he saw the bloody body of the policeman.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sa insidente.
english: The investigation into the incident is ongoing.

text: Nagalaom si Senate Pro Tempore Ping Lacson nga indi mag-untat sa pagpakigbato si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Senate Pro Tempore Ping Lacson hopes that President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. will not stop fighting.

text: batok sa nagaduging nga korapsyon sa pungsod.
english: against the rampant corruption in the country.

text: Suno pa kay Senator Lacson nga kuntaani indi madula ang momentum sang Presidente matapos ang SONA 2025 batok sa mga wala sang huya nga naangot sa corruption sa flood control.
english: Senator Lacson said he hopes the President's momentum will not be lost after the SONA 2025 against those who are shamelessly involved in corruption in flood control.

text: Suno pa sa iya nga kinahanglan nga pabaskugon ang kampanya batok sa korupsyon sa tuig 2026.
english: He said the anti-corruption campaign needs to be intensified by 2026.

text: Ginapangunahan ni Senator Lacson ang Blue Ribbon Committee sa imbestigasyon sa gina-alegar nga kickback scheme sa mga ghost o substandard flood control projects.
english: Senator Lacson is leading the Blue Ribbon Committee in the investigation into the alleged kickback scheme in ghost or substandard flood control projects.

text: Sa matandaan nga nangin kotrobersyal ang ini nga problema sa pungsod kun sa diin nanginpulos ang pila ka indibidwal sang DPWH officials, mga mamalidha, kag mga kontraktor halin sa kwarta sang mga taxpayer.
english: It can be recalled that this problem has become controversial in the country where some individuals of DPWH officials, lawmakers, and contractors have benefited from taxpayers' money.

text: Dugang pa ni Lacson nga ang nagligad nga dokumento halin ato kay DPWH undersecretary Maria Catalina Cabral nga nangin basehan sang imbestigasyon.
english: Lacson added that the previous document was from DPWH undersecretary Maria Catalina Cabral which became the basis of the investigation.

text: Gin-detain sang mga pulis sa Poland ang renowned Ukrainian boxer kag heavyweight boxing champion nga si Oleksandr Usyk samtang yara ini sa Krakow airport.
english: Police in Poland detained renowned Ukrainian boxer and heavyweight boxing champion Oleksandr Usyk while he was at the Krakow airport.

text: Ginkumpirma ini ni Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelenskyy kun sa diin ginpahayag sini nga wala siya nanamian sa pag-tratar sa ila champion apisar pa nga gin-hilway man ini gilayon.
english: This was confirmed by Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy who said he did not like the treatment of their champion despite the fact that he was immediately released.

text: Wala sang ginhatag nga detalye ang presidente apang nagguwa sa reports sang ulihi nga gin-detain si Usyk sang Polish police matapos ini nag-protesta batok sa sala nga akusasyon batok sa iya abyan sa airport.
english: The president did not provide details but reports later emerged that Usyk was detained by Polish police after he protested against false accusations against his friend at the airport.

text: Ginbatuan sini ang pahayag sang staff sa airport nga hubog ang iya abyan kag indi mahimo makabyahe — bagay nga napamatud-an nga sala bangud gin-check ang iya abyan sa “deep alcohol intoxication” kag negatibo ang resulta.
english: He refuted the airport staff’s statement that his friend was drunk and could not travel — something that was proven wrong because his friend was checked for “deep alcohol intoxication” and the result was negative.

text: Bangud sa hitabo, nagtulog si Usyk kag ang abyan sini sa Poland sa sulod sang isa ka gab-i antes nagkadto sa Thessaloniki sa Greece.
english: Because of the incident, Usyk and his friend slept in Poland for one night before traveling to Thessaloniki in Greece.

text: Ang 37-anyos nga boksidor nga Olympic gold medalist sang 2012 ang kilala bilang isa sa pina-prominente nga atleta sa Ukraine kag sa luwas sang pungsod kag nagpasakop man kag nag-organisar anay sang mga proyekto nga naangot sa pagpamatok sa Russian invasion.
english: The 37-year-old boxer, who was an Olympic gold medalist in 2012, is known as one of the most prominent athletes in Ukraine and abroad and has also participated in and organized projects related to the opposition to the Russian invasion.

text: Nangin mas popular siya sang ginlutos niya si Tyson Fury sang Mayo sa Saudi Arabia kag nangin una nga undisputed world heavyweight champion sa sulod sang 24 ka tuig.
english: He rose to prominence when he defeated Tyson Fury in May in Saudi Arabia to become the first undisputed world heavyweight champion in 24 years.

text: Makaligad sini, ginbakante man ni Usyk ang amo nga undisputed title matapos nga wala sini gin-atubang ang iya mandatory challenger kag sa baylo, nagpasugot nga magsambuwa liwat kay Fury sa isa ka rematch nga natalana sa Disyembre 21 sa Saudi Arabia sa gihapon.
english: Usyk later vacated the undisputed title after he did not face his mandatory challenger and instead agreed to fight Fury again in a rematch scheduled for December 21 in Saudi Arabia.

text: Magluwas nga WBC, WBA kag WBO heavyweight champion, isa man ka undisputed champion si Usyk sa cruiserweight kag wala sang kalutusan sa sulod sang 22 ka mga hampang.
english: In addition to being the WBC, WBA and WBO heavyweight champion, Usyk is also the undisputed cruiserweight champion and is undefeated in 22 fights.

text: Naitala ang muling pagkaantala ng isinusulong na ceasefire deal sa Gaza bunsod ng hindi pagkakasundo ng mga partido hinggil sa lawak ng pag-urong ng mga puwersang Israeli mula sa Palestinian enclave.
english: The proposed ceasefire deal in Gaza has been delayed again due to disagreements between the parties over the extensive withdrawal of Israeli forces from the Palestinian enclave.

text: Ayon sa mga ulat mula sa Israel at Palestine, nagpapatuloy pa rin ang hindi direktang negosasyon sa Doha, Qatar, para sa isang 60-araw na tigil-putukan na unang iminungkahi ng Estados Unidos noong nakaraang Sabado.
english: According to reports from Israel and Palestine, indirect negotiations are still ongoing in Doha, Qatar, for a 60-day ceasefire first proposed by the United States last Saturday.

text: Bagamat umaasa si U.S. President Donald Trump sa pag-usad ng mga usapan, tila mas humihirap ang kalagayan matapos masangkot ang Israeli forces sa isang mass shooting incident.
english: Although U.S. President Donald Trump is hoping for a breakthrough in talks, the situation seems to be getting worse after Israeli forces were involved in a mass shooting incident.

text: Ayon sa mga medics sa Gaza, hindi bababa sa 17 katao ang nasawi matapos pagbabarilin umano ng mga tropang Israeli habang ang mga biktima ay nasa isang aid distribution point upang kumuha ng pagkain.
english: According to medics in Gaza, at least 17 people were injured after Israeli troops allegedly shot them while the victims were at an aid distribution point to get food.

text: Sa ulat ng United Nations, umaabot na sa 800 katao ang nasawi sa kaparehong mga sitwasyon sa loob lamang ng anim na linggo.
english: According to the United Nations, up to 800 people have been trapped in similar situations in just six weeks.

text: Ayon sa mga saksi, tinamaan sa ulo at katawan ang mga biktima.
english: According to witnesses, the victims were hit in the head and body.

text: Nakumpirma rin ito ng isang reporter mula sa Reuters na personal na nakakita sa mga labi ng mga biktima na nakabalot sa puting shroud sa Nasser Hospital habang nagluluksa ang mga kaanak.
english: This was also confirmed by a reporter from Reuters who personally saw the lips of the victims wrapped in white shrouds at Nasser Hospital while the children were mourning.

text: Inamin naman ng militar ng Israel ang insidente ngunit iginiit nilang warning shots lamang ang kanilang pinakawalan at wala silang nakitang tinamaan mula rito.
english: The Israeli military acknowledged the incident but insisted they only fired warning shots and did not see any casualties.

text: Samantala, patuloy ang dayalogo ng mga delegasyon mula sa Israel at Hamas sa Qatar upang maabot ang kasunduan para sa unti-unting pagpapalaya ng mga bihag, pag-urong ng mga tropang Israeli, at pag-uusap tungkol sa posibleng wakas ng digmaan.
english: Meanwhile, delegations from Israel and Hamas continue dialogue in Qatar to reach an agreement for the gradual release of hostages, the withdrawal of Israeli troops, and talks on a possible end to the war.

text: Iginiit ng Israel na ang pagkaantala sa kasunduan ay bunsod ng pagtanggi umano ng Hamas sa mga panukalang pag-alis ng Gaza.
english: Israel insists that the delay in the agreement is the result of Hamas' alleged rejection of proposals to withdraw from Gaza.

text: Ngunit ayon sa Hamas, nais lamang nilang bumalik sa mga teritoryong dating napagkasunduan sa mga nakaraang usapan.
english: But according to Hamas, they only want to return to the territories previously agreed in previous talks.

text: Ang insidente ng pamamaril sa Rafah nitong Sabado ay itinuturing na pinakabagong trahedya sa gitna ng krisis, kung saan nasawi ang ilang sibilyan habang desperadong kumukuha ng pagkain.
english: The shooting incident in Rafah on Saturday is considered the latest tragedy in the midst of the crisis, where several civilians were killed while desperately getting food.

text: Matatandaang inilunsad ng Israel ang bagong sistema ng pamamahagi ng ayuda noong Mayo, katuwang ang Estados Unidos.
english: Israel launched a new aid distribution system in May, along with the United States.

text: Binabantayan ito ng mga tropang Israeli upang pigilan ang pagsasamantala ng mga militante, ngunit kinukuwestiyon ito ng United Nations dahil sa panganib na kinakaharap ng mga sibilyan.
english: It is guarded by Israeli troops to prevent militant exploitation, but the United Nations questions it because of the danger civilians face.

text: Samantala, libu-libong Israeli ang nagtipon sa Tel Aviv upang ipanawagan ang agarang pagpapalaya sa mga natitirang bihag at ang tuluyang pagtatapos ng madugong digmaan.
english: Meanwhile, thousands of Israelis gathered in Tel Aviv to call for the immediate release of the remaining hostages and an immediate end to the bloody conflict.

text: Nagpaguwa sang iya nga statement si suspended Cavite 4th District Rep.

text: Kiko Barzaga kaangot sa kamatayon ni Dueñas, Iloilo Vice Mayor Aimee Paz Lamasan.

text:

text: Ginpasuni man ni Barzaga nga makaduluda ang timing kag nature sa likod sang kamatayon ni Lamasan.
english: Barzaga also alleged that the timing and nature behind Lamasan's death was suspicious.

text:

He said, “An investigation must be made to determine whether her death was caused by her knowledge of the flood control anomalies in the province of Iloilo.”

He even said “Happy New Year” at the end of his video.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) nga natabo ang insidente sa isa ka residential village sa Barangay Tabuc Suba, La Paz, Iloilo City sang Disyembre 30.
english: Earlier, the Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) said the incident occurred in a residential village in Barangay Tabuc Suba, La Paz, Iloilo City on December 30.

text: Base sa inisyal nga reports, ginapreparar sang vice mayor ang mga gamit sini, apang aksidente sini nga napitik ang trigger sang iya pusil kag naigo siya sa tuo nga bahin sang iya nga tiyan.
english: According to initial reports, the vice mayor was preparing his belongings when he accidentally pulled the trigger of his gun and hit him in the right side of his stomach.

text: Ginpaidalom pa si Lamasan sa operasyon, samtang napatay sang Bisperas sang New Year samtang padayon siya nga ginabulong sa ospital.
english: Lamasan underwent surgery, while he died on New Year's Eve while undergoing treatment at the hospital.

text: Nagtukod na ang ICPO sang Special Investigation Team agud nga lantawon ang sirkumstansya sa likod sang kamatayon sini.
english: The ICPO has set up a Special Investigation Team to look into the circumstances behind his death.

text: Sa statement naman sang pamilya Lamasan, ginsiling nila nga ipaguwa nila ang official cause of death ni Lamasan kun mangin available na ang supporting documents.
english: In a statement, the Lamasan family said they will release the official cause of death of Lamasan when the supporting documents become available.

text: “During this difficult time, the Lamasan family respectfully requests continued prayers for the eternal repose of the soul of Honorable Aimee Paz Lamasan, and for strength for her bereaved loved ones as they mourn her loss,” suno sa pamilya Lamasan.#
english: “During this difficult time, the Lamasan family respectfully requests continued prayers for the eternal repose of the soul of Honorable Aimee Paz Lamasan, and for strength for her bereaved loved ones as they mourn her loss,” the Lamasan family said.#

text: Mas gin-istriktuhan sang Department of Trade and Industry-Fair Trade Enforcement Bureau (DTI-FTEB) ang monitoring sa uncertified fireworks samtang nga nagahilapit ang Bag-ong Tuig.
english: The Department of Trade and Industry-Fair Trade Enforcement Bureau (DTI-FTEB) has tightened monitoring of uncertified fireworks as the New Year approaches.

text: Ini kasunod sang apelar halin sa legal firecracker manufacturers nga mas huguton sang otoridad ang pagpatuman sang pagsulundan batok sa pagbaligya sang iligal ukon wala na-certify nga mga produkto.
english: This follows an appeal from legal firecracker manufacturers for the authorities to tighten the enforcement of rules against the sale of illegal or uncertified products.

text: Pahayag sang bureau, sa kada may madakpan sila nga nagalapas nga manufacturers, maga-isyu sila sang cease and desist orders kag may yara pa sang special law nga amo naman ang iga-enforce ang mga pulis kaangot naman sa criminal aspect.
english: The bureau said that whenever they catch violating manufacturers, they will issue cease and desist orders and there is a special law that the police will enforce regarding the criminal aspect.

text: Nagpasalig man ang bureau nga nagapakig-angot sila sa Philippine National Police (PNP) kag sa local government units (LGUs) kaangot naman sa mga ordinansa kag designated areas para sa pag-display kag pagbaligya sang certified firecrackers.
english: The bureau also assured that they are liaising with the Philippine National Police (PNP) and local government units (LGUs) regarding ordinances and designated areas for the display and sale of certified firecrackers.

text: Una naman nga nagpanawagan si DTI Secretary Cristina Aldeguer-Roque sa consumers nga magbakal lamang sang certified fireworks para sigurado nga safe subong nga holiday season.
english: Earlier, DTI Secretary Cristina Aldeguer-Roque urged consumers to buy only certified fireworks to ensure safety this holiday season.

text: May nabalhag naman ang Bureau of Philippine Standards ang comprehensive list sang certified fireworks sa website sang DTI.
english: The Bureau of Philippine Standards has published a comprehensive list of certified fireworks on the DTI website.

text: Sa bahin naman sang Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE), ginpahanumdom sa mga establisyemento sa pyrotechnics industry nga istrikto nga magsunod sa Occupational Safety and Health Standards.
english: On the other hand, the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) reminded establishments in the pyrotechnics industry to strictly follow the Occupational Safety and Health Standards.

text: Base sa Labor Advisory No.
english: Based on Labor Advisory No.

text: 15 nga gin-isyu sini nga weekend, ginsiling nga katungdanan sang mga kumpaniya nga siguruhon nga safe ang ulubrahan para sa tanan nga workers.
english: 15 issued this weekend, said it is the duty of companies to ensure a safe workplace for all workers.

text: Ginmanduan man ang regional directors sang ahensya nga magpasa sang lista sang mga establisyemento nga ila nga na-monitor sa Bureau of Working Conditions antes ang Enero 10, 2025.
english: The agency's regional directors were also instructed to submit a list of establishments they have monitored to the Bureau of Working Conditions before January 10, 2025.

text: Maskne, mainit, mabalhas, amu na ang gakaeksperyensyahan sang mga Pilipino bangud sa adlaw adlaw nga pagsuksuk sang facemask.
english: Maskne, hot, sweaty, that's what Filipinos are experiencing because of the daily wearing of facemasks.

text: Mabudlay pa gid kun magkaon bangud indi malikawasn nga mauyatan ang gamit na nga facemask.
english: It is even more difficult to eat because it is inevitable to hold the facemask.

text: Gusto mo bala sang easy way out?
english: Want an easy way out?

text: Gusto mo bala nga kun magkaon ka indi mo na kinahanglan nga kuhaon ang imo facemask?
english: Do you wish you didn't have to take off your facemask when you eat?

text: May sabat dira ang South Korea.
english: South Korea has an answer here.

text: Sa nasambit nga pungsod, may yara sang ginabaligya nga ila gintawag nga “kosk”, bag-o nga sahi sang South Korean face mask nga ang ilong lang ang ginatakpan.
english: In the said country, there is a sale of what they called “kosk”, a new type of South Korean face mask that only covers the nose.

text: Ang ‘kosk” ang combination sa ‘ko’ Korean word para sa nose ukon ilong kag ‘mask’.
english: 'Kosk' is a combination of 'ko' the Korean word for nose and 'mask'.

text: Ang amu nga kosk ang ginabligya sang Atman company sa diin ini ang may duha ka parts sa diin ang sa dalom nga bahin ang mahimo nga makakas agud nga ma-expose ang baba kun magkaon.
english: The kosk is sold by Atman company where it has two parts where the bottom part can be removed to expose the mouth when eating.

text: Ang Kosk ang mabakal lamang sa South Korea kag nakabaton naman ini sang madamo nga pagpakamalaut halin Western world.
english: Kosk is only available in South Korea and has received a lot of criticism from the Western world.

text: Madamo na ang mga komento nga ini “strange idea” kag “next level of stupidity” nga invention bangud ila ini ginkabig nga useless accessory batuk sa COVID-19.
english: There have been many comments that this is a “strange idea” and “next level of stupidity” invention because they considered it a useless accessory against COVID-19.

text: Apang, ang kosk ang may yara sang 5-star rating halin sa 118 reviews sa South Korean store sa diin ang pack sang 10 masks ang nagabalor sang 9,800 won ($8.20).
english: However, kosk has a 5-star rating from 118 reviews in the South Korean store where a pack of 10 masks costs 9,800 won ($8.20).

text: PILA sang nasugilanon naton, parti sa ulihi nga hampang sa tunga sang San Miguel Beer (SMB) kag Ginebra, indi makapati nga mapierde ang SMB kontra sa Ginebra.
english: SOME of those we spoke to, about the last game between San Miguel Beer (SMB) and Ginebra, could not believe that SMB would lose against Ginebra.

text: Sa nagligad nga Game 6 sang Miyerkoles sa ila Best of 7 championship round, ang Ginebra nagdaug, 4-2, kontra sa defending champion nga SMB.
english: Last Wednesday’s Game 6 in their Best of 7 championship round, Ginebra won, 4-2, against defending champion SMB.

text: Kalaw-ay kuno sang hampang sang SMB.
english: SMB's game is said to be ugly.

text: Daw indi kuno mapatihan.
english: He said it was unbelievable.

text: Labi na gid sang pagsugod sang ila hampang sa  3rd quarter tubtub sa 4th kag last quarter.
english: Especially from the beginning of their game in the 3rd quarter to the 4th and last quarter.

text: Daw hungod kuno nga nagpa-pierde ang SMB.
english: It seems that SMB deliberately lost.

text: Bisan mahapos nga “shoot” indi nila kuno mapasulod kag daw indi sila kahibalo mag-gwardya nga naghatag sing kahigayunan sa Ginebra agud makapamuntos sing husto.
english: Even an easy shot they couldn't get in and they didn't seem to know how to guard which gave Ginebra the opportunity to score properly.

text: Well, gapati kita nga indi man seguro hungod nga nagpa-pierde ang San Miguel Beer.
english: Well, we believe that San Miguel Beer didn't lose on purpose.

text: Ano balaklon katulad sang pila ka player sadtong nagliligad nga dinag-on sa PBA nga na-iskandalo kay ang iban ginabaligya nila ang ila hampang?
english: What to buy like some players last year in the PBA who were scandalized because others sold their game?

text: Of course, posible.
english: Of course, possible.

text: Pero gapati kita nga wala ini sa kalidad sang San Miguel Beer.
english: But we believe that it is not in the quality of San Miguel Beer.

text: Kulang lang seguro sa kondisyon ukon “low”, ukon manubo, lang ang ila “biorhythm” nga nagakatabo man sa mga atleta.
english: They are probably just lacking in condition or “low”, or low, just their “biorhythm” which happens to athletes.

text: Pareho bala sa mga babaye nga may tion sang ila pagdugo nga mangakig na kon tandugon.
english: It's like women who have their periods and get angry when they're touched.

text: Samtang “high”, ukon mataas, ang “biorhythm” sadto sang Ginebra.
english: Meanwhile, the biorhythm of Geneva was high.

text: In fact, nakanotar gani ang isa ka matahum nga court announcer sang pagpaluya sang taga-SMB samtang nagahampang.
english: In fact, a beautiful court announcer even noticed the SMB player's weakness while playing.

text: Daw kapoy kaayo sa ila panghulag.
english: They seem very tired in their movements.

text: Importante ang ining “biorhythm” sa player.
english: This biorhythm is important to the player.

text: Dapat mabal-an ini sang coach agud maseguro nga ang tanan nga mga player sa court yara sa ila “high” nga “biorhythm” agud makahampang sing may kapagsik.
english: The coach must be aware of this to ensure that all players on the court are in their “high” “biorhythm” to play with energy.

text: Basi masiling kamo nga pagpangapin ini sa Ginebra.
english: You might say this is a defense of Geneva.

text: Indi.
english: No.

text: Ang matuod, “fan” ako ya sang SMB, madaug man ukon mapierde.
english: The truth is, I'm a fan of SMB, win or lose.

text: Kongrats na lang sa Ginebra.
english: Congratulations to Geneva.

text: Tubtub sa dason nga sambuwa sa basketball court.
english: Until the next game on the basketball court.

text:
***

State-sponsored, ukon kahimuan sang gobyerno, gid bala ang pagpamatay sang mga drug personalities sa idalom sang administrasyon ni Presidente Duterte, katulad sang pagpati sang iban?
english:
***

Is the killing of drug personalities under President Duterte's administration state-sponsored, as some believe?

text: Nga ini kahimuan gid man sang aton kapulisan pagkatapos magsugo ang Presidente nga pamatyon ini sila?
english: That this is the action of our police after the President ordered them to be killed?

text: Sa matandaan ta pa, sa una nga inadlaw mismo sang iya pagpungko sa pwesto, nag-warning na si Presidente sa mga drug personalities – druglord, pusher kag mga protector.
english: As we can recall, on the first day of his assumption of office, the President warned against drug personalities – druglords, pushers and protectors.

text:
Matigda niya nga ginsiling nga “I will kill you!”

Apang ini bala nagakahulugan nga basta pamatyon lang ini sila sandig lang sa suspetso kag indi sandig sa aton “Rule of Law” nga naga-mando nga tagaan sila sing “due process” kag “fair trial” tubtub mahusgahan gid sang husgado?
english:
He suddenly said, “I will kill you!”

But does this mean that they will be killed on suspicion and not on our Rule of Law which mandates that they be given due process and fair trial until they are judged by the court?

text: To be fair sa kay Presidente kag sa mga pulis, gin-explikar sang Presidente kag sang pamunuan sang kapulisan nga ang mga suspetsado puede mapatay lang in “self-defense” sa bahin sang mga pulis ukon sa tion lang sang pagpakig-enkwentro sa ila.
english: To be fair to the President and the police, the President and the police leadership explained that suspects can only be killed in “self-defense” on the part of the police or during an encounter with them.

text: Sa subong, sobra na sa 4,000 ang napatay nga mga drug personalities sa legitimo nga operasyon, sunu sa kapulisan.
english: So far, more than 4,000 drug personalities have been killed in legitimate operations, police said.

text: Sunu ugaling sa mga human rights advocates, sobra 10,000 na ang napatay sa sining War on Drugs.
english: However, according to human rights advocates, more than 10,000 people have been killed in this War on Drugs.

text: Kon matuod, ano ya ang natabo sa mga napatay nga mga 6,000 nga wala ma-rekord sang kapulisan, apang na-rekord sang mga human rights advocates?
english: If so, what happened to the 6,000 deaths that were not recorded by the police, but were recorded by human rights advocates?

text: Ginkalimtan lang tungod indi matagaan sing ebidensya ukon testigo sa idalom sang ginasiling nga legitimo nga operasyon?
english: Just forgotten because evidence or witnesses cannot be provided under a supposedly legitimate operation?

text: In fact, gadalom gani ang suspetso sang iban nga may “death squad” nga ginalakipan sang mga pulis – retirado man ukon yara sa aktibo nga serbisyo.
english: In fact, some even suspect that there is a “death squad” that includes policemen – whether retired or on active duty.

text: Ginpatihan ini sang iban tungod sang pila ka mga kaso sa diin na-link ang pila ka mga pulis sa pagpamatay sang mga motorcycle-riding, nga mas popular tawgon nga riding-in-tandem tungod sa masami duha ang sakay sini.
english: Some believed this because of several cases where some police officers were linked to the killing of motorcycle-riding, which is more popularly called riding-in-tandem because it usually has two people on board.

text: May mga 900 ka kaso na sing motorcycle-riding nga pagpamatay sumugod sadtong Oktubre 11, 2017 tubtub Hunyo 4,2018.
english: There have been about 900 cases of motorcycle-riding killings from October 11, 2017 to June 4, 2018.

text: Pero, kon may ara gid man nga “death squad”, ini bala nga mga pulis nagapaidalom sa sugo sang ila pamunuan?
english: But, if there really is a “death squad”, are these policemen subject to the orders of their leadership?

text: Ukon naga-akto lang sa ila kaugalingon kasubong sa mga sibilyan nga mga vigilantes nga “frustrated” sa kapaslawan sang aton gobyerno nga madakpan kag mahunong sa bilangguan ining mga “salot sang katilingban”?
english: Or are they just acting like civilian vigilantes who are “frustrated” with our government's failure to arrest and imprison these “plagues of society”?

text: Kon ano man ang matuod, kinahanglan dira ang pamatuod.
english: Whatever is true, it needs proof.

text: Ang aton Human Rights Commission daw wala man ugaling mapakita nga ebidensya.
english: Our Human Rights Commission, however, does not seem to have shown any evidence.

text: (w_mateojr@yahoo.com/PN)
english: (w_mateojr@yahoo.com/PN)

text: Natalana nga hingalitan sang Filipino boxer nga si Melvin Jerusalem ang hometown advantage sa iya pagdepensa sang ginauyatan nga World Boxing Council (WBC) minimumweight title batok sa undefeated Mexican nga si Luis Angel Castillo sa Mandaluyong City College sa Domingo, Septyembre 22.
english: Filipino boxer Melvin Jerusalem is scheduled to take advantage of the hometown advantage in his defense of the World Boxing Council (WBC) minimumweight title against undefeated Mexican Luis Angel Castillo at Mandaluyong City College on Sunday, September 22.

text: Ini ang mandatory defense ni Jerusalem matapos nagdaug sang belt kag napatilaw sa Japanese nga si Yudai Shigeoka ang una nga kapierdehan via split decision sang Marso 31 sa Nagoya, Japan.
english: This is Jerusalem's mandatory defense after winning the belt and suffering Japanese Yudai Shigeoka's first loss via split decision on March 31 in Nagoya, Japan.

text: Suno kay Michael Domingo, trainer sang Pinoy boxer, nahibaluan na nila nga si Castillo ang mangin mandatory challenger humalin sang nagdaug siya gani ila ini ginpreparahan sadto pa.
english: Michael Domingo, trainer of the Pinoy boxer, said they knew that Castillo would be the mandatory challenger since he won so they prepared for him long ago.

text: Samtang, apisar ini ang first career title shot ni Castillo kag pinakauna nga away sa gwa sang iya pungsod, dako ang pagsalig sang 27-anyos nga Mexican nga mangibabaw ini batok kay Melvin.
english: Meanwhile, despite this being Castillo's first career title shot and his first fight outside his country, the 27-year-old Mexican is confident that he will prevail against Melvin.

text: Ginatudlo nga ang pag-clog sang mga debris sa drainage sang Iloilo Central Market ang rason sang nagpuswak kag nagkalaguba nga tiles sa merkado.
english: It is alleged that the clogging of debris in the drainage of the Iloilo Central Market was the cause of the burst and broken tiles in the market.

text: Ini ang base sa resulta sang ginpatigayon nga joint inspection sang SM Prime Holdings Inc., (SMPHI), Local Economic Enterprise Office (LEEO), kag City Engineer’s Office kahapon nga adlaw.
english: This is based on the results of the joint inspection conducted by SM Prime Holdings Inc., (SMPHI), Local Economic Enterprise Office (LEEO), and City Engineer's Office yesterday.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantilaga Gorzal, spokesperson ni Mayor Raisa Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga agud malikawan ang masunod nga insidente, magadugang sang water pump sa Iloilo Central Market agud mapadasig ang pagpa-gwa sang tubig padulong sa main drainage system.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joy Fantilaga Gorzal, spokesperson of Mayor Raisa Treñas, said that to avoid the next incident, a water pump will be added to the Iloilo Central Market to speed up the release of water to the main drainage system.

text: Bangud sang insidente, walo ka vendors ang naapektuhan.
english: Due to the incident, eight vendors were affected.

text: Sa tatlo ka vendors, ginabulubanta nga masobra ₱229,000 ang balor sang ila mga produkto nga nadamage.
english: Of the three vendors, it is estimated that more than ₱229,000 worth of their products were damaged.

text: Sa bahin sang rice and grains, naglab-ot sa ₱81,000 ang balor sang 74 ka sako sang bugas ang nabasa.
english: In terms of rice and grains, 74 sacks of rice worth ₱81,000 were sold.

text: Sa kabug-usan, ginabulubanta nga masobra ₱311,000 ang kabug-usan nga balor sang mga produkto nga nadamage.
english: In total, the total value of the damaged products is estimated at more than ₱311,000.

text: Ginpahayag man nga ang mga claims sang mga vendors gin-submit na sa contractor.
english: It was also stated that the claims of the vendors have been submitted to the contractor.

text: Ginpasalig nga may ara sang 100 percent refund para sa mga apektado nga vendors kag igarelease ini gilayon.
english: He assured that there will be a 100 percent refund for the affected vendors and it will be released immediately.

text: Padayon naman ang close monitoring sang City Government kag mga concerned agencies agud masiguro nga indi na maliwat ang pareho nga problema.
english: The City Government and concerned agencies continue to closely monitor the situation to ensure that the same problem does not happen again.

text: Nagpaathag ang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) sa pagkakas sang imahe sang Philippine heroes sa bag-o nga series sang polymer banknotes nga ginsapubliko sang nagligad lamang nga adlaw.
english: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) has explained the removal of the image of Philippine heroes from the new series of polymer banknotes that was made public yesterday.

text: Suno kay Atty. Sarah Severina Curtis, director sang BSP Banknotes and Securities Production Management Department, ang mga picture sang mga baganihan ang ginkakas sa bag-o nga P500, P100 kag P50 banknotes apang magapabilin man ang mga ini sa paper banknotes.
english: According to Atty. Sarah Severina Curtis, director of the BSP Banknotes and Securities Production Management Department, said the pictures of the heroes have been removed from the new P500, P100 and P50 banknotes but will remain on the paper banknotes.

text: Sa baylo nga nawong sang mga baganihan, naka-feature sa bag-o nga banknotes ang mga sapat kag ang traditional local weave designs.
english: Instead of the faces of heroes, the new banknotes feature animals and traditional local weave designs.

text: Lakip sa mga sapat amo ang Visayan spotted deer, Palawan peacock pheasant kag whale shark nga patimaan suno sa central bank sang rich biodiversity sa Pilipinas ukon ang presensya sang endemic kag endangered species sa Pilipinas.
english: Among the animals are the Visayan spotted deer, Palawan peacock pheasant and whale shark which according to the central bank is a sign of the rich biodiversity in the Philippines or the presence of endemic and endangered species in the Philippines.

text: “‘Yung sa heroes…wala pong pagtanggal.
english: “‘The heroes…there is no removal.

text: Dagdag lang ito sa mga disenyo sa banknotes.
english: It's just an addition to the designs on the banknotes.

text: We want to also feature what other elements of Filipino identities are (sic) Bukod sa heroes, we are also known for our rich biodiversity kasi ,so ‘yung mga endemic, endangered species unto naman natin I-feature,” pahayag ni Curtis.
english: We want to also feature what other elements of Filipino identities are (sic) Besides heroes, we are also known for our rich biodiversity because, so ‘yung endemic, endangered species unto naman natin I-feature,” Curtis said.

text: Dugang sini, kun i-feature ini nga endangered animals, mas magasangkad ang ihibalo sang publiko nga kinahanglan ang paghatag sang proteksyon sa palibot kag sa dunang-manggad.
english: He added that if these endangered animals are featured, the public will be more aware of the need to protect the environment and natural resources.

text: Bangud sini nga mga pagbag-o sa bag-o nga banknotes, wala na ang imahe nanday former president Corazon Aquino kag bana sini nga si former Sen.
english: Due to these changes in the new banknotes, the image of former President Corazon Aquino and her husband, former Sen.

text: Benigno “Ninoy” Aquino Jr., amo man ang former presidents nga sanday Sergio Osmena kag Manuel Roxas.
english: Benigno “Ninoy” Aquino Jr., as well as former presidents Sergio Osmena and Manuel Roxas.

text: Sang ginpamangkot kun ano ang matabo sa nawong ni Cory Aquino, sabat ni Curtis: “Dito sa polymer banknotes, hindi po natin siya nai-feature pero we want to ensure na circulating pa rin po ang ating papel na banknotes.
english: When asked what will happen to Cory Aquino's face, Curtis replied: “Here in the polymer banknotes, we did not feature him but we want to ensure that our paper banknotes are still circulating.

text:
In terms of ratio, mas marami pa rin ang paper banknotes.”

Una na nga nag-reklamo ang August Twenty-One Movement (ATOM) nga ini ang una nga tion sa maragtas nga indi mga baganihan ang naka-feature sa designs sang Philippine currency.
english:
In terms of ratio, there are still more paper banknotes.”

Earlier, the August Twenty-One Movement (ATOM) complained that this is the first time in history that non-heroes have featured in the designs of the Philippine currency.

text: Mangin si Senator Francis “Chiz” Escudero ang nagpahayag man nga luyag sini nga magpa-athag ang BSP kun ngaa ginkakas ang historical figures sa kuwrata sang Pilipinas.
english: Even Senator Francis “Chiz” Escudero said he wants the BSP to explain why the historical figures were removed from the Philippine currency.

text: “The BSP, by law, is authorized to do that.
english: “The BSP, by law, is authorized to do that.

text: However, it does carry with it the responsibility to explain and be accountable regarding whatever changes it has or will do.
english: However, it does carry with it the responsibility to explain and be accountable regarding whatever changes it has or will do.

text: Am awaiting, together with a lot of curious people and with bated breath the reason and annotation of the changes,” pahayag sang senate president.
english: Am awaiting, together with a lot of curious people and with bated breath the reason and annotation of the changes,” the senate president said.

text: Ini nga bag-o nga polymer banknotes ang iga-release na sa limited quantities lamang umpisa sa Lunes, Disyembre 23.#
english: These new polymer banknotes will be released in limited quantities only starting Monday, December 23.#

text: Ginsulit ni North Korean leader Kim Jong nga handa ang ila pungsod nga maghatag sang “unconditional support” sa Russia agud nga ma-“resolba” ang kumplikto sini sa Ukraine.
english: North Korean leader Kim Jong reiterated that his country is ready to provide "unconditional support" to Russia in order to "resolve" its conflict with Ukraine.

text: Lakip ini sa ginpahayag ni Kim sang nagkitaay sila ni Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov sa Pyongyang.
english: This was among Kim's remarks during a meeting with Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov in Pyongyang.

text: Tatlo ka adlaw ang pagbisita sang diplomat sa North Korea.
english: The diplomat is on a three-day visit to North Korea.

text: Nagkitaay sila sa Lavrov sa eastern coastal city sang Wonsan.
english: They met in Lavrov in the eastern coastal city of Wonsan.

text: “Kim Jong Un reaffirmed the DPRK (Democratic People’s Republic of Korea) is ready to unconditionally support and encourage all the measures taken by the Russian leadership as regards the tackling of the root cause of the Ukrainian crisis,” santo sa report sang state news agency sang North Korea nga KCNA.
english: “Kim Jong Un reaffirmed the DPRK (Democratic People’s Republic of Korea) is ready to unconditionally support and encourage all the measures taken by the Russian leadership as regards the tackling of the root cause of the Ukrainian crisis,” North Korea’s state news agency KCNA reported.

text: Matandaan nga nagsapol man anay si Lavrov sa iya North Korean counterpart nga si Choe Son Hui sa Wonsan.
english: Lavrov also met with his North Korean counterpart Choe Son Hui in Wonsan.

text: Nagpaguwa sila sang joint statement nga nagapasalig sang suporta agud nga ma-safeguard ang soberanya kag ang territorial integrity sang ila mga pungsod.
english: They issued a joint statement pledging support to safeguard the sovereignty and territorial integrity of their countries.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagpadala ang North Korea sang linibo nga mga soldado sa Russia agud magbulig sa gyera batok sa Ukraine nga nag-umpisa sang Pebrero 2022.
english: North Korea has sent thousands of soldiers to Russia to help in the war against Ukraine that began in February 2022.

text: Naghiwat ang Malacañang sang concert kagab-i, Septyembre 15, agud nga suguran ang isa ka tuig nga countdown para sa maragtason nga pag-host sang Pilipinas sang FIVB Men’s Volleyball World Championship sa 2025.
english: Malacañang held a concert last night, September 15, to begin the one-year countdown for the Philippines' historic hosting of the FIVB Men's Volleyball World Championship in 2025.

text:
Duha ka oras ang event nga gintawag nga “PH to Serve: A Concert for the One-Year Countdown to the Philippine Hosting of the FIVB Volleyball Men’s World Championship 2025.”

Gin-imbitar ang players sang national team nga Alas Pilipinas sa event nga ginpangunahan man mismo ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english:
The two-hour event dubbed “PH to Serve: A Concert for the One-Year Countdown to the Philippine Hosting of the FIVB Volleyball Men’s World Championship 2025.”

The players of the national team Alas Pilipinas were invited to the event which was also led by President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: Kaupod ni Marcos sa concert amo sanday First Lady Marie Louise Araneta-Marcos, Local Organizing Committee Co-Chair William Vincent Marcos, FIVB General Director Fabio Azebedo, Philippine National Volleyball Federation president Ramon “Tats” Suzara, Cabinet secretaries, government officials, kag iban pa nga mga atleta.
english: Marcos was joined at the concert by First Lady Marie Louise Araneta-Marcos, Local Organizing Committee Co-Chair William Vincent Marcos, FIVB General Director Fabio Azebedo, Philippine National Volleyball Federation president Ramon “Tats” Suzara, Cabinet secretaries, government officials, and other athletes.

text: Lakip sa performers amo ang Filipino singers nga nagpasakop sa World Championships of Performing Arts amo man ang laser lights kag LED artists.
english: Among the performers were Filipino singers who participated in the World Championships of Performing Arts as well as laser lights and LED artists.

text: Matabo ang World Championship sa September 12 – 28 sa masunod nga tuig nga amo ang una nga bes nga maga-host ang Pilipinas kag una man nga tion sa bilog nga Southeast Asia.
english: The World Championship will be held from September 12 to 28 next year, the first time the Philippines will host and the first time in Southeast Asia.

text: Bilang host country, awtomatiko nga naka-qualify ang Pilipinas kaupod sa defending champion nga Italy.
english: As the host country, the Philippines automatically qualified alongside defending champion Italy.

text: Sa draw sang nagligad nga gab-i, nagtupa ang Pilipinas sa Pool A kun sa diin makasambuwa sini ang Iran, Egypt, kag Tunisia sa imbukada nga mga hampang.
english: In last night's draw, the Philippines fell to Pool A where it will face Iran, Egypt, and Tunisia in the opening matches.

text: GINPIRMAHAN ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte sadtong Agosto 6, 2018 ang Philippine Identification System Act (PISA) nga nagapatuman sang biometric nga pagkilala (identification) paagi sa computer science.
english: PRESIDENT Rodrigo Duterte signed on August 6, 2018 the Philippine Identification System Act (PISA) that implements biometric identification through computer science.

text: May nakauyon sini kag may wala man sing nakauyon, labi na gid ang pamahog sini sa privacy concerns sang pumuluyo.
english: Some agreed with it and some disagreed, especially its threat to the privacy concerns of the people.

text: Sa indi kauyon sa PISA, puede bala makabalibad sa pagpartisipar sa idalom sang sining kasuguan sa ila right to privacy?
english: Can those who disagree with PISA refuse to participate under this law in their right to privacy?

text: Wala pa kita makakuha sang kopya sang sining kasuguan, kag indi anay kita makasiling.
english: We have not yet obtained a copy of this law, and we cannot yet say.

text: Kon mandatory ini, ti wala na kita, nga indi kauyon, seguro sing mahimo luas lang magkulomoron.
english: If it's mandatory, then we have no choice but to disagree.

text: Kon indi man, kay regulatory lang ini, ano bala ang kondisyon agud puede gihapon kita ma-akomodar bisan indi maka-rehistro sa PISA?
english: If not, since it is regulatory, what are the conditions so that we can still be accommodated even if we cannot register for PISA?

text: Tani puede ang election ID nga may biometric identification man ukon bisan ang universal PhilHealth ID.
english: Please have an election ID with biometric identification or even a universal PhilHealth ID.

text: Ang pila nga indi kauyon sang National ID indi luyag sini tungod indi sila luyag mangin “surveillance state” ang Pilipinas padulong sa totalitarian ukon police state nga nagapahuyang sang aton demokrasya kag hilway nga pagpangabuhi.
english: Some who disagree with the National ID do not want it because they do not want the Philippines to become a “surveillance state” towards a totalitarian or police state that undermines our democracy and freedom of life.

text: Ang PISA, sunu sa balita kag sa aton paghangop sini, magakilala sang pisikal nga pagkatawo sang tawo nga indi siya masal-an sa kay kon sin-o man (unique individuality) paagi sa biometrics.
english: PISA, according to the news and our understanding of it, will recognize the physical identity of a person without being mistaken for anyone else (unique individuality) through biometrics.

text: Sa ini nga biometric identification, ang pumuluyo nga naka-rehistro diri gina-requirer sa paghatag sang iya bug-os nga ngalan, sex, blood type, adlaw sang pagkatawo, lugar sang pagkatawo, marital status, kag retrato sang tag-iya sang ID.
english: In this biometric identification, the citizen registered here is required to provide his full name, sex, blood type, date of birth, place of birth, marital status, and photograph of the ID holder.

text: Dugang pa nga impormasyon sa Philippine ID System (PhilSys) registry ang mobile number, email  address, ang biometrics data, lakip na ang full set of fingerprints kag iris scan.
english: Additional information in the Philippine ID System (PhilSys) registry includes mobile number, email address, biometrics data, including full set of fingerprints and iris scan.

text: Abaw, kadamo gid sang gina-requirer ba!
english: Wow, there are so many requirements!

english: It's like a prisoner outside that the government doesn't want to escape and if he does, he can easily be arrested again.

text: Ti, ngaa gid himuon ta ini sa mga inosente nga mga tawo nga luyag lang maghulag sing hilway nga wala sing may naga-pakialam?
english: Well, why exactly would we do this to innocent people who just want to move freely without anyone caring?

text: Well, basi justified man ang gobyerno tungod sa kariit sang panahon subong.
english: Well, maybe the government is justified because of the difficult times.

text: May terorista diri kag dira.
english: There is a terrorist here and there.

english: There’s a gun-for-hire.

text: May mga durugista nga luyag mag-triping sa bisan mga inosente nga mga tawo.

text: Etcetera, nga kon indi ikaw ang tumod, masalabat ka sang galupad nga bala, bato sang naga-away nga mga gang, kag ultimo isa ka singkwenta pesos mo bulakwaton pa sang snatcher.

text: Tungod sini, kinahanglan makilala sila sang aton mga otoridad agud mabantayan sing maayo.
english: Because of this, they need to be identified by our authorities in order to be closely monitored.

text: Okay, basi justified gid man ang ining National ID kag wala gid man pierdihon kita kon tumod lang sang aton mga otoridad ang mga may kamalamalahan nga mga personas.
english: Okay, maybe this National ID is justified and we will not lose if our authorities only target those who have powerful persons.

text: Pero dapat lang seguro nga kilalahon man sang aton mga otoridad ang lehitimo nga privacy sang mga pumuluyo kag kilalahon lang nila ang dapat paukpan sang ila pagka-mabantayon.
english: But perhaps our authorities should also recognize the legitimate privacy of the citizens and recognize only those who should be covered by their vigilance.

text: Indi man dapat maglapaw ang authentication sa dapat lang tuktukan nga impormasyon.
english: Authentication should not go beyond the information that must be entered.

text: Pila ka physical biometric information nga puede lumapaw sa dapat amo ang fingerprint  patterns nga maka-disclose sang chromosomal diseases; iris patterns nga maka-reveal sang genetic sex; hand vein patterns nga maka-reveal vascular diseases; kag iban pa nga depekto nga indi luyag sang pasyente ipahibalo sa iban kag luyag isekreto sang pamilya tungod makahuluya ukon makatuga sang dikriminasyon sa ila.
english: Some physical biometric information that can go beyond what should be are fingerprint patterns that can disclose chromosomal diseases; iris patterns that can reveal genetic sex; hand vein patterns that can reveal vascular diseases; and other defects that the patient does not want to disclose to others and the family wants to keep secret because it is embarrassing or discriminatory against them.

text: Kinahanglan respetuhon ang kasubong nga privacy agud ma-amligan man ang dungog kag necessary confidentiality katulad sangsa tunga sang doktor kag pasyente, sang abogado kag kliyente kag iban pa nga kinahanglan maghatag proteksyon sa mga tawo nga ang impormasyon sa ila dapat proteksyunan agud maamligan ang ila kinamatarong.
english: Such privacy must be respected in order to protect the dignity and necessary confidentiality such as between doctor and patient, lawyer and client and others who need to provide protection to people whose information must be protected in order to protect their rights.

text: Tani maamligan sang gobyerno ining ila mahibal-an nga puede gamiton sa katontohan.
english: I hope the government will protect this information that can be used in the future.

text: Man, ini nga mga sensitibo nga impormasyon puede magamit sang, por ejemplo, kontra pulitiko agud isyuhan ang kasumpong ukon sin-o man nga kaaway agud pakamalainon ang indi nila mauyunan.
english: Also, this sensitive information can be used by, for example, political opponents to issue the opponent or any enemy to criticize those they disagree with.

text: Apang, may ikasarang bala ang aton gobyerno agud mapunggan ang pag-leak sining mga importante nga biometric information nga magamit sa kalainan?
english: However, does our government have the capacity to prevent the leakage of this important biometric information that can be used for evil?

text: Kon wala, daku pa ini nga problema.
english: If not, this is still a big problem.

text: Naglab-ot sa 12 ka mga kabarangayan ang apektado sa Concepcion, Iloilo bangud sang shear line kun sa diin 216 ka mga motor bangka ang nagkalaguba sang nagligad nga Enero 3.
english: A total of 12 barangays in Concepcion, Iloilo were affected by the shear line where 216 motor boats were damaged last January 3.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ens.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ens.

text: El John Ga, spokesperson sang Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga nagpatigayon ang PCG sang assessment sa mga apektado nga lugar upod ang koordinasyon sang Local Government Unit (LGU) kag Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO).
english: El John Ga, spokesperson of the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) Iloilo, said the PCG conducted an assessment in the affected areas in coordination with the Local Government Unit (LGU) and the Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO).

text: Nagdangat man sa 213 ka mga fisherfolk ukon mga manugpangisda ang naapektuhan bangud nagkalaguba ang ila mga bangka.
english: A total of 213 fisherfolk or fishermen were also affected because their boats were damaged.

text: Sa 216 ka mga motor bangka nga nagkalaguba, 172 ang partially damaged samtang 44 ang totally damaged.
english: Of the 216 motor boats that were damaged, 172 were partially damaged while 44 were totally damaged.

text: Magluwas sa mga motor bangka, may yara man sang mga cottages nga naapektuhan kag ang iban totally damaged.
english: Besides motor boats, some cottages were also affected and some were totally damaged.

text: Ginatinguhaan naman sang PCG nga makipag-angot sa Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) kag sa LGU sang lugar agud matagaan sang bulig ang mga naapektuhan.
english: The PCG is trying to liaise with the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) and the LGU of the area to provide assistance to the affected.
