text:
𝗨𝗦𝗔 —Nagpaguwa sang duha ka bag-o nga bonus track ang American pop superstar nga si Ariana Grande bilang selebrasyon sang ika-10 nga tuig sang iya sophomore album nga “My Everything.”

Sa isa ka sorpresa nga pagpaguwa, gin-treat ni Grande ang iya fans sang bag-o nga mga track nga “Cadillac Song” kag “Too Close,” nga wala pa ma-release nga paborito sang mga avid fans.
english:
𝗨𝗦𝗔 —American pop superstar Ariana Grande has released two new bonus tracks in celebration of the 10th anniversary of her sophomore album “My Everything.”

In a surprise release, Grande treated her fans to new tracks “Cadillac Song” and “Too Close,” unreleased avid fan favorites.

text: Ang “My Everything” nagpakilala kay Grande sa kalibutan paagi sa mga hits pareho sang “Break Free,” “One Last Time,” “Bang Bang” upod kay Jessie J kag Nicki Minaj, “Love Me Harder” upod kay The Weeknd, “Problem” upod kay Iggy Azalea, kag iban pa.
english: “My Everything” introduced Grande to the world with hits like “Break Free,” “One Last Time,” “Bang Bang” with Jessie J and Nicki Minaj, “Love Me Harder” with The Weeknd, “Problem” with Iggy Azalea, and more.

text: Sang nagligad nga tuig, ginsaulog man ni Grande ang ika-10 nga tuig sang iya debut album nga “Yours Truly” apang may mga live sessions.
english: Last year, Grande also celebrated the 10th anniversary of her debut album “Yours Truly” but with live sessions.

text: Ginpaguwa ni Grande ang iya pinakaulihi nga album nga “eternal sunshine” nga may mga kanta pareho sang “yes, and?” “we can’t be friends,” lakip ang iban pa, nga nagalibot nahanungod sa mga kasubo ka nagaangot sa iya nagligad nga relasyon.
english: Grande released her latest album “eternal sunshine” with songs like “yes, and?” “we can’t be friends,” among others, revolving around the sorrows associated with her past relationship.

text: Madamo nga mga fans ang nakaobserbar sang pagsambit ni Grande sa iya nagligad nga relasyon sa real estate agent nga si Dalton Gomez.
english: Many fans noticed Grande’s reference to her past relationship with real estate agent Dalton Gomez.

text: Sanday Grande kag Gomez nagsugod sa pag-date sang 2020 kag nagpakasal sang 2021 sa puluy-an sang singer sa Montecito sa Southern California.
english: Grande and Gomez began dating in 2020 and married in 2021 at the singer’s home in Montecito in Southern California.

text: Pila ka mga American media outlets ang nauna nga nagsiling nga nag-file sang diborsyo si Grande 2 ka bulan pagkatapos nga una nga ginreport ang ila una nga pagbulagay.
english: Several American media outlets previously claimed that Grande filed for divorce 2 months after their initial split was first reported.

text: Ang isa ka magazine nagsiling nga ang pagbulagay sang duha ang “kind and patient” kag sila nga duha ang “naka-move on” na.
english: A magazine said the split between the two was “kind and patient” and that they had both “moved on”.

text: Pagkatapos sang iya pagbulagay kay Gomez, si Grande ang gin-link sa iya kaupod nga “Wicked” star nga si Ethan Slater.
english: After her split from Gomez, Grande was linked to fellow “Wicked” star Ethan Slater.

text: Pag-abot sa pagpakot kun bala ang isa ka tawo ukon suspek nagahambal sang matuod ukon nagabinutig, limitado lang ang aton nga pamaagi.
english: When it comes to predicting whether a person or suspect is telling the truth or lying, our approach is limited.

text: Apang may isa ka grupo sang Israeli researchers nga nag-imbento sang isa ka pinasahi nga lie detector.
english: But a group of Israeli researchers have invented a unique lie detector.

text: Gamit ang stickers nga may electrodes nga naga-monitor kag naga-measure sang aktibidad sang muscles kag nerves, natukiban sang grupo nga kun nagabutig ang isa ka indibidwal, naga-activate ang muscles sini sa guya kag kilay.
english: Using stickers with electrodes that monitor and measure the activity of muscles and nerves, the team found that when an individual lies, the muscles in his face and eyebrows activate.

text: Suno sa pinuno sang grupo nga si Prof.
english: According to the head of the group, Prof.

text: Dino Levy, wala pa sang sensors nga makatakos sang muscle contractions magluwas sa ila gin-imbento nga stickers.
english: Dino Levy, there are no sensors that can measure muscle contractions except for their invented stickers.

text: Sa ginpatigayon nga tests sa gin-imbento nga X-trodes sensors, 73% ang success rate sa lie identification kun sa diin natukiban nga mas epektibo ini sa iban pa nga existing technology.
english: Sa ginpatigayon nga tests sa gin-imbento nga X-trodes sensors, 73% ang success rate sa lie identification kun sa diin natukiban nga mas epektibo ini sa iban pa nga existing technology.

text: Pahayag sang mga researchers, sa tion nga nga magsaka ang rate sang ila gin-imbento nga lie detection, ini nga teknolohiya ang mahimo gamiton sa police interrogations, airport, online job interviews, kag iban pa.
english: The researchers say that once the rate of their invented lie detection increases, this technology can be used in police interrogations, airports, online job interviews, and others.

text: SAMTANG nagatakam-takam na ang madamo nga mabuksan liwat ang Boracay sa Oktubre 26, anom ka bulan pagkatapos nga ginpasarhan ini sang gobyerno sadtong Abril 26, may bag-o naman nga mga problema ang atubangon sang gobyerno sa pagbukas sini.
english: SAMTANG nagatakam-takam na ang madamo nga mabuksan liwat ang Boracay sa Oktubre 26, anom ka bulan pagkatapos nga ginpasarhan ini sang gobyerno sadtong Abril 26, may bag-o naman nga mga problema ang atubangon sang gobyerno sa pagbukas sini.

text: Ining mga problema, sa kabug-usan, amo kon paano i-mentenar ang kalimpyo sang bantugon nga isla sa turismo kag ang pagpabalik sang kapagsik sang ekonomiya sini kag sang kalapit nga mga lugar, pati na ang pungsod sa kabug-usan.
english: These problems, in general, are how to maintain the cleanliness of the famous tourist island and the restoration of the economic vitality of its and surrounding areas, as well as the country as a whole.

text: Ang daku gid sadto nga problema sa Boracay amo ang pagka-“cesspool” sang Boracay, sunu mismo sa pagtawag ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte, nga dapat gid limpyuhan sing lubos.
english: The biggest problem in Boracay was the cesspool of Boracay, as President Rodrigo Duterte called it, which must be thoroughly cleaned up.

text: Ang isa ka “cesspool” isa ka polunduhan ukon talambakan sang higko katulad sang septic tank nga ginatipunan sang higko sang tawo.
english: A cesspool is a septic tank-like reservoir for human waste.

text: In other words, isa ka lugar ini sang tawo nga ang kahigko  indi na naton mabaton sa aton konsyensya, labi na gid para sa aton mga bisita.
english: In other words, it is a place of people whose filth we can no longer accept in our conscience, especially for our guests.

text: Ang sadto masinaw nga tubig duag lubog kag mahigko na, amat-amat naman nga ginadagyawan ini sang red tide sa madamo nga bahin sang baybayon, gatalangkas lang ang mabaho nga basura sa palibot, kag mabaho man ang mga sulungawan.
english: The once clear water looks muddy and dirty, it is slowly being covered by the red tide in many parts of the beach, the smelly garbage is just rising around, and the sewers are smelly.

text: Gapanong man ang ilegal nga mga istruktura bisan sa bibi sang baybay,  sobra ang kagahod sang mga naga-party kon gab-i, kag syempre ang nagaalawas na nga mga bisita.
english: Illegal structures are also crowded even on the beach, the noise of the partygoers at night, and of course the visitors who are getting tired.

text:
***

Tungod sa kadamo sining mga problema, kita sa aton kolum, tungod sa limitado man nga ispasyo, indi ta man matagaan sing tugda ang tanan.
english:
***

Because of the many problems, we in our column, because of the limited space, we can not give advice to all.

text: Matutok lang anay kita diri sa problema sang naga-alawas nga mga bisita sa Boracay kag kon ano man ang masuhestyon naton nga solusyon.
english: Let's just focus here on the problem of overcrowding in Boracay and whatever solutions we can suggest.

text: Kon ano gid ang bagay nga “carrying capacity” sang bisita sang Boracay indi kita ugaling makasiling gid sing igsakto tungod sa madamo man nga factors.
english: However, we cannot say exactly what the carrying capacity of Boracay visitors is due to many factors.

text: Nonetheless, ang pila ka eksperto nagasiling nga ang “carrying capacity” sang Boracay yara lang sa mga isa ka milyon nga turista sa kada adlaw nga isip.
english: Nonetheless, some experts say that Boracay's carrying capacity is only about one million tourists per day.

text: Sunu sa statistics sang gobyerno, sadtong Enero tubtub Hunyo 2018 ang nagduaw sa Boracay – foreigner kag domestic – naglab-ot na sa sobra tatlo ka milyon.
english: According to government statistics, from January to June 2018, more than three million people visited Boracay – foreign and domestic.

text: Wala nagasiling  ini kon ano gid ang “carrying capacity” sang Boracay sang mga turista sa kada adlaw.
english: It does not say what the carrying capacity of Boracay is for tourists on a daily basis.

text: Apang may ideya kita sa retrato nga ginpakita sa internet sang isa ka bisita.
english: But we have an idea from the photo shown on the internet by a visitor.

text: Susmariosep!
english: Susmariose!

text: Ang retrato nagapakita sang sobra nga pagginutok sang mga bisita sa baybayon sa diin masami nagasayo ang mga turista.
english: The photo shows the overcrowding of visitors on the beach where tourists often make mistakes.

text: Daw mga sardinas sa lata!
english: Looks like sardines in a can!

text: Ti, ano ang mahimo ta sa sini nga problema?
english: Well, what can we do about this problem?

text: Primera bes, mas gadamo ang bisita, mas gadamo man ang basura kag syempre dugang ina nga problema.
english: For the first time, the more visitors, the more garbage and of course that's an additional problem.

text: Basi indi ta man masabat sing lubos ang pagkinahanglan sang mga pumuluyo sa potable water nga mainom, kag ang tubig sa paglimpyo sang nagakaigu ang mga higko nga matuga sang mga bisita.
english: We may not be able to fully meet the needs of the residents for potable water to drink, and the water to clean up the waste caused by visitors.

text: Ti, problema ina gihapon.
english: Well, that’s still a problem.

text: Basi labi na gid maglala ang problema ta sa HIV/AIDS sa dugang man nga pagduging sang mga pating nga manubo sing lupad.
english: Maybe our HIV/AIDS problem will get worse with the increase in the number of low-flying sharks.

text: Etcetera.
english: Etc.

text:
***

Ti, ano ang solusyon naton sa sini nga mga problema sang gasulobra nga turista?
english:
***

So, what is our solution to these problems of overtourism?

text: Isa dira nga limitahan ang pagsulod sang mga bisita sa Boracay.
english: One of them is to limit the entry of visitors to Boracay.

text: Kag, tungod sina, kon paano man bawion ang kakulangan sang kitaon (revenue) tungod mangin diutay na lang ang mga bisita.
english: And, because of that, how to make up for the lack of revenue because there will be fewer visitors.

text: May nagproponer nga limitahan gid ang pagsulod sang turista sa Boracay sa “carrying capacity” lang.
english: Someone proposed to limit the entry of tourists into Boracay to carrying capacity only.

text: Apang tungod luyag ta ipaluntad ang kahilwayan sa tanan nga turista, nga amo gid ang makaganyat sa ila sa pagkari diri, indi bagay i-martial law ang pagsulod kag pagginawi nila diri.
english: But since we want to promote freedom for all tourists, which is what will attract them to come here, it is not appropriate to impose martial law on their entry and behavior here.

text: Agud mabawi ang kakulangan sa kita, ang suhestyon amo nga pataason ang rate ukon bayad sang pagsulod sa Boracay agud mapunggan ang pagsulod sang madamo.
english: To compensate for the revenue shortfall, the suggestion is to increase the rate or fee of entry to Boracay to prevent mass entry.

text: Apang kon igapatigayon ini, dapat nga makasarang bisan ang mga average ta nga mga pumuluyo.
english: But if it is to be implemented, even our average citizens should be able to afford it.

text: Pasugtan man nga maka-negosyo dira ang mas pulupigado, labi na gid ang mga tumandok nga ang mayor nga interes amo lang ang ila pangabuhian.
english: The poorer, especially the indigenous people whose main interest is their livelihood, will also be allowed to do business there.

text: Dapat pasanyugon man ang tourism promotion sang iban nga lugar, labi na gid ang yara sa Negros Occidental, Guimaras kag Panay nga makabulig man sa pagdugang sang kita naton sa turismo.
english: The tourism promotion of other areas, especially those in Negros Occidental, Guimaras and Panay, should also be promoted which will also help increase our tourism revenue.

text: May panibag-o na naman nga oil price hike sa masunod nga semana.
english: There will be another oil price hike next week.

text: Ini ang base sa international trading sa apat ka sunod-sunod nga adlaw.
english: This is based on international trading for four consecutive days.

text:
Ang estimated nga price adjustments amo ang mga masunod:

Gasoline   – magasaka sang  P0.35 tubtob P0.70 per liter
Diesel     – maganubo sang  P1.10 tubtob P1.40 per liter
Kerosene   – maganubo sang  P0.90 tubtob P1.00 per liter

Suno kay Department of Energy-Oil Industry Management Bureau Assistant Director Rodela Romero, ang pagsaka sa presyo sang gatong ang naangot sa geopolitical climate sa Middle East kag atrasado nga output hikes sa Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries.
english:
The estimated price adjustments are as follows:

Gasoline – to rise by P0.35 to P0.70 per liter
Diesel – to drop by P1.10 to P1.40 per liter
Kerosene – to drop by P0.90 to P1.00 per liter

According to Department of Energy-Oil Industry Management Bureau Assistant Director Rodela Romero, the rise in fuel prices is linked to the geopolitical climate in the Middle East and delayed output hikes in the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries.

text: Ianunsyo naman sa Lunes ang pinal nga price adjustments kag ipatuman ini sa Martes.
english: The final price adjustments will be announced on Monday and implemented on Tuesday.

text: Nagapalang git-om bala ang imo bibig bisan wala ka nagapanigarilyo?
english: Do your lips turn black even though you don't smoke?

text: Luyag mo bala ma achieve ang kissable lips apang daw imposible bangud sang amo ni nga problema?
english: Do you want to achieve kissable lips but it seems impossible because of this problem?

text: Suno kay Dr. Jean Marquez isa ka dermatologist, ang pagpalanggit-om sang imo bibig ang resulta sang paggamit sang habon nga may maisog nga chemical sa imo nga guya.
english: According to Dr. Jean Marquez is a dermatologist, the darkening of your lips is the result of using soap with harsh chemicals on your face.

text: Bangud manipis ang panit saaton nga lip area madasig ini mag-itom kapin pa kun ma silakan sang adlaw.//  Gin rekomenda ni Dr.Jean nga kun gusto mo maachieve ang kissable lips mag gamit sang mild soap kag lip balm nga may yara sang moisturizer kag sun screen agud ma protektahan ang imo bibig kag malikawan ang discolorization.
english: Because the skin in our lip area is thin, it quickly turns black especially when exposed to the sun.// Dr. Jean recommends that if you want to achieve kissable lips, use a mild soap and lip balm with moisturizer and sun screen to protect your lips and prevent discolorization.

text: Magluwas sa pagbutang sang sun screen ginrekomenda man ni Dr.Jean ang pigment laser treatment agud mag hugot ang imo nga bibig.
english: In addition to applying sun screen, Dr. Jean also recommended pigment laser treatment to tighten your lips.

text: 12 ang nominasyon para sa Filipino boy band samtang pito naman para sa nation’s girl group.
english: 12 nominations for the Filipino boy band while seven for the nation's girl group.

text: Ang “Pagtatag!” ang na-nominate para sa Album of the Year samtang ang hit single naman sang SB19 nga “GENTO” ang nakalinya sa posible nga makabulsa sang anum ka awards lakip ang Record of the Year, Song of the Year, kag Best Performance by a Group.
english: The “Establishment!” is nominated for Album of the Year while SB19's hit single “GENTO” is in line to pocket six awards including Record of the Year, Song of the Year, and Best Performance by a Group.

text: Nominated man ang boy band sa Best Dance/Electronic Recording, Best Ballad Recording, Best Pop Recording, Best Music Video, kag Best Engineered Recording nga pagpakita sang wide-ranging impact sini sa local music scene.
english: The boy band was also nominated for Best Dance/Electronic Recording, Best Ballad Recording, Best Pop Recording, Best Music Video, and Best Engineered Recording showing its wide-ranging impact on the local music scene.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, standout man sa awards subong nga tuig ang BINI nga yara man ang pangalan sa nagkalain-lain nga kategorya kaangay sang Record of the Year sa track nga “Pantropiko” amo man ang Song of the Year.
english: On the other hand, BINI is also a standout in this year's awards with its name in various categories such as Record of the Year for the track “Pantropiko” as well as Song of the Year.

text: Nominated man ini sa Best Performance by a Group, Best Inspirational Recording, Best Pop Recording, Best Music Video, kag Best Engineered Recording.
english: It was also nominated for Best Performance by a Group, Best Inspirational Recording, Best Pop Recording, Best Music Video, and Best Engineered Recording.

text: Ang eligible entries para sa 37th Awit Awards amo ang mga kanta, mga album, kag iban pa nga music-related performances nga napaguwa sa tunga sang Enero 1 kag Disyembre 31, 2023.
english: Eligible entries for the 37th Awit Awards are songs, albums, and other music-related performances released between January 1 and December 31, 2023.

text: Nalakip ang embahada sang Vatican sa mga nahalitan bangud sang atake sang Russia sa Kyiv sa Ukraine sang Huwebes sang aga.
english: The Vatican embassy was among those damaged by Russia’s attack on Kyiv in Ukraine on Thursday morning.

text: Suno sa embassy, may damage sa main building sang Apostolic Nunciature amo man sa service areas.
english: According to the embassy, ​​there was damage to the main building of the Apostolic Nunciature as well as to the service areas.

text: Nagpahayag naman si Archbishop Visvaldas Kulbokas, ang ambassador sang Vatican sa Ukraine, nga nasaksihan sini ang drones nga nagalibot sa area kun sa diin nahamtang ang embahada.
english: Archbishop Visvaldas Kulbokas, the Vatican's ambassador to Ukraine, said he witnessed drones circling the area where the embassy is located.

text:
Gindugang sini nga nakabati siya sang pila ka pagsigabong sang gab-i.

Pahayag sini, bangud sa Russian attack, may mga naguba sa atop kag sa parking garage sang embassy, apang ginkumpirma sini nga safe ang tanan nga mga personnel.
english:
He added that he heard several explosions during the night.

He said that due to the Russian attack, there were damages to the roof and parking garage of the embassy, ​​but he confirmed that all personnel are safe.

text: Natabo ang airstrikes nga ini kadungan sang pagbukas man sang international conference sa Roma kun sa diin ginatutukan sang diskusyon ang tatlo ka tuig nga gyera sang Russia batok sa Ukraine.
english: The airstrikes coincided with the opening of an international conference in Rome where discussions focused on Russia's three-year war against Ukraine.

text: Sa amo nga conferece, may ginpasalig nga billions of dollars nga ayuda para sa Kyiv.
english: At the conference, billions of dollars in aid were promised for Kyiv.

text: Nahibaluan nga may yara sang formal diplomatic relations ang Vatican sa 180 ka mga pungsod.
english: The Vatican has formal diplomatic relations with 180 countries.

text: Kilala ang ila mga ambassador nga wala nagabiya sa ila posisyon kag wala man nagahalin sa embahada apisar pa sa tion nga may gyera.
english: Their ambassadors are known to never leave their posts and never leave the embassy even in times of war.

text: Bangud sa pandemya, ang tanan ang halos indi makapadulong sa baybay agud ma-eksperyensya kag ma-enjoy ang view sang malapad nga balas kag duag blue nga tubig.
english: Due to the pandemic, almost everyone cannot go to the beach to experience and enjoy the view of the wide sand and blue water.

text: Apang indi ini problema para sa isa ka russian family bangud kaangay nga gina-istaran ni Aquaman ang ila ginapanag-iyahan nga Apartment.
english: But this is not a problem for a russian family because it seems that Aquaman lives in the apartment they own.

text: Nagtrending sa social media ang nasambit nga apartment bangud daw matuod gid nga baybay ang disensyo sang salog nga napun-an sang marine life, kaangay sang seashells, dolphin, sea stars kag iban pa.
english: The apartment is trending on social media because the floor design looks like a real beach filled with marine life, such as seashells, dolphins, sea stars and others.

text: Cloud-covered sky naman ang disenyo sang dingding nga kun imo tulukon daw yara ka lang sa baybay samtang nagasimhot sang summer breeze.
english: The wall is designed with a cloud-covered sky that makes you feel like you are on the beach while breathing the summer breeze.

text: May disenyo man nga puti nga balas ang salog nga daw kasubong nga ginatapakan mo gid sa baybay.
english: The floor also has a white sand pattern that makes you feel like you're actually stepping on the beach.

text: Ang nasambit nga apartment ang ginabaligya sa balor nga $376,000 ukon P18.8 million.
english: The apartment is for sale for $376,000 or P18.8 million.

text: Masami nga problema sang kababaihan amo ang nagapabalik-balik kag madasig magdamo nga acne ukon mga pimples.
english: A common problem for women is recurrent and fast-growing acne or pimples.

text: Ang aton nga guya, ilong kag agtang ang masami nga gina tubuan sang pimples.
english: Our face, nose and forehead are the most common areas where pimples grow.

text: May yara bala ini sang kahilabtanan sa imo nga ikaayong lawas ukon naga hatag bala ini sang mensahe nga may yara sang problema ang imo lawas kapin pa kun ini ang nagapa balik-balik sa pareho lang nga parti sang lawas?
english: Does it have anything to do with your health or does it give a message that there is a problem with your body especially if it is repeated in the same part of the body?

text: Suno kay Dr. Stephanie Sy-Chua, isa ka dermatologist sa Philippine Dermatological Society, wala sang insakto nga scientific basis sa acne face mapping ukon ang masami nga pagtubo sang pimples sa pareho nga parte sang imo guya.
english: According to Dr. Stephanie Sy-Chua, a dermatologist at the Philippine Dermatological Society, doesn’t have a proper scientific basis for acne face mapping or the frequent growth of pimples on the same part of your face.

text: Ang parte sang imo guya kun diin masami nga naga tubo ang pimples ang nagakadapat lang nga mangin malimpyo paagi sa paghilam-os kag paggamit sang tama ka maisog nga habon ukon facial wash.
english: The part of your face where pimples often grow should only be kept clean by washing and using a very strong soap or facial wash.

text: Dugang pa ni Sy-Chua ang pagkaon kag pag-inom sang dairy products kaangay sang gatas ang maka cause sang acne.
english: Sy-Chua added that eating and drinking dairy products such as milk can cause acne.

text: Nagpanugyan si Sy-Chua nga mas maayo nga magbisita sa imo dermatologist agud mahatagan sang insakto nga advice kag consultation bangud suno sa iya “There’s no guaranteed improvement without proper treatment”.
english: Sy-Chua advised that it is better to visit your dermatologist for proper advice and consultation because according to him “There’s no guaranteed improvement without proper treatment”.

text: Ginplastar ni Vice President Sara Duterte nga nagahanda na para sa senatorial elections ang iya amay nga si anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte kag duha ka mga utod nga sanday Sebastian (Baste) kag Paolo (Pulong).
english: Vice President Sara Duterte said her father, former President Rodrigo Duterte, and two brothers, Sebastian (Baste) and Paolo (Pulong), are preparing for the senatorial elections.

text: “When I talked to the group of former president Rodrigo Duterte, they told me that they are now preparing to run.
english: “When I talked to the group of former president Rodrigo Duterte, they told me that they are now preparing to run.

text: When I also talked to my older brother, (Paolo) Pulong Duterte, he told me that he was ready to run for senator.
english: When I also talked to my older brother, (Paolo) Pulong Duterte, he told me that he was ready to run for senator.

text: The people around my youngest sibling (Sebastian) Baste Duterte also informed me that they are preparing or already prepared,” suno sa bise-presidente.
english: The people around my youngest sibling (Sebastian) Baste Duterte also informed me that they are preparing or already prepared,” the vice-president said.

text: Suno kay Sara, wala siya nakahibalo kun may iban pa sila nga updon sa line-up, apang sa iya pagbanta, bangud halin ang iya amay sa Partido Federal ng Pilipinas, posible nga may iban man halin sa amo nga partido nga makaupod sa ila nga senatorial slate.
english: Sara said she does not know if they will have others in the line-up, but she estimates that since her father is from the Federal Party of the Philippines, it is possible that there will be others from that party who will join their senatorial slate.

text: ”Hindi ko alam kung meron ba silang mga kasamahan sa lineup pero dahil, ito ay assumption ko lang, si Pangulong Duterte ay galing sa PDP, likely kasama rin niya ang ibang PDP na mga senador,” dugang sini.
english: "I don't know if they have any colleagues in the lineup but since, this is my assumption, President Duterte is from the PDP, likely he is also with other PDP senators," he added.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang PDP ang may yara sang tatlo ka mga senador nga posible magpa-eleher liwat: sanday Ronald ”Bato” dela Rosa, Christopher ”Bong” Go, kag Francis Tolentino.
english: The PDP has three senators who are likely to run for re-election: Ronald ”Bato” dela Rosa, Christopher ”Bong” Go, and Francis Tolentino.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang bise-presidentE nga ginhambalan siya sang iya iloy nga magbalik sa Davao City kag magpadalagan bilang mayor.
english: Earlier, the vice-president said his mother told him to return to Davao City and run for mayor.

text: Sang ginpamangkot ini anay kun mag-resign siya bilang vice president, ginsiling siya nga wala naistoryahan ang amo nga bagay.
english: When asked if he would resign as vice president, he said the matter had not been discussed.

text: Hunyo 19 sang nagpasa si Sara sang resignation sa Gabinete ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: On June 19, Sara submitted her resignation to the Cabinet of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: apang nagapabilin nga vice president sa pungsod.
english: but remains vice president in the country.

text: Nadakpan sang mga security guards ang magkahagugma nga nagapakighilawas sa Children’s Park sa Burnham Park sa Baguio City.
english: Security guards caught a couple having sex at the Children's Park in Burnham Park in Baguio City.

text: Nagaedad sang 22-anyos ang babaye kag 23-anyos naman ang lalaki.
english: The woman is 22 years old and the man is 23 years old.

text: Suno sa otoridad, nagaronda ang gwardya sang una nga nakit-an ang duwa nga nagahalukanay.
english: According to authorities, the guard was on patrol when the two were first seen kissing.

text: Sang ulihi, sang ila ginbalikan, ginpahayag nga nagapakighilawas na ang mga ini.
english: Later, when they returned, they were reportedly having sex.

text: Mangatubang sang kaso nga grave scandal ang magkahagugma.
english: The couple will face charges of grave scandal.

text: Nagpahanumdom naman ang kapulisan sa publiko nga respetuhon ang mga pampubliko nga lugar.
english: Police reminded the public to respect public places.

text: NADULA ang cellphone ni asawahon sadtong nagligad nga semana.
english: MY WIFE lost her cellphone last week.

text: Gapati siya nga nabiktima siya sang pickpocket nga yara sa iya tupad nga namilit nga masal-ut gid sa tupad niya bisan sobra na kagutok nga ginpasugtan man sang drayber.
english: He believes he was the victim of a pickpocket who was next to him who insisted on getting next to him even though it was so crowded that the driver agreed.

text: Ambot kon ngaa may drayber nga dalok-dalok sa pasahero nga ga-enjoy kon mag-antos ang iya pasahero sa kagagutok samtang ang kasuguan nagadumili sini.
english: I don't know why there are drivers who are harassing passengers who enjoy when their passengers suffer from congestion when the law prohibits it.

text: Ano abe sa imo, Migs Boyet Parcon?
english: What do you think, Migs Boyet Parcon?

text: Tungod sa kagutok, nangin “careless” si Mrs. sa pagdala sang iya bag.
english: Because of the crowd, Mrs. to carry his bag.

text: Ginbutang  gid niya ini sa iya atubangan, nga naganga-nga gali ang baba, malapit sa sining daku nga pasahero nga lalake nga gapilit gid magdukdok para makasal-ot.
english: He put it in front of him, with his mouth open, next to this big male passenger who was trying to bend down to get in.

text: Ugaling, sang manaug na pauli si Mrs. sa dyep lapit sa katedral, namulalungan niya nga bukas na gali ang iya bag kag wala na ang iya cellphone.
english: However, when Mrs. in the jeep near the cathedral, he noticed that his bag was open and his cellphone was gone.

text: Gin-tsek pa namon kon basi nalipatan lang niya sa upisina ukon diin pa da paagi sa pagtawag, apang wala gid.
english: We even checked to see if he had forgotten it at the office or somewhere else by calling, but nothing.

text:
Ang pirme lang nga sabat sang operator amo ang: “Your cellphone cannot be reached” nga indi ini ang usual nga sabat sang operator nga tani “Either your call is out of coverage area, or…”

Ang amon suspetso amo nga ang nag-remedyo sang cellphone ni Mrs. naghabuy na sang daan nga SIM sang iya cellphone kag gin-islan agud magamit na sini.
english:
The operator's usual response is: “Your cellphone cannot be reached” which is not the usual response from the operator that should be “Either your call is out of coverage area, or…”

Our suspicion is that the person who repaired Mrs. threw away the old SIM of his cellphone and replaced it so that he could use it.

text: Gin-suhestyon ko kay Mrs. nga i-report ini sa National Telecommunication Commission (NTC) nga may upisina diri sa siyudad sang Iloilo.
english: I suggested to Mrs. to report it to the National Telecommunication Commission (NTC) which has an office here in Iloilo City.

text: Tamad na si Mrs. ugaling magpagamo kay baratuhon man lang ang iya cellphone kag nagbakal na gid lang siya sing bag-o. Ginpahibalo na niya gani ang mga abyan sang iya bag-o nga numero kag nagpasaan nga indi na nila paggamiton ang iya daan nga numero.
english: Mrs. is lazy. but make trouble because his cellphone is cheap and he just bought a new one. He even informed his friends of his new number and promised not to use his old number.

text: Kon nagsugot lang si Mrs. sa akon hingyo, gapati ako nga may mahimo ang NTC (ukon ang NBI) sa pag-locate sang cellphone ni Mrs., labi na gid kay pareho na ka-abanse sa iban nga pungsod ang facilidad sang gobyerno naton agud mahimo ini.
english: If only Mrs. in my request, I believe that the NTC (or the NBI) can do something to locate Mrs.'s cellphone, especially since our government's facility is as advanced as other countries to do this.

text: Matuod nga may mga kasuguan sa privacy of communication ang Estados Unidos kag ang Pilipinas, apang ma-medyosan gihapon ini nga problema sang gobyerno, kag kon sin-o pa nga expert sa telecommunication.
english: It is true that the United States and the Philippines have privacy of communication laws, but this problem can still be solved by the government, and anyone else who is an expert in telecommunications.

text: Ma-locate man gani nila kon diin matultulan ang lain na nga nagagamit sang cellphone.
english: They can even locate the location of another cellphone user.

text: Tungod man sa mga kasuguan sa privacy of communication sa Estados Unidos, diri sa Pilipinas kag sa iban pa nga pungsod, indi ugaling magamit ang ano man nga impormasyon nga makuha sa sini nga mga cellphone sang mga otoridad sa korte.
english: However, due to privacy of communication laws in the United States, the Philippines and other countries, any information obtained from these cellphones cannot be used by authorities in court.

text: Apang magamit gihapon nila ini nga mga impormasyon kag ma-locate ang cellphone kag ang nagagamit na sini, lakip na ang mga suspetsado sa krimen.
english: But they can still use this information and locate the cellphone and its users, including crime suspects.

text: Mahimo ini sang mga otoridad paagi sa mobile signal tracking, bisan gani sa wi-fi kag bluetooth tracking, information leaks halin sa apps kag web browsing, pag-fake sang na-turn-off nga cellphone gamit ang mga malware, paghibalo sang nadula nga sim ukon ang phone number, paggamit sang Global Positioning System sa mga smartphone, ukon ang paggamit sang encrypted communication ukon coded message nga masarangan gihapon lubaron sang mga eksperto.
english: Authorities can do this through mobile signal tracking, even wi-fi and bluetooth tracking, information leaks from apps and web browsing, faking a turned-off cellphone with malware, detecting a lost sim or phone number, using the Global Positioning System on smartphones, or using encrypted communication or messages that can still be accessed expert.

text: Para indi malubad dayon ang encrypted message, nga masami ginagamit sa espionage, ang ginahimo diri amo ang pag-ilis sang encryption now and then para indi malubad dayon sa nagakaigu nga panahon sang paggamit.
english: To prevent immediate decryption of an encrypted message, which is often used in espionage, what is done here is to change the encryption now and then to prevent immediate decryption during the appropriate period of use.

text:
Kon na-delete gid man ang unod sang cellphone, puede man ma-undelete ini sang mga forensic expert kag ma-charge ang nag-delete sini sing may malisya for “obstruction of an investigation.”

Tungod sini, luyag naton ipanugyan sa mga nakawatan sang cellphone, nga importante gihapon sa ila, nga puede ninyo ipahibalo ang pagkadula sang inyo cellphone sa NTC ukon sa National Bureau of Investigation para mabawi ini, pati na ang pagdakop sa mga makawat sang inyo cellphone.
english:
If the contents of the cellphone were deleted, forensic experts can also undelete them and charge the person who deleted them with malice for “obstruction of an investigation.”

Therefore, we would like to advise those who have stolen their cellphones, which are still important to them, that they can report the loss of their cellphones to the NTC or the National Bureau of Investigation for recovery, as well as the arrest of those who stole their cellphones.

english: (w_mateojr@yahoo.com/PN)

text: Muling nanawagan si dating Kagalang-galang na Mahistrado ng Korte Suprema Antonio Carpio sa pamahalaan ng Pilipinas na magsampa ng panibagong kaso sa isang pandaigdigang hukuman upang tutulan ang mga inaangking teritoryo ng Tsina sa Spratly Islands.
english: Former Supreme Court Justice Antonio Carpio has once again called on the Philippine government to file a new case in an international court to dispute China's claimed territories in the Spratly Islands.

text: Sa kanyang talumpati, binigyang-diin ni Carpio ang kahalagahan ng makasaysayang mga mapa at kasunduan—tulad ng 1734 Murillo Velarde map at ang 1900 Treaty of Washington—bilang matibay na ebidensya ng pagmamay-ari ng Pilipinas sa naturang mga teritoryo.
english: In his speech, Carpio stressed the importance of historical maps and treaties—such as the 1734 Murillo Velarde map and the 1900 Treaty of Washington—as strong evidence of Philippine sovereignty over these territories.

text: Ayon sa kanya, kung sakaling tumanggi sa arbitrasyon ang Tsina, Vietnam, at Malaysia, maari pa ring dalhin ng Pilipinas ang usapin sa tinatawag na “court of world opinion” upang ipakita sa buong mundo ang katotohanan sa likod ng isyu.
english: According to him, if China, Vietnam, and Malaysia refuse arbitration, the Philippines can still take the matter to the so-called “court of world opinion” to show the world the truth behind the issue.

text: Hinikayat din ni Carpio ang pamahalaan na makipag-ugnayan sa Vietnam at Malaysia upang maisulong ang mapayapang arbitrasyon sa International Court of Justice (ICJ).
english: Carpio also urged the government to engage with Vietnam and Malaysia to promote peaceful arbitration at the International Court of Justice (ICJ).

text: Bukod dito, may mga panukala rin sa kasalukuyan na magsampa ng bagong kaso kaugnay ng Sandy Cay at ang pinalawak na continental shelf ng bansa.
english: In addition, there are also proposals to file new cases in connection with Sandy Cay and the country's expanded continental shelf.

text: Nanatiling mahalagang usapin sa larangan ng pandaigdigang diplomasya at katarungan ang sigalot sa West Philippine Sea.
english: The West Philippine Sea dispute remains an important issue in the field of international diplomacy and justice.

text: Gin-report nga missing ang duha ka atleta sang Congo pila ka adlaw lang gid matapos nag-compete sa 2024 Paralympic Games.
english: The two Congolese athletes were reported missing just days after competing in the 2024 Paralympic Games.

text: Ini amo ang shot putter nga si Mireille Nganga kag sprinter nga si Emmanuel Grace Mouambako nga pareho man nga flag bearers sang ila pungsod sang ginpatigayon ang opening ceremony.
english: They are shot putter Mireille Nganga and sprinter Emmanuel Grace Mouambako who were both flag bearers of their countries during the opening ceremony.

text: May yara sang leg impairment si Nganga nga nagpasakop sa javelin kag shot put events; samtang bulag naman si Mouambako nga nagpang-apat pa anay sa men’s 100-meter dash.
english: Nganga, who has a leg impairment, competed in the javelin and shot put events; while Mouambako finished fourth in the men’s 100-meter dash.

text: Pareho man sila nga absent sa closing ceremony sang nagligad nga Domingo.
english: Both were also absent from last Sunday’s closing ceremony.

text: Suno sa Congolese delegation, ulihi nga nakit-an ang duha sang Septyembre 5 sa atlete’s village sa Saint-Denis sa naaminhan sang Paris.
english: According to the Congolese delegation, the two were last seen on September 5 in the athlete’s village in Saint-Denis north of Paris.

text: Ginapahayag nga pareho man missing ang ila nga suitcase apang ang ila passport ang ginauyatan sang ila mga kaupdanan nga taga-Congo.
english: Both of their suitcases are reportedly missing but their passports are being held by their Congolese companions.

text: Wala pa sang opisyal nga pahayag halin sa Paralympic Committee sang Democratic Republic of Congo apang nagbukas na sang kaugalingon nga imbestigasyon ang host country nga France.
english: There is no official statement from the Paralympic Committee of the Democratic Republic of Congo but host country France has opened its own investigation.

text: Matandaan nga antes pormal nga nagsugod ang Paris Paralympics, gin-report man nga missing ang Rwandan volleyball player nga si Claudine Bazubagira nga nakapasakop man anay sa 2016 Games in Rio de Janeiro kag sa 2020 Games sa Tokyo.
english: Before the Paris Paralympics formally began, Rwandan volleyball player Claudine Bazubagira, who also participated in the 2016 Games in Rio de Janeiro and the 2020 Games in Tokyo, was also reported missing.

text:
KON MAY mas importante pa sa ginhambal ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte sa iya State of the Nation Address, ukon SONA, sadtong Lunes sang hapon ina amo ang pagkilala sa Diyos nga sang nagligad lang nga inadlaw gintawag niya nga “stupid.”

Sa tunga-tunga sang iya paghambal, kag samtang ginapaathag niya ang iya matahum nga mga damgo pa para sa mga pumuluyo, gindugang niya sa pagsiling ang:”God willing….”  nga gatugyan  sa Diyos sang Iya luyag gid nga matabo.
english:
IF THERE is anything more important than what President Rodrigo Duterte said in his State of the Nation Address, or SONA, on Monday afternoon, it is to recognize the God whom he called “stupid” just the other day.

In the middle of his speech, and as he explained his beautiful dreams for the people, he added:”God willing….”  who leaves to God what He really wants to happen.

text: Kon sinsero man ukon indi ini nga paghatag niya sang kadungganan sa Diyos, nga “indi stupid” sa matuod, indi na ta seguro baisan pa.
english: Whether or not this is sincere or not, he is giving glory to God, who is “not stupid” in fact, we probably can't argue anymore.

text: Ang importante amo nga nahambal niya ini nga wala sing pang-alag-ag nga nagpahumok sang aton balatyagon kag nagpapati sa aton nga sinsero gid man ining iya paghatag sing kadungganan sa Diyos.
english: The important thing is that he said it without hesitation that softened our feelings and made us believe that he was sincere in giving glory to God.

text: Lakip na ang bisan kis-a nga wala gid siya nakapamuyayaw sang “Putang ina mo!” sa sulod sang sobra 40 minutos niya nga SONA.
english: Including the one time he never shouted “Putang ina mo!” during his more than 40-minute SONA.

text:
Nagpatimaan ini nga dinaug niya ang diyablo sa sini nga kahigayunan sang masami niya pang-insulto sa kon sin-o lang nga iloy, nga kon matuod man sa natungdan bisan gani si Kristo wala nag-kondena kag naghatag sang iya kapatawaran kag “second chance” sa pagbag-o.

***

Upod man kita sa Presidente sa matigdas gihapon niya nga tindug kontra sa ilegal nga droga tungod sang wala tupong nga panghalit sini sa aton mga kabataan kag sa sosyedad sa kabug-usan.
english:
This showed that he had defeated the devil on this occasion when he often insulted any mother, which if true of her even Christ did not condemn and gave his forgiveness and “second chance” to change.

***

We also stand with the President in his strong stand against illegal drugs because of the unprecedented harm they cause to our children and society as a whole.

text: Ginpuis niya gihapon sa iya SONA ang mga human rights advocates sa pagsiling: “Your concern is human rights; mine is human lives…” Angot diri, siling ni Presidente nga sige ang “relentless kag chilling” nga away sa droga.
english: In his SONA, he also urged human rights advocates to say: “Your concern is human rights; mine is human lives...” In this regard, the President said that the “relentless and chilling” fight against drugs continues.

text: Ang aton lang amo nga sa sini nga away kontra droga, kondenahon ta lang ang kasal-anan kag indi ang “tawo nga ang Diyos mismo ang nagtuga sa iya imahen” kag ang paghatag sa ila sang “second chance” katulad sa ginhatag ni Kristo sa makasalanan nga si Maria Magdalena.
english: Our only goal is that in this fight against drugs, let us condemn sin and not the “man whom God himself created in his image” and give them a “second chance” like Christ gave to the sinner Mary Magdalene.

text:
***

Ang iban nga concern ni Duterte sa SONA galakip sang mga isyu nga masami man niya ginaliwat-liwat sa iya mga pamulong-pulong.
english:
***

Duterte's other concerns in the SONA include issues that he often repeats in his speeches.

text: Lakip sini ang contractualization, universal health care, isyu sa West Philippine Sea, ang justification sang martial law sa Mindanao, ang draft Federal Constitution (nga indi kita sugot tungod nagatukod ini sang authoritarian government), ang TRAIN Law (nga gina-kwestyon sang madamo), ang dugang nga sueldo sa armadong kusog kag iban pa nga mga government workers, libre nga edukasyon tubtub kolehiyo, ang pagpasanyog sang bulig sang gobyerno sa mga 4Ps, kag iban pa.
english: These include contractualization, universal health care, issues in the West Philippine Sea, the justification of martial law in Mindanao, the draft Federal Constitution (which we do not agree with because it establishes an authoritarian government), the TRAIN Law (which is questioned by many), the increase in salaries in the armed forces and other government workers, free college education the promotion of government assistance to 4Ps, among others.

text:
***

May rason matuod ang pagpasige sang mabaskug nga pagpakig-away sa ilegal nga droga nga ginapilit ni Presidente Duterte.
english:
***

There is a reason why President Duterte is insisting on a strong fight against illegal drugs.

text: Sunu sa survey sang Pulse Asia (June 15-21, 2018), 69 porsyento sang mga Filipino ang gatan-aw sa Gyera kontra Droga nga amo ang numero uno gid nga accomplishment sang administrasyong Duterte.
english: According to a Pulse Asia survey (June 15-21, 2018), 69 percent of Filipinos see the War on Drugs as the number one accomplishment of the Duterte administration.

text: Gasunod ang pag-away sa kriminalidad nga nagalab-ut sa 50 porsento nga ginasundan sang salary increase sang mga police kag mga soldado nga may 30 percent.
english: This is followed by a 50 percent increase in the fight against crime followed by a 30 percent salary increase for police and soldiers.

text: Ikaapat ang away sa graft and corruption nga may 28 percent.
english: The fight against graft and corruption came in fourth with 28 percent.

text: Ikalima amo ang grant of free education sa State Universities and Colleges (SUCs) nga may 21 percent.
english: Fifth is the grant of free education to State Universities and Colleges (SUCs) with 21 percent.

text:
***

Pila ka talalupangdon nga mga hitabo sa ikatlo nga SONA ni Presidente galakip sang kibot nga paghingyu sang kadam-an sang mga myembro sang Kamara sa pagpasumpa sa session hall mismo ni kon sin-o kay Congresswoman kag anay Presidente Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo bilang sal-i kay Cong.
english:
***

Some of the notable events in the President's third SONA include the surprise request by the majority of members of the House of Representatives to swear in Congresswoman and former President Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo as a replacement for Cong.

text: Pantaleon Alvares bilang House Speaker.
english: Pantaleon Alvares as House Speaker.

text: Wala didto si Alvares sang matabo ini kay nagsugat siya kay Presidente upod si Senate President Vicente Sotto.
english: Alvares was not present when this happened because he met the President with Senate President Vicente Sotto.

text: Ini nga hitabo nag-delay sang sobra isa ka oras sa SONA ni Presidente nga naka-schedule sa a las cuatro sang hapon.
english: The incident delayed the President's SONA scheduled for 4 pm by more than an hour.

text: Ugaling nahisugtan kaupod sa Presidente nga papungkuon anay si Alvares bilang Speaker tubtub matigayon ang formal gid nga botohay sa pag-ilis kay Alvares sal-i kay Arroyo, nga natabo gid man pagkatapos sang SONA ni Presidente.
english: However, it was agreed with the President to keep Alvares as Speaker until the formal vote to replace Alvares with Arroyo, which took place after the President's SONA.

text: Wala man mapirmahan ni Presidente Duterte and proposed Bangsamoro Organic Law nga na-schedule tani bag-o sang SONA.
english: President Duterte also failed to sign the proposed Bangsamoro Organic Law that was scheduled before the SONA.

text: Ginpasalig ugaling ni Presidente nga pirmahan niya ini sa sulod sang 48 ka oras pagkatapos sang SONA kay luyag pa niya basahon ini.
english: However, the President assured that he will sign it within 48 hours after the SONA because he still wants to read it.

text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY – Nagsabat si Vice President Sara Duterte natuhoy sa viral “gurgur” video sini sa diin sang ginpamangkot kun ngaa may pilas ini sa iya liog, nagsabat ini nga gintuyo siya nga gulgulon.
english: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY – Vice President Sara Duterte has responded to her viral “gurgur” video where when asked why she had a wound on her neck, she replied that she was intentionally strangled.

text: Suno sa bise presidente, indi na kinahanglan pa nga ipaathag ang nasambit nga video.
english: The vice president said there is no need to explain the video.

text: Ini ang iya ginpahayag kadungan sa ambush interview sa Cagayan de Oro City.
english: He said this during an ambush interview in Cagayan de Oro City.

text: “Anong meaning nun?
english: “What does that mean?

text: Hindi naman siguro na kailangan i-interpret ‘yon,” pahayag sang bise presidente.
english: I don't think it needs to be interpreted,” the vice president said.

text: Ginpahayag sang bise presidente nga wala nangin madinalag-on ang nagtuyo nga mag-gulgol sang iya liog.
english: The vice president said the attempt to strangle him was unsuccessful.

text: “Very straightforward yon, tinanong ako kung ano iyong sugat na nasa leeg ko at sinabi ko na sinubukan nila akong i-gurgur pero hindi sila nagtagumpay,” dugang pa sini.
english: “It was very straightforward, they asked me what the wound was on my neck and I said they tried to gurgle me but they didn't succeed,” he added.

text: Magluwas diri, nagsenyas pa ini nga daw kaangay nga may kutsilyo nga ginagulgol sa iya liog.
english: He also gestured as if a knife was being stabbed in his neck.

text:
Sang gin-usisa naman kun sin-o ang ginatumod sini nga “sila,” nagsabat ang bise presidente nga, “silang lahat.”

Nahibaluan nga madamo sang mga netizens ang nag-usisa sa rason sang pilas sa liog ni Duterte nga nakit-an kadungan man sang iya speech sang nag-resign ini bilang secretary sang Department of Education (DepEd).
english:
When asked who he meant by “they,” the vice president replied, “they all.”

Many netizens have been investigating the cause of Duterte's neck injury that was found during his speech when he resigned as secretary of the Department of Education (DepEd).

text: Ginbulgar sang singer nga si Gerald Santos nga ginhimuslan siya sang isa ka musical director sang isa ka popular nga TV network 19 ka anyos na ang nagligad ukon sang tion nga isa pa lamang siya ka menor de edad.
english: Singer Gerald Santos has revealed that he was raped by a musical director of a popular TV network 19 years ago or when he was a minor.

text: Natabo ang testimoniya ni Santos sa hearing sang Senate Committee on Public Information and Mass Media kun sa diin gina-imbestigaran ang complaints sang abuse kag harassment sa entertainment industry.
english: Santos' testimony came at a hearing of the Senate Committee on Public Information and Mass Media where complaints of abuse and harassment in the entertainment industry are being investigated.

text:
Yara na subong sa 30s ang pang-edaron ni Gerald, apang wala sini napunggan nga maghilibion sang nagpanugid sa atubang sang mga senador nga wala siya na-harass ukon na-abuso kundi na-“rape.”

“Ako po ay hindi po na-harass, hindi po na-abuse.
english:
Gerald, now in his 30s, could not help but cry when he told the senators that he was not harassed or abused but raped.

“I was never harassed, never abused.

text: Ako ay na-rape po.
english: I was raped.

text: Na-rape po ako, your honor,” pahayag sini kay Senator Jinggoy Estrada nga amo ang chairman sang committee.
english: I was raped, your honor,” she told Senator Jinggoy Estrada who is the chairman of the committee.

text: Sa statement sini, natabo ang insidente sang 2005 sang nagaedad siya sang 15-anyos.
english: In his statement, the incident occurred in 2005 when he was 15 years old.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga halos duha ka dekada niya nga gin-sikreto ang natabo sa iya bangud sa kahadlok kag kahuya, ilabi na bangud sang amo nga tion, daw nabatygan niya nga wala man siya ginapamatian kag daw kinahanglan na niya mag-“move on” bangud amo na ini ang dalagan sang industriya.
english: She said she kept her incident a secret for almost two decades out of fear and shame, especially since at that time, she felt that she was not being listened to and that she needed to move on because that was the way the industry was.

text: “For 19 years ki-neep ko lamang ito dahil sa takot ko nga po, sa kahihiyan.
english: “For 19 years I just kept it because I was afraid of shame.

text:
Hiyang-hiya po talaga ako lalo na noon dahil ‘yung grupo na nasa loob ay parang dini-dismiss lang nila ‘yung sinabi ko, na parang mag-move on ka na lang kasi kalakaran ‘yan dito.”

“Kaya ‘di ko nasabi agad… sa parents ko na iyak na lang nang iyak.
english:
I was really shy especially because the group inside seemed to dismiss what I said, as if you should just move on because that's the way it is here.”

“So I didn't tell my parents right away... I just cried.

text: Kinamatayan na ng lolo ko sa sama ng loob niya kasi ‘di po ako nabigyan ng katarungan po,” pahayag sini.
english: My grandfather died in anger because I was not given justice,” he said.

text: Sang ginpamangkot kun nagaplano ini nga mag-file sang reklamo, ginsiling ni Gerald nga gusto gid sini kasuhan ang perpetrator apang wala siya sang means.
english: When asked if he plans to file a complaint, Gerald said he would like to sue the perpetrator but he does not have the means.

text: “Kaya ako po ay naninik-loob sa inyo.
english: “That's why I'm sorry for you.

text: After po nu’ng nagreklamo ako sa GMA, natanggal po ako sa GMA, halos gumapang po kami.
english: After I complained to GMA, I was fired from GMA, we almost crawled.

text: Dumating sa point na gusto ko na rin tapusin ang buhay ko.
english: It got to the point where I wanted to end my life.

text: Hirap na hirap po ako kung paano ko itataguyod ang pamilya ko,” dugang sini.
english: I am struggling to support my family,” he added.

text: Una nga nagguwa ang istorya ni Gerald sang nagpaguwa ini sang statement nga kuntani mahatag kay Sandro Muhlach ang hustisya nga wala niya naangkon sang tion nga siya ang naka-eksperyensya sini sa network.
english: Gerald's story first came to light when he released a statement saying that Sandro Muhlach would be given the justice he didn't get at the time he experienced it on the network.

text: Matandaan nga si Sandro nga anak ni Niño Muhlach ang nagreklamo sang sexual abuse batok sa duha ka independent contractors sang GMA 7 bangud sa ginaalegar pag-abuso sa iya kadungan sang gala night sang Hulyo.
english: Sandro, son of Niño Muhlach, filed a complaint of sexual abuse against two independent contractors of GMA 7 for allegedly abusing him during a gala night in July.

text: Pormal na nga napasaka ang criminal complaint sa Department of Justice subong nga Lunes.
english: The criminal complaint was formally filed with the Department of Justice on Monday.

text: Ginpagkit sang Creamline Cool Smashers ang pangalan sini bilang labing-una nga Grand Slam winners sa Premier Volleyball League (PVL) matapos nabulsa ang kampyonato sa 2024 Invitational Conference.
english: The Creamline Cool Smashers made their name as the first-ever Grand Slam winners in the Premier Volleyball League (PVL) after pocketing the championship in the 2024 Invitational Conference.

text: Nahimo ini sang Cool Smashers paagi sa paglutos sa Cignal HD Spikers sa isa ka five-set thriller sa Smart Araneta Coliseum subong nga gab-i, 21-25, 25-17, 20-25, 26-24, 15-13.
english: The Cool Smashers did it by defeating the Cignal HD Spikers in a five-set thriller at Smart Araneta Coliseum tonight, 21-25, 25-17, 20-25, 26-24, 15-13.

text: Nakumpleto sang Creamline ang kadalag-an sa isa lang ka season bangud una man sini nakuha ang championship sa All-Filipino kag Reinforced conferences.
english: Creamline completed the victory in just one season as it also won the championship in the All-Filipino and Reinforced conferences.

text: Ginpanas sang team ang 1-2 deficit kag ginpakita ang ila dinastiya, eksperyensya, kag gahum batok sa HD Spikers nga una naman nila nga ginlutos sa five sets sa semifinals sang nagligad nga conference.
english: The team erased a 1-2 deficit and showed their dynasty, experience, and power against the HD Spikers whom they had previously defeated in five sets in the semifinals of the previous conference.

text: Sa premilinary round, nagtapos ang CCS nga may four-game sweep, samtang gina-uyatan naman sang Cignal ang 3-1 card nga ang kalutusan halin man mismo sa Creamline.
english: In the premilinary round, CCS finished with a four-game sweep, while Cignal held a 3-1 card with the loss coming from Creamline itself.

text: Patay ang mag-amay matapos nga nagbato sa otoridad sa buy bust operation sa Datu Odin Sinsuat, Maguindanao del Norte.
english: A father and son were killed after throwing stones at authorities in a buy bust operation in Datu Odin Sinsuat, Maguindanao del Norte.

text: Ginpahayag nga nagpalupok sang pusil ang mga suspek sang mamutikan nga mga pulis ang ila nga ka-transakyon.
english: The suspects reportedly fired their guns when the police noticed their transaction partner.

text: Nagbalos ang mga otoridad kag naigo ang amay kag ang anak sini.
english: The authorities retaliated and hit the father and his son.

text: Arestado naman ang 18-anyos pa nga bata sang suspek samtang isa pa ang nakapalagyo.
english: The suspect's 18-year-old son was arrested while another escaped.

text: Ginakabig nga high value target ang mga mag-amay.
english: Fathers are considered high value targets.

text: Kapin P1.6 million ang balor sang illegal nga druga ang nakuha sa mga ini.
english: More than P1.6 million worth of illegal drugs were recovered from them.

text: May narekober man nga pusil kag magasin.
english: A firearm and magazine were also recovered.

text: Kaso nga paglapas sa Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act (RA 9165) ang atubangon sang isa ka arestado nga anak.
english: An arrested son will face charges of violation of the Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act (RA 9165).

text: Maga-obra sang pamaagi ang Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth) agud masiguro nga mahatagan sang maayo nga serbisyo sa ikaayong lawas ang 115 million nga miyembro sini sa 2025, apisar wala ang multi-billion-peso nga subsidy nga gin-cut sang Kamara sa ila ginaproponer nga badyet para sa masunod nga tuig.
english: The Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth) will develop a plan to ensure that it provides quality health services to its 115 million members by 2025, despite the absence of the multi-billion-peso subsidy cut by the House of Representatives in its proposed budget for next year.

text: Ini ang ginpahayag ni PhilHealth President kag CEO Emmanuel Ledesma sa isa ka press conference sang Martes, pila ka adlaw matapos aprobahan sang Kongreso ang P6.325-trillion nga national budget.
english: This was stated by PhilHealth President and CEO Emmanuel Ledesma in a press conference on Tuesday, a few days after Congress approved the P6.325-trillion national budget.

text: Wala na-appeal sa nasambit nga badyet ang P74 billion nga subsidy para sa PhilHealth bangud nga may yara ini sang P600-billion nga reserba nga pondo.
english: The P74 billion subsidy for PhilHealth was not appealed in the budget because it has a P600-billion reserve fund.

text: Suno kay Ledesma, tanan nga benepisyo sang PhilHealth pagabayaran gihapon, ilabi na ang mga benepisyo para sa mga miyembro nga nagakinahanglan sini, pareho sang mga senior citizens, mga indigents, mga may kapansanan, mga nagbalik-loob nga rebelde, kag iban pa nga marginalized sectors.
english: According to Ledesma, all PhilHealth benefits will still be paid, especially benefits for members who need them, such as senior citizens, the indigents, the disabled, returning rebels, and other marginalized sectors.

text: Dugang pa ni Ledesma, tubtob Oktubre 2024, may yara ang PhilHealth sang sobra nga P150 billion nga pondo, kag kabug-usan nga reserba nga P281 billion.
english: Ledesma added that as of October 2024, PhilHealth has a surplus of P150 billion in funds, and a total reserve of P281 billion.

text: Dugang pa sini, may investment pa nga nagabalor sang malapit sa P489 billion tubtob Nobyembre 2024.
english: In addition, there is still an investment worth nearly P489 billion until November 2024.

text: MADAMO sang aton mga pumuluyo ang wala kahibalo kon ano gid ang poder kag trabaho sang Department of Interior and Local Govrnment (DILG), partikular sa bahin sang kapulisan.
english: MANY of our citizens do not know what the powers and functions of the Department of Interior and Local Government (DILG) are, particularly in terms of the police.

text: Ano gid bala ang poder kag trabaho sang DILG?
english: What is the power and function of the DILG?

text: Pwede man bala makadakop ukon maka-aresto, lakip ang pag-file sang kaso sa mga akusado ang mga tinawo sang DILG katulad sang mga pulis, NBI kag iban pa nga may kasubong nga mandato?
english: Can DILG personnel such as the police, NBI and others with similar mandates arrest or arrest, including filing cases against the accused?

text: Ang pagpati sang iban nga napamangkot naton nga mga pumuluyo amo nga pwede, bilang mga otoridad man sa pagpatuman sang kasuguan.
english: The belief of some of the citizens we asked is that it is possible, as law enforcement authorities.

text: Lain naman ugaling ang paathag ni Iloilo City DILG director Atty. Ferdinand Panes.
english: Iloilo City DILG director Atty. Ferdinand Panes.

text: Ang obligasyon sang DILG, siling niya, amo lang ang pagbulig sa pagpatuman sang poder sang Presidente sa “overall supervision” sa mga gobyerno lokal.
english: The DILG's obligation, he said, is only to assist in the implementation of the President's power of “overall supervision” over local government units.

text: Ano gid bala ining poder nga Supervision?
english: What exactly is this Supervision power?

text: Sa isa ka masaligan nga paghangop, ang Supervision amo ang pag-oversee sa pag-trabaho sang isa ka empleyado ukon tinawo, ang pagpaseguro nga ginahimo niya ining trabaho, kag ang paghimo niya sini sunu sa standard ukon talaksan sang pagpatuman.
english: In a reliable sense, Supervision is the overseeing of the work of an employee or personnel, ensuring that he does this work, and that he does it according to the standard or standard of implementation.

text: Lain naman, ugaling ang Supervision sa Direction kag Control nga poder.
english: Supervision in Direction and Control power is different, however.

text: Sa Direction, ang isa ka empleyado ukon tinawo gatuman sang trabaho santu sa instruction sa iya, giya (guidance) ukon panugyan (advice) kon paano himuon ang trabaho.
english: In Direction, an employee or personnel performs a job according to instructions, guidance or advice on how to do the job.

text: Sa Control, ang empleyado ukon tinawo gina-diktahan kon ano ang iya trabahuon kag kon paano niya ini ipatuman, lakip ang poder sang isa ka superior sa pagsaylo-saylo sang assignment sang empleyado ukon tinawo katulad sang mga pulis sa idalom sang mayor ukon gobernador.
english: In Control, the employee or employee is dictated what he or she does and how he or she does it, including the power of a superior to transfer the assignment of the employee or employee such as police under the mayor or governor.

text: Ang paathag pa gid gani sa aton amo nga ang Supervision nga poder sang DILG sa idalom sang Presidente wala nagalakip sang poder sa pagderejer (direct) kag pag-kontrol (control) sa kapulisan.
english: The explanation to us is that the supervision power of the DILG under the President does not include the power to direct and control the police.

text: Ang obligasyon sang DILG sa pag-supervise sa pagpatuman sang mandato sang kapulisan amo lang ang pagtuytuy sa ila nga mangin epektibo sa ila mandato, kag indi mangdakop ukon mang-aresto kag indi man ang pagpasaka sang kaso sa mga suspetsado.
english: The DILG's obligation to supervise the implementation of the police's mandate is only to guide them to be effective in their mandate, and not to arrest or prosecute suspects.

text: Ang ining pagtuytuy, kon husto ang aton paghangop sa paathag ni DLG Iloilo City director Atty. Ferdinand Panes, nagalakip sa pagpatuman sang mga guidelines kag policies sa husto nga pagtuman sang mga pulis sang ila obligasyon, lakip ang magbulig sa pag-organize kag pag-train sini sa ila upod sa National Police Commission (Napolcom) agud mangin epektibo sa ila mandato.
english: This guidance, if we understand correctly the explanation of DLG Iloilo City director Atty. Ferdinand Panes, including the implementation of guidelines and policies in the proper performance of the police's duties, including helping to organize and train them with the National Police Commission (Napolcom) to be effective in their mandate.

text: Sa sina nga trabaho, ang DILG Secretary amo gani mismo ang ex-officio chairperson sang Napolcom.
english: In that job, the DILG Secretary is himself the ex-officio chairperson of Napolcom.

text:
***

Isa sang mga obligasyon sang Napolcom amo ang pagtugyan ukon pagbawi sang kontrol sang mga local chief executives (mayor ukon gobernador) sa mga kapulisan.
english:
***

One of the obligations of Napolcom is to hand over or take back control of local chief executives (mayors or governors) to the police.

text: Gina-exercise ini sang Napolcom sa pagpatuman sang “overall supervision power” sang Presidente.
english: Napolcom exercises this in the implementation of the President's overall supervision power.

text: Gina-nominar sini ang chief of police agud mapilian sang LCE sa pagpatuman niya sang iya obligasyon sa peace and order.
english: It nominates the chief of police to be elected by the LCE in the implementation of his peace and order obligations.

text: Yara man sa prerogative sang Napolcom ang pagbawi sa LCE sang kontrol sa kapulisan sa ila kapaltahan sa pagpatuman sang kasuguan, por ejemplo, kontra sa illegal gambling kag ilegal nga droga, kag ihatag balik ining poder sa Napolcom.
english: It is also the prerogative of Napolcom to withdraw from the LCE control over the police for their failure to enforce the law, for example, against illegal gambling and illegal drugs, and to give this power back to Napolcom.

text: Ang ining pagbawi sang kontrol sa kapulisan sang LCE, sa madamo na nga kahigayunan nga ginhimo sang Napolcom.
english: This recovery of control of the LCE police, on many occasions, has been done by Napolcom.

text: Sadtong 2017 (Manila Times, Agosto 1, 2017), ang Napolcom nag-isyu sang mga resolusyon nga nag-revoke sang poder sang 25 ka mga mayor kag gobernador – 1 ka gobernador sa Rehiyon 9 kag 24 ka mayor sa nagakalain-lain nga rehiyon: 7 halin sa Rehiyon 10, 5 sa Rehiyon 4A, 4 sa Rehiyon 3, 3 sa Rehiyon 12, 2 sa Rehiyon 4B, 1 sa Rehiyon 7, 1 sa Rehiyon 9 kag 1 sa Rehiyon 1.
english: In 2017 (Manila Times, August 1, 2017), the Napolcom issued resolutions revoking the powers of 25 mayors and governors – 1 governor in Region 9 and 24 mayors in various regions: 7 from Region 10, 5 in Region 4, 3A in Region 3A Region 12, 2 in Region 4B, 1 in Region 7, 1 in Region 9 and 1 in Region 1.

text: Sa sini nga tion wala pa sing LCE sa Western Visayas ang nalakip sa sining pagbawi sing poder sa pag-kontrol sa kapulisan.
english: At this time, no LCE in Western Visayas has been included in this revocation of power to control the police.

text: Nagdugang pa gid ang numero sining mga LCE nga ginkuhaan sing poder sa pagkontrol sa mga kapulisan sadtong Hunyo, 2018.
english: The number of these LCEs who were stripped of their control over the police in June, 2018 increased.

text: Naglab-ut na ini sa 186 – 8 ka gobernador kag 178 ka city kag municipal mayors.
english: This has reached 186 – 8 governors and 178 city and municipal mayors.

text: Gindugang pa diri ang 156 ka local officials nga na-suspende ukon na-dismiss tungod sang “serious dishonesty”, neglect of duty”, “conduct prejudicial to the best interest of the service”, “abuse of authority” kag mga “irregularities”.
english: In addition, 156 local officials were suspended or dismissed for serious dishonesty, neglect of duty, conduct prejudicial to the best interest of the service, abuse of authority and irregularities.

text: Nagasululobra na ang numero sang mga pasyente sa tanan nga district hospital kasunodsang dengue outbreak sa probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: The number of patients in all district hospitals is increasing following the dengue outbreak in Iloilo province.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo  kay Dr. Cynthia Cabangal-Ng, pinuno sang Hospital Management sang Probinsiya sang Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga naglab-ot na sa 1,984 ang mga pasyente sa tanan nga mga ospital sa bilog nga probinsya sa diin 769 diri ang dengue patients.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Dr. Cynthia Cabangal-Ng, head of the Hospital Management of Iloilo Province, said that the number of patients in all hospitals in the province has reached 1,984 of which 769 are dengue patients.

text: Suno kay Ng,  tuman ka dako ini nga numero para sa 590 nga gintingob nga bed capacity sang tanan nga mga district hospitals sa probinsya.
english: Ng said this figure is too large for the 590 combined bed capacity of all district hospitals in the province.

text:

text: Suno kay Batangas Rep.

text:
Indi lamang si Senator Robin Padilla ang nabutang sa kontrobersiya bangud sa diskusyon sa Senado sa spousal rape kundi mangin ang asawa sini nga si Mariel Rodriguez Padilla bangud sa pag-apin sini sa iya bana nga gintawag sang iban nga “insensitive.”

Sa Facebook, may gin-share si Mariel nga picture kun sa diin nakit-an nga nagahalukanay sila ni Robin kag may caption nga “Oh may consent ‘yan ah [kiss emojis].”

Sa comments section, nagbayluhanay pa sang komento ang duha nga naga-mensyonar sang “heat” nga masami ginagamit sa pagtumod sa sexual urges.
english:
Not only Senator Robin Padilla was in controversy over the Senate discussion on spousal rape but also his wife, Mariel Rodriguez Padilla, for defending her husband whom some called “insensitive.”

On Facebook, Mariel shared a picture of her and Robin kissing with the caption, “Oh there's consent 'yan ah [kiss emojis].”

In the comments section, the two even exchanged comments mentioning “heat” which is often used to refer to sexual urges.

text: Komento sang senador, “Hello babe.
english: The senator commented, “Hello babe.

text: I’m in heat [fire emojis],”; kag ang sabat ni Mariel, “It’s a tie.
english: I’m in heat [fire emojis],”;and Mariel’s response, “It’s a tie.

text:
I’m feeling hot hot hot [dancing girl emojis].”

Madamo ang na-insulto kag naugot sa amo nga post ni Mariel bangud may mga babaye nga biktima sang marital rape apang daw kaangay nga ginalahog-lahog lang ini sang mag-asawa.
english:
I’m feeling hot hot hot [dancing girl emojis].”

Many people were insulted and angry by Mariel's post because there are women who are victims of marital rape but it seems that the couple is just joking about it.

english: Netizens say it's not funny to make sexual consent a joke.

english: “Making fun and joking about sexual consent is so distasteful.

text: Just, no,” pahayag sang netizen.
english: Just, no,” the netizen said.

english: “Very disrespectful to all the victims of marital rape and sexual abuse within the confinement of one’s home.

english: Disgusting.

english: Well, what do we expect from these moronic enablers?

text: Kawawang Pilipinas (Poor Philippines),” pahayag pa sang isa.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang Hwebes sang nagsentro ang Senate hearing sa consensual sex sa tunga sang kasado na nga mag-partner kun sa diin nagpamangkot si Robin nga ano ang matabo kun may mood ang bana para sa pagpakighilawas apang nagapamalibad ang asawa.
english: It was learned that on Thursday when the Senate hearing focused on consensual sex between married partners where Robin asked what happens if the husband is in the mood for sex but the wife refuses.

text: Dapat suno sa iya nga may legal nga paagi sa pag-atubang sini nga sitwasyon bangud may sexual rights ang partner sa iya partner kag labaw sa tanan suno sa iya, indi man pwede mangbabaye ang lalaki bangud lain naman ini nga kaso.
english: He said there should be a legal way to deal with this situation because the partner has sexual rights to his partner and above all, he said, the man cannot marry because it is a different case.

text: “Mayroon kang sexual rights sa asawa mo.
english: “You have sexual rights to your wife.

text: So halimbawa, hindi mo naman pinipili ‘yung ‘in heat’.
english: So for example, you don't choose 'in heat'.

text: So paano ‘yun kung ayaw ng asawa mo?
english: So what if your husband doesn't like it?

text: So wala pong ibang paraan talaga?
english: So there's no other way really?

text: Para ma-ano ‘yung lalaki, so paano ‘yun, mambabae ka na lang ba?” pahayag sini sa hearing sang Committee on Public Information and Mass Media.
english: To hurt the man, so how about that, are you just a woman?” he said at a hearing of the Committee on Public Information and Mass Media.

text: Diri kag ginpahangop ni Atty. Lorna Kapunan, isa ka women’s and children’s rights advocate, nga kun magpangindi ang partner, dapat ini nga respetuhon sang isa bangud ang “no” nagakahulugan sang “no” bisan sa context pa sa pag-asawahay sa tunga sang asawa kag bana.
english: Here and explained Atty. Lorna Kapunan, a women’s and children’s rights advocate, said that if a partner refuses, one should respect it because “no” means “no” even in the context of marriage between husband and wife.

text: “With all due respect, hindi po obligasyon ng isang wife, sabi mo is to ‘serve the husband’.
english: “With all due respect, it is not the obligation of a wife, you say is to ‘serve the husband’.

text: ‘Yung basis ng psychological incapacity is ‘yung mutual obligation ng mag-asawa of love and respect.
english: The basis of psychological incapacity is the mutual obligation of the spouses of love and respect.

text: Now part of love is showing your love, but kasama rin po do’n ang respect,” pahayag ni Kapunan.##
english: Now part of love is showing your love, but it also includes respect,” Kapunan said.##

text: SUNU sa madamo na nga pagtugda kontra sa iya, si Presidente Duterte isa na seguro sa pinaka-“profane” (bastos, pala-insulto, mapintas sing baba, etc.) sing pamatasan sa lenggwahe kag gawi bisan sa publiko.
english: ACCORDING to the many allegations against him, President Duterte is probably one of the most “profane” (rude, insulting, harsh-mouthed, etc.) in language and behavior even in public.

text: In other words, indi siya naga-isahanon sa sining pamatasan.
english: In other words, he’s not alone in this behavior.
